d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The news for Europe just keeps getting worse.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə nˈuz fˈɔɹ jˈʊɹəp dʒˈʌst kˈips ɡˈɛtɪŋ wˈɝs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Tin tức về châu Âu cứ ngày càng tệ hơn.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The French government collapses, plunging EU's second largest economy into turmoil.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə fɹˈɛntʃ ɡˈʌvɚmənt kəlˈæpsɪz plˈʌndʒɪŋ eu's sˈɛkənd lˈɑɹdʒəst ɪkˈɑnəmi ˈɪntu tˈɝmˌɔɪl/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Chính phủ Pháp sụp đổ, đẩy nền kinh tế lớn thứ hai EU vào tình trạng hỗn loạn.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: France's political upheaval in December offered another glimpse at fractious European affairs.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fɹˈænsɪz pəlˈɪtəkəl əphˈivəl ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ ˈɔfɚd ənˈʌðɚ ɡlˈɪmps ˈæt fɹˈækʃəs jˌʊɹəpˈiən əfˈɛɹz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Sự bất ổn chính trị ở Pháp vào tháng 12 đã cho thấy một cái nhìn thoáng qua về các vấn đề châu Âu đầy chia rẽ.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Germany is under pressure, and Volkswagen workers are are striking hard.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /dʒˈɝməni ˈɪz ˈʌndɚ pɹˈɛʃɚ ənd vˈoʊlkswˌæɡən wˈɝkɚz ˈɑɹ ˈɑɹ stɹˈaɪkɪŋ hˈɑɹd/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Đức đang chịu áp lực, và công nhân Volkswagen đang đình công dữ dội.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: In my view, we are already in a crisis mood our former model is over.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɪn mˈaɪ vjˈu wˈi ˈɑɹ ɔlɹˈɛdi ɪn ə kɹˈaɪsəs mˈud ˈaʊɚ fˈɔɹmɚ mˈɑdəl ˈɪz ˈoʊvɚ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Theo quan điểm của tôi, chúng ta đã ở trong tâm trạng khủng hoảng, mô hình cũ của chúng ta đã kết thúc.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: If we follow our classical agenda, we will be out of the market.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪf wˈi fˈɑloʊ ˈaʊɚ klˈæsɪkəl ədʒˈɛndə wˈi wˈɪl bˈi ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə mˈɑɹkət/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Nếu chúng ta tuân theo chương trình nghị sự cổ điển của mình, chúng ta sẽ bị loại khỏi thị trường.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: I have no doubt the EU's EOM is now fighting for survival
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv nˈoʊ dˈaʊt ðə eu's eom ˈɪz nˈaʊ fˈaɪtɪŋ fˈɔɹ sɚvˈaɪvəl/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Tôi không nghi ngờ gì nữa rằng EOM của EU hiện đang chiến đấu để sinh tồn

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and struggling to keep pace with the US and China.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd stɹˈʌɡəlɪŋ tˈu kˈip pˈeɪs wˈɪð ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và đang gặp khó khăn trong việc theo kịp Hoa Kỳ và Trung Quốc.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Had the European economy grown as fast
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /hˈæd ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən ɪkˈɑnəmi ɡɹˈoʊn ˈæz fˈæst/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Nền kinh tế châu Âu đã tăng trưởng nhanh như thế nào

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: as the American economy over the past couple of decades,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈæz ðə əmˈɛɹəkən ɪkˈɑnəmi ˈoʊvɚ ðə pˈæst kˈʌpəl ˈʌv dɛkˈeɪdz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: như nền kinh tế Mỹ trong hai thập kỷ qua,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: we've been generating three trillion EUR of extra income every year that's roughly the equivalent
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈiv bˈɪn dʒˈɛnɚˌeɪtɪŋ θɹˈi tɹˈɪljən eur ˈʌv ˈɛkstɹə ˈɪnkˌʌm ˈɛvɚi jˈɪɹ ðˈæts ɹˈʌfli ðə ɪkwˈɪvələnt/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: chúng ta đã tạo ra ba nghìn tỷ euro thu nhập bổ sung mỗi năm, tương đương với

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: to the total GDP of France being routinely added into the economy.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /tˈu ðə tˈoʊtəl ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev ˈʌv fɹˈæns bˈiɪŋ ɹutˈinli ˈædəd ˈɪntu ðə ɪkˈɑnəmi/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: vào tổng GDP của Pháp được thường xuyên bổ sung vào nền kinh tế.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Europe needs to have a digital era economy with companies
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /jˈʊɹəp nˈidz tˈu hˈæv ə dˈɪdʒətəl ˈɛɹə ɪkˈɑnəmi wˈɪð kˈʌmpənˌiz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Châu Âu cần có một nền kinh tế thời đại số với các công ty

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that challenge those from China and from the US.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt tʃˈæləndʒ ðˈoʊz fɹˈʌm tʃˈaɪnə ənd fɹˈʌm ðə ˈʌs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: thách thức những người đến từ Trung Quốc và từ Mỹ.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Without that, the Reg is at risk of being unable to afford to protect itself
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wɪθˈaʊt ðˈæt ðə ɹˈɛɡ ˈɪz ˈæt ɹˈɪsk ˈʌv bˈiɪŋ ənˈeɪbəl tˈu əfˈɔɹd tˈu pɹətˈɛkt ˌɪtsˈɛlf/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Nếu không có điều đó, Reg có nguy cơ không đủ khả năng tự bảo vệ mình

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: in a world where security is no longer guaranteed.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɪn ə wˈɝld wˈɛɹ sɪkjˈʊɹəti ˈɪz nˈoʊ lˈɔŋɡɚ ɡˌɛɹəntˈid/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: trong một thế giới mà an ninh không còn được đảm bảo.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: It's just a very tense moment for the world, and Europe's at the center of it.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst ə vˈɛɹi tˈɛns mˈoʊmənt fˈɔɹ ðə wˈɝld ənd jˈʊɹəps ˈæt ðə sˈɛntɚ ˈʌv ˈɪt/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Đây là một thời điểm rất căng thẳng đối với thế giới, và châu Âu đang ở trung tâm của nó.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: This is one of the most consequential figures in global economics,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə mˈoʊst kˌɑnsəkwˈɛnʃəl fˈɪɡjɚz ɪn ɡlˈoʊbəl ˌɛkənˈɑmɪks/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Đây là một trong những nhân vật có ảnh hưởng nhất trong kinh tế toàn cầu,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and in September he sounded an alarm Fortiv is weak, was very weak.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ɪn sɛptˈɛmbɚ hˈi sˈaʊndɪd ˈæn əlˈɑɹm fortiv ˈɪz wˈik wˈɑz vˈɛɹi wˈik/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và vào tháng 9, ông đã gióng lên hồi chuông cảnh báo Fortiv yếu, rất yếu.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Mario Dragi will this morning deliver his long awaited report
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /mˈɑɹioʊ dragi wˈɪl ðˈɪs mˈɔɹnɪŋ dɪlˈɪvɚ hˈɪz lˈɔŋ əwˈeɪtɪd ɹipˈɔɹt/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Mario Draghi sẽ trình bày báo cáo được mong đợi từ lâu của ông vào sáng nay

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: on what Europe must do to regain its competitiveness.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈʌt jˈʊɹəp mˈʌst dˈu tˈu ɹɪɡˈeɪn ˈɪts kəmpˈɛtɪtɪvnɪs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Châu Âu phải làm gì để lấy lại khả năng cạnh tranh.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Mario Dragi is a highly respected economist,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /mˈɑɹioʊ dragi ˈɪz ə hˈaɪli ɹɪspˈɛktɪd ɪkˈɑnəmɪst/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Mario Draghi là một nhà kinh tế học rất được kính trọng,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: is former president of the European Central Bank,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪz fˈɔɹmɚ pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt ˈʌv ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən sˈɛntɹəl bˈæŋk/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: là cựu chủ tịch Ngân hàng Trung ương Châu Âu,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: during one of Europe's most difficult times,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /dˈʊɹɪŋ wˈʌn ˈʌv jˈʊɹəps mˈoʊst dˈɪfəkəlt tˈaɪmz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: trong một trong những thời điểm khó khăn nhất của châu Âu,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and also led Italy uh through through another challenging period.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ˈɔlsoʊ lˈɛd ˈɪtəli ˈʌ θɹˈu θɹˈu ənˈʌðɚ tʃˈæləndʒɪŋ pˈɪɹiəd/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và cũng đã dẫn dắt nước Ý vượt qua một giai đoạn đầy thử thách khác.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: He's become a figure that you look to in times of trouble.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /hˈiz bɪkˈʌm ə fˈɪɡjɚ ðˈæt jˈu lˈʊk tˈu ɪn tˈaɪmz ˈʌv tɹˈʌbəl/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy đã trở thành một nhân vật mà bạn tìm đến trong những lúc khó khăn.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: His report warned that the US and China were innovating
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /hˈɪz ɹipˈɔɹt wˈɔɹnd ðˈæt ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə wˈɝ ˌɪnəvˈeɪtɪŋ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Báo cáo của ông cảnh báo rằng Mỹ và Trung Quốc đang đổi mới

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: so expeditiously Europe needed to invest hundreds of billions of euros extra every year
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˌɛkspədˈɪʃəsli jˈʊɹəp nˈidəd tˈu ˌɪnvˈɛst hˈʌndɹədz ˈʌv bˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz ˈɛkstɹə ˈɛvɚi jˈɪɹ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: châu Âu cần đầu tư thêm hàng trăm tỷ euro mỗi năm một cách nhanh chóng

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: to compete, possibly to survive.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /tˈu kəmpˈit pˈɑsəbli tˈu sɚvˈaɪv/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: để cạnh tranh, có thể để tồn tại.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The druggy plan got the conversation started, and then, of course,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə druggy plˈæn ɡˈɑt ðə kˌɑnvɚsˈeɪʃən stˈɑɹtɪd ənd ðˈɛn ˈʌv kˈɔɹs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Kế hoạch dùng thuốc đã khơi mào cuộc trò chuyện, và sau đó, tất nhiên,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: there's Trump, and then, of course, there's China,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz tɹˈʌmp ənd ðˈɛn ˈʌv kˈɔɹs ðˈɛɹz tʃˈaɪnə/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: có Trump, và sau đó, tất nhiên, có Trung Quốc,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and then there's a war in Ukraine and a war in the Middle East.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ðˈɛɹz ə wˈɔɹ ɪn jukɹˈeɪn ənd ə wˈɔɹ ɪn ðə mˈɪdəl ˈist/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và rồi có một cuộc chiến ở Ukraine và một cuộc chiến ở Trung Đông.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The conclusion was Europe has been stuck in a rut,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə kənklˈuʒən wˈɑz jˈʊɹəp hˈæz bˈɪn stˈʌk ɪn ə ɹˈʌt/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Kết luận là châu Âu đã mắc kẹt trong một lối mòn,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and if nothing changes, in the current trajectory is maintained,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf nˈʌθɪŋ tʃˈeɪndʒəz ɪn ðə kˈɝənt tɹədʒˈɛktɚi ˈɪz meɪntˈeɪnd/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và nếu không có gì thay đổi, với quỹ đạo hiện tại được duy trì,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: then Europe will probably account for less than a tenth of global GDP by 2050,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈɛn jˈʊɹəp wˈɪl pɹˈɑbəblˌi əkˈaʊnt fˈɔɹ lˈɛs ðˈæn ə tˈɛnθ ˈʌv ɡlˈoʊbəl ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev bˈaɪ 2050/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: thì Châu Âu có lẽ sẽ chiếm chưa đến một phần mười GDP toàn cầu vào năm 2050,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: which points to Europe having a much diminished role in the global economy
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ pˈɔɪnts tˈu jˈʊɹəp hˈævɪŋ ə mˈʌtʃ dɪmˈɪnɪʃt ɹˈoʊl ɪn ðə ɡlˈoʊbəl ɪkˈɑnəmi/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: những điểm cho thấy châu Âu có vai trò giảm sút đáng kể trong nền kinh tế toàn cầu

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: in years to come.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɪn jˈɪɹz tˈu kˈʌm/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: trong những năm tới.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Increasing productivity is one of solutions to this.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˌɪnkɹˈisɪŋ pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv səlˈuʃənz tˈu ðˈɪs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Tăng năng suất là một trong những giải pháp cho vấn đề này.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: It doesn't mean making people work harder it means,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪt dˈʌzənt mˈin mˈeɪkɪŋ pˈipəl wˈɝk hˈɑɹdɚ ˈɪt mˈinz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Điều đó không có nghĩa là bắt mọi người làm việc chăm chỉ hơn, mà là,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: for the same amount of work, a person creates more value.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ðə sˈeɪm əmˈaʊnt ˈʌv wˈɝk ə pˈɝsən kɹiˈeɪts mˈɔɹ vˈælju/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: với cùng một lượng công việc, một người tạo ra nhiều giá trị hơn.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: To appreciate the challenge,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /tˈu əpɹˈiʃiˌeɪt ðə tʃˈæləndʒ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Để đánh giá cao thử thách,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: let's quickly examine one of Europe's most iconic traditional industries Italy's olive business,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /lˈɛts kwˈɪkli ɪɡzˈæmɪn wˈʌn ˈʌv jˈʊɹəps mˈoʊst ˌaɪkˈɑnɪk tɹədˈɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstɹiz ˈɪtəliz ˈɑləv bˈɪznəs/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: hãy nhanh chóng xem xét một trong những ngành công nghiệp truyền thống mang tính biểu tượng nhất châu Âu, ngành kinh doanh ô liu của Ý,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: is worth billions of euros.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈɝθ bˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: trị giá hàng tỷ euro.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Prime Minister Georgia Malone's government wants the industry to grow
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /pɹˈaɪm mˈɪnəstɚ dʒˈɔɹdʒə məlˈoʊnz ɡˈʌvɚmənt wˈɑnts ðə ˈɪndəstɹi tˈu ɡɹˈoʊ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Chính phủ của Thủ tướng Georgia Malone muốn ngành công nghiệp phát triển

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and help the country reduce its mammoth debt burden.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd hˈɛlp ðə kˈʌntɹi ɹədˈus ˈɪts mˈæməθ dˈɛt bˈɝdən/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: và giúp đất nước giảm gánh nặng nợ khổng lồ.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: It's why all of Millers receive tens of millions of euros in post pandemic EU
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪts wˈaɪ ˈɔl ˈʌv mˈɪlɚz ɹəsˈiv tˈɛnz ˈʌv mˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz ɪn pˈoʊst pændˈɛmɪk ˈijˌu/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Đó là lý do tại sao tất cả các nhà máy của Miller nhận được hàng chục triệu euro từ EU sau đại dịch

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: aid granted to Italy.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈeɪd ɡɹˈæntəd tˈu ˈɪtəli/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: viện trợ được cấp cho Ý.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Some farms spent their share upgrading their machinery.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈʌm fˈɑɹmz spˈɛnt ðˈɛɹ ʃˈɛɹ əpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ðˈɛɹ məʃˈinɚi/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Một số trang trại đã dùng phần chia của mình để nâng cấp máy móc.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Productivity is one of the best ways to grow an economy
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst wˈeɪz tˈu ɡɹˈoʊ ˈæn ɪkˈɑnəmi/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Năng suất là một trong những cách tốt nhất để phát triển nền kinh tế

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: because it means, for the same amount of work, a person creates more value.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt mˈinz fˈɔɹ ðə sˈeɪm əmˈaʊnt ˈʌv wˈɝk ə pˈɝsən kɹiˈeɪts mˈɔɹ vˈælju/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: vì nó có nghĩa là, với cùng một lượng công vi���c, một người tạo ra nhiều giá trị hơn.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: And as important as olives are, cultivating them isn't as productive
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ˈæz ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt ˈæz ˈɑlɪvz ˈɑɹ kˈʌltɪvˌeɪtɪŋ ðˈɛm ˈɪzənt ˈæz pɹədˈʌktɪv/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Và quan trọng như ô liu, việc trồng chúng không mang lại hiệu quả cao bằng

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: as developing semiconductors or solar panels two things the US and China prioritized years ago.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈæz dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ sˌɛmikəndˈʌktɚz ˈɔɹ sˈoʊlɚ pˈænəlz tˈu θˈɪŋz ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə pɹaɪˈɔɹətˌaɪzd jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: như phát triển chất bán dẫn hoặc tấm pin mặt trời hai thứ mà Hoa Kỳ và Trung Quốc đã ưu tiên từ nhiều năm trước.

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: We haven't taken frontier technologies and dispersed them through our economy in the way
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈi hˈævənt tˈeɪkən fɹəntˈɪɹ tɛknˈɑlədʒiz ənd dɪspˈɝst ðˈɛm θɹˈu ˈaʊɚ ɪkˈɑnəmi ɪn ðə wˈeɪ/
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta đã không áp dụng các công nghệ tiên phong và phổ biến chúng trong nền kinh tế của mình theo cách

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that would raise incomes and raise our efficiency,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈʊd ɹˈeɪz ˈɪnkˌʌmz ənd ɹˈeɪz ˈaʊɚ ɪfˈɪʃənsi/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: so by being left behind we are now poorer
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈoʊ bˈaɪ bˈiɪŋ lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd wˈi ˈɑɹ nˈaʊ pˈuɹɚ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and we're just not keeping pace with American productivity, which
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd wˈiɹ dʒˈʌst nˈɑt kˈipɪŋ pˈeɪs wˈɪð əmˈɛɹəkən pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti wˈɪtʃ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: is what led to the estimate
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈʌt lˈɛd tˈu ðə ˈɛstəmət/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that the EU economy is 18% smaller than it may otherwise have
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈijˌu ɪkˈɑnəmi ˈɪz 18 smˈɔlɚ ðˈæn ˈɪt mˈeɪ ˈʌðɚwˌaɪz hˈæv/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: been, and that's equal to a shortfall of about3 trillion.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈɪn ənd ðˈæts ˈikwəl tˈu ə ʃˈɔɹtfˌɔl ˈʌv about3 tɹˈɪljən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: e And why one reason is the EU's jth of massive investments in transformative start prods
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈi ənd wˈaɪ wˈʌn ɹˈizən ˈɪz ðə eu's jth ˈʌv mˈæsɪv ˌɪnvˈɛstmənts ɪn tɹˌænsfˈɔɹmɑtˌɪv stˈɑɹt pɹˈɑdz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: we don't translate technologies at the cutting edge into new businesses,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈi dˈoʊnt tɹænzlˈeɪt tɛknˈɑlədʒiz ˈæt ðə kˈʌtɪŋ ˈɛdʒ ˈɪntu nˈu bˈɪznəsəz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and we don't have hugely successful technology companies in anything like the way
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd wˈi dˈoʊnt hˈæv hjˈudʒli səksˈɛsfəl tɛknˈɑlədʒi kˈʌmpənˌiz ɪn ˈɛniθˌɪŋ lˈaɪk ðə wˈeɪ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that the US does, or even China to some extent.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈʌs dˈʌz ˈɔɹ ˈivɪn tʃˈaɪnə tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: One reason is we we don't have great vent Capital markets here.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈʌn ɹˈizən ˈɪz wˈi wˈi dˈoʊnt hˈæv ɡɹˈeɪt vˈɛnt kˈæpətəl mˈɑɹkəts hˈiɹ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Most of the world's really big companies have been funded via this actually quite tiny asset
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /mˈoʊst ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz ɹˈɪli bˈɪɡ kˈʌmpənˌiz hˈæv bˈɪn fˈʌndəd vˈaɪə ðˈɪs ˈæktʃˌuəli kwˈaɪt tˈaɪni ˈæsˌɛt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: class in Europe that sort of didn't happen.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /klˈæs ɪn jˈʊɹəp ðˈæt sˈɔɹt ˈʌv dˈɪdənt hˈæpən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Part of it also is regulation.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈɪz ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Europe really believes in regulation that's not a bad thing,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /jˈʊɹəp ɹˈɪli bɪlˈivz ɪn ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃən ðˈæts nˈɑt ə bˈæd θˈɪŋ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: as I'm always told when I'm, you know, in Brussels,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈæz ˈaɪm ˈɔlwˌeɪz tˈoʊld wˈɛn ˈaɪm jˈu nˈoʊ ɪn bɹˈʌsəlz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: is what we're doing is a blueprint for everyone else.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈʌt wˈiɹ dˈuɪŋ ˈɪz ə blˈupɹˌɪnt fˈɔɹ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: But if you put it all together, you have a situation where you're not encouraging growth.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu pˈʊt ˈɪt ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu hˈæv ə sˌɪtʃuˈeɪʃən wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒɪŋ ɡɹˈoʊθ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: We are behind everywhere else in the world.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈi ˈɑɹ bɪhˈaɪnd ˈɛvɹiwˌɛɹ ˈɛls ɪn ðə wˈɝld/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: When people talk about billions, they sound like large numbers,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈɛn pˈipəl tˈɔk əbˈaʊt bˈɪljənz ðˈeɪ sˈaʊnd lˈaɪk lˈɑɹdʒ nˈʌmbɚz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: but now we're talking about trillions in terms of the valuation of tech companies.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈʌt nˈaʊ wˈiɹ tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt tɹˈɪljənz ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ðə væljuˈeɪʃən ˈʌv tˈɛk kˈʌmpənˌiz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Just take the biggest US ones over the last couple of years.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /dʒˈʌst tˈeɪk ðə bˈɪɡəst ˈʌs wˈʌnz ˈoʊvɚ ðə lˈæst kˈʌpəl ˈʌv jˈɪɹz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: If their combined value was a country,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ kəmbˈaɪnd vˈælju wˈɑz ə kˈʌntɹi/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: it would have the third biggest GDP in the world after the US and China.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈʊd hˈæv ðə θˈɝd bˈɪɡəst ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev ɪn ðə wˈɝld ˈæftɚ ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: I think people are waking up to the fact
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk pˈipəl ˈɑɹ wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp tˈu ðə fˈækt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that Europe really is in trouble
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈʊɹəp ɹˈɪli ˈɪz ɪn tɹˈʌbəl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: because not only does it not have the the tech platforms,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈoʊnli dˈʌz ˈɪt nˈɑt hˈæv ðə ðə tˈɛk plˈætfˌɔɹmz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: but the digital era is eating into everything,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə dˈɪdʒətəl ˈɛɹə ˈɪz ˈitɪŋ ˈɪntu ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: as we're seeing what's happening in Germany with the car industry.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈæz wˈiɹ sˈiɪŋ wˈʌts hˈæpənɪŋ ɪn dʒˈɝməni wˈɪð ðə kˈɑɹ ˈɪndəstɹi/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: For example, that electric cars are fundamentally digital era products,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl ðˈæt ɪlˈɛktɹɪk kˈɑɹz ˈɑɹ fˌʌndəmˈɛntəli dˈɪdʒətəl ˈɛɹə pɹˈɑdəkts/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Volkswagen is at the the center of this difficult transition.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /vˈoʊlkswˌæɡən ˈɪz ˈæt ðə ðə sˈɛntɚ ˈʌv ðˈɪs dˈɪfəkəlt tɹænzˈɪʃən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: It's still Europe's biggest car maker and one of the EU's industrial engines,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪts stˈɪl jˈʊɹəps bˈɪɡəst kˈɑɹ mˈeɪkɚ ənd wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə eu's ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl ˈɛndʒənz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: but it didn't prepare for an electric vehicle revolution
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt dˈɪdənt pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ ˈæn ɪlˈɛktɹɪk vˈihɪkəl ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: or that it would be led by an American startup called Tesla
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðˈæt ˈɪt wˈʊd bˈi lˈɛd bˈaɪ ˈæn əmˈɛɹəkən stˈɑɹtˌʌp kˈɔld tˈɛslə/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and later rivaled by China.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd lˈeɪtɚ ɹˈaɪvəld bˈaɪ tʃˈaɪnə/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: VW became emblematic of Germany's struggle.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /vw bɪkˈeɪm ˌɛmbləmˈætɪk ˈʌv dʒˈɝməniz stɹˈʌɡəl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: What VW is trying to do is close up to three factories we're talking about tens
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈʌt vw ˈɪz tɹˈaɪɪŋ tˈu dˈu ˈɪz klˈoʊs ˈʌp tˈu θɹˈi fˈæktɚiz wˈiɹ tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt tˈɛnz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: of thousands, potentially, of job cuts.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈʌv θˈaʊzəndz pətˈɛnʃəli ˈʌv dʒˈɑb kˈʌts/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Meanwhile, Germany's neighbor is politically and financially deadlocked.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /mˈinwˌaɪl dʒˈɝməniz nˈeɪbɚ ˈɪz pəlˈɪtɪkəli ənd fənˈænʃəli dˈɛdlˌɑkt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: France has a number of problems high debt is one of them.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fɹˈæns hˈæz ə nˈʌmbɚ ˈʌv pɹˈɑbləmz hˈaɪ dˈɛt ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðˈɛm/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The deficit is very wide, so that's the gap between
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə dˈɛfəsət ˈɪz vˈɛɹi wˈaɪd sˈoʊ ðˈæts ðə ɡˈæp bɪtwˈin/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: what the government spends and what it brings in in tax revenue.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈʌt ðə ɡˈʌvɚmənt spˈɛndz ənd wˈʌt ˈɪt bɹˈɪŋz ɪn ɪn tˈæks ɹˈɛvənˌu/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: That's huge and it's proving very difficult to tackle.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæts hjˈudʒ ənd ˈɪts pɹˈuvɪŋ vˈɛɹi dˈɪfəkəlt tˈu tˈækəl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: It's also over what the EU even allows, which is this 3% of GDP.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ ˈoʊvɚ wˈʌt ðə ˈijˌu ˈivɪn əlˈaʊz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðˈɪs 3 ˈʌv ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: France was well past that this year and is forecast to be for some time,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fɹˈæns wˈɑz wˈɛl pˈæst ðˈæt ðˈɪs jˈɪɹ ənd ˈɪz fˈɔɹkˌæst tˈu bˈi fˈɔɹ sˈʌm tˈaɪm/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and it makes investors more apprehensive about buying French debt.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ˈɪt mˈeɪks ˌɪnvˈɛstɚz mˈɔɹ ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv əbˈaʊt bˈaɪɪŋ fɹˈɛntʃ dˈɛt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: That's what this line shows the higher the line,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæts wˈʌt ðˈɪs lˈaɪn ʃˈoʊz ðə hˈaɪɚ ðə lˈaɪn/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: the riskier France is judged to be relative to the traditionally very safe Germany.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɪskiɚ fɹˈæns ˈɪz dʒˈʌdʒd tˈu bˈi ɹˈɛlətɪv tˈu ðə tɹədˈɪʃənəli vˈɛɹi sˈeɪf dʒˈɝməni/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and In December, that risk was the highest it had
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ ðˈæt ɹˈɪsk wˈɑz ðə hˈaɪəst ˈɪt hˈæd/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: been since 2012, when Europe was in the midst of a debt crisis,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈɪn sˈɪns 2012 wˈɛn jˈʊɹəp wˈɑz ɪn ðə mˈɪdst ˈʌv ə dˈɛt kɹˈaɪsəs/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: which is just compounding the fiscal difficulties that that it faces.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kəmpˈaʊndɪŋ ðə fˈɪskəl dˈɪfəkəltiz ðˈæt ðˈæt ˈɪt fˈeɪsəz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: So until there is a political resolution, it's hard to see the French economy turning around.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈoʊ əntˈɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə pəlˈɪtəkəl ɹˌɛzəlˈuʃən ˈɪts hˈɑɹd tˈu sˈi ðə fɹˈɛntʃ ɪkˈɑnəmi tˈɝnɪŋ ɚˈaʊnd/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: People are waking up the fact that that France is facing a potential debt crisis,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /pˈipəl ˈɑɹ wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp ðə fˈækt ðˈæt ðˈæt fɹˈæns ˈɪz fˈeɪsɪŋ ə pətˈɛnʃəl dˈɛt kɹˈaɪsəs/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and Germany, on the other hand, is facing a potential employment crisis
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd dʒˈɝməni ˈɑn ðə ˈʌðɚ hˈænd ˈɪz fˈeɪsɪŋ ə pətˈɛnʃəl ɛmplˈɔɪmənt kɹˈaɪsəs/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: where it won't have the same number of workers producing the types of thing
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈɛɹ ˈɪt wˈoʊnt hˈæv ðə sˈeɪm nˈʌmbɚ ˈʌv wˈɝkɚz pɹədˈusɪŋ ðə tˈaɪps ˈʌv θˈɪŋ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that Germany has made itself famous for, and that impacts the whole of the European Union.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt dʒˈɝməni hˈæz mˈeɪd ˌɪtsˈɛlf fˈeɪməs fˈɔɹ ənd ðˈæt ˌɪmpˈækts ðə hˈoʊl ˈʌv ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən jˈunjən/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: I really don't think Europe can do anything without France and Germany.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli dˈoʊnt θˈɪŋk jˈʊɹəp kˈæn dˈu ˈɛniθˌɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt fɹˈæns ənd dʒˈɝməni/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Reeing and doing well, you need those two economies to push everyone else,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /reeing ənd dˈuɪŋ wˈɛl jˈu nˈid ðˈoʊz tˈu ɪkˈɑnəmiz tˈu pˈʊʃ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and everyone else trades with them, so we have no options.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls tɹˈeɪdz wˈɪð ðˈɛm sˈoʊ wˈi hˈæv nˈoʊ ˈɑpʃənz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: We need them to do well.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈi nˈid ðˈɛm tˈu dˈu wˈɛl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Put together, this is the state of Europe
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə stˈeɪt ˈʌv jˈʊɹəp/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: that Mario Drogy rang the alarm about the block is too reliant on traditional industry,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈæt mˈɑɹioʊ drogy ɹˈæŋ ðə əlˈɑɹm əbˈaʊt ðə blˈɑk ˈɪz tˈu ɹɪlˈaɪənt ˈɑn tɹədˈɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstɹi/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: too unproductive, too uncoordinated, and too averse to risk.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /tˈu ˌʌnpɹədˈʌktɪv tˈu ənkoʊˈɔɹdəneɪtɪd ənd tˈu əvˈɝs tˈu ɹˈɪsk/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: This fractured political landscape,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈɪs fɹˈæktʃɚd pəlˈɪtəkəl lˈændskˌeɪp/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: in which countries look to protect their own interests over
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɪn wˈɪtʃ kˈʌntɹiz lˈʊk tˈu pɹətˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn ˈɪntɹəsts ˈoʊvɚ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: those of the Union, makes change difficult.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈoʊz ˈʌv ðə jˈunjən mˈeɪks tʃˈeɪndʒ dˈɪfəkəlt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: So what's next?
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌts nˈɛkst/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Where do we look for warning signs or silver linings?
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /wˈɛɹ dˈu wˈi lˈʊk fˈɔɹ wˈɔɹnɪŋ sˈaɪnz ˈɔɹ sˈɪlvɚ lˈaɪnɪŋz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: The euro against the dollar is a good diagnostic
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðə jˈuɹoʊ əɡˈɛnst ðə dˈɑlɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd dˌaɪəɡnˈɑstɪk/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: for where Europe is being left behind it's trended downward
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /fˈɔɹ wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹəp ˈɪz bˈiɪŋ lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd ˈɪts tɹˈɛndɪd dˈaʊnwɚd/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: and traded at equal value only a handful of times,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ənd tɹˈeɪdɪd ˈæt ˈikwəl vˈælju ˈoʊnli ə hˈændfˌʊl ˈʌv tˈaɪmz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: but to command geopolitical weight you need a big economy in dollar terms.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /bˈʌt tˈu kəmˈænd dʒˌioʊpəlˈɪtɪkəl wˈeɪt jˈu nˈid ə bˈɪɡ ɪkˈɑnəmi ɪn dˈɑlɚ tˈɝmz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: So crossing that parody threshold is a worrisome indicator for economists and politicians.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /sˈoʊ kɹˈɔsɪŋ ðˈæt pˈɛɹədi θɹˈɛʃˌoʊld ˈɪz ə wˈɝisəm ˈɪndəkˌeɪtɚ fˈɔɹ ɪkˈɑnəmɪsts ənd pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: A fall to par could embolden populist politicians who oppose the currency,
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ə fˈɔl tˈu pˈɑɹ kˈʊd ɛmbˈoʊldən pˈɑpjələst pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz hˈu əpˈoʊz ðə kˈɝənsi/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: raising the remote but real threat of another Brexit-like event.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɹˈeɪzɪŋ ðə ɹɪmˈoʊt bˈʌt ɹˈil θɹˈɛt ˈʌv ənˈʌðɚ brexitlike ɪvˈɛnt/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Germany's right-wing AfD party said it's planning an election campaign advocating
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /dʒˈɝməniz ɹˈaɪtwˌɪŋ afd pˈɑɹti sˈɛd ˈɪts plˈænɪŋ ˈæn ɪlˈɛkʃən kæmpˈeɪn ˈædvəkˌeɪtɪŋ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: this, but experts, including Drogy, have stressed that change, however difficult, is possible.
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ðˈɪs bˈʌt ˈɛkspɚts ˌɪnklˈudɪŋ drogy hˈæv stɹˈɛst ðˈæt tʃˈeɪndʒ hˌaʊˈɛvɚ dˈɪfəkəlt ˈɪz pˈɑsəbəl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: Cars, machines, robots this kind of precision engineering required to create this kind of hardware
d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /kˈɑɹz məʃˈinz ɹˈoʊbˌɑts ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pɹisˈɪʒən ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹɪŋ ɹikwˈaɪɚd tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv hˈɑɹdwˌɛɹ/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ jˈʊɹəp ˈɪz tɹədˈɪʃənəli vˈɛɹi vˈɛɹi ɡˈʊd ˈæt pˌɑɹtˈɪkjəlɚli nˈɔɹðɚn ˈɪtəli sˈʌðɚn dʒˈɝməni swˈɪtsɚlənd/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.text: These places, that are very, very good at making things very well,

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /mˈeɪ plˈeɪ ə pˈɪvətəl ɹˈoʊl/

d04faa06-3eac-4357-b596-e1559c2f1c98.ipa: /ɪn wˈɛɹ wˈi wˈi pɹədˈus ˈʌ hˈaɪ kwˈɑləti tˌɛknəlˈɑdʒɪkəl ɡˈʊdz ɡˈoʊɪŋ fˈɔɹwɚd/
