e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Em bé nước ngoài, để tôi nói thật.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: Yeah, you know what I'm thinking see it in your eyes.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈæ jˈu nˈoʊ wˈʌt ˈaɪm θˈɪŋkɪŋ sˈi ˈɪt ɪn jˈɔɹ ˈaɪz/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Vâng, bạn biết tôi đang nghĩ gì, tôi thấy nó trong mắt bạn.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: You hate that you want me hit up when you cry.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈu hˈeɪt ðˈæt jˈu wˈɑnt mˈi hˈɪt ˈʌp wˈɛn jˈu kɹˈaɪ/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Bạn ghét việc bạn muốn tôi liên lạc khi bạn khóc.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: You're scared to be lonely, especially in the night.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈʊɹ skˈɛɹd tˈu bˈi lˈoʊnli əspˈɛʃli ɪn ðə nˈaɪt/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Bạn sợ cô đơn, đặc biệt là vào ban đêm.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: I'm scared that I'll miss you.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Tôi sợ rằng tôi sẽ nhớ bạn.
Tôi không muốn cảm giác này.
Tôi không đủ khả năng chi trả cho tình yêu.
Tôi cố gắng tìm kiếm trách nhiệm.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: It ain't working cause you're perfect and I know that you're worth it.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈeɪnt wˈɝkɪŋ kˈɑz jˈʊɹ pɚfˈɛkt ənd ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt jˈʊɹ wˈɝθ ˈɪt/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Nó không hoạt động vì bạn quá hoàn hảo và tôi biết bạn xứng đáng với điều đó.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: I can't walk away even though we're gone.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈænt wˈɔk əwˈeɪ ˈivɪn ðˈoʊ wˈiɹ ɡˈɔn/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Tôi không thể rời đi ngay cả khi chúng ta đã chia tay.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: Yeah, I'm finding ways to stay concentrated.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈæ ˈaɪm fˈaɪndɪŋ wˈeɪz tˈu stˈeɪ kˈɑnsəntɹˌeɪtɪd/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Vâng, tôi đang tìm cách để giữ sự tập trung.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: Yes, I'm blaming you and you know I can't take it now.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaɪm blˈeɪmɪŋ jˈu ənd jˈu nˈoʊ ˈaɪ kˈænt tˈeɪk ˈɪt nˈaʊ/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Vâng, tôi đang đổ lỗi cho bạn và bạn biết rằng bây giờ tôi không thể chịu đựng được.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: You do, you know what I'm thinking see it in your eyes.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /jˈu dˈu jˈu nˈoʊ wˈʌt ˈaɪm θˈɪŋkɪŋ sˈi ˈɪt ɪn jˈɔɹ ˈaɪz/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Bạn biết, bạn biết tôi đang nghĩ gì, tôi thấy nó trong mắt bạn.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: Makes everything keep it real with you while we care for you more.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.ipa: /mˈeɪks ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ kˈip ˈɪt ɹˈil wˈɪð jˈu wˈaɪl wˈi kˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ jˈu mˈɔɹ/
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Giữ mọi thứ chân thật với bạn trong khi chúng tôi quan tâm bạn nhiều hơn.

e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.text: Baby, I'm a baby, the distance.
e5acf9cc-c9bb-4394-a589-0cfa6aea1035.vietnamese_text: Em yêu, em là một đứa trẻ, khoảng cách.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Now turn to section two.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /nˈaʊ tˈɝn tˈu sˈɛkʃən tˈu/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy chuyển sang phần hai.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Section two, you will hear a radio program about singing in a choir.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /sˈɛkʃən tˈu jˈu wˈɪl hˈiɹ ə ɹˈeɪdiˌoʊ pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm əbˈaʊt sˈɪŋɪŋ ɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Phần hai, bạn sẽ nghe một chương trình radio về hát trong dàn hợp xướng.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 15.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /fˈɝst jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 15/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Đầu tiên, bạn có một chút thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 15.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Now, listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 15.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən kˈɛɹfəli ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 15/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ, hãy lắng nghe cẩn thận và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 15.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: And for our regular spot on things to do in town, here's our reporter, Samuel Cooper.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ spˈɑt ˈɑn θˈɪŋz tˈu dˈu ɪn tˈaʊn hˈɪɹz ˈaʊɚ ɹɪpˈɔɹtɚ sˈæmjul kˈupɚ/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Và với chuyên mục thường lệ về những việc nên làm trong thành phố, đây là phóng viên của chúng tôi, Samuel Cooper.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: It's been fun to write about joining some of our local choirs. Thank you.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn fˈʌn tˈu ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kwˈaɪɹz θˈæŋk jˈu/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Thật vui khi được viết về việc tham gia một số dàn hợp xướng địa phương của chúng tôi. Cảm ơn bạn.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Well, feeling a bit apprehensive about my ability to sing in tune,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɛl fˈilɪŋ ə bˈɪt ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv əbˈaʊt mˈaɪ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈɪŋ ɪn tˈun/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Chà, cảm thấy hơi lo lắng về khả năng hát đúng tông của mình,

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: I recently headed off for rehearsals at the town's three biggest choirs Mitchell's Town Choir,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli hˈɛdəd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈæt ðə tˈaʊnz θɹˈi bˈɪɡəst kwˈaɪɹz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Tôi gần đây đã đi tập dượt tại ba dàn hợp xướng lớn nhất thị trấn, Dàn hợp xướng Thị trấn Mitchell,

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: the Black Bell Male Voice Choir, and the Caroline Singers.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə blˈæk bˈɛl mˈeɪl vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ ənd ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Hợp xướng nam Black Bell, và Dàn hợp xướng Caroline.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: I received a very warm welcome at all three choirs.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹəsˈivd ə vˈɛɹi wˈɔɹm wˈɛlkəm ˈæt ˈɔl θɹˈi kwˈaɪɹz/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã nhận được sự chào đón rất nồng nhiệt tại cả ba dàn hợp xướng.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: They are always on the lookout for new and enthusiastic singers.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˈɑn ðə lˈʊkˌaʊt fˈɔɹ nˈu ənd ɪnθˌuziˈæstɪk sˈɪŋɚz/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Họ luôn tìm kiếm những ca sĩ mới và nhiệt huyết.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Now, obviously, deciding which choir to join will depend to some extent
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɑbviəsli dˌɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɪtʃ kwˈaɪɚ tˈu dʒˈɔɪn wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ, rõ ràng, việc quyết định tham gia dàn hợp xướng nào sẽ phụ thuộc ở một mức độ nào đó

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: on your taste in music.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɑn jˈɔɹ tˈeɪst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: về sở thích âm nhạc của bạn.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Black Bell caters for most musical taste, as it has a hugely varied repertoire,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /blˈæk bˈɛl kˈeɪtɚz fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst mjˈuzɪkəl tˈeɪst ˈæz ˈɪt hˈæz ə hjˈudʒli vˈɛɹid ɹˈɛpɚtwˌɑɹ/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Black Bell phục vụ hầu hết các sở thích âm nhạc, vì nó có một danh mục nhạc vô cùng đa dạng.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: as does Mitchell's Town.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæz dˈʌz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: cũng như Thị trấn của Mitchell.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: If you're after a more classical feel,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn có cảm giác cổ điển hơn,

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.vietnamese_text: The Caroline Singers có xu hướng tập trung vào các bản madrigal, đó là hát không có nhạc đệm, không có nhạc cụ nào.

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: or make friends that's on offer.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You could win a gold medal, too.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody competition in Atlanta,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: And if all of that isn't enough,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Before you hear the rest of the program,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ jˈu hˈiɹ ðə ɹˈɛst ˈʌv ðə pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: you have some time to look at questions 16 to 20.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu h��æv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 16 tˈu 20/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Now listen and answer questions.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You may feel unable to join a choir
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because of work or family commitments.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: This has been done in companies large and small,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: of some people's mind, it's having the opportunity to switch off
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and focus on something completely different that they're after.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: with because, naturally enough, people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: which is just common sense really.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: They started off four years ago with just five people that's now risen to 19,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈ��ɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The same is true for late afternoon.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: free of charge, to members of the choir.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end of section two.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd ˈʌv sˈɛkʃən tˈu/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You now have half a minute,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu nˈaʊ hˈæv hˈæf ə mˈɪnət/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and for our regular spot on things to do in town, here's our reporter, Samuel Cooper.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ spˈɑt ˈɑn θˈɪŋz tˈu dˈu ɪn tˈaʊn hˈɪɹz ˈaʊɚ ɹɪpˈɔɹtɚ sˈæmjul kˈupɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: It's been fun to write about joining some of our local choirs.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn fˈʌn tˈu ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kwˈaɪɹz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Thank you. Well, feeling a bit apprehensive.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu wˈɛl fˈilɪŋ ə bˈɪt ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: About my ability to sing in tune,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /əbˈaʊt mˈaɪ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈɪŋ ɪn tˈun/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: I recently headed off for rehearsals at the town's three biggest choirs Mitchell's Town Choir,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli hˈɛdəd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈæt ðə tˈaʊnz θɹˈi bˈɪɡəst kwˈaɪɹz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: the Black Bell Male Voice Choir, and the Caroline Singers.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə blˈæk bˈɛl mˈeɪl vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ ənd ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: I received a very warm welcome at all three choirs.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹəsˈivd ə vˈɛɹi wˈɔɹm wˈɛlkəm ˈæt ˈɔl θɹˈi kwˈaɪɹz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: They are always on the lookout for new and enthusiastic singers.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˈɑn ðə lˈʊkˌaʊt fˈɔɹ nˈu ənd ɪnθˌuziˈæstɪk sˈɪŋɚz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Now, obviously, deciding which choir to join will depend to some extent
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɑbviəsli dˌɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɪtʃ kwˈaɪɚ tˈu dʒˈɔɪn wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: on your taste in music.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɑn jˈɔɹ tˈeɪst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Black Bell caters for most musical taste, as it has a hugely varied repertoire,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /blˈæk bˈɛl kˈeɪtɚz fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst mjˈuzɪkəl tˈeɪst ˈæz ˈɪt hˈæz ə hjˈudʒli vˈɛɹid ɹˈɛpɚtwˌɑɹ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: as does Mitchell's Town.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæz dˈʌz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: If you're after a more classical feel,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: or make friends that's on offer.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You could win a gold medal, too.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody Competition in Atlanta,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: And if all of that isn't enough,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: You may feel unable to join a choir
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because of work or family commitments.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: This has been done in companies large and small.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: And I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: of some people's mind...
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: It's having the opportunity to switch off and focus on something completely different that they're after.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: with, because naturally enough people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: which is just common sense, really.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: They started off four years ago with just five people.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈɑɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: That's now risen to 19, while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19 wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: The same is true for late afternoon.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: free of charge to members of the choir.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end.
87aad0e9-84d9-4f26-98d5-ffdb2eb563a2.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd/

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Section two. You will hear a holiday company representative talking to a group
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /sˈɛkʃən tˈu jˈu wˈɪl hˈiɹ ə hˈɑlədˌeɪ kˈʌmpənˌi ɹˌɛpɹəzˈɛntətɪv tˈɔkɪŋ tˈu ə ɡɹˈup/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Phần hai. Bạn sẽ nghe một đại diện công ty du lịch nói chuyện với một nhóm

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: of tourists in a large
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈʌv tˈʊɹəsts ɪn ə lˈɑɹdʒ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: của khách du lịch trong một lớn

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: hotel about things they can do during their holiday.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /hoʊtˈɛl əbˈaʊt θˈɪŋz ðˈeɪ kˈæn dˈu dˈʊɹɪŋ ðˈɛɹ hˈɑlədˌeɪ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: khách sạn về những điều họ có thể làm trong kỳ nghỉ của mình.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 16.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /fˈɝst jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 16/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Đầu tiên, bạn có một chút thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 16.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 16. Hello everyone.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən kˈɛɹfəli ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 16 həlˈoʊ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy nghe cẩn thận và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 16. Xin chào mọi người.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: I'm Jake Stevens and I'm your rep here at the hotel.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈaɪm dʒˈeɪk stˈivənz ənd ˈaɪm jˈɔɹ ɹˈɛp hˈiɹ ˈæt ðə hoʊtˈɛl/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Tôi là Jake Stevens và tôi là đại diện của quý khách tại khách sạn.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: I'm sure you'll all have a great time here.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈaɪm ʃˈʊɹ jˈul ˈɔl hˈæv ə ɡɹˈeɪt tˈaɪm hˈiɹ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Tôi chắc chắn rằng tất cả các bạn sẽ có một khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời ở đây.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: So, let me tell you a bit about what's on offer.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /sˈoʊ lˈɛt mˈi tˈɛl jˈu ə bˈɪt əbˈaʊt wˈʌts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Vậy, để tôi nói cho bạn biết một chút về những gì được cung cấp.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: I'll start by telling you about some of the excursions that are available for guests.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈaɪl stˈɑɹt bˈaɪ tˈɛlɪŋ jˈu əbˈaʊt sˈʌm ˈʌv ðə ɪkskˈɝʒənz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ əvˈeɪləbəl fˈɔɹ ɡˈɛsts/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ bắt đầu bằng cách nói về một số chuyến tham quan có sẵn cho du khách.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: One thing you have to do while you're here is go dolphin watching.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈʌn θˈɪŋ jˈu hˈæv tˈu dˈu wˈaɪl jˈʊɹ hˈiɹ ˈɪz ɡˈoʊ dˈɑlfən wˈɑtʃɪŋ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Một điều bạn phải làm khi ở đây là đi ngắm cá heo.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: On our boat trips, we pretty well guarantee you'll see dolphins.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɑn ˈaʊɚ bˈoʊt tɹˈɪps wˈi pɹˈɪti wˈɛl ɡˌɛɹəntˈi jˈul sˈi dˈɑlfənz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Trong các chuyến đi thuyền của chúng tôi, chúng tôi khá chắc chắn bạn sẽ thấy cá heo.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: If you don't, you can repeat the trip free of charge.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu dˈoʊnt jˈu kˈæn ɹɪpˈit ðə tɹˈɪp fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn không làm vậy, bạn có thể đi lại miễn phí.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: We organize daily trips for just 35 euros.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪz dˈeɪli tɹˈɪps fˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst 35 jˈuɹˌoʊz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi tổ chức các chuyến đi hàng ngày chỉ với 35 euro.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Unfortunately, there aren't any places left for this afternoon's trip,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənfˈɔɹtʃənətli ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹənt ˈɛni plˈeɪsəz lˈɛft fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs ˌæftɚnˈunz tɹˈɪp/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Rất tiếc, không còn chỗ nào cho chuyến đi chiều nay,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: but come and see me to book for later in the week.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /bˈʌt kˈʌm ənd sˈi mˈi tˈu bˈʊk fˈɔɹ lˈeɪtɚ ɪn ðə wˈik/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: nhưng hãy đến gặp tôi để đặt lịch cho cuối tuần này.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: If you're energetic, I'd recommend our forest walk.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˌɛnɚdʒˈɛtɪk ˈaɪd ɹˌɛkəmˈɛnd ˈaʊɚ fˈɔɹəst wˈɔk/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn tràn đầy năng lượng, tôi khuyên bạn nên đi bộ trong rừng.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's a guided walk of about 7 km.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts ə ɡˈaɪdəd wˈɔk ˈʌv əbˈaʊt 7 km/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Đó là một chuyến đi bộ có hướng dẫn dài khoảng 7 km.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: There'll be a stop halfway and you'll be provided with a drink and sandwiches.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈɛɹəl bˈi ə stˈɑp hˈæfwˈeɪ ənd jˈul bˈi pɹəvˈaɪdɪd wˈɪð ə dɹˈɪŋk ənd sˈændwɪtʃɪz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Sẽ có một điểm dừng ở giữa đường và bạn sẽ được cung cấp đồ uống và bánh sandwich.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: There's some fairly steep climbs up the hills,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz sˈʌm fˈɛɹli stˈip klˈaɪmz ˈʌp ðə hˈɪlz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Có một số đoạn dốc khá cao lên đồi,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: so you need to be reasonably fit for this one with good shoes.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu nˈid tˈu bˈi ɹˈizənəbli fˈɪt fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs wˈʌn wˈɪð ɡˈʊd ʃˈuz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: vì vậy bạn cần có thể lực tương đối tốt cho lần này với đôi giày tốt.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Oh, and bring a waterproof in case it rains.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈoʊ ənd bɹˈɪŋ ə wˈɔtɚpɹˌuf ɪn kˈeɪs ˈɪt ɹˈeɪnz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: À, và mang theo áo mưa phòng trường hợp trời mưa.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's just 25 euros all inclusive and it's every Wednesday.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst 25 jˈuɹˌoʊz ˈɔl ˌɪnklˈusɪv ənd ˈɪts ˈɛvɚi wˈɛnzdi/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chỉ 25 euro trọn gói và diễn ra vào mỗi thứ Tư.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Then on Thursdays, we organize a cycle trip,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈɑn θˈɝzdeɪz wˈi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪz ə sˈaɪkəl tɹˈɪp/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Sau đó vào các ngày thứ Năm, chúng tôi tổ chức một chuyến đi xe đạp,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: which will give you all the fun of biking without the effort.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɪl ɡˈɪv jˈu ˈɔl ðə fˈʌn ˈʌv bˈaɪkɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ðə ˈɛfɚt/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: sẽ mang lại cho bạn mọi niềm vui của việc đạp xe mà không tốn sức.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: We'll take you and your bike up to the top of Mount Lana
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈil tˈeɪk jˈu ənd jˈɔɹ bˈaɪk ˈʌp tˈu ðə tˈɑp ˈʌv mˈaʊnt lˈænə/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi sẽ đưa bạn và xe đạp của bạn lên đỉnh núi Lana

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and leave you to bike back.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd lˈiv jˈu tˈu bˈaɪk bˈæk/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và để bạn đạp xe về.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's a 700 m drop in just 20 km,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts ə 700 ˈɛm dɹˈɑp ɪn dʒˈʌst 20 km/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Đó là một sự sụt giảm 700 m chỉ trong 20 km,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: so this isn't really for inexperienced cyclists as you'll be going pretty fast.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈɪs ˈɪzənt ɹˈɪli fˈɔɹ ɪnɪkspˈɪɹiənst sˈaɪkəlɪsts ˈæz jˈul bˈi ɡˈoʊɪŋ pɹˈɪti fˈæst/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: vì vậy, điều này không thực sự dành cho những người đi xe đạp thiếu kinh nghiệm vì bạn sẽ đi khá nhanh.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: And if it's a clear day, you'll have fantastic views.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɪts ə klˈɪɹ dˈeɪ jˈul hˈæv fæntˈæstɪk vjˈuz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Và nếu trời quang đãng, bạn sẽ có những khung cảnh tuyệt vời.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: On our local craft tour, you can find out about the traditional activities in the island.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɑn ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kɹˈæft tˈʊɹ jˈu kˈæn fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə tɹədˈɪʃənəl æktˈɪvətiz ɪn ðə ˈaɪlənd/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Trong chuyến tham quan thủ công địa phương của chúng tôi, bạn có thể tìm hiểu về các hoạt động truyền thống trên đảo.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: And the best thing about this trip is that it's completely free.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd ðə bˈɛst θˈɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðˈɪs tɹˈɪp ˈɪz ðˈæt ˈɪts kəmplˈitli fɹˈi/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Và điều tuyệt vời nhất về chuyến đi này là nó hoàn toàn miễn phí.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: You'll be taken to a factory where jewelry is made and also a ceramic center.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /jˈul bˈi tˈeɪkən tˈu ə fˈæktɚi wˈɛɹ dʒˈuəlɹi ˈɪz mˈeɪd ənd ˈɔlsoʊ ə sɚˈæmɪk sˈɛntɚ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Bạn sẽ được đưa đến một nhà máy sản xuất đồ trang sức và cả một trung tâm gốm sứ.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: If you want, you can buy some of the products, but that's entirely up to you.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt jˈu kˈæn bˈaɪ sˈʌm ˈʌv ðə pɹˈɑdəkts bˈʌt ðˈæts ɪntˈaɪɚli ˈʌp tˈu jˈu/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn, bạn có thể mua một số sản phẩm, nhưng điều đó hoàn toàn tùy thuộc vào bạn.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: The trip starts after lunch on Thursday and you'll return by 6:00 p.m.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðə tɹˈɪp stˈɑɹts ˈæftɚ lˈʌntʃ ˈɑn θˈɝzdˌeɪ ənd jˈul ɹɪtˈɝn bˈaɪ 600 pˈiˈɛm/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chuyến đi bắt đầu sau bữa trưa vào thứ Năm v�� bạn sẽ trở về trước 18:00.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: If you're interested in astronomy, you may already know
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn əstɹˈɑnəmi jˈu mˈeɪ ɔlɹˈɛdi nˈoʊ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn quan tâm đến thiên văn học, bạn có thể đã biết

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: that the island's one of the best places in the world to observe the night sky.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈaɪləndz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst plˈeɪsəz ɪn ðə wˈɝld tˈu əbzˈɝv ðə nˈaɪt skˈaɪ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: rằng hòn đảo này là một trong những nơi tốt nhất trên thế giới để quan sát bầu trời đêm.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: We can offer trips to the observatory on Friday for those who are interested.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈi kˈæn ˈɔfɚ tɹˈɪps tˈu ðə əbzˈɝvətˌɔɹi ˈɑn fɹˈaɪdi fˈɔɹ ðˈoʊz hˈu ˈɑɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi có thể cung cấp các chuyến đi đến đài thiên văn vào thứ Sáu cho những ai quan tâm.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: They cost 90 euros per person and you'll be shown the huge telescopes
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈeɪ kˈɑst 90 jˈuɹˌoʊz pˈɝ pˈɝsən ənd jˈul bˈi ʃˈoʊn ðə hjˈudʒ tˈɛləskˌoʊps/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Chúng có giá 90 euro mỗi người và bạn sẽ được xem những kính thiên văn khổng lồ

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and have a talk from an expert who will explain all about how they work.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd hˈæv ə tˈɔk fɹˈʌm ˈæn ˈɛkspɚt hˈu wˈɪl ɪksplˈeɪn ˈɔl əbˈaʊt hˈaʊ ðˈeɪ wˈɝk/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và có một buổi nói chuyện từ một chuyên gia, người sẽ giải thích tất cả về cách chúng hoạt động.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Afterwards, we'll head down to Sunset Beach
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈæftɚwɚdz wˈil hˈɛd dˈaʊn tˈu sˈʌnsˌɛt bˈitʃ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Sau đó, chúng ta sẽ xuống Bãi biển Sunset

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: where you can have a dip in the ocean if you want
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈɛɹ jˈu kˈæn hˈæv ə dˈɪp ɪn ðə ˈoʊʃən ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: nơi bạn có thể ngâm mình dưới biển nếu muốn

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: before we head off back to the hotel.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ wˈi hˈɛd ˈɔf bˈæk tˈu ðə hoʊtˈɛl/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: trước khi chúng ta quay về khách sạn.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Finally, there's horse riding.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /fˈaɪnəli ðˈɛɹz hˈɔɹs ɹˈaɪdɪŋ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Cuối cùng, có cưỡi ng��a.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: This is organized by the Equestrian Center over near Playa Cortina
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzd bˈaɪ ðə ɪkwˈɛstɹiən sˈɛntɚ ˈoʊvɚ nˈɪɹ plˈaɪə kɚtˈinə/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Điều này được tổ chức bởi Trung tâm Kỵ sĩ gần Playa Cortina

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and it's a great experience if you're a keen horseback rider
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts ə ɡɹˈeɪt ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ə kˈin hˈɔɹsbˌæk ɹˈaɪdɚ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và đó là một trải nghiệm tuyệt vời nếu bạn là một người cưỡi ngựa nhiệt tình

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: or even if you've never been on a horse before.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ˈivɪn ˈɪf jˈuv nˈɛvɚ bˈɪn ˈɑn ə hˈɔɹs bɪfˈɔɹ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: hoặc ngay cả khi bạn chưa từng cưỡi ngựa trước đây.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: They take you down to the beach and you can canter along the sand
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ðˈeɪ tˈeɪk jˈu dˈaʊn tˈu ðə bˈitʃ ənd jˈu kˈæn kˈæntɚ əlˈɔŋ ðə sˈænd/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Họ đưa bạn xuống bãi biển và bạn có thể phi nước đại dọc theo bờ cát

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and through the waves.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd θɹˈu ðə wˈeɪvz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và qua những con sóng.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It costs 35 euros and it's available every day.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪt kˈɑsts 35 jˈuɹˌoʊz ənd ˈɪts əvˈeɪləbəl ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Giá 35 euro và có sẵn hàng ngày.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Before you hear the rest of the talk you have some time to look
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ jˈu hˈiɹ ðə ɹˈɛst ˈʌv ðə tˈɔk jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Trước khi nghe phần còn lại của bài nói, bạn có thời gian để xem

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: at questions 17 to 20.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 17 tˈu 20/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: ở các câu hỏi từ 17 đến 20.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Now listen and answer questions 17 to 20.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz 17 tˈu 20/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy nghe và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 17 đến 20.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: So there's plenty to do in the daytime, but what about nightlife?
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈɛɹz plˈɛnti tˈu dˈu ɪn ðə dˈeɪtˌaɪm bˈʌt wˈʌt əbˈaʊt nˈaɪtlˌaɪf/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Vậy có rất nhiều việc để làm vào ban ngày, nhưng còn về cuộc sống về đêm thì sao?

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Well, the number one attraction's called Musical Favorites.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈɛl ðə nˈʌmbɚ wˈʌn attraction's kˈɔld mjˈuzɪkəl fˈeɪvɚɪts/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Điểm thu hút số một có tên là Musical Favorites.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Guests enjoy a three-course meal and unlimited free drinks
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ɡˈɛsts ˌɛndʒˈɔɪ ə threecourse mˈil ənd ənlˈɪmətɪd fɹˈi dɹˈɪŋks/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Khách hàng được thưởng thức bữa ăn ba món và đồ uống miễn phí không giới hạn

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and watch a fantastic show starting with musical set in Paris
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd wˈɑtʃ ə fæntˈæstɪk ʃˈoʊ stˈɑɹtɪŋ wˈɪð mjˈuzɪkəl sˈɛt ɪn pˈɛɹɪs/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và xem một chương trình tuyệt vời bắt đầu bằng một vở nhạc kịch lấy bối cảnh ở Paris

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and then crossing the Atlantic to Las Vegas and finally Copacabana.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn kɹˈɔsɪŋ ðə ətlˈæntɪk tˈu lˈɑs vˈeɪɡəs ənd fˈaɪnəli kˌoʊpəkəbˈænə/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và sau đó băng qua Đại Tây Dương đến Las Vegas và cuối cùng là Copacabana.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: At the end, the cast members come down from the stage still in their stunning costumes
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈæt ðə ˈɛnd ðə kˈæst mˈɛmbɚz kˈʌm dˈaʊn fɹˈʌm ðə stˈeɪdʒ stˈɪl ɪn ðˈɛɹ stˈʌnɪŋ kɑstˈumz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Cuối cùng, các diễn viên bước xuống sân khấu vẫn trong bộ trang phục lộng lẫy của họ

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and you'll have a chance to chat with them.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd jˈul hˈæv ə tʃˈæns tˈu tʃˈæt wˈɪð ðˈɛm/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và bạn sẽ có cơ hội trò chuyện với họ.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's hugely popular, so let me know now if you're interested
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts hjˈudʒli pˈɑpjəlɚ sˈoʊ lˈɛt mˈi nˈoʊ nˈaʊ ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nó cực kỳ phổ biến, vì vậy hãy cho tôi biết ngay nếu bạn quan tâm

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: because it's no good leaving it until the last minute.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts nˈoʊ ɡˈʊd lˈivɪŋ ˈɪt əntˈɪl ðə lˈæst mˈɪnət/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: vì không tốt nếu để đến phút cuối.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's on Friday night.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɑn fɹˈaɪdi nˈaɪt/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Đó là vào tối thứ Sáu.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: Tickets are just 50 euros each but for an extra 10 euros,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /tˈɪkəts ˈɑɹ dʒˈʌst 50 jˈuɹˌoʊz ˈitʃ bˈʌt fˈɔɹ ˈæn ˈɛkstɹə 10 jˈuɹˌoʊz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Vé chỉ có giá 50 euro mỗi vé nhưng với thêm 10 euro,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: you can have a table right by the stage.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn hˈæv ə tˈeɪbəl ɹˈaɪt bˈaɪ ðə stˈeɪdʒ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: bạn có thể có một bàn ngay cạnh sân khấu.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: If you'd like to go back in time, there's the castle feast on Saturday evening.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk tˈu ɡˈoʊ bˈæk ɪn tˈaɪm ðˈɛɹz ðə kˈæsəl fˈist ˈɑn sˈætɚdi ˈivnɪŋ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn quay ngược thời gian, có Lễ hội Lâu đài vào tối thứ Bảy.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: It's held in a 12th-century castle
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ˈɪts hˈɛld ɪn ə 12thcentury kˈæsəl/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Nó được tổ chức tại một lâu đài thế kỷ 12

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: and you eat in the great courtyard with ladies in long gowns serving your food.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd jˈu ˈit ɪn ðə ɡɹˈeɪt kˈɔɹtjˌɑɹd wˈɪð lˈeɪdiz ɪn lˈɔŋ ɡˈaʊnz sˈɝvɪŋ jˈɔɹ fˈud/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: và bạn ăn ở sân lớn với những quý cô mặc váy dài phục vụ thức ăn cho bạn.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: You're given a whole chicken each,
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /jˈʊɹ ɡˈɪvən ə hˈoʊl tʃˈɪkən ˈitʃ/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Bạn được cho một con gà nguyên con,

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: which you eat in the medieval way using your hands instead of cutlery.
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ jˈu ˈit ɪn ðə mɪdˈivəl wˈeɪ jˈuzɪŋ jˈɔɹ hˈændz ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv kˈʌtlɚi/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: mà bạn ăn theo kiểu thời trung cổ bằng tay thay vì dùng dao dĩa.

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: And you're entertained by competitions
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.ipa: /ənd jˈʊɹ ˌɛntɚtˈeɪnd bˈaɪ kˌɑmpətˈɪʃənz/
acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.vietnamese_text: Và bạn thấy thích thú với các cuộc thi

acccdbc2-5e5e-4b68-a132-aeb4909d30c4.text: where the horseback riders attempt to knock one another off their horses.

848bac60-9342-42c7-8c1d-8f11547eb8da.ipa: /fˈɔɹ jˈu ˈaɪ wˈʊd lˈaɪ fˈɔɹ jˈu kˈip ˈɪt ɹˈil/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Vietnam will officially pilot a domestic carbon credit trading exchange
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /viˌɛtnˈɑm wˈɪl əfˈɪʃəli pˈaɪlət ə dəmˈɛstɪk kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət tɹˈeɪdɪŋ ɪkstʃˈeɪndʒ/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Việt Nam sẽ chính thức thí điểm sàn giao dịch tín chỉ carbon trong nước

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: as outlined in a revised decree by the government.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈæz ˈaʊtlˌaɪnd ɪn ə ɹɪvˈaɪzd dɪkɹˈi bˈaɪ ðə ɡˈʌvɚmənt/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: như đã nêu trong một sắc lệnh sửa đổi của chính phủ.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: With major industries preparing for tighter emission regulations and green investments gaining momentum,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈɪð mˈeɪdʒɚ ˈɪndəstɹiz pɹipˈɛɹɪŋ fˈɔɹ tˈaɪtɚ ɪmˈɪʃən ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃənz ənd ɡɹˈin ˌɪnvˈɛstmənts ɡˈeɪnɪŋ moʊmˈɛntəm/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Với các ngành công nghiệp lớn đang chuẩn bị cho các quy định phát thải chặt chẽ hơn và các khoản đầu tư xanh ngày càng tăng,

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: how ready is Vietnam to embrace this transition?
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /hˈaʊ ɹˈɛdi ˈɪz viˌɛtnˈɑm tˈu ɛmbɹˈeɪs ðˈɪs tɹænzˈɪʃən/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Việt Nam đã sẵn sàng đón nhận sự chuyển đổi này đến mức nào?

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: How can businesses make use of the trading exchange?
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /hˈaʊ kˈæn bˈ��znəsəz mˈeɪk jˈus ˈʌv ðə tɹˈeɪdɪŋ ɪkstʃˈeɪndʒ/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Các doanh nghiệp có thể tận dụng sàn giao dịch thương mại như thế nào?

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: And what can Vietnam learn from international experience?
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt kˈæn viˌɛtnˈɑm lˈɝn fɹˈʌm ˌɪntɚnˈæʃənəl ɪkspˈɪɹiəns/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Và Việt Nam có thể học hỏi được gì từ kinh nghiệm quốc tế?

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: We'll find out more in this week's cross talk.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈil fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt mˈɔɹ ɪn ðˈɪs wˈiks kɹˈɔs tˈɔk/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta sẽ tìm hiểu thêm trong buổi nói chuyện chéo tuần này.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: But first, let's see
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /bˈʌt fˈɝst lˈɛts sˈi/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Nhưng trước hết, hãy xem

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: how Vietnam is setting its journey for the carbon credit trading exchange implementation.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /hˈaʊ viˌɛtnˈɑm ˈɪz sˈɛtɪŋ ˈɪts dʒˈɝni fˈɔɹ ðə kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət tɹˈeɪdɪŋ ɪkstʃˈeɪndʒ ˌɪmpləmɛntˈeɪʃən/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Việt Nam đang thiết lập hành trình của mình cho việc triển khai sàn giao dịch tín chỉ carbon.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: From 2025 to 2028, Vietnam plans to trial its domestic carbon market with full-scale operations
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fɹˈʌm 2025 tˈu 2028 viˌɛtnˈɑm plˈænz tˈu tɹˈaɪəl ˈɪts dəmˈɛstɪk kˈɑɹbən mˈɑɹkət wˈɪð fullscale ˌɑpɚˈeɪʃənz/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Từ năm 2025 đến năm 2028, Việt Nam dự kiến sẽ thử nghiệm thị trường carbon trong nước với hoạt động quy mô đầy đủ

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: and international connectivity slated for 2029.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd ˌɪntɚnˈæʃənəl kənɛktˈɪvɪti slˈeɪtɪd fˈɔɹ 2029/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: và kết nối quốc tế dự kiến vào năm 2029.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Key legal foundations include decree number06 2022 and the revised decree number 119 issued in June.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /kˈi lˈiɡəl faʊndˈeɪʃənz ˌɪnklˈud dɪkɹˈi number06 2022 ənd ðə ɹɪvˈaɪzd dɪkɹˈi nˈʌmbɚ 119 ˈɪʃud ɪn dʒˈun/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Các nền tảng pháp lý chính bao gồm nghị định số 06 năm 2022 và nghị định sửa đổi số 119 ban hành vào tháng 6.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: In particular, by 2028, Vietnam aims to establish a national registry system,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ɪn pɚtˈɪkjəlɚ bˈaɪ 2028 viˌɛtnˈɑm ˈeɪmz tˈu ɪstˈæblɪʃ ə nˈæʃənəl ɹˈɛdʒɪstɹi sˈɪstəm/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Đặc biệt, đến năm 2028, Việt Nam đặt mục tiêu thiết lập một hệ thống đăng ký quốc gia,

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: launch a pilot domestic carbon trading platform and roll out carbon credit exchange
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /lˈɔntʃ ə pˈaɪlət dəmˈɛstɪk kˈɑɹbən tɹˈeɪdɪŋ plˈætfˌɔɹm ənd ɹˈoʊl ˈaʊt kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət ɪkstʃˈeɪndʒ/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: ra mắt nền tảng giao dịch carbon trong nước thí điểm và triển khai sàn giao dịch tín chỉ carbon

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: and offsetting alongside programs to raise awareness and build capacity for a carbon market.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd ɔfsˈɛtɪŋ əlˈɔŋsˈaɪd pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæmz tˈu ɹˈeɪz əwˈɛɹnəs ənd bˈɪld kəpˈæsəti fˈɔɹ ə kˈɑɹbən mˈɑɹkət/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: và các chương trình bù đắp song song để nâng cao nhận thức và xây dựng năng lực cho thị trường carbon.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: The Ministry of Agriculture and Environment will lead the development
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ðə mˈɪnəstɹi ˈʌv ˈæɡɹɪkˌʌltʃɚ ənd ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt wˈɪl lˈɛd ðə dɪvˈɛləpmənt/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Bộ Nông nghiệp và Môi trường sẽ dẫn đầu sự phát triển

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: and operation of the registry, ensuring data integration between the registry and the trading platform.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd ˌɑpɚˈeɪʃən ˈʌv ðə ɹˈɛdʒɪstɹi ɛnʃˈʊɹɪŋ dˈeɪtə ˌɪntəɡɹˈeɪʃən bɪtwˈin ðə ɹˈɛdʒɪstɹi ənd ðə tɹˈeɪdɪŋ plˈætfˌɔɹm/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: và vận hành sổ đăng ký, đảm bảo tích hợp dữ liệu giữa sổ đăng ký và nền tảng giao dịch.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: From 2029 onward, Vietnam plans to introduce greenhouse gas emission quotota auctions,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fɹˈʌm 2029 ˈɔnwɚd viˌɛtnˈɑm plˈænz tˈu ˌɪntɹədˈus ɡɹˈinhˌaʊs ɡˈæs ɪmˈɪʃən quotota ˈɑkʃənz/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Từ năm 2029 trở đi, Việt Nam dự kiến sẽ triển khai đấu giá hạn ngạch phát thải khí nhà kính,

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: finalize carbon credit regulations,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fˈaɪnəlˌaɪz kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃənz/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: hoàn thiện quy định về tín chỉ carbon,

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: and establish a full legal framework to connect the domestic market with the global carbon market.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd ɪstˈæblɪʃ ə fˈʊl lˈiɡəl fɹˈeɪmwˌɝk tˈu kənˈɛkt ðə dəmˈɛstɪk mˈɑɹkət wˈɪð ðə ɡlˈoʊbəl kˈɑɹbən mˈɑɹkət/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: và thiết lập một khuôn khổ pháp lý đầy đủ để kết nối thị trường nội địa với thị trường carbon toàn cầu.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: So today we are happy to have Mr.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /sˈoʊ tədˈeɪ wˈi ˈɑɹ hˈæpi tˈu hˈæv mˈɪstɚ/
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, hôm nay chúng tôi rất vui khi có ông

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Denzel Eats in the studio with us, managing director at Pioneer International Consulting,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /dˈɛnzəl ˈits ɪn ðə stˈudiˌoʊ wˈɪð ˈʌs mˈænədʒɪŋ dɚˈɛktɚ ˈæt pˌaɪənˈɪɹ ˌɪntɚnˈæʃənəl kənsˈʌltɪŋ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: uh, to talk about carbon credit, and we will also be connecting with Mr.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈʌ tˈu tˈɔk əbˈaʊt kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət ənd wˈi wˈɪl ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi kənˈɛktɪŋ wˈɪð mˈɪstɚ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Fam Dangan, vice uh, general director of Wuang Energy Group and director of VP Carbon.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fam dangan vˈaɪs ˈʌ dʒˈɛnɚəl dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv wuang ˈɛnɚdʒi ɡɹˈup ənd dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv vˌipˈi kˈɑɹbən/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Thank you so much for coming to our studio today.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ fˈɔɹ kˈʌmɪŋ tˈu ˈaʊɚ stˈudiˌoʊ tədˈeɪ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Great. Thank you very much for having me.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: This company specializes in producing bamboo products for export to the European
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈʌmpənˌi spˈɛʃəlˌaɪzəz ɪn pɹədˈusɪŋ bæmbˈu pɹˈɑdəkts fˈɔɹ ˈɛkspɔɹt tˈu ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: The entire production process is chemical-free, forming a circular chain geared at green transformation.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Beyond sustainable production, the company is also preparing its supply chain for a green transition

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Experts say Vietnam offers ideal conditions for businesses to tap into its abundant carbon credit supply.

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: It also ranks among the world's top four countries in Clean Development Mechanism CDM registrations,
