e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˌɪntɚnˈæʃənəl fənˈæns sˈɛntɚ wˈi mˈʌst fˈoʊkəs nˈɑt ˈoʊnli dˈɪdʒətəl bˈækbˌoʊn/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: but maybe more, more than that, blockchain backbone.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /bˈʌt mˈeɪbi mˈɔɹ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ðˈæt blˈɑktʃˈeɪn bˈækbˌoʊn/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: So with Vietnam already engaging in bilateral mechanisms like the JCM with Japan.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈɪð viˌɛtnˈɑm ɔlɹˈɛdi ɛnɡˈeɪdʒɪŋ ɪn baɪlˈætɚəl mˈɛkənˌɪzəmz lˈaɪk ðə jcm wˈɪð dʒəpˈæn/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Um, what opportunities do you see for regional integration
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈʌm wˈʌt ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz dˈu jˈu sˈi fˈɔɹ ɹˈidʒənəl ˌɪntəɡɹˈeɪʃən/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: or project based linkages with ASEAN or other markets?
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈɔɹ pɹˈɑdʒɛkt bˈeɪst lˈɪŋkɪdʒɪz wˈɪð əzˈiən ˈɔɹ ˈʌðɚ mˈɑɹkəts/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: So I think there are two big advantages from um the existing um JCM uh relationship.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ tˈu bˈɪɡ ædvˈæntɪdʒɪz fɹˈʌm ˈʌm ðə ɪɡzˈɪstɪŋ ˈʌm jcm ˈʌ ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪp/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: First is the development of further bilateral relationships with countries um within Asia.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fˈɝst ˈɪz ðə dɪvˈɛləpmənt ˈʌv fˈɝðɚ baɪlˈætɚəl ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪps wˈɪð kˈʌntɹiz ˈʌm wɪðˈɪn ˈeɪʒə/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: So using the tried and tested uh relationship
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈuzɪŋ ðə tɹˈaɪd ənd tˈɛstɪd ˈʌ ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪp/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: that exists with Japan being rolled out bilaterally um through Asia, I think.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ðˈæt ɪɡzˈɪsts wˈɪð dʒəpˈæn bˈiɪŋ ɹˈoʊld ˈaʊt baɪlˈætɚəli ˈʌm θɹˈu ˈeɪʒə ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: And the second is uh development of um a regional framework through
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd ðə sˈɛkənd ˈɪz ˈʌ dɪvˈɛləpmənt ˈʌv ˈʌm ə ɹˈidʒənəl fɹˈeɪmwˌɝk θɹˈu/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: which um standards um developed in Vietnam can be um compliant
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈʌm stˈændɚdz ˈʌm dɪvˈɛləpt ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm kˈæn bˈi ˈʌm kəmplˈaɪənt/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: with or indeed form the foundation for those multilateral um frameworks.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈɪð ˈɔɹ ˌɪndˈid fˈɔɹm ðə faʊndˈeɪʃən fˈɔɹ ðˈoʊz mˌʌltɪlˈætɚəl ˈʌm fɹˈeɪmwˌɝks/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: So that's really ensuring that the monitoring, reporting and verification process is compliant.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈæts ɹˈɪli ɛnʃˈʊɹɪŋ ðˈæt ðə mˈɑnətɚɪŋ ɹipˈɔɹtɪŋ ənd vˌɛɹəfəkˈeɪʃən pɹˈɑsˌɛs ˈɪz kəmplˈaɪənt/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Um, perhaps we'll see both happening in parallel um more uh bilateral relationships such
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈʌm pɚhˈæps wˈil sˈi bˈoʊθ hˈæpənɪŋ ɪn pˈɛɹəlˌɛl ˈʌm mˈɔɹ ˈʌ baɪlˈætɚəl ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪps sˈʌtʃ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: as the JCM, and then in parallel a multilateral framework um being developed.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈæz ðə jcm ənd ðˈɛn ɪn pˈɛɹəlˌɛl ə mˌʌltɪlˈætɚəl fɹˈeɪmwˌɝk ˈʌm bˈiɪŋ dɪvˈɛləpt/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: But I think, in terms of the the medium-term,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ðə ðə mediumterm/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: um an Azan um carbon trading um regime um is is something definitely
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ˈʌm ˈæn azan ˈʌm kˈɑɹbən tɹˈeɪdɪŋ ˈʌm ɹəʒˈim ˈʌm ˈɪz ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɛfənətli/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: to be uh the target.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /tˈu bˈi ˈʌ ðə tˈɑɹɡət/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: And finally, what changes would you like to see in Vietnam's regulatory environment to further
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ənd fˈaɪnəli wˈʌt tʃˈeɪndʒəz wˈʊd jˈu lˈaɪk tˈu sˈi ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑmz ɹˈɛɡjələtˌɔɹi ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt tˈu fˈɝðɚ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: support carbon credit trading?
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /səpˈɔɹt kˈɑɹbən kɹˈɛdət tɹˈeɪdɪŋ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: We must define uh credit government credit as a financial assets one law,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈi mˈʌst dɪfˈaɪn ˈʌ kɹˈɛdət ɡˈʌvɚmənt kɹˈɛdət ˈæz ə fənˈænʃəl ˈæsˌɛts wˈʌn lˈɔ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: one registry, one standard, and we can set a stable VAT
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈʌn ɹˈɛdʒɪstɹi wˈʌn stˈændɚd ənd wˈi kˈæn sˈɛt ə stˈeɪbəl vˈæt/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: that mean onetop digital portal for project approval stream uh was streamlined,
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ðˈæt mˈin onetop dˈɪdʒətəl pˈɔɹtəl fˈɔɹ pɹˈɑdʒɛkt əpɹˈuvəl stɹˈim ˈʌ wˈɑz stɹˈimlˌaɪnd/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: administrative uh continuous project registration, uh validation, trading project should be simple.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /ədmˈɪnəstɹˌeɪtɪv ˈʌ kəntˈɪnjuəs pɹˈɑdʒɛkt ɹˌɛdʒɪstɹˈeɪʃən ˈʌ vˌælədˈeɪʃən tɹˈeɪdɪŋ pɹˈɑdʒɛkt ʃˈʊd bˈi sˈɪmpəl/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Well, thank you so much uh to the both of you for joining us
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /wˈɛl θˈæŋk jˈu sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ ˈʌ tˈu ðə bˈoʊθ ˈʌv jˈu fˈɔɹ dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ ˈʌs/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: for this very interesting conversation today.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs vˈɛɹi ˈɪntɹəstɪŋ kˌɑnvɚsˈeɪʃən tədˈeɪ/

e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.text: Thank you very much.
e4300a04-1697-4ff2-894b-f58a1d16a072.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu vˈɛɹi mˈʌtʃ/

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: If I could begin to be half of what you think of me,
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ kˈʊd bɪɡˈɪn tˈu bˈi hˈæf ˈʌv wˈʌt jˈu θˈɪŋk ˈʌv mˈi/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Nếu tôi có thể bắt đầu trở thành một nửa những gì bạn nghĩ về tôi,

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I could do about anything.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd dˈu əbˈaʊt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi có thể làm bất cứ điều gì.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I could even learn how to love.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd ˈivɪn lˈɝn hˈaʊ tˈu lˈʌv/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi thậm chí còn có thể học cách yêu.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: When I see the way you act, wondering when I'm coming back.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ sˈi ðə wˈeɪ jˈu ˈækt wˈʌndɚɪŋ wˈɛn ˈaɪm kˈʌmɪŋ bˈæk/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Khi tôi thấy cách bạn hành động, tự hỏi khi nào tôi sẽ quay lại.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I could do about anything.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd dˈu əbˈaʊt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi có thể làm bất cứ điều gì.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I could even learn how to love like you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd ˈivɪn lˈɝn hˈaʊ tˈu lˈʌv lˈaɪk jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi thậm chí có thể học cách yêu như bạn.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I always thought I might be bad.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈɔlwˌeɪz θˈɔt ˈaɪ mˈaɪt bˈi bˈæd/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi luôn nghĩ mình có thể tệ.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: Now I'm sure that it's true cuz I think you're
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈaɪm ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ˈɪts tɹˈu cuz ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk jˈʊɹ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ tôi chắc chắn điều đó là thật vì tôi nghĩ bạn là

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: so good and I'm nothing like you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd ənd ˈaɪm nˈʌθɪŋ lˈaɪk jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: tuyệt vời và tôi không giống bạn chút nào.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: Look at you go.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /lˈʊk ˈæt jˈu ɡˈoʊ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Nhìn bạn kìa.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I just adore you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst ədˈɔɹ jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi chỉ yêu bạn.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I wish that I knew what makes you think I'm so special.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɪʃ ðˈæt ˈaɪ nˈu wˈʌt mˈeɪks jˈu θˈɪŋk ˈaɪm sˈoʊ spˈɛʃəl/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi ước gì tôi biết điều gì khiến bạn nghĩ tôi đặc biệt như vậy.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: If I could begin to do something that does right
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ kˈʊd bɪɡˈɪn tˈu dˈu sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dˈʌz ɹˈaɪt/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Nếu tôi có thể bắt đầu làm điều gì đó đúng đắn

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: by you, I would do about anything.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /bˈaɪ jˈu ˈaɪ wˈʊd dˈu əbˈaʊt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: bởi bạn, tôi sẽ làm bất cứ điều gì.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I would even learn how to love.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈʊd ˈivɪn lˈɝn hˈaʊ tˈu lˈʌv/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi thậm chí còn học cách yêu.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: When I see the way you look, shaken by how long it took,
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ sˈi ðə wˈeɪ jˈu lˈʊk ʃˈeɪkən bˈaɪ hˈaʊ lˈɔŋ ˈɪt tˈʊk/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Khi tôi thấy ánh mắt anh, rung động vì thời gian đã trôi qua quá lâu,

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I can do about anything.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈæn dˈu əbˈaʊt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi có thể làm bất cứ điều gì.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: I could even learn how to love like you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd ˈivɪn lˈɝn hˈaʊ tˈu lˈʌv lˈaɪk jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Tôi thậm chí có thể học cách yêu như bạn.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: Love like you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /lˈʌv lˈaɪk jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Yêu như bạn.

90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.text: Love me like you.
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.ipa: /lˈʌv mˈi lˈaɪk jˈu/
90b15d5f-f09a-42ac-ab83-01b303232bc4.vietnamese_text: Yêu em như cách anh vẫn làm.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: What's up, sunshine?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈʌts ˈʌp sˈʌnʃˌaɪn/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Dạo này thế nào, nắng vàng?

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I am feeling fine.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm fˈilɪŋ fˈaɪn/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tôi cảm thấy ổn.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Thanks to Miss Castellanos, Miss Ray, and all of my besties,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /θˈæŋks tˈu mˈɪs kɑsteɪlˈɑnoʊz mˈɪs ɹˈeɪ ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv mˈaɪ besties/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Nhờ có cô Castellanos, cô Ray, và tất cả những người bạn thân nhất của tôi,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: or shall I say vesties, at Baldwin in Austin, Texas.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ʃˈæl ˈaɪ sˈeɪ vesties ˈæt bˈɔldwən ɪn ˈɔstən tˈɛksəs/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: hoặc tôi nên nói là vesties, tại Baldwin ở Austin, Texas.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Thumbs up for the creativity with each of your thumb prints.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /θˈʌmz ˈʌp fˈɔɹ ðə kɹˌieɪtˈɪvəti wˈɪð ˈitʃ ˈʌv jˈɔɹ θˈʌm pɹˈɪnts/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tuyệt vời cho sự sáng tạo với mỗi dấu vân tay của bạn.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And this, impeccable.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˌɪmpˈɛkəbəl/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Và cái này, hoàn hảo.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I am Coy Wire, it's time to shine with your CNN 10 minutes of news.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm kˈɔɪ wˈaɪɚ ˈɪts tˈaɪm tˈu ʃˈaɪn wˈɪð jˈɔɹ sˈiˈɛnˈɛn 10 mˈɪnəts ˈʌv nˈuz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tôi là Coy Wire, đã đến lúc tỏa sáng với 10 phút tin tức của CNN.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: We begin in Ohio, where a hazardous situation has been unfolding
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈi bɪɡˈɪn ɪn oʊhˈaɪoʊ wˈɛɹ ə hˈæzɚdəs sˌɪtʃuˈeɪʃən hˈæz bˈɪn ənfˈoʊldɪŋ/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta bắt đầu ở Ohio, nơi một tình huống nguy hiểm đang diễn ra

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: after a chemical tank exploded in Toledo.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl tˈæŋk ɪksplˈoʊdəd ɪn təlˈidoʊ/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: sau khi một bể hóa chất phát nổ ở Toledo.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The blast Tuesday night came after a chemical leak,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə blˈæst tˈuzdi nˈaɪt kˈeɪm ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl lˈik/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Vụ nổ tối thứ Ba xảy ra sau một vụ rò rỉ hóa chất,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: forcing hundreds of people to evacuate their homes,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fˈɔɹsɪŋ hˈʌndɹədz ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɪvˈækjəˌeɪt ðˈɛɹ hˈoʊmz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: buộc hàng trăm người phải sơ tán khỏi nhà của họ,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: while others within several miles were told to shelter indoors because of concerns about toxic fumes.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈaɪl ˈʌðɚz wɪðˈɪn sˈɛvɹəl mˈaɪlz wˈɝ tˈoʊld tˈu ʃˈɛltɚ ˈɪndˌɔɹz bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv kənsˈɝnz əbˈaʊt tˈɑksɪk fjˈumz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: trong khi những người khác trong phạm vi vài dặm được yêu cầu trú ẩn trong nhà vì lo ngại về khói độc.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Some residents said that the chemical haze
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈʌm ɹˈɛzɪdənts sˈɛd ðˈæt ðə kˈɛməkəl hˈeɪz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Một số cư dân cho biết làn khói hóa chất

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: was so thick they initially thought there was a fire.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈɑz sˈoʊ θˈɪk ðˈeɪ ˌɪnˈɪʃəli θˈɔt ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz ə fˈaɪɚ/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: dày đến mức ban đầu họ nghĩ có cháy.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I assumed it was a house fire.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ əsˈumd ˈɪt wˈɑz ə hˈaʊs fˈaɪɚ/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã cho rằng đó là một vụ cháy nhà.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And when I opened up the door and and and person peeked out,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ˈaɪ ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp ðə dˈɔɹ ənd ənd ənd pˈɝsən pˈikt ˈaʊt/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Và khi tôi mở cửa ra và và và người đó ló đầu ra,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I realized it was something different, and that's when I grabbed my phone.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈiəlˌaɪzd ˈɪt wˈɑz sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt ənd ðˈæts wˈɛn ˈaɪ ɡɹˈæbd mˈaɪ fˈoʊn/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tôi nhận ra đó là một thứ gì đó khác, và đó là lúc tôi lấy điện thoại của mình.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And then when my nose started burning, I knew exactly it was definitely something different.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈɛn mˈaɪ nˈoʊz stˈɑɹtɪd bˈɝnɪŋ ˈaɪ nˈu ɪɡzˈæktli ˈɪt wˈɑz dˈɛfənətli sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Và rồi khi mũi tôi bắt đầu bỏng rát, tôi biết chính xác đó chắc chắn là một thứ gì đó khác biệt.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It was a smell.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ə smˈɛl/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Đó là một mùi hương.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It was the smell was so was so bad,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ðə smˈɛl wˈɑz sˈoʊ wˈɑz sˈoʊ bˈæd/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Mùi đó thật kinh khủng,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I I literally had to cover my my mouth and my nose.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈaɪ lˈɪtɚəli hˈæd tˈu kˈʌvɚ mˈaɪ mˈaɪ mˈaʊθ ənd mˈaɪ nˈoʊz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Tôi thực sự phải che miệng và mũi của mình.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: That's how bad it it was.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæts hˈaʊ bˈæd ˈɪt ˈɪt wˈɑz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Mọi chuyện tệ đến mức đó.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The company that owns the tank says it contains glycidyl methacrylate,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ðˈæt ˈoʊnz ðə tˈæŋk sˈɛz ˈɪt kəntˈeɪnz glycidyl methacrylate/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Công ty sở hữu bồn chứa cho biết nó chứa glycidyl methacrylate,

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: an industrial chemical used to help make certain plastics, paints, and coatings.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæn ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl kˈɛməkəl jˈuzd tˈu hˈɛlp mˈeɪk sˈɝtən plˈæstɪks pˈeɪnts ənd kˈoʊtɪŋz/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: một hóa chất công nghiệp được sử dụng để sản xuất một số loại nhựa, sơn và chất phủ.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Health officials say exposure can irritate the eyes, skin, and respiratory system.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /hˈɛlθ əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ kˈæn ˈɪɹɪtˌeɪt ðə ˈaɪz skˈɪn ənd ɹˈɛspɚətˌɔɹi sˈɪstəm/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Các quan chức y tế cho biết việc tiếp xúc có thể gây kích ứng mắt, da và hệ hô hấp.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The city's mayor says the exposure is not expected to cause a lasting health disturbance.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə sˈɪtiz mˈeɪɚ sˈɛz ðə ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ ˈɪz nˈɑt ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu kˈɑz ə lˈæstɪŋ hˈɛlθ dɪstˈɝbəns/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Thị trưởng thành phố cho biết việc phơi nhiễm này không được dự kiến sẽ gây ra rối loạn sức khỏe kéo dài.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Officials say the leak was due to a quote error
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ðə lˈik wˈɑz dˈu tˈu ə kwˈoʊt ˈɛɹɚ/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: Các quan chức cho biết rò rỉ là do lỗi trích dẫn

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that occurred when the material was being transferred.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt əkˈɝd wˈɛn ðə mətˈɪɹiəl wˈɑz bˈiɪŋ tɹænsfˈɝd/
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.vietnamese_text: đã xảy ra khi vật liệu đang được chuyển giao.

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: As of this taping, first responders, hazmat,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæz ˈʌv ðˈɪs tˈeɪpɪŋ fˈɝst ɹɪspˈɑndɚz hazmat/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and safety teams hadn't been approaching the tank in case there would be more explosions.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd sˈeɪfti tˈimz hˈædənt bˈɪn əpɹˈoʊtʃɪŋ ðə tˈæŋk ɪn kˈeɪs ðˈɛɹ wˈʊd bˈi mˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And here's your knowledge drop some chemicals that are stable
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd hˈɪɹz jˈɔɹ nˈɑlədʒ dɹˈɑp sˈʌm kˈɛmɪkəlz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ stˈeɪbəl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: as liquids can become far more dangerous if they heat up,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæz lˈɪkwədz kˈæn bɪkˈʌm fˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ dˈeɪndʒɚəs ˈɪf ðˈeɪ hˈit ˈʌp/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: vaporize, or react unexpectedly, which is why emergency crews aren't just fighting
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /vˈeɪpɚˌaɪz ˈɔɹ ɹiˈækt ˌʌnɪkspˈɛktɪdli wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz wˈaɪ ɪmˈɝdʒənsi kɹˈuz ˈɑɹənt dʒˈʌst fˈaɪtɪŋ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: what they can see, they're monitoring what's in the air.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ kˈæn sˈi ðˈɛɹ mˈɑnətɚɪŋ wˈʌts ɪn ðə ˈɛɹ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: In the past 5 months, there have been evacuations, even deaths,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ɪn ðə pˈæst 5 mˈʌnθs ðˈɛɹ hˈæv bˈɪn ɪvˌækjəwˈeɪʃənz ˈivɪn dˈɛθs/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: across the US after chemical leaks or explosions in Southern California,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /əkɹˈɔs ðə ˈʌs ˈæftɚ kˈɛməkəl lˈiks ˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz ɪn sˈʌðɚn kˌæləfˈɔɹnjə/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Washington State, and a recycling plant also in Toledo just 2 months ago.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈɑʃɪŋtən stˈeɪt ənd ə ɹisˈaɪkəlɪŋ plˈænt ˈɔlsoʊ ɪn təlˈidoʊ dʒˈʌst 2 mˈʌnθs əɡˈoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Pop quiz, hotshot what country is the world's largest coffee producer?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /pˈɑp kwˈɪz hˈɑʃˌɑt wˈʌt kˈʌntɹi ˈɪz ðə wˈɝldz lˈɑɹdʒəst kˈɑfi pɹədˈusɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Brazil, Indonesia, Colombia, or Ethiopia?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˌɪndoʊnˈiʒə kəlˈʌmbiə ˈɔɹ ˌiθiˈoʊpiə/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: If you said Brazil, you are no average Joe.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu sˈɛd bɹəzˈɪl jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈoʊ ˈævɚɪdʒ dʒˈoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Brazil produces roughly 1/3 of the world's coffee,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl pɹədˈusəz ɹˈʌfli 13 ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz kˈɑfi/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and if you like sugar in yours, they've got you covered there, too.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪk ʃˈʊɡɚ ɪn jˈʊɹz ðˈeɪv ɡˈɑt jˈu kˈʌvɚd ðˈɛɹ tˈu/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Brazil is also the world's biggest producer of sugarcane.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə wˈɝldz bˈɪɡəst pɹədˈusɚ ˈʌv ʃˈʊɡɚkˌeɪn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Millions of workers in Brazil, Latin America's largest economy,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /mˈɪljənz ˈʌv wˈɝkɚz ɪn bɹəzˈɪl lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkəz lˈɑɹdʒəst ɪkˈɑnəmi/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: are getting something many people around the world would love an extra day off.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɑɹ ɡˈɛtɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ mˈɛni pˈipəl ɚˈaʊnd ðə wˈɝld wˈʊd lˈʌv ˈæn ˈɛkstɹə dˈeɪ ˈɔf/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: As Brazil heads to the polls this weekend to elect their next president,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæz bɹəzˈɪl hˈɛdz tˈu ðə pˈoʊlz ðˈɪs wˈikˌɛnd tˈu ɪlˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ nˈɛkst pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: the nation's Senate has voted to reduce the country's work week from 6 days to 5,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə nˈeɪʃənz sˈɛnət hˈæz vˈoʊtɪd tˈu ɹədˈus ðə kˈʌntɹiz wˈɝk wˈik fɹˈʌm 6 dˈeɪz tˈu 5/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: from 44 hours to 40, without reducing pay.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fɹˈʌm 44 ˈaʊɚz tˈu 40 wɪθˈaʊt ɹədˈusɪŋ pˈeɪ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It's Brazil's largest labor reform in decades,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪts bɹəzˈɪlz lˈɑɹdʒəst lˈeɪbɚ ɹəfˈɔɹm ɪn dɛkˈeɪdz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and is expected to affect more than 35 million workers.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ˈɪz ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu əfˈɛkt mˈɔɹ ðˈæn 35 mˈɪljən wˈɝkɚz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Brazil is following a growing trend across Latin America after Mexico,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz fˈɑloʊɪŋ ə ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ tɹˈɛnd əkɹˈɔs lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkə ˈæftɚ mˈɛksəkˌoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Chile, and Colombia recently passed similar laws to cap hours and benefit workers.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /tʃˈɪli ənd kəlˈʌmbiə ɹˈisəntli pˈæst sˈɪməlɚ lˈɔz tˈu kˈæp ˈaʊɚz ənd bˈɛnəfɪt wˈɝkɚz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The move is seen as a big legislative win for incumbent President Lula da Silva,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə mˈuv ˈɪz sˈin ˈæz ə bˈɪɡ lˈɛdʒəslˌeɪtɪv wˈɪn fˈɔɹ ˌɪnkˈʌmbənt pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt lˈulə dˈɑ sˈɪlvə/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: who's currently seeking a fourth non-consecutive term.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /hˈuz kˈɝəntli sˈikɪŋ ə fˈɔɹθ nonconsecutive tˈɝm/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: He's currently locked in a tight race with Senator Flavio Bolsonaro,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /hˈiz kˈɝəntli lˈɑkt ɪn ə tˈaɪt ɹˈeɪs wˈɪð sˈɛnətɚ flˈɑvioʊ bolsonaro/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who Lula defeated in 2022.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə sˈʌn ˈʌv fˈɔɹmɚ pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt jair bolsonaro hˈu lˈulə dɪfˈitəd ɪn 2022/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The two face off in a runoff election this Sunday.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə tˈu fˈeɪs ˈɔf ɪn ə ɹˈʌnˌɔf ɪlˈɛkʃən ðˈɪs sˈʌndˌeɪ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: You've probably heard of Apple's newest phone.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /jˈuv pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈɝd ˈʌv ˈæpəlz nˈuəst fˈoʊn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Officially launching tomorrow, the tech giant isn't just upgrading it is folding it in half.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /əfˈɪʃəli lˈɔntʃɪŋ təmˈɑɹˌoʊ ðə tˈɛk dʒˈaɪənt ˈɪzənt dʒˈʌst əpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪz fˈoʊldɪŋ ˈɪt ɪn hˈæf/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable smartphone,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈɪz ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable smˈɑɹtfˌoʊn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: but some might say it comes with about 2,000 problems.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt sˈʌm mˈaɪt sˈeɪ ˈɪt kˈʌmz wˈɪð əbˈaʊt 2000 pɹˈɑbləmz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: First, it cost 2,000 bucks.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fˈɝst ˈɪt kˈɑst 2000 bˈʌks/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And what about the engineering challenges?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹɪŋ tʃˈæləndʒɪz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: How do you make a screen bend thousands of times without cracking?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈu jˈu mˈeɪk ə skɹˈin bˈɛnd θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv tˈaɪmz wɪθˈaʊt kɹˈækɪŋ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: But could its design make it more useful or just more expensive?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt kˈʊd ˈɪts dɪzˈaɪn mˈeɪk ˈɪt mˈɔɹ jˈusfəl ˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɛnsɪv/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Apple gave CNN's Lisa Eadicicco one to take for a test fold.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæpəl ɡˈeɪv sˈiˈɛnˈɛnz lˈisə eadicicco wˈʌn tˈu tˈeɪk fˈɔɹ ə tˈɛst fˈoʊld/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: This does feel sort of like an iPad, but not quite.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɪs dˈʌz fˈil sˈɔɹt ˈʌv lˈaɪk ˈæn ˈaɪpˌæd bˈʌt nˈɑt kwˈaɪt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: This is the iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable iPhone.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And this is a really big deal for Apple
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə ɹˈɪli bˈɪɡ dˈil fˈɔɹ ˈæpəl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: because it's the first time the iPhone has had a significant change like
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts ðə fˈɝst tˈaɪm ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn hˈæz hˈæd ə səɡnˈɪfɪkənt tʃˈeɪndʒ lˈaɪk/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: this in its nearly 20-year history.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɪs ɪn ˈɪts nˈɪɹli 20year hˈɪstɚi/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: So, I thought the Duo was going to feel more awkward,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɔt ðə dˈuoʊ wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu fˈil mˈɔɹ ˈɑkwɚd/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: but it's really about the same size as a passport.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts ɹˈɪli əbˈaʊt ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz ˈæz ə pˈæspˌɔɹt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And just for comparison, this is the latest foldable from Samsung,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst fˈɔɹ kəmpˈɛɹəsən ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə lˈeɪtəst foldable fɹˈʌm sˈæmsˌʌŋ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: which has been a leader in the foldable market so far.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ hˈæz bˈɪn ə lˈidɚ ɪn ðə foldable mˈɑɹkət sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I'm going to be using the iPhone Duo
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈi jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: as my regular phone for the next week to see how it holds up.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæz mˈaɪ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ fˈoʊn fˈɔɹ ðə nˈɛkst wˈik tˈu sˈi hˈaʊ ˈɪt hˈoʊldz ˈʌp/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: So, this is my first full day with the iPhone Duo.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈɪs ˈɪz mˈaɪ fˈɝst fˈʊl dˈeɪ wˈɪð ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I am currently.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm kˈɝəntli/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: In the car, driving down to Cape May,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ɪn ðə kˈɑɹ dɹˈaɪvɪŋ dˈaʊn tˈu kˈeɪp mˈeɪ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I've been using the iPhone Duo on this trip to read the news,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪv bˈɪn jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈɑn ðˈɪs tɹˈɪp tˈu ɹˈɛd ðə nˈuz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: scroll through social media.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /skɹˈoʊl θɹˈu sˈoʊʃəl mˈidiə/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It is nicer to kind of have this much bigger screen
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz nˈaɪsɚ tˈu kˈaɪnd ˈʌv hˈæv ðˈɪs mˈʌtʃ bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that feels more like a tablet.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt fˈilz mˈɔɹ lˈaɪk ə tˈæblət/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It does make it a lot easier to read.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt dˈʌz mˈeɪk ˈɪt ə lˈɑt ˈiziɚ tˈu ɹˈɛd/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And so far, I'm not really noticing the crease that much at all.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ ˈaɪm nˈɑt ɹˈɪli nˈoʊtɪsɪŋ ðə kɹˈis ðˈæt mˈʌtʃ ˈæt ˈɔl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I thought it would be a little bit more noticeable the more
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɔt ˈɪt wˈʊd bˈi ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt mˈɔɹ nˈoʊtəsəbəl ðə mˈɔɹ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that I've used it, but so far, so good.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈaɪv jˈuzd ˈɪt bˈʌt sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Let's take it out for a run.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /lˈɛts tˈeɪk ˈɪt ˈaʊt fˈɔɹ ə ɹˈʌn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I'm pretty impressed with how light this felt while I was running.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪm pɹˈɪti ˌɪmpɹˈɛst wˈɪð hˈaʊ lˈaɪt ðˈɪs fˈɛlt wˈaɪl ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɹˈʌnɪŋ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: It actually didn't feel any different than if I was running with my regular iPhone.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈæktʃˌuəli dˈɪdənt fˈil ˈɛni dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæn ˈɪf ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɹˈʌnɪŋ wˈɪð mˈaɪ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Next up was the Cape May Zoo, where I put the camera to the test.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /nˈɛkst ˈʌp wˈɑz ðə kˈeɪp mˈeɪ zˈu wˈɛɹ ˈaɪ pˈʊt ðə kˈæmɚə tˈu ðə tˈɛst/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The camera doesn't feel as awkward as you think,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə kˈæmɚə dˈʌzənt fˈil ˈæz ˈɑkwɚd ˈæz jˈu θˈɪŋk/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and sometimes it was nice having the bigger screen as a viewfinder.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪt wˈɑz nˈaɪs hˈævɪŋ ðə bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin ˈæz ə vjˈufˌaɪndɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I liked being able to prop up the phone to steady my shot,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪkt bˈiɪŋ ˈeɪbəl tˈu pɹˈɑp ˈʌp ðə fˈoʊn tˈu stˈɛdi mˈaɪ ʃˈɑt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: but the zoom isn't as good as what you'd get on the iPhone 18 Pro.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə zˈum ˈɪzənt ˈæz ɡˈʊd ˈæz wˈʌt jˈud ɡˈɛt ˈɑn ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn 18 pɹˈoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: But be warned, the inner camera behind the display isn't great.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt bˈi wˈɔɹnd ðə ˈɪnɚ kˈæmɚə bɪhˈaɪnd ðə dɪsplˈeɪ ˈɪzənt ɡɹˈeɪt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Photos can look dark and kind of grainy.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fˈoʊtˌoʊz kˈæn lˈʊk dˈɑɹk ənd kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɡɹˈeɪni/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: By day three, I was thinking about different creative ways to use the front screen,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈaɪ dˈeɪ θɹˈi ˈaɪ wˈɑz θˈɪŋkɪŋ əbˈaʊt dˈɪfɚənt kɹiˈeɪtɪv wˈeɪz tˈu jˈus ðə fɹˈʌnt skɹˈin/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: like dragging and dropping photos from my gallery to a text message at dinner.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /lˈaɪk dɹˈæɡɪŋ ənd dɹˈɑpɪŋ fˈoʊtˌoʊz fɹˈʌm mˈaɪ ɡˈælɚi tˈu ə tˈɛkst mˈɛsədʒ ˈæt dˈɪnɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: This is day five with the iPhone Duo,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz dˈeɪ fˈaɪv wˈɪð ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and we're about to hit the road to head home from Cape May.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd wˈiɹ əbˈaʊt tˈu hˈɪt ðə ɹˈoʊd tˈu hˈɛd hˈoʊm fɹˈʌm kˈeɪp mˈeɪ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: We have a pretty long car ride coming up,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈi hˈæv ə pɹˈɪti lˈɔŋ kˈɑɹ ɹˈaɪd kˈʌmɪŋ ˈʌp/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: which is the perfect time to play some games on the iPhone Duo.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðə pɚfˈɛkt tˈaɪm tˈu plˈeɪ sˈʌm ɡˈeɪmz ˈɑn ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: This is one of the games that is actually optimized for this big screen.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ɡˈeɪmz ðˈæt ˈɪz ˈæktʃˌuəli ˈɑptəmˌaɪzd fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs bˈɪɡ skɹˈin/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: As you can see, it takes up the entire display, almost edge to edge.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈæz jˈu kˈæn sˈi ˈɪt tˈeɪks ˈʌp ðə ɪntˈaɪɚ dɪsplˈeɪ ˈɔlmˌoʊst ˈɛdʒ tˈu ˈɛdʒ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: But as I've been testing this phone, I've actually noticed
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈæz ˈaɪv bˈɪn tˈɛstɪŋ ðˈɪs fˈoʊn ˈaɪv ˈæktʃˌuəli nˈoʊtəst/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that a lot of apps aren't optimized for that bigger screen
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈæps ˈɑɹənt ˈɑptəmˌaɪzd fˈɔɹ ðˈæt bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: because developers still need to update their apps.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz dɪvˈɛləpɚz stˈɪl nˈid tˈu əpdˈeɪt ðˈɛɹ ˈæps/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: So, after using the iPhone Duo for about a week,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈæftɚ jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ fˈɔɹ əbˈaʊt ə wˈik/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I've been wondering, why is Apple releasing a foldable iPhone now?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪv bˈɪn wˈʌndɚɪŋ wˈaɪ ˈɪz ˈæpəl ɹilˈisɪŋ ə foldable ˈaɪfˌoʊn nˈaʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: I think part of that might come down to the fact
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðˈæt mˈaɪt kˈʌm dˈaʊn tˈu ðə fˈækt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that Apple has faced pressure to prove it can still innovate
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈæpəl hˈæz fˈeɪst pɹˈɛʃɚ tˈu pɹˈuv ˈɪt kˈæn stˈɪl ˈɪnəvˌeɪt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and build on the success of the iPhone.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd bˈɪld ˈɑn ðə səksˈɛs ˈʌv ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Will the iPhone Duo be that answer?
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈɪl ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ bˈi ðˈæt ˈænsɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: We'll find out when the phone launches on October 23rd.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈil fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt wˈɛn ðə fˈoʊn lˈɔntʃəz ˈɑn ɑktˈoʊbɚ 23rd/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: From the revolutionary streets of the 18th century to modern political demonstrations,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ðə ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃənˌɛɹi stɹˈits ˈʌv ðə 18th sˈɛntʃɚi tˈu mˈɑdɚn pəlˈɪtəkəl dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃənz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: classical music has always been a key tool for political mobilization.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk hˈæz ˈɔlwˌeɪz bˈɪn ə kˈi tˈul fˈɔɹ pəlˈɪtəkəl mˌoʊbələzˈeɪʃən/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The lyrics were used as a way to spread news, rally citizens, and empower demonstrators.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə lˈɪɹɪks wˈɝ jˈuzd ˈæz ə wˈeɪ tˈu spɹˈɛd nˈuz ɹˈæli sˈɪtəzənz ənd ɪmpˈaʊɚ dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪtɚz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Now, amid the political unrest in France over the surging cost of living
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /nˈaʊ əmˈɪd ðə pəlˈɪtəkəl ənɹˈɛst ɪn fɹˈæns ˈoʊvɚ ðə sˈɝdʒɪŋ kˈɑst ˈʌv lˈɪvɪŋ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and the lack of government funding for education, the Orchestre du Nouvel Monde,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ðə lˈæk ˈʌv ɡˈʌvɚmənt fˈʌndɪŋ fˈɔɹ ˌɛdʒəkˈeɪʃən ðə orchestre dˈu nˈuvəl mˈɑnd/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: or the Orchestra of the New World, is tapping back into their revolutionary rhythms.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈʌv ðə nˈu wˈɝld ˈɪz tˈæpɪŋ bˈæk ˈɪntu ðˈɛɹ ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃənˌɛɹi ɹˈɪðəmz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Aurivane Scatola explains how.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /aurivane scatola ɪksplˈeɪnz hˈaʊ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: These musicians have joined protests in France by providing the soundtrack.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈiz mjuzˈɪʃənz hˈæv dʒˈɔɪnd pɹˈoʊtˌɛsts ɪn fɹˈæns bˈaɪ pɹəvˈaɪdɪŋ ðə sˈaʊndtɹˌæk/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: For us, a symphonic orchestra should be wherever it's more useful,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ˈʌs ə sɪmfˈɑnɪk ˈɔɹkəstɹə ʃˈʊd bˈi wɛɹˈɛvɚ ˈɪts mˈɔɹ jˈusfəl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and today it's in the streets The goal of the Orchestra of the New World
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd tədˈeɪ ˈɪts ɪn ðə stɹˈits ðə ɡˈoʊl ˈʌv ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈʌv ðə nˈu wˈɝld/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: is to politicize classical music and bring it to the heart of the struggles,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪz tˈu pəlˈɪtɪsˌaɪz klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk ənd bɹˈɪŋ ˈɪt tˈu ðə hˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðə stɹˈʌɡəlz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and we want to turn the orchestra into a space of gathering and collective power.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu tˈɝn ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈɪntu ə spˈeɪs ˈʌv ɡˈæðɚɪŋ ənd kəlˈɛktɪv pˈaʊɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The Orchestre de Nouvel Monde says they're committed to social and climate justice in France.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə orchestre dˈi nˈuvəl mˈɑnd sˈɛz ðˈɛɹ kəmˈɪtɪd tˈu sˈoʊʃəl ənd klˈaɪmət dʒˈʌstəs ɪn fɹˈæns/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: We are not here to use classical music to rehabilitate the image of the movement,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈi ˈɑɹ nˈɑt hˈiɹ tˈu jˈus klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk tˈu ɹˌihəbˈɪlətˌeɪt ðə ˈɪmədʒ ˈʌv ðə mˈuvmənt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: but we want to empower it.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu ɪmpˈaʊɚ ˈɪt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: We want to empower
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu ɪmpˈaʊɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: it because we believe in the power of classical music The protest started in support
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt bɪkˈɔz wˈi bɪlˈiv ɪn ðə pˈaʊɚ ˈʌv klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk ðə pɹˈoʊtˌɛst stˈɑɹtɪd ɪn səpˈɔɹt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: of striking teachers, and in the past month tens of thousands of people,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈʌv stɹˈaɪkɪŋ tˈitʃɚz ənd ɪn ðə pˈæst mˈʌnθ tˈɛnz ˈʌv θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv pˈipəl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: including students and unions, have taken to the streets across France, with some demonstrations turning violent.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˌɪnklˈudɪŋ stˈudənts ənd jˈunjənz hˈæv tˈeɪkən tˈu ðə stɹˈits əkɹˈɔs fɹˈæns wˈɪð sˈʌm dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃənz tˈɝnɪŋ vˈaɪələnt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Today's story getting a 10 out of 10.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /tədˈeɪz stˈɔɹi ɡˈɛtɪŋ ə 10 ˈaʊt ˈʌv 10/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Scientists in London inventing a solution to pop a real-world pollution problem.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈaɪəntɪsts ɪn lˈʌndən ˌɪnvˈɛntɪŋ ə səlˈuʃən tˈu pˈɑp ə realworld pəlˈuʃən pɹˈɑbləm/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The newly established BioLoop says that they have developed the first balloon
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə nˈuli ɪstˈæblɪʃt bioloop sˈɛz ðˈæt ðˈeɪ hˈæv dɪvˈɛləpt ðə fˈɝst bəlˈun/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: that is biodegradable or something that can be broken down by bacteria
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz bˌaɪoʊdəɡɹˈeɪdəbəl ˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt kˈæn bˈi bɹˈoʊkən dˈaʊn bˈaɪ bæktˈɪɹiə/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and fungi and is turning it into natural substance like water, carbon dioxide, or nutrients.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd fˈʌndʒaɪ ənd ˈɪz tˈɝnɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪntu nˈætʃɚəl sˈʌbstəns lˈaɪk wˈɔtɚ kˈɑɹbən daɪˈɑksˌaɪd ˈɔɹ nˈutɹiənts/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: The team says BioLoop is made from rubber that has been treated to break down organically.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðə tˈim sˈɛz bioloop ˈɪz mˈeɪd fɹˈʌm ɹˈʌbɚ ðˈæt hˈæz bˈɪn tɹˈitɪd tˈu bɹˈeɪk dˈaʊn ɔɹɡˈænɪkli/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: While natural latex is a fluid that comes out of a latex tree,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /wˈaɪl nˈætʃɚəl lˈeɪtˌɛks ˈɪz ə flˈuəd ðˈæt kˈʌmz ˈaʊt ˈʌv ə lˈeɪtˌɛks tɹˈi/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: it becomes rubber through a process called sulfur vulcanization,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɪt bɪkˈʌmz ɹˈʌbɚ θɹˈu ə pɹˈɑsˌɛs kˈɔld sˈʌlfɚ vulcanization/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: and that is the process that has toxic chemicals which can leach into the environment.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə pɹˈɑsˌɛs ðˈæt hˈæz tˈɑksɪk kˈɛmɪkəlz wˈɪtʃ kˈæn lˈitʃ ˈɪntu ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: So, existing latex balloons in their form have a terrible impact on the environment.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /sˈoʊ ɪɡzˈɪstɪŋ lˈeɪtˌɛks bəlˈunz ɪn ðˈɛɹ fˈɔɹm hˈæv ə tˈɛɹəbəl ˌɪmpˈækt ˈɑn ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: They're responsible for killing over a million seabirds every single year,
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ɹispˈɑnsəbəl fˈɔɹ kˈɪlɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ə mˈɪljən seabirds ˈɛvɚi sˈɪŋɡəl jˈɪɹ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: 100,000 sea turtles, and they leach carcinogens and toxins into our environment.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /100000 sˈi tˈɝtəlz ənd ðˈeɪ lˈitʃ kɑɹsˈɪnədʒənz ənd tˈɑksənz ˈɪntu ˈaʊɚ ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: BioLoop plans to develop more biodegradable party balloons, then move on to latex gloves, medical devices.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /bioloop plˈænz tˈu dɪvˈɛləp mˈɔɹ bˌaɪoʊdəɡɹˈeɪdəbəl pˈɑɹti bəlˈunz ðˈɛn mˈuv ˈɑn tˈu lˈeɪtˌɛks ɡlˈʌvz mˈɛdəkəl dɪvˈaɪsəz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Even clothing and apparel.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈivɪn klˈoʊðɪŋ ənd əpˈæɹəl/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: All right, superstars, shout-out time.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt sˌupɚstˈɑɹz shoutout tˈaɪm/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Our first one is going to Mrs.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ˈaʊɚ fˈɝst wˈʌn ˈɪz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu mˈɪsɪz/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Caballero and all of our friends at Bonita Vista in Chula Vista, California. Rise up.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /kˌæbəjˈɛɹoʊ ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ fɹˈɛndz ˈæt boʊnˈitə vˈɪstə ɪn tʃˈulə vˈɪstə kˌæləfˈɔɹnjə ɹˈaɪz ˈʌp/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: And for our next shout-out, we are sending some love up to Seattle, Washington.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ nˈɛkst shoutout wˈi ˈɑɹ sˈɛndɪŋ sˈʌm lˈʌv ˈʌp tˈu siˈætəl wˈɑʃɪŋtən/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Miss Bargfrede, Mr.
273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.ipa: /mˈɪs bargfrede mˈɪstɚ/

273549ce-8758-49b6-aded-96047d8b784e.text: Kenyon, and all of our friends at Eckstein Middle.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Part one. You will hear a woman from a job agency giving information
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /pˈɑɹt wˈʌn jˈu wˈɪl hˈiɹ ə wˈʊmən fɹˈʌm ə dʒˈɑb ˈeɪdʒənsi ɡˈɪvɪŋ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Phần một. Bạn sẽ nghe một người phụ nữ từ một công ty giới thiệu việc làm cung cấp thông tin

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: to a man about work
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /tˈu ə mˈæn əbˈaʊt wˈɝk/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: cho một người đàn ông về công việc

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: in a chain of restaurants.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ɪn ə tʃˈeɪn ˈʌv ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnts/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: trong một chuỗi nhà hàng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /fˈɝst jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz wˈʌn tˈu fˈaɪv/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Đầu tiên, bạn có một chút thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ một đến năm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən kˈɛɹfəli ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz wˈʌn tˈu fˈaɪv/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy lắng nghe cẩn thận và trả lời các câu hỏi từ một đến năm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, I understand you're interested in restaurant work.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ ˌʌndɚstˈænd jˈʊɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnt wˈɝk/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vậy, tôi hiểu bạn quan tâm đến công việc nhà hàng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Yes, I've got a bit of experience and I can provide references.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaɪv ɡˈɑt ə bˈɪt ˈʌv ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ənd ˈaɪ kˈæn pɹəvˈaɪd ɹˈɛfɚənsɪz/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vâng, tôi có một chút kinh nghiệm và tôi có thể cung cấp các tài liệu tham khảo.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's good. I can check all that later.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts ɡˈʊd ˈaɪ kˈæn tʃˈɛk ˈɔl ðˈæt lˈeɪtɚ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tốt. Tôi có thể kiểm tra tất cả những điều đó sau.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Now, Milo's restaurants have some vacancies at the moment.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈaʊ milo's ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnts hˈæv sˈʌm vˈeɪkənsiz ˈæt ðə mˈoʊmənt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Hiện tại, Nhà hàng Milo có một số vị trí đang tuyển dụng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: They're a really good company to work for, lots of benefits.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ə ɹˈɪli ɡˈʊd kˈʌmpənˌi tˈu wˈɝk fˈɔɹ lˈɑts ˈʌv bˈɛnəfɪts/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Họ là một công ty rất tốt để làm việc, có nhiều phúc lợi.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: All right. Yes.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt jˈɛs/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Được rồi. Vâng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: They've got a very good reputation for looking after staff.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈeɪv ɡˈɑt ə vˈɛɹi ɡˈʊd ɹˌɛpjətˈeɪʃən fˈɔɹ lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæftɚ stˈæf/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Họ có danh tiếng rất tốt về việc chăm sóc nhân viên.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: For example, all employees get training, even temporary staff.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl ˈɔl ɛmplˈɔɪiz ɡˈɛt tɹˈeɪnɪŋ ˈivɪn tˈɛmpɚˌɛɹi stˈæf/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ví dụ, tất cả nhân viên đều được đào tạo, kể cả nhân viên tạm thời.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Oh, really? That's quite unusual, isn't it? Certainly is.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈoʊ ɹˈɪli ðˈæts kwˈaɪt ənjˈuʒˌuəl ˈɪzənt ˈɪt sˈɝtənli ˈɪz/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ồ, thật vậy sao? Điều đó khá lạ, phải không? Chắc chắn rồi.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: And do staff get free uniforms, too?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd dˈu stˈæf ɡˈɛt fɹˈi jˈunəfˌɔɹmz tˈu/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Và nhân viên có được miễn phí đồng phục không?

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Um you just need to wear a white t-shirt and black trousers, it says here.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈʌm jˈu dʒˈʌst nˈid tˈu wˈɛɹ ə wˈaɪt tshirt ənd blˈæk tɹˈaʊzɚz ˈɪt sˈɛz hˈiɹ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Bạn chỉ cần mặc áo phông trắng và quần đen, ở đây ghi vậy.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, I guess not.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ ɡˈɛs nˈɑt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vậy, tôi đoán là không.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: But another benefit of working for a big company like
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt ənˈʌðɚ bˈɛnəfɪt ˈʌv wˈɝkɪŋ fˈɔɹ ə bˈɪɡ kˈʌmpənˌi lˈaɪk/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nhưng một lợi ích khác khi làm việc cho một công ty lớn như

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: this is that you can get a discount at any of their restaurants.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn ɡˈɛt ə dɪskˈaʊnt ˈæt ˈɛni ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnts/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: đây là bạn có thể được giảm giá tại bất kỳ nhà hàng nào của họ.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Even at weekends?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈæt wˈikˌɛndz/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ngay cả vào cuối tuần?

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: No, but you'll be working then anyway.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈoʊ bˈʌt jˈul bˈi wˈɝkɪŋ ðˈɛn ˈɛniwˌeɪ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Không, nhưng dù sao thì bạn cũng sẽ làm việc lúc đó.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Oh, yes, I suppose so.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈoʊ jˈɛs ˈaɪ səpˈoʊz sˈoʊ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ồ, vâng, tôi đoán vậy.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Um most of their restaurants are in the city center, aren't they?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈʌm mˈoʊst ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnts ˈɑɹ ɪn ðə sˈɪti sˈɛntɚ ˈɑɹənt ðˈeɪ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Hầu hết các nhà hàng của họ đều ở trung tâm thành phố, phải không?

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, easy to get to by bus?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈizi tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu bˈaɪ bˈʌs/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vậy, đi xe buýt đến đó có dễ không?

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Yes, that's right.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˈæts ɹˈaɪt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vâng, đúng vậy.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: But if you have to do a late shift and finish work
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv tˈu dˈu ə lˈeɪt ʃˈɪft ənd fˈɪnɪʃ wˈɝk/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nhưng nếu bạn phải làm ca đêm và kết thúc công việc

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: after midnight, the company will pay for you to get a taxi home.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈæftɚ mˈɪdnˌaɪt ðə kˈʌmpənˌi wˈɪl pˈeɪ fˈɔɹ jˈu tˈu ɡˈɛt ə tˈæksi hˈoʊm/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: sau nửa đêm, công ty sẽ trả tiền taxi cho bạn về nhà.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I probably won't need one.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ pɹˈɑbəblˌi wˈoʊnt nˈid wˈʌn/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tôi có lẽ sẽ không cần một cái.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I think I'd use my bike. Okay.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈaɪd jˈus mˈaɪ bˈaɪk ˌoʊkˈeɪ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ dùng xe đạp của mình. Được.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Now, they do have some quite specific requirements for the kind of person they're looking for.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðˈeɪ dˈu hˈæv sˈʌm kwˈaɪt spəsˈɪfɪk ɹɪkwˈaɪɹmənts fˈɔɹ ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pˈɝsən ðˈɛɹ lˈʊkɪŋ fˈɔɹ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Giờ thì, họ có một số yêu cầu khá cụ thể về loại người mà họ đang tìm kiếm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Milo's is a young, dynamic company and they're really keen on creating a strong team.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /milo's ˈɪz ə jˈʌŋ daɪnˈæmɪk kˈʌmpənˌi ənd ðˈɛɹ ɹˈɪli kˈin ˈɑn kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ə stɹˈɔŋ tˈim/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Milo's là một công ty trẻ, năng động và họ rất mong muốn xây dựng một đội ngũ vững mạnh.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: It's really important that you can fit in and get on well with everyone.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɪts ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn fˈɪt ɪn ənd ɡˈɛt ˈɑn wˈɛl wˈɪð ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Điều thực sự quan trọng là bạn có thể hòa nhập và hòa hợp tốt với mọi người.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Yeah, I've got no problem with that.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈæ ˈaɪv ɡˈɑt nˈoʊ pɹˈɑbləm wˈɪð ðˈæt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vâng, tôi không có vấn đề gì với điều đó.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: It sounds good, actually.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɪt sˈaʊndz ɡˈʊd ˈæktʃˌuəli/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nghe hay đấy, thực ra.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: The last place I worked for was quite demanding, too.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðə lˈæst plˈeɪs ˈaɪ wˈɝkt fˈɔɹ wˈɑz kwˈaɪt dɪmˈændɪŋ tˈu/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nơi làm việc cuối cùng của tôi cũng khá đòi hỏi.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: We had to make sure we gave a really high level of service.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈi hˈæd tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ wˈi ɡˈeɪv ə ɹˈɪli hˈaɪ lˈɛvəl ˈʌv sˈɝvəs/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi phải đảm bảo rằng chúng tôi cung cấp dịch vụ ở mức độ rất cao.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's good to hear because that will be equally important at Milo's.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts ɡˈʊd tˈu hˈiɹ bɪkˈɔz ðˈæt wˈɪl bˈi ˈikwəli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt ˈæt milo's/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Thật tốt khi nghe điều đó vì điều đó cũng sẽ quan trọng không kém tại Milo's.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I know they want people who have an eye for detail.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈeɪ wˈɑnt pˈipəl hˈu hˈæv ˈæn ˈaɪ fˈɔɹ dɪtˈeɪl/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tôi biết họ muốn những người có con mắt tinh tường.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's fine. I'm very used to working in that kind of environment.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts fˈaɪn ˈaɪm vˈɛɹi jˈuzd tˈu wˈɝkɪŋ ɪn ðˈæt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Không sao đâu. Tôi rất quen làm việc trong môi trường như vậy.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Perfect. So, the only other thing that's required is good communication skills.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /pɚfˈɛkt sˈoʊ ðə ˈoʊnli ˈʌðɚ θˈɪŋ ðˈæts ɹikwˈaɪɚd ˈɪz ɡˈʊd kəmjˌunəkˈeɪʃən skˈɪlz/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tuyệt vời. Vậy thì, điều duy nhất khác cần thiết là kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, you'll need to have a certificate in English.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈul nˈid tˈu hˈæv ə sɚtˈɪfɪkət ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, bạn sẽ cần có chứng chỉ tiếng Anh.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Sure. Before you hear the rest of the conversation,
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ʃˈʊɹ bɪfˈɔɹ jˈu hˈiɹ ðə ɹˈɛst ˈʌv ðə kˌɑnvɚsˈeɪʃən/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Chắc chắn rồi. Trước khi bạn nghe phần còn lại của cuộc trò chuyện,

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: you have some time to look at questions six to 10.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz sˈɪks tˈu 10/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: bạn có thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ sáu đến mười không.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Now listen and answer questions six to 10. Okay.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz sˈɪks tˈu 10 ˌoʊkˈeɪ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy nghe và trả lời các câu hỏi từ sáu đến mười. Được rồi.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Let's have a look at the current job vacancies at Milo's.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /lˈɛts hˈæv ə lˈʊk ˈæt ðə kˈɝənt dʒˈɑb vˈeɪkənsiz ˈæt milo's/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Hãy cùng xem các vị trí tuyển dụng hiện tại tại Milo's.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: The first one is in Wivenhoe Street.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðə fˈɝst wˈʌn ˈɪz ɪn wivenhoe stɹˈit/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Cái đầu tiên ở Phố Wivenhoe.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Sorry, where? Wivenhoe.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈɑɹi wˈɛɹ wivenhoe/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Xin lỗi, ở đâu? Wivenhoe.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: W I V E N H O E.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /dˈʌbəlju ˈaɪ vˈi ˈi ˈɛn ˈeɪtʃ ˈoʊ ˈi/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: W I V E N H O E.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: It's quite central, just off Cork Street.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɪts kwˈaɪt sˈɛntɹəl dʒˈʌst ˈɔf kˈɔɹk stɹˈit/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nó khá trung tâm, ngay gần phố Cork.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Oh, right. They're looking for a breakfast supervisor.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈoʊ ɹˈaɪt ðˈɛɹ lˈʊkɪŋ fˈɔɹ ə bɹˈɛkfəst sˈupɚvˌaɪzɚ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ồ, đúng rồi. Họ đang tìm một giám sát viên bữa sáng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That would be okay.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈʊd bˈi ˌoʊkˈeɪ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Điều đó sẽ ổn.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, you're probably familiar with the kind of responsibilities involved.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈʊɹ pɹˈɑbəblˌi fəmˈɪljɚ wˈɪð ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪlətiz ˌɪnvˈɑlvd/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vậy, có lẽ bạn đã quen với loại trách nhiệm liên quan.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Obviously, checking that all the portions are correct, et cetera.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɑbviəsli tʃˈɛkɪŋ ðˈæt ˈɔl ðə pˈɔɹʃənz ˈɑɹ kɚˈɛkt ˈɛt sˈɛtɚə/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Rõ ràng là, kiểm tra xem tất cả các phần có đúng không, v.v.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: And then things like checking all the procedures for cleaning the equipment are being followed.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk tʃˈɛkɪŋ ˈɔl ðə pɹəsˈidʒɚz fˈɔɹ klˈinɪŋ ðə ɪkwˈɪpmənt ˈɑɹ bˈiɪŋ fˈɑloʊd/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: và sau đó là các vấn đề như kiểm tra tất cả các quy trình làm sạch thiết bị có đang được tuân thủ hay không.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Okay. And what about the salary?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˌoʊkˈeɪ ənd wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə sˈælɚi/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Còn về lương thì sao?

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: In my last job, I was getting £9.50 per hour.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ɪn mˈaɪ lˈæst dʒˈɑb ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɡˈɛtɪŋ 950 pˈɝ ˈaʊɚ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Ở công việc cuối cùng của tôi, tôi được trả 9,50 bảng mỗi giờ.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I was hoping to get a bit more than that.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt ə bˈɪt mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ðˈæt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tôi mong đợi nhiều hơn một chút.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Well, to begin with, you'd be getting £9.75,
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈɛl tˈu bɪɡˈɪn wˈɪð jˈud bˈi ɡˈɛtɪŋ 975/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Chà, để bắt đầu, bạn sẽ nhận được 9,75 bảng Anh,

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: but that goes up to £11.25 after 3 months.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈæt ɡˈoʊz ˈʌp tˈu 1125 ˈæftɚ 3 mˈʌnθs/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: nhưng con số đó sẽ tăng lên 11,25 bảng Anh sau 3 tháng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's not too bad.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts nˈɑt tˈu bˈæd/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Không tệ lắm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: And I suppose it's a very early start.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ səpˈoʊz ˈɪts ə vˈɛɹi ˈɝli stˈɑɹt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Và tôi đoán là một khởi đầu rất sớm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's the only unattractive thing about this job.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts ðə ˈoʊnli ˌʌnətɹˈæktɪv θˈɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðˈɪs dʒˈɑb/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Đó là điều duy nhất không hấp dẫn về công việc này.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: But then you have the afternoons and evenings free.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛn jˈu hˈæv ðə ˌæftɚnˈunz ənd ˈivnɪŋz fɹˈi/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nhưng sau đó bạn có cả buổi chiều và buổi tối rảnh.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, the restaurant starts serving breakfast from 7:00 a.m.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðə ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnt stˈɑɹts sˈɝvɪŋ bɹˈɛkfəst fɹˈʌm 700 ˈæm/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vậy, nhà hàng bắt đầu phục vụ bữa sáng từ 7:00 sáng.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: and you'd have to be there at 5:30 to set everything up.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd jˈud hˈæv tˈu bˈi ðˈɛɹ ˈæt 530 tˈu sˈɛt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈʌp/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Bạn sẽ phải có mặt lúc 5:30 để chuẩn bị mọi thứ.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: But you'd be finished at 12:30. Hmm.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈud bˈi fˈɪnɪʃt ˈæt 1230 hm/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Nhưng bạn sẽ xong lúc 12:30. Hừm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Well, as you say, there are advantages to that.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈɛl ˈæz jˈu sˈeɪ ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ædvˈæntɪdʒɪz tˈu ðˈæt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Vâng, như bạn nói, điều đó cũng có những ưu điểm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Now, you might also be interested in the job at the City Road branch.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /nˈaʊ jˈu mˈaɪt ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn ðə dʒˈɑb ˈæt ðə sˈɪti ɹˈoʊd bɹˈæntʃ/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ, bạn cũng có thể quan tâm đến công việc tại chi nhánh City Road.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That's for a junior chef, so again a position of responsibility.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæts fˈɔɹ ə dʒˈunjɚ ʃˈɛf sˈoʊ əɡˈɛn ə pəzˈɪʃən ˈʌv ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Đó là dành cho một đầu bếp cấp dưới, vì vậy một lần nữa là một vị trí có trách nhiệm.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I might prefer that, actually. Right.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ mˈaɪt pɹəfˈɝ ðˈæt ˈæktʃˌuəli ɹˈaɪt/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Tôi có lẽ sẽ thích điều đó hơn, thực tế. Đúng vậy.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Well, obviously, this role would involve supporting the sous chef and other senior staff.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈɛl ˈɑbviəsli ðˈɪs ɹˈoʊl wˈʊd ˌɪnvˈɑlv səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðə sˈuz ʃˈɛf ənd ˈʌðɚ sˈinjɚ stˈæf/
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.vietnamese_text: Rõ ràng, vai trò này sẽ bao gồm việc hỗ trợ bếp phó và các nhân viên cấp cao khác.

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: And you'd be responsible for making sure there's enough stock each week
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd jˈud bˈi ɹispˈɑnsəbəl fˈɔɹ mˈeɪkɪŋ ʃˈʊɹ ðˈɛɹz ɪnˈʌf stˈɑk ˈitʃ wˈik/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: and sorting out all the deliveries.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ənd sˈɔɹtɪŋ ˈaʊt ˈɔl ðə dɪlˈɪvɚiz/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I've never done that before,
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪv nˈɛvɚ dˈʌn ðˈæt bɪfˈɔɹ/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: but I imagine it's fairly straightforward once you get the hang of it.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ ˌɪmˈædʒən ˈɪts fˈɛɹli stɹˈeɪtfˈɔɹwɚd wˈʌns jˈu ɡˈɛt ðə hˈæŋ ˈʌv ˈɪt/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Yes, and you'd be working alongside more experienced staff to begin
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈɛs ənd jˈud bˈi wˈɝkɪŋ əlˈɔŋsˈaɪd mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɪɹiənst stˈæf tˈu bɪɡˈɪn/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: with, so I'm sure it wouldn't be a problem.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈɪð sˈoʊ ˈaɪm ʃˈʊɹ ˈɪt wˈʊdənt bˈi ə pɹˈɑbləm/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: The salary's slightly higher here.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðə salary's slˈaɪtli hˈaɪɚ hˈiɹ/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: It's an annual salary of £23,000. Right.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈæn ˈænjuəl sˈælɚi ˈʌv 23000 ɹˈaɪt/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: I know that if they like you, it's likely you'll be promoted quite quickly,
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪf ðˈeɪ lˈaɪk jˈu ˈɪts lˈaɪkli jˈul bˈi pɹəmˈoʊtɪd kwˈaɪt kwˈɪkli/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: so that's worth thinking about.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈæts wˈɝθ θˈɪŋkɪŋ əbˈaʊt/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: Yes, it does sound interesting.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈɪt dˈʌz sˈaʊnd ˈɪntɹəstɪŋ/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: What are the hours like?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /wˈʌt ˈɑɹ ðə ˈaʊɚz lˈaɪk/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: The usual, I think.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðə jˈuʒəwəl ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: There's a lot of evening and weekend work, but they're closed on Mondays.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈivnɪŋ ənd wˈikˌɛnd wˈɝk bˈʌt ðˈɛɹ klˈoʊzd ˈɑn mˈʌndiz/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: But you do get one Sunday off every 4 weeks.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu dˈu ɡˈɛt wˈʌn sˈʌndˌeɪ ˈɔf ˈɛvɚi 4 wˈiks/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: So, would you like me to send off your CV?
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʊd jˈu lˈaɪk mˈi tˈu sˈɛnd ˈɔf jˈɔɹ sˌivˈi/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: That is the end of part one.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd ˈʌv pˈɑɹt wˈʌn/

66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.text: You now have 1 minute to check your answers to part one.
66f88564-ef5c-4f45-b0ab-5640f3282136.ipa: /jˈu nˈaʊ hˈæv 1 mˈɪnət tˈu tʃˈɛk jˈɔɹ ˈænsɚz tˈu pˈɑɹt wˈʌn/

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Unit 13 Leonardo da Vinci.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /jˈunət 13 lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ dˈɑ vˈɪnsi/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Bài 13 Leonardo da Vinci.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: When most people hear the name Leonardo da Vinci,
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /wˈɛn mˈoʊst pˈipəl hˈiɹ ðə nˈeɪm lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ dˈɑ vˈɪnsi/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Khi hầu hết mọi người nghe tên Leonardo da Vinci,

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: they think of art, but in fact, he was a man of many talents.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /ðˈeɪ θˈɪŋk ˈʌv ˈɑɹt bˈʌt ɪn fˈækt hˈi wˈɑz ə mˈæn ˈʌv mˈɛni tˈælənts/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: họ nghĩ về nghệ thuật, nhưng thực tế, ông là một người đàn ông có nhiều tài năng.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He was a scientist, an inventor, and an artist.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈɑz ə sˈaɪəntɪst ˈæn ˌɪnvˈɛntɚ ənd ˈæn ˈɑɹtəst/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy là một nhà khoa học, một nhà phát minh và một nghệ sĩ.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Leonardo da Vinci was born in 1452 in Vinci, Italy.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ dˈɑ vˈɪnsi wˈɑz bˈɔɹn ɪn 1452 ɪn vˈɪnsi ˈɪtəli/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Leonardo da Vinci sinh năm 1452 tại Vinci, Ý.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: When he was 14, his father sent him to Florence to train under Andrea del Verrocchio,
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /wˈɛn hˈi wˈɑz 14 hˈɪz fˈɑðɚ sˈɛnt hˈɪm tˈu flˈɔɹəns tˈu tɹˈeɪn ˈʌndɚ ˈændɹˌiə dˈɛl verrocchio/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Khi ông 14 tuổi, cha ông đã gửi ông đến Florence để học việc dưới sự chỉ bảo của Andrea del Verrocchio,

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: one of the best artists in the area.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst ˈɑɹtɪsts ɪn ðə ˈɛɹiə/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: một trong những nghệ sĩ xuất sắc nhất trong khu vực.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Leonardo became better than Verrocchio.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ bɪkˈeɪm bˈɛtɚ ðˈæn verrocchio/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Leonardo trở nên giỏi hơn Verrocchio.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: By his early 20s, Leonardo was famous for his painting.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /bˈaɪ hˈɪz ˈɝli 20s lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ wˈɑz fˈeɪməs fˈɔɹ hˈɪz pˈeɪntɪŋ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Vào đầu những năm 20 tuổi, Leonardo đã nổi tiếng với bức tranh của mình.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He was especially good at painting colors and details.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈɑz əspˈɛʃli ɡˈʊd ˈæt pˈeɪntɪŋ kˈʌlɚz ənd dɪtˈeɪlz/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy đặc biệt giỏi trong việc vẽ màu sắc và chi tiết.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: This made his paintings very lifelike.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /ðˈɪs mˈeɪd hˈɪz pˈeɪntɪŋz vˈɛɹi lˈaɪflˌaɪk/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Điều này làm cho các bức tranh của ông trở nên rất sống động.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: His most famous paintings are the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈɪz mˈoʊst fˈeɪməs pˈeɪntɪŋz ˈɑɹ ðə mˈoʊnə lˈisə ənd ðə lˈæst sˈʌpɚ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Những bức tranh nổi tiếng nhất của ông là Mona Lisa và Bữa Tiệc Ly.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Leonardo was also a great scientist.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ wˈɑz ˈɔlsoʊ ə ɡɹˈeɪt sˈaɪəntɪst/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Leonardo cũng là một nhà khoa học vĩ đại.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He was a good observer of life and nature.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈɑz ə ɡˈʊd əbzˈɝvɚ ˈʌv lˈaɪf ənd nˈeɪtʃɚ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy là một người quan sát cuộc sống và thiên nhiên giỏi.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He would ask himself simple questions like, "How do birds fly?"
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈʊd ˈæsk hɪmsˈɛlf sˈɪmpəl kwˈɛstʃənz lˈaɪk hˈaʊ dˈu bˈɝdz flˈaɪ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Anh ấy sẽ tự hỏi mình những câu hỏi đơn giản như, "Làm thế nào chim bay?"

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Then he would try to find the answers.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /ðˈɛn hˈi wˈʊd tɹˈaɪ tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə ˈænsɚz/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Rồi anh ấy sẽ cố gắng tìm câu trả lời.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He was interested in everything.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈɑz ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy quan tâm đến mọi thứ.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: For example, he studied the inner workings of the human body.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl hˈi stˈʌdid ðə ˈɪnɚ wˈɝkɪŋz ˈʌv ðə hjˈumən bˈɑdi/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ví dụ, ông ấy đã nghiên cứu hoạt động bên trong cơ thể con người.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He would cut up dead bodies to examine their insides.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi wˈʊd kˈʌt ˈʌp dˈɛd bˈɑdiz tˈu ɪɡzˈæmɪn ðˈɛɹ ˌɪnsˈaɪdz/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Anh ta sẽ mổ xẻ xác chết để kiểm tra nội tạng của chúng.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Leonardo was also a talented inventor.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ wˈɑz ˈɔlsoʊ ə tˈæləntɪd ˌɪnvˈɛntɚ/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Leonardo cũng là một nhà phát minh tài năng.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: He believed that by understanding how each part of a machine worked,
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˈi bɪlˈivd ðˈæt bˈaɪ ˌʌndɚstˈændɪŋ hˈaʊ ˈitʃ pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə məʃˈin wˈɝkt/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ông tin rằng bằng cách hiểu cách mỗi bộ phận của máy hoạt động,

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: the parts could be changed and combined in different ways to make new machines.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /ðə pˈɑɹts kˈʊd bˈi tʃˈeɪndʒd ənd kəmbˈaɪnd ɪn dˈɪfɚənt wˈeɪz tˈu mˈeɪk nˈu məʃˈinz/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: các bộ phận có thể được thay đổi và kết hợp theo những cách khác nhau để tạo ra những cỗ máy mới.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Using his artistic talent, Leonardo drew pictures of many inventions.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /jˈuzɪŋ hˈɪz ɑɹtˈɪstɪk tˈælənt lˌiənˈɑɹdoʊ dɹˈu pˈɪktʃɚz ˈʌv mˈɛni ˌɪnvˈɛnʃənz/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Bằng tài năng nghệ thuật của mình, Leonardo đã vẽ nhiều bức tranh về các phát minh.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: However, few of them were built and tested during his lifetime.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /hˌaʊˈɛvɚ fjˈu ˈʌv ðˈɛm wˈɝ bˈɪlt ənd tˈɛstɪd dˈʊɹɪŋ hˈɪz lˈaɪftˌaɪm/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Tuy nhiên, chỉ có một vài trong số đó được xây dựng và thử nghiệm trong suốt cuộc đời ông.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: For example, his parachute wasn't built until 1783.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl hˈɪz pˈɛɹəʃˌut wˈɑzənt bˈɪlt əntˈɪl 1783/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ví dụ, dù của ông ấy không được chế tạo cho đến năm 1783.

345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.text: Also, his war tank wasn't used until World War I in 1917.
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.ipa: /ˈɔlsoʊ hˈɪz wˈɔɹ tˈæŋk wˈɑzənt jˈuzd əntˈɪl wˈɝld wˈɔɹ ˈaɪ ɪn 1917/
345551bc-d962-49d5-9ffa-9420151cd98c.vietnamese_text: Ngoài ra, xe tăng của ông ta không được sử dụng cho đến Thế chiến thứ nhất vào năm 1917.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: If you've always been the smart one, the high achiever,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈuv ˈɔlwˌeɪz bˈɪn ðə smˈɑɹt wˈʌn ðə hˈaɪ ətʃˈivɚ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn luôn là người thông minh, người đạt thành tích cao,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: the go-to person, the one that people turn to for the answers,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðə ɡˈoʊtˌu pˈɝsən ðə wˈʌn ðˈæt pˈipəl tˈɝn tˈu fˈɔɹ ðə ˈænsɚz/
