bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: người đáng tin cậy, người mà mọi người tìm đến để có câu trả lời,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: you would think that confidence would just come easily naturally.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu wˈʊd θˈɪŋk ðˈæt kˈɑnfədəns wˈʊd dʒˈʌst kˈʌm ˈizəli nˈætʃɚəli/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: bạn sẽ nghĩ rằng sự tự tin sẽ đến một cách dễ dàng tự nhiên.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But it doesn't.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt dˈʌzənt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nhưng nó không.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: In fact, I found that some of the most brilliant people I've supported
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ɪn fˈækt ˈaɪ fˈaʊnd ðˈæt sˈʌm ˈʌv ðə mˈoʊst bɹˈɪljənt pˈipəl ˈaɪv səpˈɔɹtɪd/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Thực tế, tôi thấy rằng một số người thông minh nhất mà tôi đã hỗ trợ

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: or mentored, the Fortune 500 execs, the PhDs, the founders,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈɛntɚd ðə fˈɔɹtʃən 500 ˌɛɡzˈɛks ðə phds ðə fˈaʊndɚz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: hoặc được cố vấn, các giám đốc điều hành Fortune 500, các tiến sĩ, những người sáng lập,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: they are often the ones most consumed by self-doubt.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔfən ðə wˈʌnz mˈoʊst kənsˈumd bˈaɪ selfdoubt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: họ thường là những người bị dày vò bởi sự nghi ngờ bản thân nhất.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, if you've ever doubted yourself,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈuv ˈɛvɚ dˈaʊtɪd jɚsˈɛlf/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Vậy, nếu bạn từng nghi ngờ bản thân,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: if you've ever felt like you don't deserve
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈuv ˈɛvɚ fˈɛlt lˈaɪk jˈu dˈoʊnt dɪzˈɝv/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: nếu bạn đã từng cảm thấy mình không xứng đáng

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: to be where you are, or felt
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /tˈu bˈi wˈɛɹ jˈu ˈɑɹ ˈɔɹ fˈɛlt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: ở nơi bạn đang ở, hoặc cảm thấy

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: like your confidence hasn't quite caught up to your competence
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /lˈaɪk jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns hˈæzənt kwˈaɪt kˈɑt ˈʌp tˈu jˈɔɹ kˈɑmpətɪns/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: sự tự tin của bạn vẫn chưa theo kịp năng lực của bạn

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: or experience, this is for you.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ðˈɪs ˈɪz fˈɔɹ jˈu/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: hoặc kinh nghiệm, đây là dành cho bạn.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: In this episode, I'll walk you through three surprising ways
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ɪn ðˈɪs ˈɛpəsˌoʊd ˈaɪl wˈɔk jˈu θɹˈu θɹˈi sɚpɹˈaɪzɪŋ wˈeɪz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Trong tập này, tôi sẽ hướng dẫn bạn ba cách đáng ngạc nhiên

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: that your intelligence might actually be sabotaging your self-belief,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛlədʒəns mˈaɪt ˈæktʃˌuəli bˈi sˈæbətˌɑʒɪŋ jˈɔɹ selfbelief/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: trí thông minh của bạn có thể thực sự đang phá hoại niềm tin vào bản thân,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and three practical strategies to build self-rust, to own your success,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd θɹˈi pɹˈæktəkəl stɹˈætədʒiz tˈu bˈɪld selfrust tˈu ˈoʊn jˈɔɹ səksˈɛs/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: và ba chiến lược thực tế để xây dựng sự tự tin, để làm chủ thành công của bạn,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and finally feel like you belong in the room.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd fˈaɪnəli fˈil lˈaɪk jˈu bɪlˈɔŋ ɪn ðə ɹˈum/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: và cuối cùng cảm thấy bạn thuộc về nơi này.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: The first thing we need to do is get clear
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðə fˈɝst θˈɪŋ wˈi nˈid tˈu dˈu ˈɪz ɡˈɛt klˈɪɹ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Việc đầu tiên chúng ta cần làm là làm rõ

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: on what we're dealing with, imposttor syndrome.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈʌt wˈiɹ dˈilɪŋ wˈɪð imposttor sˈɪndɹˌoʊm/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: về những gì chúng ta đang đối mặt, hội chứng kẻ mạo danh.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: How many people do you think have actually experienced imposttor syndrome?
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /hˈaʊ mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈu jˈu θˈɪŋk hˈæv ˈæktʃˌuəli ɪkspˈɪɹiənst imposttor sˈɪndɹˌoʊm/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn nghĩ có bao nhiêu người thực sự đã trải qua hội chứng kẻ mạo danh?

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: A study from the Journal of General Internal Medicine found
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ə stˈʌdi fɹˈʌm ðə dʒˈɝnəl ˈʌv dʒˈɛnɚəl ˌɪntˈɝnəl mˈɛdəsən fˈaʊnd/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Một nghiên cứu từ Tạp chí Y học Nội khoa Tổng quát đã phát hiện ra

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: that up to 82% of people, yes, that's eight out of 10,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈʌp tˈu 82 ˈʌv pˈipəl jˈɛs ðˈæts ˈeɪt ˈaʊt ˈʌv 10/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: lên tới 82% số người, vâng, đó là tám trên 10 người,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: experienced it at some point in their lives.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ɪkspˈɪɹiənst ˈɪt ˈæt sˈʌm pˈɔɪnt ɪn ðˈɛɹ lˈɪvz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: từng trải qua điều đó vào một thời điểm nào đó trong đời.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, let's look at the real reason confidence drops when competence rises.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ lˈɛts lˈʊk ˈæt ðə ɹˈil ɹˈizən kˈɑnfədəns dɹˈɑps wˈɛn kˈɑmpətɪns ɹˈaɪzəz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Vậy, hãy xem lý do thực sự khiến sự tự tin giảm khi năng lực tăng lên.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: The more you know, the more aware you become of what you don't know.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðə mˈɔɹ jˈu nˈoʊ ðə mˈɔɹ əwˈɛɹ jˈu bɪkˈʌm ˈʌv wˈʌt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Càng biết nhiều, bạn càng nhận thức rõ hơn về những gì mình chưa biết.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: This was the core finding of researchers David Dunning and Justin Krueger.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɪs wˈɑz ðə kˈɔɹ fˈaɪndɪŋ ˈʌv ɹˈisɚtʃɚz dˈeɪvɪd dˈʌnɪŋ ənd dʒˈʌstən kɹˈuɡɚ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Đây là phát hiện cốt lõi của các nhà nghiên cứu David Dunning và Justin Krueger.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They discovered that people with low ability tend to overestimate themselves
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ dɪskˈʌvɚd ðˈæt pˈipəl wˈɪð lˈoʊ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈɛnd tˈu ˌoʊvɚˈɛstəmˌeɪt ðɛmsˈɛlvz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Họ phát hiện ra rằng những người có năng lực thấp có xu hướng đánh giá quá cao bản thân

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: because they don't yet know enough to realize what they're missing.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ dˈoʊnt jˈɛt nˈoʊ ɪnˈʌf tˈu ɹˈiəlˌaɪz wˈʌt ðˈɛɹ mˈɪsɪŋ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: bởi vì họ chưa biết đủ để nhận ra những gì họ đang bỏ lỡ.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But as your skills grow, so does your awareness.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈæz jˈɔɹ skˈɪlz ɡɹˈoʊ sˈoʊ dˈʌz jˈɔɹ əwˈɛɹnəs/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nhưng khi kỹ năng của bạn phát triển, nhận thức của bạn cũng vậy.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You start spotting nuance.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu stˈɑɹt spˈɑtɪŋ nˈuɑns/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn bắt đầu nhận thấy sự tinh tế.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You see the complexity.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu sˈi ðə kəmplˈɛksəti/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn thấy sự phức tạp.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You recognize the gaps.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz ðə ɡˈæps/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn nhận ra những khoảng trống.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And ironically, that's the moment your confidence dips even as your competence is rising.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd aɪɹˈɑnɪkli ðˈæts ðə mˈoʊmənt jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns dˈɪps ˈivɪn ˈæz jˈɔɹ kˈɑmpətɪns ˈɪz ɹˈaɪzɪŋ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Và trớ trêu thay, đó là khoảnh khắc sự tự tin của bạn giảm sút ngay cả khi năng lực của bạn đang tăng lên.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: At the start of anything new, maybe a job, a new business,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈæt ðə stˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈɛniθˌɪŋ nˈu mˈeɪbi ə dʒˈɑb ə nˈu bˈɪznəs/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Khi bắt đầu một điều gì đó mới, có thể là một công việc, một doanh nghiệp mới,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: a skill, your confidence is weirdly high.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ə skˈɪl jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns ˈɪz wˈɪɹdli hˈaɪ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: một kỹ năng, sự tự tin của bạn cao một cách kỳ lạ.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's being on what researchers call the peak of Mount Stupid.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈiɪŋ ˈɑn wˈʌt ɹˈisɚtʃɚz kˈɔl ðə pˈik ˈʌv mˈaʊnt stˈupəd/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nó đang ở cái mà các nhà nghiên cứu gọi là đỉnh của Núi Ngu

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You don't know enough to feel intimidated.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ ɪnˈʌf tˈu fˈil ˌɪntˈɪmɪdˌeɪtɪd/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn không biết đủ để cảm thấy bị đe dọa.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But then it hits you.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛn ˈɪt hˈɪts jˈu/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nhưng rồi bạn nhận ra.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You suddenly realize how much there is to learn,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu sˈʌdənli ɹˈiəlˌaɪz hˈaʊ mˈʌtʃ ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz tˈu lˈɝn/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Bạn đột nhiên nhận ra có quá nhiều điều để học,

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and your confidence takes a nose dive into the valley of despair.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns tˈeɪks ə nˈoʊz dˈaɪv ˈɪntu ðə vˈæli ˈʌv dɪspˈɛɹ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: và sự tự tin của bạn lao dốc xuống thung lũng tuyệt vọng.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Now, that's the rough part, and that's the part where most people question themselves.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðˈæts ðə ɹˈʌf pˈɑɹt ənd ðˈæts ðə pˈɑɹt wˈɛɹ mˈoʊst pˈipəl kwˈɛstʃən ðɛmsˈɛlvz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Đó là phần khó khăn, và đó là phần mà hầu hết mọi người tự hỏi bản thân.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's also the part where most people give up or quit.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ ðə pˈɑɹt wˈɛɹ mˈoʊst pˈipəl ɡˈɪv ˈʌp ˈɔɹ kwˈɪt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Đây cũng là phần mà hầu hết mọi người bỏ cuộc hoặc dừng lại.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: If you stay the course, if you keep practicing, learning, applying, you start climbing again.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu stˈeɪ ðə kˈɔɹs ˈɪf jˈu kˈip pɹˈæktəsɪŋ lˈɝnɪŋ əplˈaɪɪŋ jˈu stˈɑɹt klˈaɪmɪŋ əɡˈɛn/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn kiên trì, nếu bạn tiếp tục luyện tập, học hỏi, áp dụng, bạn sẽ bắt đầu leo lên lại.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And that's called being on the slope of enlightenment.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈæts kˈɔld bˈiɪŋ ˈɑn ðə slˈoʊp ˈʌv ˌɛnlˈaɪtənmənt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Và đó được gọi là đang trên con đường giác ngộ.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And then eventually you will reach the plateau of sustainability.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ɪvˈɛntʃəwəli jˈu wˈɪl ɹˈitʃ ðə plætˈoʊ ˈʌv səstˌeɪnəbˈɪlɪti/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Và rồi cuối cùng bạn sẽ đạt đến đỉnh cao của sự bền vững.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And that's where real confidence lives.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈæts wˈɛɹ ɹˈil kˈɑnfədəns lˈɪvz/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Và đó là nơi sự tự tin thực sự tồn tại.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: That's the kind that's built on earned experience.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈæts ðə kˈaɪnd ðˈæts bˈɪlt ˈɑn ˈɝnd ɪkspˈɪɹiəns/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Đó là loại được xây dựng dựa trên kinh nghiệm đã tích lũy được.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So for most, confidence rises with competence once you get past the peak
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst kˈɑnfədəns ɹˈaɪzəz wˈɪð kˈɑmpətɪns wˈʌns jˈu ɡˈɛt pˈæst ðə pˈik/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, đối với hầu hết mọi người, sự tự tin tăng lên cùng với năng lực khi bạn vượt qua đỉnh cao

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: of Mount Stupid, of course.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈʌv mˈaʊnt stˈupəd ˈʌv kˈɔɹs/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: của Núi Ngu, tất nhiên rồi.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But here is where imposttor syndrome actually flips the script.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt hˈiɹ ˈɪz wˈɛɹ imposttor sˈɪndɹˌoʊm ˈæktʃˌuəli flˈɪps ðə skɹˈɪpt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nhưng ở đây là nơi hội chứng kẻ mạo danh thực sự thay đổi kịch bản.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: If you feel like a fraud, it's not because you're incompetent.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu fˈil lˈaɪk ə fɹˈɔd ˈɪts nˈɑt bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ ˌɪnkˈɑmpətənt/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn cảm thấy mình là kẻ lừa đảo, đó không phải vì bạn thiếu năng lực.

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's usually because your confidence is stuck in the valley of despair
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts jˈuʒəwəli bɪkˈɔz jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns ˈɪz stˈʌk ɪn ðə vˈæli ˈʌv dɪspˈɛɹ/
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.vietnamese_text: Thông thường là vì sự tự tin của bạn đang mắc kẹt trong thung lũng tuyệt vọng

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: while your objective competence is soaring.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈaɪl jˈɔɹ əbdʒˈɛktɪv kˈɑmpətɪns ˈɪz sˈɔɹɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, you are getting more experience, you're learning, you're growing,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu ˈɑɹ ɡˈɛtɪŋ mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɪɹiəns jˈʊɹ lˈɝnɪŋ jˈʊɹ ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: but your confidence is not growing with it.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədəns ˈɪz nˈɑt ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ wˈɪð ˈɪt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, you've become almost so good that you can see
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈuv bɪkˈʌm ˈɔlmˌoʊst sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn sˈi/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: what others miss, but instead of feeling accomplished, it feels like luck.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈʌt ˈʌðɚz mˈɪs bˈʌt ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv fˈilɪŋ əkˈɑmplɪʃt ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk lˈʌk/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It feels like you've tricked people, like it could all fall apart at any second.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk jˈuv tɹˈɪkt pˈipəl lˈaɪk ˈɪt kˈʊd ˈɔl fˈɔl əpˈɑɹt ˈæt ˈɛni sˈɛkənd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And that was me.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈæt wˈɑz mˈi/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And honestly, sometimes it still is.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˈɑnəstli səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪt stˈɪl ˈɪz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: There was a point in my career
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz ə pˈɔɪnt ɪn mˈaɪ kɚˈɪɹ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: when I thought maybe another degree will finally shut down the doubt.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ θˈɔt mˈeɪbi ənˈʌðɚ dɪɡɹˈi wˈɪl fˈaɪnəli ʃˈʌt dˈaʊn ðə dˈaʊt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, I did an MBA uh to prove that I was capable.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ dˈɪd ˈæn ˈɛmbˈiˈeɪ ˈʌ tˈu pɹˈuv ðˈæt ˈaɪ wˈɑz kˈeɪpəbəl/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I started my PhD to feel like I was of value.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ stˈɑɹtɪd mˈaɪ pˈiˌeɪtʃdˈi tˈu fˈil lˈaɪk ˈaɪ wˈɑz ˈʌv vˈælju/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And still the voice came back.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd stˈɪl ðə vˈɔɪs kˈeɪm bˈæk/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: When I was a PhD candidate, I would sit in rooms full of brilliant minds
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈɑz ə pˈiˌeɪtʃdˈi kˈændədeɪt ˈaɪ wˈʊd sˈɪt ɪn ɹˈumz fˈʊl ˈʌv bɹˈɪljənt mˈaɪndz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and immediately felt like I had to prove that I deserved to be there.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˌɪmˈidˌiətli fˈɛlt lˈaɪk ˈaɪ hˈæd tˈu pɹˈuv ðˈæt ˈaɪ dɪzˈɝvd tˈu bˈi ðˈɛɹ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Even though I had co-founded a global company, I'd worked with Fortune 500s,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈivɪn ðˈoʊ ˈaɪ hˈæd cofounded ə ɡlˈoʊbəl kˈʌmpənˌi ˈaɪd wˈɝkt wˈɪð fˈɔɹtʃən 500s/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I'd built an audience of millions, but the moment I was around academics
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪd bˈɪlt ˈæn ˈɑdiəns ˈʌv mˈɪljənz bˈʌt ðə mˈoʊmənt ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɚˈaʊnd ˌækədˈɛmɪks/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and professors, I felt like I absolutely didn't belong.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd pɹəfˈɛsɚz ˈaɪ fˈɛlt lˈaɪk ˈaɪ ˌæbsəlˈutli dˈɪdənt bɪlˈɔŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But what opened my eyes wasn't so much my experience.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈʌt ˈoʊpənd mˈaɪ ˈaɪz wˈɑzənt sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ mˈaɪ ɪkspˈɪɹiəns/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It was watching the other PhD candidates in the room.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz wˈɑtʃɪŋ ðə ˈʌðɚ pˈiˌeɪtʃdˈi kˈændədeɪts ɪn ðə ɹˈum/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: These were some of the most accomplished people that I'd ever met.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈiz wˈɝ sˈʌm ˈʌv ðə mˈoʊst əkˈɑmplɪʃt pˈipəl ðˈæt ˈaɪd ˈɛvɚ mˈɛt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Because getting into a top doctoral program isn't exactly easy.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ɡˈɛtɪŋ ˈɪntu ə tˈɑp dˈɑktɚəl pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm ˈɪzənt ɪɡzˈæktli ˈizi/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And yet, I could see it.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd jˈɛt ˈaɪ kˈʊd sˈi ˈɪt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I could see in how they were hesitating to speak up,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈʊd sˈi ɪn hˈaʊ ðˈeɪ wˈɝ hˈɛzətˌeɪtɪŋ tˈu spˈik ˈʌp/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: how they were overexlaining to sound smart,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /hˈaʊ ðˈeɪ wˈɝ overexlaining tˈu sˈaʊnd smˈɑɹt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: they were all trying to feel like they belonged, too.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ˈɔl tɹˈaɪɪŋ tˈu fˈil lˈaɪk ðˈeɪ bɪlˈɔŋd tˈu/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And part of it is because the more competent and intelligent someone
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈɪt ˈɪz bɪkˈɔz ðə mˈɔɹ kˈɑmpətɪnt ənd ˌɪntˈɛlədʒənt sˈʌmwˌʌn/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: is, the higher their internal standard for what counts as good enough.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪz ðə hˈaɪɚ ðˈɛɹ ˌɪntˈɝnəl stˈændɚd fˈɔɹ wˈʌt kˈaʊnts ˈæz ɡˈʊd ɪnˈʌf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They're also usually acutely aware of what they don't know and what they haven't mastered yet.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɔlsoʊ jˈuʒəwəli əkjˈutli əwˈɛɹ ˈʌv wˈʌt ðˈeɪ dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ ənd wˈʌt ðˈeɪ hˈævənt mˈæstɚd jˈɛt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And that's called metacognitive awareness.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈæts kˈɔld metacognitive əwˈɛɹnəs/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's actually a form of intellectual humility.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈæktʃˌuəli ə fˈɔɹm ˈʌv ˌɪntəlˈɛktʃuəl hjumˈɪlɪti/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So if you have ever felt like a fraud,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ˈɛvɚ fˈɛlt lˈaɪk ə fɹˈɔd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: despite your track record of high performance, you are not broken.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /dɪspˈaɪt jˈɔɹ tɹˈæk ɹəkˈɔɹd ˈʌv hˈaɪ pɚfˈɔɹməns jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈɑt bɹˈoʊkən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You are not lacking.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈɑt lˈækɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Your brain is just doing exactly what a smart brain does.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈɔɹ bɹˈeɪn ˈɪz dʒˈʌst dˈuɪŋ ɪɡzˈæktli wˈʌt ə smˈɑɹt bɹˈeɪn dˈʌz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It sees the gaps and it's aiming high.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt sˈiz ðə ɡˈæps ənd ˈɪts ˈeɪmɪŋ hˈaɪ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: This episode is brought to you by Big Trust.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɛpəsˌoʊd ˈɪz bɹˈɔt tˈu jˈu bˈaɪ bˈɪɡ tɹˈʌst/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Louis House shared, "The moments that matter most are usually the ones
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /lˈuɪs hˈaʊs ʃˈɛɹd ðə mˈoʊmənts ðˈæt mˈætɚ mˈoʊst ˈɑɹ jˈuʒəwəli ðə wˈʌnz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: when doubt gets the loudest.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈɛn dˈaʊt ɡˈɛts ðə lˈaʊdəst/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Big trust is the playbook for rising above it and making the most of those moments."
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈɪɡ tɹˈʌst ˈɪz ðə plˈeɪbʊk fˈɔɹ ɹˈaɪzɪŋ əbˈʌv ˈɪt ənd mˈeɪkɪŋ ðə mˈoʊst ˈʌv ðˈoʊz mˈoʊmənts/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I'll tell you more at the end.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪl tˈɛl jˈu mˈɔɹ ˈæt ðə ˈɛnd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Now, back to the episode.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /nˈaʊ bˈæk tˈu ðə ˈɛpəsˌoʊd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, now that we understand why it happens, let's talk about
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ nˈaʊ ðˈæt wˈi ˌʌndɚstˈænd wˈaɪ ˈɪt hˈæpənz lˈɛts tˈɔk əbˈaʊt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: how this shows up and what to do instead. First, perfectionism.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /hˈaʊ ðˈɪs ʃˈoʊz ˈʌp ənd wˈʌt tˈu dˈu ˌɪnstˈɛd fˈɝst pɚfˈɛkʃənˌɪzəm/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Most high achievers that I've trained or worked with sit
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /mˈoʊst hˈaɪ ətʃˈivɚz ðˈæt ˈaɪv tɹˈeɪnd ˈɔɹ wˈɝkt wˈɪð sˈɪt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: in what I call the perfectionism prison.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ɪn wˈʌt ˈaɪ kˈɔl ðə pɚfˈɛkʃənˌɪzəm pɹˈɪzən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: If it's not flawless, it doesn't count.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɪts nˈɑt flˈɔləs ˈɪt dˈʌzənt kˈaʊnt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: If there's any room for criticism, they'd rather not try.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹz ˈɛni ɹˈum fˈɔɹ kɹˈɪtɪsˌɪzəm ðˈeɪd ɹˈæðɚ nˈɑt tɹˈaɪ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It wasn't that they had excessively high standards.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑzənt ðˈæt ðˈeɪ hˈæd ɪksˈɛsɪvli hˈaɪ stˈændɚdz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I mean, that was part of it.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ mˈin ðˈæt wˈɑz pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈɪt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But what I was seeing is that the standards that they set
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈʌt ˈaɪ wˈɑz sˈiɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt ðə stˈændɚdz ðˈæt ðˈeɪ sˈɛt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and their behavior was mostly driven by one thing, and that one thing was fear.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛɹ bɪhˈeɪvjɚ wˈɑz mˈoʊstli dɹˈɪvən bˈaɪ wˈʌn θˈɪŋ ənd ðˈæt wˈʌn θˈɪŋ wˈɑz fˈɪɹ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: There was fear of failure, fear of judgment or fear of not being enough.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz fˈɪɹ ˈʌv fˈeɪljɚ fˈɪɹ ˈʌv dʒˈʌdʒmənt ˈɔɹ fˈɪɹ ˈʌv nˈɑt bˈiɪŋ ɪnˈʌf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And the problem with this kind of perfectionism
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðə pɹˈɑbləm wˈɪð ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pɚfˈɛkʃənˌɪzəm/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: is that it leads to burnout, to procrastination, and a constant sense
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪz ðˈæt ˈɪt lˈidz tˈu bˈɝnˌaʊt tˈu pɹəkɹˌæstənˈeɪʃən ənd ə kˈɑnstənt sˈɛns/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: that nothing you do is ever good enough.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈæt nˈʌθɪŋ jˈu dˈu ˈɪz ˈɛvɚ ɡˈʊd ɪnˈʌf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, you end up more anxious, you criticize yourself more, and you have lower self-esteem.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu ˈɛnd ˈʌp mˈɔɹ ˈæŋkʃəs jˈu kɹˈɪtɪsˌaɪz jɚsˈɛlf mˈɔɹ ənd jˈu hˈæv lˈoʊɚ selfesteem/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, this brings us to strategy number one, the good enough protocol.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈɪs bɹˈɪŋz ˈʌs tˈu stɹˈætədʒi nˈʌmbɚ wˈʌn ðə ɡˈʊd ɪnˈʌf pɹˈoʊtəkˌɑl/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: This is something I've implemented into my own life
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈaɪv ˈɪmpləmˌɛntəd ˈɪntu mˈaɪ ˈoʊn lˈaɪf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and it's completely changed how I make decisions, how I respond
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts kəmplˈitli tʃˈeɪndʒd hˈaʊ ˈaɪ mˈeɪk dɪsˈɪʒənz hˈaʊ ˈaɪ ɹɪspˈɑnd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: when things don't go to plan and the kinds of standards that I set for myself.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈɛn θˈɪŋz dˈoʊnt ɡˈoʊ tˈu plˈæn ənd ðə kˈaɪndz ˈʌv stˈændɚdz ðˈæt ˈaɪ sˈɛt fˈɔɹ mˌaɪsˈɛlf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: To understand what makes this strategy so effective, you first need to understand
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /tˈu ˌʌndɚstˈænd wˈʌt mˈeɪks ðˈɪs stɹˈætədʒi sˈoʊ ɪfˈɛktɪv jˈu fˈɝst nˈid tˈu ˌʌndɚstˈænd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: that there are two types of decision makers.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ tˈu tˈaɪps ˈʌv dɪsˈɪʒən mˈeɪkɚz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: We've got satisficers and maximizers.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈiv ɡˈɑt satisficers ənd maximizers/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I used to be a maximizer.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ jˈuzd tˈu bˈi ə maximizer/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I used to need to explore every option to weigh every possibility to optimize every outcome.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ jˈuzd tˈu nˈid tˈu ɪksplˈɔɹ ˈɛvɚi ˈɑpʃən tˈu wˈeɪ ˈɛvɚi pˌɑsəbˈɪlətˌi tˈu ˈɑptəmˌaɪz ˈɛvɚi ˈaʊtkˌʌm/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I used to chase the best.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ jˈuzd tˈu tʃˈeɪs ðə bˈɛst/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: I was constantly getting stuck in overthinking, overanalysis, self-doubt, and it was utterly exhausting.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz kˈɑnstəntli ɡˈɛtɪŋ stˈʌk ɪn overthinking overanalysis selfdoubt ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz ˈʌtɚli ɪɡzˈɔstɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: This is what it feels like to be a maximizer because you are never satisfied.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌt ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk tˈu bˈi ə maximizer bɪkˈɔz jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈɛvɚ sˈætəsfˌaɪd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But then I learned about the power of aiming for good enough.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛn ˈaɪ lˈɝnd əbˈaʊt ðə pˈaʊɚ ˈʌv ˈeɪmɪŋ fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd ɪnˈʌf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And this is a satisficer's mindset.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə satisficer's mˈaɪndsˌɛt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Far from being lazy or that they can't be bothered to have high standards,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /fˈɑɹ fɹˈʌm bˈiɪŋ lˈeɪzi ˈɔɹ ðˈæt ðˈeɪ kˈænt bˈi bˈɑðɚd tˈu hˈæv hˈaɪ stˈændɚdz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: this mindset really values progress over perfection.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɪs mˈaɪndsˌɛt ɹˈɪli vˈæljuz pɹˈɑɡɹˌɛs ˈoʊvɚ pɚfˈɛkʃən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So satisfers make a decision once it meets the need and then they move forward.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ satisfers mˈeɪk ə dɪsˈɪʒən wˈʌns ˈɪt mˈits ðə nˈid ənd ðˈɛn ðˈeɪ mˈuv fˈɔɹwɚd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They don't get stuck.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ dˈoʊnt ɡˈɛt stˈʌk/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They're not aiming for the best.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ nˈɑt ˈeɪmɪŋ fˈɔɹ ðə bˈɛst/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They're aiming for whatever satisfies the objective.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈeɪmɪŋ fˈɔɹ wˌʌtˈɛvɚ sˈætɪsfˌaɪz ðə əbdʒˈɛktɪv/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And the objective is progress or growth.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðə əbdʒˈɛktɪv ˈɪz pɹˈɑɡɹˌɛs ˈɔɹ ɡɹˈoʊθ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Research shows that satisficers tend to be less anxious.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ɹisˈɝtʃ ʃˈoʊz ðˈæt satisficers tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi lˈɛs ˈæŋkʃəs/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They can make decisions faster and they stick to them.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ kˈæn mˈeɪk dɪsˈɪʒənz fˈæstɚ ənd ðˈeɪ stˈɪk tˈu ðˈɛm/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And importantly, they're more content with their choices.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˌɪmpˈɔɹtəntli ðˈɛɹ mˈɔɹ kˈɑntɛnt wˈɪð ðˈɛɹ tʃˈɔɪsəz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And when it comes to imposter syndrome, that really matters
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu ˌɪmpˈɔstɚ sˈɪndɹˌoʊm ðˈæt ɹˈɪli mˈætɚz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: because imposter thoughts and perfectionism often go hand in hand.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˌɪmpˈɔstɚ θˈɔts ənd pɚfˈɛkʃənˌɪzəm ˈɔfən ɡˈoʊ hˈænd ɪn hˈænd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They are like best buddies.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ lˈaɪk bˈɛst bˈʌdiz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You feel like you're not really qualified,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu fˈil lˈaɪk jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ɹˈɪli kwˈɑləfˌaɪd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: so you try to overcompensate by making everything flawless so that you're never found out.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu tɹˈaɪ tˈu overcompensate bˈaɪ mˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ flˈɔləs sˈoʊ ðˈæt jˈʊɹ nˈɛvɚ fˈaʊnd ˈaʊt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And this is where the close enough protocol becomes an absolute lifeline.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈɛɹ ðə klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf pɹˈoʊtəkˌɑl bɪkˈʌmz ˈæn ˈæbsəlˌut lˈaɪflˌaɪn/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It is a mindset.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz ə mˈaɪndsˌɛt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's an approach.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈæn əpɹˈoʊtʃ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's something that I encourage you to literally say out loud,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt ˈaɪ ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ jˈu tˈu lˈɪtɚəli sˈeɪ ˈaʊt lˈaʊd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: but just make sure people aren't around you.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt dʒˈʌst mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ pˈipəl ˈɑɹənt ɚˈaʊnd jˈu/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So, you say it out loud if you're by yourself.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu sˈeɪ ˈɪt ˈaʊt lˈaʊd ˈɪf jˈʊɹ bˈaɪ jɚsˈɛlf/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Let's say your presentation didn't go exactly as you wanted.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /lˈɛts sˈeɪ jˈɔɹ pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən dˈɪdənt ɡˈoʊ ɪɡzˈæktli ˈæz jˈu wˈɔntɪd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Close enough to land the message.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf tˈu lˈænd ðə mˈɛsədʒ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Your workout wasn't as intense as you'd planned.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈɔɹ wˈɝkˌaʊt wˈɑzənt ˈæz ˌɪntˈɛns ˈæz jˈud plˈænd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Close enough to build consistency.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf tˈu bˈɪld kənsˈɪstənsi/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Did the email feel a little awkward?
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə imˈeɪl fˈil ə lˈɪtəl ˈɑkwɚd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Close enough to show you care.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf tˈu ʃˈoʊ jˈu kˈɛɹ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: These two words, close enough, are a pattern interrupt for the perfectionist.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈiz tˈu wˈɝdz klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf ˈɑɹ ə pˈætɚn ˌɪntɚˈʌpt fˈɔɹ ðə pɚfˈɛkʃənəst/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: They challenge the lie that if something isn't perfect, it's worthless.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðˈeɪ tʃˈæləndʒ ðə lˈaɪ ðˈæt ˈɪf sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɪzənt pɚfˈɛkt ˈɪts wˈɝθləs/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: And I repeat these words in my head constantly.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ ɹɪpˈit ðˈiz wˈɝdz ɪn mˈaɪ hˈɛd kˈɑnstəntli/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Because perfectionism is often driven by what's called loss aversion,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz pɚfˈɛkʃənˌɪzəm ˈɪz ˈɔfən dɹˈɪvən bˈaɪ wˈʌts kˈɔld lˈɔs əvˈɝʒən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: which is this fear that small imperfections will lead to big gigantic consequences.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðˈɪs fˈɪɹ ðˈæt smˈɔl ˌɪmpɚfˈɛkʃənz wˈɪl lˈɛd tˈu bˈɪɡ dʒaɪɡˈæntɪk kˈɑnsəkwˌɛnsəz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Like if you don't nail how you facilitate your team meeting,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /lˈaɪk ˈɪf jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈeɪl hˈaʊ jˈu fəsˈɪlətˌeɪt jˈɔɹ tˈim mˈitɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: all of your teammates are going to think that you're incompetent.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɔl ˈʌv jˈɔɹ tˈimmˌeɪts ˈɑɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu θˈɪŋk ðˈæt jˈʊɹ ˌɪnkˈɑmpətənt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: your manager will stop trusting that you're capable
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈɔɹ mˈænədʒɚ wˈɪl stˈɑp tɹˈʌstɪŋ ðˈæt jˈʊɹ kˈeɪpəbəl/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and then you will be taken off your top client's account.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn jˈu wˈɪl bˈi tˈeɪkən ˈɔf jˈɔɹ tˈɑp klˈaɪənts əkˈaʊnt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: None of that is true.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /nˈʌn ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪz tɹˈu/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's just a story that you've made up in your head.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst ə stˈɔɹi ðˈæt jˈuv mˈeɪd ˈʌp ɪn jˈɔɹ hˈɛd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But when you shift to close enough, you're guiding yourself into satisficing mode.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈɛn jˈu ʃˈɪft tˈu klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf jˈʊɹ ɡˈaɪdɪŋ jɚsˈɛlf ˈɪntu satisficing mˈoʊd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It frees up mental bandwidth and gives you permission to move forward.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt fɹˈiz ˈʌp mˈɛntəl bˈændwɪdθ ənd ɡˈɪvz jˈu pɚmˈɪʃən tˈu mˈuv fˈɔɹwɚd/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It keeps you showing up.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt kˈips jˈu ʃˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: So for non-critical tasks, intentionally lower your standards.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /sˈoʊ fˈɔɹ noncritical tˈæsks ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli lˈoʊɚ jˈɔɹ stˈændɚdz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Think of it as strategic imperfection.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /θˈɪŋk ˈʌv ˈɪt ˈæz stɹətˈidʒɪk ˌɪmpɚfˈɛkʃən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Now, of course, high standards do have a time and place.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈʌv kˈɔɹs hˈaɪ stˈændɚdz dˈu hˈæv ə tˈaɪm ənd plˈeɪs/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: like if you are making a life or death decision
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /lˈaɪk ˈɪf jˈu ˈɑɹ mˈeɪkɪŋ ə lˈaɪf ˈɔɹ dˈɛθ dɪsˈɪʒən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: if you are a pilot mid-flight or diffusing a bomb.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu ˈɑɹ ə pˈaɪlət mˈɪdflˌaɪt ˈɔɹ dɪfjˈuzɪŋ ə bˈɑm/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: But in most areas of life and work, it just slows you down.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /bˈʌt ɪn mˈoʊst ˈɛɹiəz ˈʌv lˈaɪf ənd wˈɝk ˈɪt dʒˈʌst slˈoʊz jˈu dˈaʊn/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: As I always say to our students, done is better than perfect.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈæz ˈaɪ ˈɔlwˌeɪz sˈeɪ tˈu ˈaʊɚ stˈudənts dˈʌn ˈɪz bˈɛtɚ ðˈæn pɚfˈɛkt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Execution beats obsession.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˌɛksəkjˈuʃən bˈits əbsˈɛʃən/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You can always improve next time, but only if you give yourself permission to actually start.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˌɪmpɹˈuv nˈɛkst tˈaɪm bˈʌt ˈoʊnli ˈɪf jˈu ɡˈɪv jɚsˈɛlf pɚmˈɪʃən tˈu ˈæktʃˌuəli stˈɑɹt/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: The second way imposter syndrome shows up is the comparison complex.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ðə sˈɛkənd wˈeɪ ˌɪmpˈɔstɚ sˈɪndɹˌoʊm ʃˈoʊz ˈʌp ˈɪz ðə kəmpˈɛɹəsən kˈɑmplɛks/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: Ever walked into a room full of high performers
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɛvɚ wˈɔkt ˈɪntu ə ɹˈum fˈʊl ˈʌv hˈaɪ pɚfˈɔɹmɚz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: and instantly felt like you're the least impressive one there?
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ənd ˈɪnstəntli fˈɛlt lˈaɪk jˈʊɹ ðə lˈist ˌɪmpɹˈɛsɪv wˈʌn ðˈɛɹ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: It's because when you're surrounded by other high achievers,
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪts bɪkˈɔz wˈɛn jˈʊɹ sɚˈaʊndɪd bˈaɪ ˈʌðɚ hˈaɪ ətʃˈivɚz/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: it is easy to feel like you're falling behind, no matter how well you're actually doing.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz ˈizi tˈu fˈil lˈaɪk jˈʊɹ fˈɑlɪŋ bɪhˈaɪnd nˈoʊ mˈætɚ hˈaʊ wˈɛl jˈʊɹ ˈæktʃˌuəli dˈuɪŋ/

bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.text: You start measuring your worth by what others are achieving.
bea13e2b-d4aa-47c9-a0d0-b4a005f459d7.ipa: /jˈu stˈɑɹt mˈɛʒɚɪŋ jˈɔɹ wˈɝθ bˈaɪ wˈʌt ˈʌðɚz ˈɑɹ ətʃˈivɪŋ/

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Imagine everything you wrote came to life.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ˌɪmˈædʒən ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ jˈu ɹˈoʊt kˈeɪm tˈu lˈaɪf/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Hãy tưởng tượng mọi thứ bạn viết đều trở thành hiện thực.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Katarina woke up in a beautiful villa she had never seen before.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /kˌɑtɚˈinə wˈoʊk ˈʌp ɪn ə bjˈutəfəl vˈɪlə ʃˈi hˈæd nˈɛvɚ sˈin bɪfˈɔɹ/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Katarina tỉnh dậy trong một biệt thự xinh đẹp mà cô chưa từng thấy trước đây.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: She had no idea how she got there.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ʃˈi hˈæd nˈoʊ aɪdˈiə hˈaʊ ʃˈi ɡˈɑt ðˈɛɹ/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Cô ấy không biết làm thế nào mình lại ở đó.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: On the table was the only clue.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ˈɑn ðə tˈeɪbəl wˈɑz ðə ˈoʊnli klˈu/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Trên bàn là manh mối duy nhất.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Her first wish had already come true.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /hˈɝ fˈɝst wˈɪʃ hˈæd ɔlɹˈɛdi kˈʌm tɹˈu/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Ước nguyện đầu tiên của cô ấy đã thành hiện thực.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Curious, she tested the next one.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /kjˈʊɹiəs ʃˈi tˈɛstɪd ðə nˈɛkst wˈʌn/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Tò mò, cô ấy đã thử cái tiếp theo.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: And then another.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ənˈʌðɚ/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Và rồi một cái nữa.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: One by one, every wish came to life.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /wˈʌn bˈaɪ wˈʌn ˈɛvɚi wˈɪʃ kˈeɪm tˈu lˈaɪf/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Từng điều ước một, tất cả đều trở thành hiện thực.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Was this book magic?
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /wˈɑz ðˈɪs bˈʊk mˈædʒɪk/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Cuốn sách này có phải là phép thuật không?

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Then she turned to a bigger question.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ðˈɛn ʃˈi tˈɝnd tˈu ə bˈɪɡɚ kwˈɛstʃən/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Rồi cô ấy chuyển sang một câu hỏi lớn hơn.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: She put her pen to the page and waited. Nothing came.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ʃˈi pˈʊt hˈɝ pˈɛn tˈu ðə pˈeɪdʒ ənd wˈeɪtɪd nˈʌθɪŋ kˈeɪm/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Cô ấy đặt bút lên trang giấy và chờ đợi. Không có gì đến cả.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Imagining small wishes was easy, but envisioning an entire life was harder.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ˌɪmˈædʒənɪŋ smˈɔl wˈɪʃɪz wˈɑz ˈizi bˈʌt ɛnvˈɪʒənɪŋ ˈæn ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈaɪf wˈɑz hˈɑɹdɚ/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Việc tưởng tượng những điều ước nhỏ bé thì dễ dàng, nhưng hình dung cả một cuộc đời thì khó hơn.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Where to even begin?
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /wˈɛɹ tˈu ˈivɪn bɪɡˈɪn/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Bắt đầu từ đâu đây?

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: That's when she understood what the workbook was really here for.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ðˈæts wˈɛn ʃˈi ˌʌndɚstˈʊd wˈʌt ðə wˈɝkbˌʊk wˈɑz ɹˈɪli hˈiɹ fˈɔɹ/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Đó là lúc cô ấy hiểu được mục đích thực sự của cuốn sách bài tập.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: To guide her to the answers rooted in her truest self.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /tˈu ɡˈaɪd hˈɝ tˈu ðə ˈænsɚz ɹˈutəd ɪn hˈɝ tɹˈuɪst sˈɛlf/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Để dẫn dắt cô ấy đến những câu trả lời bắt nguồn từ con người thật nhất của cô ấy.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: With each honest answer, she understood herself more deeply.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /wˈɪð ˈitʃ ˈɑnəst ˈænsɚ ʃˈi ˌʌndɚstˈʊd hɚsˈɛlf mˈɔɹ dˈipli/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Với mỗi câu trả lời chân thật, cô ấy càng hiểu rõ hơn về bản thân mình.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Her answers brought life to her vision, translating it into practical goals and next steps.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /hˈɝ ˈænsɚz bɹˈɔt lˈaɪf tˈu hˈɝ vˈɪʒən tɹænzlˈeɪtɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪntu pɹˈæktəkəl ɡˈoʊlz ənd nˈɛkst stˈɛps/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Câu trả lời của cô ấy đã thổi hồn vào tầm nhìn của cô ấy, chuyển nó thành các mục tiêu thực tế và các bước tiếp theo.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: The real magic was realizing her dream life was hers to create.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ðə ɹˈil mˈædʒɪk wˈɑz ɹˈiəlˌaɪzɪŋ hˈɝ dɹˈim lˈaɪf wˈɑz hɚz tˈu kɹiˈeɪt/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Phép màu thực sự là nhận ra cuộc sống mơ ước của cô ấy là do cô ấy tự tạo ra.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: A dream life doesn't appear all at once.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /ə dɹˈim lˈaɪf dˈʌzənt əpˈɪɹ ˈɔl ˈæt wˈʌns/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Cuộc sống mơ ước không xuất hiện cùng một lúc.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: You shape it day by day through the choices you make and the steps you take.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /jˈu ʃˈeɪp ˈɪt dˈeɪ bˈaɪ dˈeɪ θɹˈu ðə tʃˈɔɪsəz jˈu mˈeɪk ənd ðə stˈɛps jˈu tˈeɪk/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Bạn định hình nó từng ngày thông qua những lựa chọn bạn đưa ra và những bước đi bạn thực hiện.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Begin with a 2027 Artist of Life Workbook.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /bɪɡˈɪn wˈɪð ə 2027 ˈɑɹtəst ˈʌv lˈaɪf wˈɝkbˌʊk/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Bắt đầu với một Sổ tay Nghệ sĩ Cuộc sống 2027.

e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.text: Nurture what is wild and true in you.
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.ipa: /nˈɝtʃɚ wˈʌt ˈɪz wˈaɪld ənd tɹˈu ɪn jˈu/
e8398482-3a56-4390-805c-1707868606ef.vietnamese_text: Nuôi dưỡng những gì hoang dã và chân thật trong bạn.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I was a victim of the 5:00 a.m. club.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz ə vˈɪktəm ˈʌv ðə 500 ˈæm klˈʌb/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi là nạn nhân của câu lạc bộ 5 giờ sáng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Wake up, brush teeth, chug green juice, drive to the gym in the dark.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /wˈeɪk ˈʌp bɹˈʌʃ tˈiθ tʃˈʌɡ ɡɹˈin dʒˈus dɹˈaɪv tˈu ðə dʒˈɪm ɪn ðə dˈɑɹk/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Thức dậy, đánh răng, uống nước ép xanh, lái xe đến phòng tập trong bóng tối.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Sometimes there'd be snow.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ðˈɛɹd bˈi snˈoʊ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Đôi khi sẽ có tuyết.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I think when we go through these phases,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk wˈɛn wˈi ɡˈoʊ θɹˈu ðˈiz fˈeɪzəz/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ khi chúng ta trải qua những giai đoạn này,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: it's always in a desperate attempt to get our life together.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɪn ə dˈɛspɹɪt ətˈɛmpt tˈu ɡˈɛt ˈaʊɚ lˈaɪf təɡˈɛðɚ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: đó luôn là một nỗ lực tuyệt vọng để sắp xếp lại cuộc sống của chúng ta.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: But let's be honest, who are we trying to impress?
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt lˈɛts bˈi ˈɑnəst hˈu ˈɑɹ wˈi tɹˈaɪɪŋ tˈu ˌɪmpɹˈɛs/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Nhưng hãy thành thật đi, chúng ta đang cố gắng gây ấn tượng với ai?

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I've come to realize that although I like feeling productive,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪv kˈʌm tˈu ɹˈiəlˌaɪz ðˈæt ˌɔlðˈoʊ ˈaɪ lˈaɪk fˈilɪŋ pɹədˈʌktɪv/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi nhận ra rằng mặc dù tôi thích cảm giác làm việc hiệu quả,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: that doesn't mean I have to cram a million things into my morning
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈæt dˈʌzənt mˈin ˈaɪ hˈæv tˈu kɹˈæm ə mˈɪljən θˈɪŋz ˈɪntu mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: điều đó không có nghĩa là tôi phải nhồi nhét cả triệu thứ vào buổi sáng của mình

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: routine before 10:00 a.m.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ɹutˈin bɪfˈɔɹ 1000 ˈæm/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: lịch trình trước 10 giờ sáng

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So, I quit the traditional morning routine.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ kwˈɪt ðə tɹədˈɪʃənəl mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹutˈin/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Vậy là tôi đã bỏ thói quen buổi sáng truyền thống.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And honestly, I've never been happier.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɑnəstli ˈaɪv nˈɛvɚ bˈɪn hˈæpiɚ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và thật lòng mà nói, tôi chưa bao giờ hạnh phúc hơn thế.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So, here's what I cut.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈɪɹz wˈʌt ˈaɪ kˈʌt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Vậy, đây là những gì tôi đã cắt.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The 5 a.m. alarm gone.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə 5 ˈæm əlˈɑɹm ɡˈɔn/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Chuông báo thức 5 giờ sáng đã reo.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I care about getting enough sleep rather than waking up at a certain time.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ kˈɛɹ əbˈaʊt ɡˈɛtɪŋ ɪnˈʌf slˈip ɹˈæðɚ ðˈæn wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp ˈæt ə sˈɝtən tˈaɪm/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi quan tâm đến việc ngủ đủ giấc hơn là thức dậy vào một thời điểm nhất định.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Super strenuous workouts gone.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈupɚ stɹˈɛnjuəs wˈɝkˌaʊts ɡˈɔn/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Các bài tập cực kỳ vất vả đã xong.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I was in a big Pilates phase a few months ago,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɪn ə bˈɪɡ pɪlˈɑtˌis fˈeɪz ə fjˈu mˈʌnθs əɡˈoʊ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Vài tháng trước tôi đang theo một trào lưu Pilates lớn,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but they actually made me feel more tired.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈeɪ ˈæktʃˌuəli mˈeɪd mˈi fˈil mˈɔɹ tˈaɪɚd/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: nhưng chúng thực sự khiến tôi cảm thấy mệt mỏi hơn.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And I'm not talking about being a little sore.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪm nˈɑt tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt bˈiɪŋ ə lˈɪtəl sˈɔɹ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và tôi không nói về việc hơi đau.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I was fullblown exhausted days after my workout.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz fullblown ɪɡzˈɔstɪd dˈeɪz ˈæftɚ mˈaɪ wˈɝkˌaʊt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi kiệt sức hoàn toàn nhiều ngày sau buổi tập luyện của mình.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Cramming tons of work in gone.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /kɹˈæmɪŋ tˈʌnz ˈʌv wˈɝk ɪn ɡˈɔn/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Nhồi nhét tấn công việc đã qua.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I don't want to immediately start my day stressed out about work.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu ˌɪmˈidˌiətli stˈɑɹt mˈaɪ dˈeɪ stɹˈɛst ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt wˈɝk/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi không muốn bắt đầu ngày mới với sự căng thẳng về công việc.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The morning is my time to start my day off right now.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ ˈɪz mˈaɪ tˈaɪm tˈu stˈɑɹt mˈaɪ dˈeɪ ˈɔf ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Buổi sáng là thời gian để tôi bắt đầu ngày mới thật tốt đẹp.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: What happened after I stopped doing all of that?
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /wˈʌt hˈæpənd ˈæftɚ ˈaɪ stˈɑpt dˈuɪŋ ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Điều gì đã xảy ra sau khi tôi ngừng làm tất cả những điều đó?

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Nothing. Nothing happened.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈʌθɪŋ nˈʌθɪŋ hˈæpənd/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Không có gì. Không có gì xảy ra cả.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: My career didn't fall apart.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /mˈaɪ kɚˈɪɹ dˈɪdənt fˈɔl əpˈɑɹt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Sự nghiệp của tôi không tan vỡ.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I didn't gain a bunch of weight.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈɪdənt ɡˈeɪn ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv wˈeɪt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi không tăng cân nhiều.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I didn't become lazy.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈɪdənt bɪkˈʌm lˈeɪzi/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã không trở nên lười biếng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Nothing happened to me.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈʌθɪŋ hˈæpənd tˈu mˈi/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Không có gì xảy ra với tôi.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: In fact, I am much happier now than I was back then.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ɪn fˈækt ˈaɪ ˈæm mˈʌtʃ hˈæpiɚ nˈaʊ ðˈæn ˈaɪ wˈɑz bˈæk ðˈɛn/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Thực tế là bây giờ tôi hạnh phúc hơn nhiều so với trước đây.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So, let me show you what my current morning routine looks like now.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ lˈɛt mˈi ʃˈoʊ jˈu wˈʌt mˈaɪ kˈɝənt mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹutˈin lˈʊks lˈaɪk nˈaʊ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Vậy, để tôi cho bạn thấy lịch trình buổi sáng hiện tại của tôi trông như thế nào.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I still wake up with an alarm, but definitely not as early as 5:00 a.m.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ stˈɪl wˈeɪk ˈʌp wˈɪð ˈæn əlˈɑɹm bˈʌt dˈɛfənətli nˈɑt ˈæz ˈɝli ˈæz 500 ˈæm/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi vẫn thức dậy bằng báo thức, nhưng chắc chắn không sớm như 5 giờ sáng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: My body feels its best when I wake up around 7:30.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /mˈaɪ bˈɑdi fˈilz ˈɪts bˈɛst wˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈeɪk ˈʌp ɚˈaʊnd 730/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Cơ thể tôi cảm thấy khỏe nhất khi tôi thức dậy vào khoảng 7:30.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And because I'm self-employed and work from home, I'm grateful
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪm selfemployed ənd wˈɝk fɹˈʌm hˈoʊm ˈaɪm ɡɹˈeɪtfəl/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và vì tôi tự kinh doanh và làm việc tại nhà, tôi biết ơn

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: that I can wake up a little bit later.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈaɪ kˈæn wˈeɪk ˈʌp ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt lˈeɪtɚ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: để tôi có thể thức dậy muộn hơn một chút.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I absolutely love my Hatch alarm clock.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˌæbsəlˈutli lˈʌv mˈaɪ hˈætʃ əlˈɑɹm klˈɑk/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi hoàn toàn yêu thích đồng hồ báo thức Hatch của mình.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It gradually wakes me up, so I'm not panicking when my alarm goes off.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡɹˈædʒuəli wˈeɪks mˈi ˈʌp sˈoʊ ˈaɪm nˈɑt pˈænɪkɪŋ wˈɛn mˈaɪ əlˈɑɹm ɡˈoʊz ˈɔf/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Nó từ từ đánh thức tôi dậy, vì vậy tôi không hoảng sợ khi chuông báo thức reo.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Something I have kept from my morning routine is hydration,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈaɪ hˈæv kˈɛpt fɹˈʌm mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹutˈin ˈɪz haɪdɹˈeɪʃən/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Một điều tôi đã giữ lại từ thói quen buổi sáng của mình là uống đủ nước,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but instead of celery juice, it's room temperature lemon water.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv sˈɛlɚi dʒˈus ˈɪts ɹˈum tˈɛmpɹətʃɚ lˈɛmən wˈɔtɚ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: nhưng thay vì nước ép cần tây, thì là nước chanh ở nhiệt độ phòng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I honestly can't be bothered to use a cold pressed juicer,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈɑnəstli kˈænt bˈi bˈɑðɚd tˈu jˈus ə kˈoʊld pɹˈɛst juicer/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Thành thật mà nói, tôi không đủ sức để dùng máy ép chậm,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but lemon juice still has tons of great benefits.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt lˈɛmən dʒˈus stˈɪl hˈæz tˈʌnz ˈʌv ɡɹˈeɪt bˈɛnəfɪts/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: nhưng nước chanh vẫn có vô số lợi ích tuyệt vời.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I have a confession to make.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv ə kənfˈɛʃən tˈu mˈeɪk/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi có một lời thú nhận.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I haven't worked out in over a month,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈævənt wˈɝkt ˈaʊt ɪn ˈoʊvɚ ə mˈʌnθ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã không tập thể dục trong hơn một tháng rồi,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: which is pretty unusual for me,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz pɹˈɪti ənjˈuʒˌuəl fˈɔɹ mˈi/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: điều này khá bất thường đối với tôi,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but I've just been going through a lot of things, and that's okay.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪv dʒˈʌst bˈɪn ɡˈoʊɪŋ θɹˈu ə lˈɑt ˈʌv θˈɪŋz ənd ðˈæts ˌoʊkˈeɪ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: nhưng tôi vừa trải qua rất nhiều chuyện, và điều đó không sao cả.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'm being patient with myself.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪm bˈiɪŋ pˈeɪʃənt wˈɪð mˌaɪsˈɛlf/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi đang kiên nhẫn với chính mình.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I have been walking outside a lot though, so I haven't been entirely sedentary.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv bˈɪn wˈɔkɪŋ ˈaʊtsˈaɪd ə lˈɑt ðˈoʊ sˈoʊ ˈaɪ hˈævənt bˈɪn ɪntˈaɪɚli sˈɛdəntˌɛɹi/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tuy nhiên, tôi đã đi bộ ngoài trời rất nhiều, vì vậy tôi không hoàn toàn ít vận động.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And I think after waking up at 5:00 for a year
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈæftɚ wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp ˈæt 500 fˈɔɹ ə jˈɪɹ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và tôi nghĩ sau khi thức dậy lúc 5 giờ sáng trong một năm

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: and doing intense workouts, I went the opposite.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd dˈuɪŋ ˌɪntˈɛns wˈɝkˌaʊts ˈaɪ wˈɛnt ðə ˈɑpəzət/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: và tập luyện cường độ cao, tôi đã làm ngược lại.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And now I only focus on moving my body, increasing flexibility, and raising my heart rate.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ ˈaɪ ˈoʊnli fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn mˈuvɪŋ mˈaɪ bˈɑdi ˌɪnkɹˈisɪŋ flˌɛksəbˈɪləti ənd ɹˈeɪzɪŋ mˈaɪ hˈɑɹt ɹˈeɪt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và bây giờ tôi chỉ tập trung vào việc vận động cơ thể, tăng cường sự linh hoạt và nâng cao nhịp tim.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Then it is time for some beauty rituals.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ sˈʌm bjˈuti ɹˈɪtʃuəlz/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Vậy thì đã đến lúc thực hiện một vài nghi thức làm đẹp.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Again, I think the morning is the best time for self-care
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /əɡˈɛn ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ ˈɪz ðə bˈɛst tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ selfcare/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ buổi sáng là thời gian tốt nhất để chăm sóc bản thân.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: and just getting your mind and body right for the day.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst ɡˈɛtɪŋ jˈɔɹ mˈaɪnd ənd bˈɑdi ɹˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ðə dˈeɪ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: và chỉ cần làm cho tâm trí và cơ thể bạn sẵn sàng cho ngày mới.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Before I do my skincare,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ dˈu mˈaɪ skincare/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Trước khi tôi làm chăm sóc da,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I like to sit in front of my red light panel and meditate.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪk tˈu sˈɪt ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv mˈaɪ ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt pˈænəl ənd mˈɛdətˌeɪt/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích ngồi trước tấm đèn đỏ của mình và thiền định.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is such an easy habit stack.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ˈæn ˈizi hˈæbət stˈæk/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Đây là một chuỗi thói quen thật dễ dàng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Not only am I rejuvenating my skin, but also my mind.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈɑt ˈoʊnli ˈæm ˈaɪ ɹidʒˈuvənˌeɪtɪŋ mˈaɪ skˈɪn bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Không chỉ làn da của tôi đang được trẻ hóa, mà tâm trí tôi cũng vậy.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And since my life is pretty stressful right now,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd sˈɪns mˈaɪ lˈaɪf ˈɪz pɹˈɪti stɹˈɛsfəl ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Và vì cuộc sống của tôi khá căng thẳng ngay lúc này,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: this really gets me in the right headsp space.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ɹˈɪli ɡˈɛts mˈi ɪn ðə ɹˈaɪt headsp spˈeɪs/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: điều này thực sự giúp tôi có được tâm trạng phù hợp.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I think habit stacking your beauty rituals is such a great way to get more
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk hˈæbət stˈækɪŋ jˈɔɹ bjˈuti ɹˈɪtʃuəlz ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈɔɹ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ việc kết hợp các thói quen làm đẹp của bạn là một cách tuyệt vời để có thêm

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: out of your morning.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaʊt ˈʌv jˈɔɹ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: ra khỏi buổi sáng của bạn.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: But you don't need to spend a lot of time doing them.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid tˈu spˈɛnd ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm dˈuɪŋ ðˈɛm/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Nhưng bạn không cần phải dành nhiều thời gian để làm chúng.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Even if it's one small thing that makes you feel more beautiful
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf ˈɪts wˈʌn smˈɔl θˈɪŋ ðˈæt mˈeɪks jˈu fˈil mˈɔɹ bjˈutəfəl/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Ngay cả khi đó là một điều nhỏ bé khiến bạn cảm thấy xinh đẹp hơn

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: or confident, it's worth doing.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədənt ˈɪts wˈɝθ dˈuɪŋ/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: hoặc tự tin, nó đáng để làm.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: My other favorite beauty habit stack is to listen to a podcast while doing my nails.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /mˈaɪ ˈʌðɚ fˈeɪvɚɪt bjˈuti hˈæbət stˈæk ˈɪz tˈu lˈɪsən tˈu ə pˈɔdkˌæst wˈaɪl dˈuɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Thói quen làm đẹp yêu thích khác của tôi là nghe podcast trong khi làm móng tay.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Most of you guys know my complicated nail journey.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /mˈoʊst ˈʌv jˈu ɡˈaɪz nˈoʊ mˈaɪ kˈɑmpləkˌeɪtəd nˈeɪl dʒˈɝni/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Hầu hết các bạn đều biết hành trình làm móng phức tạp của tôi.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I've gone through periods of constantly getting my nails done at a salon,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪv ɡˈɔn θɹˈu pˈɪɹiədz ˈʌv kˈɑnstəntli ɡˈɛtɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz dˈʌn ˈæt ə səlˈɑn/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã trải qua những giai đoạn liên tục đi làm móng ở tiệm,

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but the gel would absolutely destroy my nail beds.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə dʒˈɛl wˈʊd ˌæbsəlˈutli dɪstɹˈɔɪ mˈaɪ nˈeɪl bˈɛdz/
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.vietnamese_text: nhưng gel sẽ hủy hoại hoàn toàn giường móng của tôi.

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And I hate breathing in the chemicals, which is such a shame
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ hˈeɪt bɹˈiðɪŋ ɪn ðə kˈɛmɪkəlz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə ʃˈeɪm/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: because I really love the look of nails.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli lˈʌv ðə lˈʊk ˈʌv nˈeɪlz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: But I recently discovered these gel alternative polishes from manicurists
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli dɪskˈʌvɚd ðˈiz dʒˈɛl ɔltˈɝnətɪv polishes fɹˈʌm manicurists/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: that you can do at home in three steps.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn dˈu ˈæt hˈoʊm ɪn θɹˈi stˈɛps/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I love that this formula is plant-based with all the benefits of traditional gel,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ðˈæt ðˈɪs fˈɔɹmjələ ˈɪz plantbased wˈɪð ˈɔl ðə bˈɛnəfɪts ˈʌv tɹədˈɪʃənəl dʒˈɛl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but without the damage or chemicals.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt wɪθˈaʊt ðə dˈæmədʒ ˈɔɹ kˈɛmɪkəlz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The Extreme Flash top coat lasts up to 21 days, which is insane.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə ɛkstɹˈim flˈæʃ tˈɑp kˈoʊt lˈæsts ˈʌp tˈu 21 dˈeɪz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ˌɪnsˈeɪn/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And if you're like me and you hate taking off your nails with a drill,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈaɪk mˈi ənd jˈu hˈeɪt tˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɔf jˈɔɹ nˈeɪlz wˈɪð ə dɹˈɪl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: these easily come off with an acetone-free remover.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈiz ˈizəli kˈʌm ˈɔf wˈɪð ˈæn acetonefree ɹɪmˈuvɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Having my nails done makes me feel so put together even on my busiest days.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /hˈævɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz dˈʌn mˈeɪks mˈi fˈil sˈoʊ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ ˈivɪn ˈɑn mˈaɪ bˈɪziəst dˈeɪz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If you guys want to ditch traditional gel and maintain healthier nails,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu ɡˈaɪz wˈɑnt tˈu dˈɪtʃ tɹədˈɪʃənəl dʒˈɛl ənd meɪntˈeɪn hˈɛlθiɚ nˈeɪlz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'll link this kit from Manicurist in the description.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪŋk ðˈɪs kˈɪt fɹˈʌm mˈænɪkjˌɝɪst ɪn ðə dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And you can get 15% off sitewide using my code.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd jˈu kˈæn ɡˈɛt 15 ˈɔf sitewide jˈuzɪŋ mˈaɪ kˈoʊd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It is time to now make my matcha.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈaɪm tˈu nˈaʊ mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is one of my favorite parts of my morning.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt pˈɑɹts ˈʌv mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'm a big believer in that you don't really need to measure anything,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪm ə bˈɪɡ bəlˈivɚ ɪn ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt ɹˈɪli nˈid tˈu mˈɛʒɚ ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: you know, you just measure with your heart.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ jˈu dʒˈʌst mˈɛʒɚ wˈɪð jˈɔɹ hˈɑɹt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So, the first thing I do is I will heat up some water in my kettle.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðə fˈɝst θˈɪŋ ˈaɪ dˈu ˈɪz ˈaɪ wˈɪl hˈit ˈʌp sˈʌm wˈɔtɚ ɪn mˈaɪ kˈɛtəl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Just like a very small amount.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk ə vˈɛɹi smˈɔl əmˈaʊnt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: You don't need too much.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid tˈu mˈʌtʃ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And then while that's heating up, I like to take some warm water.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈaɪl ðˈæts hˈitɪŋ ˈʌp ˈaɪ lˈaɪk tˈu tˈeɪk sˈʌm wˈɔɹm wˈɔtɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And I'll just fill like a small cup to soak my whisk.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪl dʒˈʌst fˈɪl lˈaɪk ə smˈɔl kˈʌp tˈu sˈoʊk mˈaɪ wˈɪsk/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is really important to soften the bristles.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt tˈu sˈɑfən ðə bɹˈɪsəlz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It helps to like mix better.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈɛlps tˈu lˈaɪk mˈɪks bˈɛtɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Then I'm going to take two to three scoops of my favorite matcha.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu tˈeɪk tˈu tˈu θɹˈi skˈups ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt matcha/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is Rocky's matcha.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz rocky's matcha/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If you're looking for that super creamy, gently sweet,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈʊkɪŋ fˈɔɹ ðˈæt sˈupɚ kɹˈimi dʒˈɛntli swˈit/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: nutty kind of matcha that you always get at a cafe,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈʌti kˈaɪnd ˈʌv matcha ðˈæt jˈu ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɡˈɛt ˈæt ə kəfˈeɪ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: this is the one you have to get.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə wˈʌn jˈu hˈæv tˈu ɡˈɛt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And then just sift it through.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dʒˈʌst sˈɪft ˈɪt θɹˈu/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is to remove any of the clumps.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz tˈu ɹimˈuv ˈɛni ˈʌv ðə klˈʌmps/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: All right. By now, my water is almost boiling.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt bˈaɪ nˈaʊ mˈaɪ wˈɔtɚ ˈɪz ˈɔlmˌoʊst bˈɔɪlɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: You don't want to use boiling water because it's going to burn your matcha
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈu dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu jˈus bˈɔɪlɪŋ wˈɔtɚ bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈɝn jˈɔɹ matcha/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: and make it taste bitter.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd mˈeɪk ˈɪt tˈeɪst bˈɪtɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I just like to cover about like that much.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk tˈu kˈʌvɚ əbˈaʊt lˈaɪk ðˈæt mˈʌtʃ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And then take my softened whisk.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn tˈeɪk mˈaɪ sˈɔfənd wˈɪsk/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And now we whisk in an M motion.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ wˈi wˈɪsk ɪn ˈæn ˈɛm mˈoʊʃən/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'd say you want to whisk it for about a minute.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪd sˈeɪ jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu wˈɪsk ˈɪt fˈɔɹ əbˈaʊt ə mˈɪnət/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And you'll know it's ready
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd jˈul nˈoʊ ˈɪts ɹˈɛdi/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: when you start to see some tiny bubbles at the top like this.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /wˈɛn jˈu stˈɑɹt tˈu sˈi sˈʌm tˈaɪni bˈʌbəlz ˈæt ðə tˈɑp lˈaɪk ðˈɪs/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It should look foamy.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪt ʃˈʊd lˈʊk fˈoʊmi/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I've just got some almond milk in here with some ice.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪv dʒˈʌst ɡˈɑt sˈʌm ˈɑmənd mˈɪlk ɪn hˈiɹ wˈɪð sˈʌm ˈaɪs/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And now it's time for my favorite part.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ ˈɪts tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt pˈɑɹt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Got to get every last drop.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ɡˈɑt tˈu ɡˈɛt ˈɛvɚi lˈæst dɹˈɑp/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Matcha's expensive. We can't waste any.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /matcha's ɪkspˈɛnsɪv wˈi kˈænt wˈeɪst ˈɛni/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I feel like this is one of the best matchas I've ever made
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ fˈil lˈaɪk ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst matchas ˈaɪv ˈɛvɚ mˈeɪd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: in terms of color.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv kˈʌlɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Like look at that.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /lˈaɪk lˈʊk ˈæt ðˈæt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: All right, let's try it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt lˈɛts tɹˈaɪ ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: No astringency at all.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈoʊ astringency ˈæt ˈɔl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It's like so just like perfect.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪts lˈaɪk sˈoʊ dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk pɚfˈɛkt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'm telling you guys, a good matcha latte will hit every single time.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪm tˈɛlɪŋ jˈu ɡˈaɪz ə ɡˈʊd matcha lˈɑtˌeɪ wˈɪl hˈɪt ˈɛvɚi sˈɪŋɡəl tˈaɪm/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I also don't add any sweetener because the powder that I use is already naturally sweet.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈɔlsoʊ dˈoʊnt ˈæd ˈɛni swˈitənɚ bɪkˈɔz ðə pˈaʊdɚ ðˈæt ˈaɪ jˈus ˈɪz ɔlɹˈɛdi nˈætʃɚəli swˈit/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: This is so good.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I was actually so thirsty this whole morning.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈoʊ θˈɝsti ðˈɪs hˈoʊl mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So, I already drank like half of this.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ ɔlɹˈɛdi dɹˈæŋk lˈaɪk hˈæf ˈʌv ðˈɪs/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The reason I can really take my time in the mornings
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə ɹˈizən ˈaɪ kˈæn ɹˈɪli tˈeɪk mˈaɪ tˈaɪm ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: is because I know exactly how much time I have
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪz bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ɪɡzˈæktli hˈaʊ mˈʌtʃ tˈaɪm ˈaɪ hˈæv/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: before I need to start actually doing work.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ nˈid tˈu stˈɑɹt ˈæktʃˌuəli dˈuɪŋ wˈɝk/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'm not stressed in the morning because I actually plan everything out the night before.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪm nˈɑt stɹˈɛst ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ ˈæktʃˌuəli plˈæn ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈaʊt ðə nˈaɪt bɪfˈɔɹ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I write everything down.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈaɪt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ dˈaʊn/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Yes, I have a Google calendar, Apple calendar, but nothing will ever beat a physical planner.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaɪ hˈæv ə ɡˈuɡəl kˈæləndɚ ˈæpəl kˈæləndɚ bˈʌt nˈʌθɪŋ wˈɪl ˈɛvɚ bˈit ə fˈɪzɪkəl plˈænɚ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: You can see it, feel it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn sˈi ˈɪt fˈil ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The tactile movement of writing stuff down helps you remember it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə tˈæktɪl mˈuvmənt ˈʌv ɹˈaɪtɪŋ stˈʌf dˈaʊn hˈɛlps jˈu ɹɪmˈɛmbɚ ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And before I go to bed, I review the next day's schedule
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ ɡˈoʊ tˈu bˈɛd ˈaɪ ɹˌivjˈu ðə nˈɛkst dˈeɪz skˈɛdʒʊl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: so I know what's expected.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ nˈoʊ wˈʌts ɪkspˈɛktəd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'm also just someone who needs to mentally prepare for things.
