ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪm ˈɔlsoʊ dʒˈʌst sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu nˈidz tˈu mˈɛntəli pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ θˈɪŋz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Like if I have a day packed with meetings, I need to mentally prepare for it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /lˈaɪk ˈɪf ˈaɪ hˈæv ə dˈeɪ pˈækt wˈɪð mˈitɪŋz ˈaɪ nˈid tˈu mˈɛntəli pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So having a physical calendar, something I can actually see,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈævɪŋ ə fˈɪzɪkəl kˈæləndɚ sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈaɪ kˈæn ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈi/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: not a notification, is what makes my peaceful mornings possible.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /nˈɑt ə nˌoʊtəfəkˈeɪʃən ˈɪz wˈʌt mˈeɪks mˈaɪ pˈisfəl mˈɔɹnɪŋz pˈɑsəbəl/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I know that everything I just described sounds like a routine,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst dɪskɹˈaɪbd sˈaʊndz lˈaɪk ə ɹutˈin/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: but I don't call it that.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt kˈɔl ˈɪt ðˈæt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And here's why.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd hˈɪɹz wˈaɪ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I don't do all of this every day.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt dˈu ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈɪs ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: My nails now last so long, I don't even need to do them every day
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz nˈaʊ lˈæst sˈoʊ lˈɔŋ ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn nˈid tˈu dˈu ðˈɛm ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: or even every week.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ˈivɪn ˈɛvɚi wˈik/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: It's barely even a task.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɛɹli ˈivɪn ə tˈæsk/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If I've got somewhere
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪv ɡˈɑt sˈʌmwˌɛɹ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: to be and I don't have time to do red light therapy, I skip it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /tˈu bˈi ənd ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu dˈu ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt θˈɛɹəpi ˈaɪ skˈɪp ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If I can't make my matcha, I don't make my matcha.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ kˈænt mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: There's some mornings I do three things from this list and that's it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz sˈʌm mˈɔɹnɪŋz ˈaɪ dˈu θɹˈi θˈɪŋz fɹˈʌm ðˈɪs lˈɪst ənd ðˈæts ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I don't punish myself for not completing something.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt pˈʌnɪʃ mˌaɪsˈɛlf fˈɔɹ nˈɑt kəmplˈitɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: There's no streak I have to maintain.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz nˈoʊ stɹˈik ˈaɪ hˈæv tˈu meɪntˈeɪn/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And especially as women, we need to be in tune with our bodies
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd əspˈɛʃli ˈæz wˈɪmən wˈi nˈid tˈu bˈi ɪn tˈun wˈɪð ˈaʊɚ bˈɑdiz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: and do different things throughout the month.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd dˈu dˈɪfɚənt θˈɪŋz θɹuˈaʊt ðə mˈʌnθ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If I'm about to get my period,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪm əbˈaʊt tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈaɪ pˈɪɹiəd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: sometimes I don't have the energy to be doing all of this.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv ðə ˈɛnɚdʒi tˈu bˈi dˈuɪŋ ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈɪs/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I'll literally just sit on my couch and use my heating pad instead
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪtɚəli dʒˈʌst sˈɪt ˈɑn mˈaɪ kˈaʊtʃ ənd jˈus mˈaɪ hˈitɪŋ pˈæd ˌɪnstˈɛd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: because that's what my body needs.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ðˈæts wˈʌt mˈaɪ bˈɑdi nˈidz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I think sometimes we need to let go of being super rigid
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk səmtˈaɪmz wˈi nˈid tˈu lˈɛt ɡˈoʊ ˈʌv bˈiɪŋ sˈupɚ ɹˈɪdʒəd/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: and allow the fluidity of life.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd əlˈaʊ ðə fluˈɪdəti ˈʌv lˈaɪf/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: If your routine is not serving you and you don't even know
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈɔɹ ɹutˈin ˈɪz nˈɑt sˈɝvɪŋ jˈu ənd jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn nˈoʊ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: why you do certain things, we need to recalibrate that.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /wˈaɪ jˈu dˈu sˈɝtən θˈɪŋz wˈi nˈid tˈu recalibrate ðˈæt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: The whole point of living an intentional life is to know the reasons
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðə hˈoʊl pˈɔɪnt ˈʌv lˈɪvɪŋ ˈæn ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl lˈaɪf ˈɪz tˈu nˈoʊ ðə ɹˈizənz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: for why you do things.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /fˈɔɹ wˈaɪ jˈu dˈu θˈɪŋz/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: Because if you understand the reason for doing something,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪf jˈu ˌʌndɚstˈænd ðə ɹˈizən fˈɔɹ dˈuɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: you're more likely to be consistent with it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /jˈʊɹ mˈɔɹ lˈaɪkli tˈu bˈi kənsˈɪstənt wˈɪð ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And if something is not serving you or adding value to your morning,
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɪz nˈɑt sˈɝvɪŋ jˈu ˈɔɹ ˈædɪŋ vˈælju tˈu jˈɔɹ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: then don't do it.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ðˈɛn dˈoʊnt dˈu ˈɪt/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I hope you enjoyed following me along on my morning routine.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈoʊp jˈu ˌɛndʒˈɔɪd fˈɑloʊɪŋ mˈi əlˈɔŋ ˈɑn mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹutˈin/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And if this inspired you, let me know in the comments.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ðˈɪs ˌɪnspˈaɪɚd jˈu lˈɛt mˈi nˈoʊ ɪn ðə kˈɑmɛnts/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: I am really curious about what you guys do in the morning.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm ɹˈɪli kjˈʊɹiəs əbˈaʊt wˈʌt jˈu ɡˈaɪz dˈu ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: So tell me in the comments what you do every day.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ tˈɛl mˈi ɪn ðə kˈɑmɛnts wˈʌt jˈu dˈu ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And if you're also a victim of the 5 a.m.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɔlsoʊ ə vˈɪktəm ˈʌv ðə 5 ˈæm/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: club, let me know, too.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /klˈʌb lˈɛt mˈi nˈoʊ tˈu/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: And if you liked this video, then you would really love this one.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪkt ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ ðˈɛn jˈu wˈʊd ɹˈɪli lˈʌv ðˈɪs wˈʌn/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: All right, I got to get my day started, but thanks
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt ˈaɪ ɡˈɑt tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈaɪ dˈeɪ stˈɑɹtɪd bˈʌt θˈæŋks/

ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.text: so much for watching, and I'll see you in the next one. Bye.
ee6a15af-fc6c-44ee-b48f-2bfaca92a080.ipa: /sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ fˈɔɹ wˈɑtʃɪŋ ənd ˈaɪl sˈi jˈu ɪn ðə nˈɛkst wˈʌn bˈaɪ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you've wondered why some people always seem to look polished,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈuv wˈʌndɚd wˈaɪ sˈʌm pˈipəl ˈɔlwˌeɪz sˈim tˈu lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn đã từng thắc mắc tại sao một số người luôn trông chỉnh tề,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: no matter where you catch them, they have this composure that seems effortless.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /nˈoʊ mˈætɚ wˈɛɹ jˈu kˈætʃ ðˈɛm ðˈeɪ hˈæv ðˈɪs kəmpˈoʊʒɚ ðˈæt sˈimz ˈɛfɚtləs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Bất kể bạn bắt gặp chúng ở đâu, chúng đều có sự điềm tĩnh dường như không cần cố gắng.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: In this video, I want to share my top tips
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɪn ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ ˈaɪ wˈɑnt tˈu ʃˈɛɹ mˈaɪ tˈɑp tˈɪps/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Trong video này, tôi muốn chia sẻ những lời khuyên hàng đầu của mình

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and grooming habits make it easy to always look polished.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ɡɹˈumɪŋ hˈæbəts mˈeɪk ˈɪt ˈizi tˈu ˈɔlwˌeɪz lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và thói quen chăm sóc bản thân giúp bạn luôn trông chỉnh tề.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you're new to my channel, hi, I'm Juliana.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ nˈu tˈu mˈaɪ tʃˈænəl hˈaɪ ˈaɪm dʒˌuliˈænə/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn mới đến kênh của tôi, xin chào, tôi là Juliana.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'm going to go step by step, starting with the more foundational aspects.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu ɡˈoʊ stˈɛp bˈaɪ stˈɛp stˈɑɹtɪŋ wˈɪð ðə mˈɔɹ faʊndˈeɪʃənəl ˈæspˌɛkts/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ đi từng bước, bắt đầu với những khía cạnh nền tảng hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Your hair, skin, and nails play a huge role in terms
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ skˈɪn ənd nˈeɪlz plˈeɪ ə hjˈudʒ ɹˈoʊl ɪn tˈɝmz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tóc, da và móng tay của bạn đóng vai trò rất quan trọng trong các thuật ngữ

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: of how put together you seem.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈʌv hˈaʊ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu sˈim/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: của việc bạn trông có vẻ chỉnh chu như thế nào.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I think hair makes the biggest difference.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk hˈɛɹ mˈeɪks ðə bˈɪɡəst dˈɪfɚəns/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ kiểu tóc tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn nhất.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'm a huge proponent for heatless waves.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪm ə hjˈudʒ pɹəpˈoʊnənt fˈɔɹ heatless wˈeɪvz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi là người ủng hộ mạnh mẽ cho các kiểu tóc xoăn không dùng nhiệt.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'll link a video in the cards where I have a tutorial
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪŋk ə vˈɪdioʊ ɪn ðə kˈɑɹdz wˈɛɹ ˈaɪ hˈæv ə tutˈɔɹiəl/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ liên kết một video trong thẻ nơi tôi có hướng dẫn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: on how to do them.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɑn hˈaʊ tˈu dˈu ðˈɛm/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: về cách thực hiện chúng.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They save a lot of time and a lot of hair damage.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ sˈeɪv ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm ənd ə lˈɑt ˈʌv hˈɛɹ dˈæmədʒ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Họ tiết kiệm rất nhiều thời gian và giảm thiểu hư tổn tóc.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'm personally someone who loves to have my hair curled,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪm pˈɝsənəli sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu lˈʌvz tˈu hˈæv mˈaɪ hˈɛɹ kˈɝld/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Cá nhân tôi thích làm xoăn tóc,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: which I don't think would be as sustainable if I use heat tools.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt θˈɪŋk wˈʊd bˈi ˈæz səstˈeɪnəbəl ˈɪf ˈaɪ jˈus hˈit tˈulz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: mà tôi không nghĩ là bền vững bằng nếu tôi sử dụng dụng cụ tạo kiểu bằng nhiệt.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Some people, however, may not actually want curly hair.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈʌm pˈipəl hˌaʊˈɛvɚ mˈeɪ nˈɑt ˈæktʃˌuəli wˈɑnt kˈɝli hˈɛɹ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tuy nhiên, một số người có thể không thực sự muốn có mái tóc xoăn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Some people prefer straight hair or they have a different curl pattern.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈʌm pˈipəl pɹəfˈɝ stɹˈeɪt hˈɛɹ ˈɔɹ ðˈeɪ hˈæv ə dˈɪfɚənt kˈɝl pˈætɚn/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Một số người thích tóc thẳng hoặc họ có kiểu xoăn khác.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: The thing you want to focus
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðə θˈɪŋ jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Điều bạn muốn tập trung vào

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: on when it comes to looking polished is to have a clean hair silhouette,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt ˈɪz tˈu hˈæv ə klˈin hˈɛɹ sˌɪləwˈɛt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: khi nói đến việc trông chỉnh tề là có một đường nét tóc gọn gàng,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: just like the silhouette of your body.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk ðə sˌɪləwˈɛt ˈʌv jˈɔɹ bˈɑdi/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: như hình bóng cơ thể em vậy.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Your hair will take on a specific shape.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ wˈɪl tˈeɪk ˈɑn ə spəsˈɪfɪk ʃˈeɪp/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tóc của bạn sẽ có một hình dạng cụ thể.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: And hair will tend to look most polished when it has a very clean silhouette.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd hˈɛɹ wˈɪl tˈɛnd tˈu lˈʊk mˈoʊst pˈɑlɪʃt wˈɛn ˈɪt hˈæz ə vˈɛɹi klˈin sˌɪləwˈɛt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Và tóc sẽ có xu hướng trông bóng bẩy nhất khi nó có đường nét rất gọn gàng.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: By clean, it just means that it has a noticeable shape to it.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈaɪ klˈin ˈɪt dʒˈʌst mˈinz ðˈæt ˈɪt hˈæz ə nˈoʊtəsəbəl ʃˈeɪp tˈu ˈɪt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Bằng cách sạch sẽ, nó chỉ có nghĩa là nó có một hình dạng rõ ràng.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: And this shape can be straight, curly, or wavy
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ʃˈeɪp kˈæn bˈi stɹˈeɪt kˈɝli ˈɔɹ wˈeɪvi/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Và hình dạng này có thể thẳng, xoăn hoặc gợn sóng

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and not blurred with a lot of flyaways or frizzy hair.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd nˈɑt blˈɝd wˈɪð ə lˈɑt ˈʌv flyaways ˈɔɹ frizzy hˈɛɹ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và không bị xơ rối hay phồng xù.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Personally, my hair can get frizzy and puffy quite easily.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /pˈɝsənəli mˈaɪ hˈɛɹ kˈæn ɡˈɛt frizzy ənd pˈʌfi kwˈaɪt ˈizəli/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Cá nhân tôi, tóc tôi khá dễ bị xù và phồng lên.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: So, two things that have helped me are a hair oil.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ tˈu θˈɪŋz ðˈæt hˈæv hˈɛlpt mˈi ˈɑɹ ə hˈɛɹ ˈɔɪl/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, hai thứ đã giúp tôi là một loại dầu dưỡng tóc.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I use this very sparingly.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ jˈus ðˈɪs vˈɛɹi spˈɛɹɪŋli/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi sử dụng cái này rất hạn chế.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you have finer hair, but I love this one from Keristas.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv fˈaɪnɚ hˈɛɹ bˈʌt ˈaɪ lˈʌv ðˈɪs wˈʌn fɹˈʌm keristas/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn có mái tóc mỏng hơn, nhưng tôi thích loại này của Keristas.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's the elixir all team.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts ðə ɪlˈɪksɚ ˈɔl tˈim/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Đó là thuốc tiên của cả đội.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I love a shine spray or a smoothing spray.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ə ʃˈaɪn spɹˈeɪ ˈɔɹ ə smˈuðɪŋ spɹˈeɪ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích xịt bóng hoặc xịt làm mượt.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Garnier Fis is their diamond sleek smoothing spray.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɡˈɑɹniɚ fˈɪs ˈɪz ðˈɛɹ dˈaɪmənd slˈik smˈuðɪŋ spɹˈeɪ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Garnier Fis là xịt dưỡng tóc bóng mượt kim cương của họ.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: You also want to choose eyebrows that suit your face.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈu ˈɔlsoʊ wˈɑnt tˈu tʃˈuz ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz ðˈæt sˈut jˈɔɹ fˈeɪs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Bạn cũng muốn chọn lông mày phù hợp với khuôn mặt của mình.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you're unsure about the best eyebrows for your features,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ənʃˈʊɹ əbˈaʊt ðə bˈɛst ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz fˈɔɹ jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn không chắc chắn về kiểu lông mày nào phù hợp nhất với các đường nét trên khuôn mặt của mình,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: thinner eyebrows tend to look best on those with smaller eyes
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /θˈɪnɚ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz tˈɛnd tˈu lˈʊk bˈɛst ˈɑn ðˈoʊz wˈɪð smˈɔlɚ ˈaɪz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: lông mày thon hơn có xu hướng trông đẹp nhất trên những người có đôi mắt nhỏ hơn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and or a softer gaze compared to thicker eyebrows
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ˈɔɹ ə sˈɑftɚ ɡˈeɪz kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu θˈɪkɚ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và hoặc một ánh nhìn dịu dàng hơn so với lông mày dày hơn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: which work best with larger eyes and or a stronger gaze.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɝk bˈɛst wˈɪð lˈɑɹdʒɚ ˈaɪz ənd ˈɔɹ ə stɹˈɔŋɚ ɡˈeɪz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: công việc nào phù hợp nhất với đôi mắt to hơn và/hoặc ánh nhìn mạnh mẽ hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's all about choosing a style that looks proportional.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔl əbˈaʊt tʃˈuzɪŋ ə stˈaɪl ðˈæt lˈʊks pɹəpˈɔɹʃənəl/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tất cả là về việc chọn một phong cách trông cân đối.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Go for a straighter brow shape.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɡˈoʊ fˈɔɹ ə stɹˈeɪtɚ bɹˈaʊ ʃˈeɪp/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tạo dáng lông mày thẳng hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you want to appear youthful and approachable, it creates a softer like kind of nicer.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu əpˈɪɹ jˈuθfəl ənd əpɹˈoʊtʃəbəl ˈɪt kɹiˈeɪts ə sˈɑftɚ lˈaɪk kˈaɪnd ˈʌv nˈaɪsɚ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn trông trẻ trung và dễ gần, nó tạo ra một cảm giác mềm mại, dễ chịu hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Expression on the face compared to arch eyebrows, which can look more intimidating
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɪkspɹˈɛʃən ˈɑn ðə fˈeɪs kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ˈɑɹtʃ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz wˈɪtʃ kˈæn lˈʊk mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɪmɪdˌeɪtɪŋ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Biểu cảm trên khuôn mặt so với lông mày cong, cái nào có thể trông đáng sợ hơn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: but also very elegant and feline.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ vˈɛɹi ˈɛləɡənt ənd fˈilˌaɪn/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: nhưng cũng rất thanh lịch và giống mèo.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It has a nice lifting effect for the eyes.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈæz ə nˈaɪs lˈɪftɪŋ ɪfˈɛkt fˈɔɹ ðə ˈaɪz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nó có tác dụng nâng cơ mắt rất tốt.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Now, when it comes to makeup,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /nˈaʊ wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu mˈeɪkˌʌp/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Còn khi nói đến trang điểm,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I don't really think you have to wear makeup to look polished,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt ɹˈɪli θˈɪŋk jˈu hˈæv tˈu wˈɛɹ mˈeɪkˌʌp tˈu lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi không thực sự nghĩ rằng bạn phải trang điểm để trông chỉnh tề.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and honestly, the wrong makeup or smudged makeup can detract, uh, from your appearance.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ˈɑnəstli ðə ɹˈɔŋ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɔɹ smˈʌdʒd mˈeɪkˌʌp kˈæn dɪtɹˈækt ˈʌ fɹˈʌm jˈɔɹ əpˈɪɹəns/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và thành thật mà nói, lớp trang điểm sai hoặc bị lem có thể làm giảm, ờ, vẻ ngoài của bạn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: So, you really want to find a style you like
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu ɹˈɪli wˈɑnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ə stˈaɪl jˈu lˈaɪk/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Vậy, bạn thực sự muốn tìm một phong cách mà bạn thích

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and only wear makeup as long as you feel like it can last on your face.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ˈoʊnli wˈɛɹ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈæz lˈɔŋ ˈæz jˈu fˈil lˈaɪk ˈɪt kˈæn lˈæst ˈɑn jˈɔɹ fˈeɪs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và chỉ trang điểm miễn là bạn cảm thấy nó có thể giữ trên mặt bạn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If your purpose for applying makeup is to make you look more lively
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈɔɹ pˈɝpəs fˈɔɹ əplˈaɪɪŋ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɪz tˈu mˈeɪk jˈu lˈʊk mˈɔɹ lˈaɪvli/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nếu mục đích của bạn khi trang điểm là để trông bạn rạng rỡ hơn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and healthy, then I would just focus on bright under eyes,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd hˈɛlθi ðˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈʊd dʒˈʌst fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn bɹˈaɪt ˈʌndɚ ˈaɪz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và khỏe mạnh, thì tôi sẽ chỉ tập trung vào vùng dưới mắt sáng,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: groomed eyebrow hairs, and rouge on the cheeks and the lips.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɡɹˈumd ˈaɪbɹˌaʊ hˈɛɹz ənd ɹˈuʒ ˈɑn ðə tʃˈiks ənd ðə lˈɪps/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: lông mày được tỉa gọn gàng, má và môi được tô son hồng.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Makeup will essentially increase your contrast level, which is the shade difference between your features.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /mˈeɪkˌʌp wˈɪl ɛsˈɛnʃəli ˌɪnkɹˈis jˈɔɹ kˈɑntɹæst lˈɛvəl wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðə ʃˈeɪd dˈɪfɚəns bɪtwˈin jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Trang điểm về cơ bản sẽ làm tăng mức độ tương phản của bạn, đó là sự khác biệt về sắc thái giữa các đường nét trên khuôn mặt bạn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: This makes a person look more healthy and vibrant.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs mˈeɪks ə pˈɝsən lˈʊk mˈɔɹ hˈɛlθi ənd vˈaɪbɹənt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Điều này làm cho người ta trông khỏe mạnh và tràn đầy sức sống hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Jewelry makes a huge difference when you have jewelry that's cohesive
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /dʒˈuəlɹi mˈeɪks ə hjˈudʒ dˈɪfɚəns wˈɛn jˈu hˈæv dʒˈuəlɹi ðˈæts koʊhˈisɪv/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Trang sức tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn khi bạn có những món trang sức hài hòa với nhau

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and matches well to your outfit.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd mˈætʃəz wˈɛl tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và hợp với trang phục của bạn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: The addition of small, sparkly elements does make you look more visually complex,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðə ədˈɪʃən ˈʌv smˈɔl spˈɑɹkli ˈɛləmənts dˈʌz mˈeɪk jˈu lˈʊk mˈɔɹ vˈɪʒwəli kˈɑmplɛks/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Việc bổ sung các yếu tố nhỏ, lấp lánh làm cho bạn trông phức tạp hơn về mặt thị giác,

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: giving the impression of looking more dressed up.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɡˈɪvɪŋ ðə ˌɪmpɹˈɛʃən ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ mˈɔɹ dɹˈɛst ˈʌp/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: tạo ấn tượng về việc trông lịch sự hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: And this is such a hack
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə hˈæk/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Và đây là một mẹo hay như vậy

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: because you don't actually have to put much effort into your jewelry.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli hˈæv tˈu pˈʊt mˈʌtʃ ˈɛfɚt ˈɪntu jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: bởi vì bạn không thực sự phải tốn nhiều công sức vào đồ trang sức của mình.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Nor do you need to have a huge jewelry collection you just want to have intentional
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /nˈɔɹ dˈu jˈu nˈid tˈu hˈæv ə hjˈudʒ dʒˈuəlɹi kəlˈɛkʃən jˈu dʒˈʌst wˈɑnt tˈu hˈæv ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Bạn cũng không cần phải có một bộ sưu tập trang sức khổng lồ, bạn chỉ cần có ý định

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: pieces that match your wardrobe and are tarnish
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /pˈisəz ðˈæt mˈætʃ jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd ˈɑɹ tˈɑɹnɪʃ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: những món đồ phù hợp với tủ quần áo của bạn và bị xỉn màu

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: proof. Even something simple like a necklace just elevates your outfit
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /pɹˈuf ˈivɪn sˈʌmθɪŋ sˈɪmpəl lˈaɪk ə nˈɛkləs dʒˈʌst ˈɛləvˌeɪts jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: bằng chứng. Ngay cả một thứ đơn giản như vòng cổ cũng làm tăng thêm vẻ đẹp cho trang phục của bạn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and makes it look more intentional.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd mˈeɪks ˈɪt lˈʊk mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: và làm cho nó trông có chủ ý hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I do love a statement earring, like a chunky earring like this.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈu lˈʌv ə stˈeɪtmənt ˈɪɹɪŋ lˈaɪk ə tʃˈʌŋki ˈɪɹɪŋ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi rất thích hoa tai bản lớn, kiểu hoa tai dày như thế này.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It really brings the whole outfit together and frames the face.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪt ɹˈɪli bɹˈɪŋz ðə hˈoʊl ˈaʊtfˌɪt təɡˈɛðɚ ənd fɹˈeɪmz ðə fˈeɪs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Nó thực sự làm cho toàn bộ trang phục trở nên hài hòa và tạo khung cho khuôn mặt.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Accessories overall make a huge difference because they add dimension to an outfit.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /æksˈɛsɚiz ˈoʊvɚˌɔl mˈeɪk ə hjˈudʒ dˈɪfɚəns bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ ˈæd dɪmˈɛnʃən tˈu ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Phụ kiện nhìn chung tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn vì chúng thêm chiều sâu cho trang phục.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They make a person appear more put together since the outfit itself looks more intentionally curated.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ mˈeɪk ə pˈɝsən əpˈɪɹ mˈɔɹ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ sˈɪns ðə ˈaʊtfˌɪt ˌɪtsˈɛlf lˈʊks mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli kjʊɹˈeɪtɪd/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Chúng khiến người mặc trông chỉnh tề hơn vì bản thân bộ trang phục trông có vẻ được phối hợp có chủ đích hơn.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Beyond your jewelry, you can do this with an intentional belt or an elegant purse.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bɪˈɑnd jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi jˈu kˈæn dˈu ðˈɪs wˈɪð ˈæn ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl bˈɛlt ˈɔɹ ˈæn ˈɛləɡənt pˈɝs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Ngoài trang sức của bạn, bạn có thể làm điều này với một chiếc thắt lưng có chủ ý hoặc một chiếc ví thanh lịch.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'm so excited to be partnering with Parisa Wong for this video.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪm sˈoʊ ɪksˈaɪtəd tˈu bˈi pˈɑɹtnɚɪŋ wˈɪð parisa wˈɔŋ fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi rất vui mừng được hợp tác với Parisa Wong cho video này.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I really resonate with their brand philosophy.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli ɹˈɛzənˌeɪt wˈɪð ðˈɛɹ bɹˈænd fəlˈɑsəfi/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Tôi thực sự đồng cảm với triết lý thương hiệu của họ.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They believe that luxury should be accessible to everyone.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ bɪlˈiv ðˈæt lˈʌɡʒɚi ʃˈʊd bˈi æksˈɛsəbəl tˈu ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Họ tin rằng sự xa hoa nên dành cho tất cả mọi người.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Their products focus on elevated designs and quality craftsmanship.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ pɹˈɑdəkts fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn ˈɛləvˌeɪtɪd dɪzˈaɪnz ənd kwˈɑləti kɹˈæftsmənʃˌɪp/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Sản phẩm của họ tập trung vào thiết kế tinh tế và tay nghề chất lượng cao.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They're exactly the pieces to have in your wardrobe
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ɪɡzˈæktli ðə pˈisəz tˈu hˈæv ɪn jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: Chúng là những món đồ hoàn hảo để có trong tủ quần áo của bạn

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: if you want to look elegant and effortless.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk ˈɛləɡənt ənd ˈɛfɚtləs/
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.vietnamese_text: nếu bạn muốn trông thanh lịch và tự nhiên.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They use responsibly sourced leathers and produce in small batches.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ jˈus ɹɪspˈɑnsəbli sourced lˈɛðɚz ənd pɹədˈus ɪn smˈɔl bˈætʃəz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: The model that I have with me is the Gabrielle.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðə mˈɑdəl ðˈæt ˈaɪ hˈæv wˈɪð mˈi ˈɪz ðə ɡˈæbɹiɛl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I love a top handle bag.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ə tˈɑp hˈændəl bˈæɡ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Something about a purse in the crook of your elbow is so ladylike to me.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ əbˈaʊt ə pˈɝs ɪn ðə kɹˈʊk ˈʌv jˈɔɹ ˈɛlbˌoʊ ˈɪz sˈoʊ lˈeɪdilˌaɪk tˈu mˈi/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: She's gorgeous and actually quite roomy.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ʃˈiz ɡˈɔɹdʒəs ənd ˈæktʃˌuəli kwˈaɪt ɹˈumi/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: She has feet at the bottom, which I think elevates any purse.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ʃˈi hˈæz fˈit ˈæt ðə bˈɑtəm wˈɪtʃ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɛləvˌeɪts ˈɛni pˈɝs/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I wanted to choose this taupe tan color because this is a color
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɔntɪd tˈu tʃˈuz ðˈɪs taupe tˈæn kˈʌlɚ bɪkˈɔz ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə kˈʌlɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that you can wear all year round.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn wˈɛɹ ˈɔl jˈɪɹ ɹˈaʊnd/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It has gorgeous gold hardware, and you can really dress it up or down.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈæz ɡˈɔɹdʒəs ɡˈoʊld hˈɑɹdwˌɛɹ ənd jˈu kˈæn ɹˈɪli dɹˈɛs ˈɪt ˈʌp ˈɔɹ dˈaʊn/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: My wardrobe is also so neutral, so it really goes with all my outfits.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /mˈaɪ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ˈɪz ˈɔlsoʊ sˈoʊ nˈutɹəl sˈoʊ ˈɪt ɹˈɪli ɡˈoʊz wˈɪð ˈɔl mˈaɪ ˈaʊtfˌɪts/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Let me show you how I style it.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /lˈɛt mˈi ʃˈoʊ jˈu hˈaʊ ˈaɪ stˈaɪl ˈɪt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: This bag works so well with fall jackets, especially with longer coats.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs bˈæɡ wˈɝks sˈoʊ wˈɛl wˈɪð fˈɔl dʒˈækɪts əspˈɛʃli wˈɪð lˈɔŋɡɚ kˈoʊts/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I tend to go with a cross body. so I love
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ tˈɛnd tˈu ɡˈoʊ wˈɪð ə kɹˈɔs bˈɑdi sˈoʊ ˈaɪ lˈʌv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that it comes with the cross body strap.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt kˈʌmz wˈɪð ðə kɹˈɔs bˈɑdi stɹˈæp/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: The colors just go so well together.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðə kˈʌlɚz dʒˈʌst ɡˈoʊ sˈoʊ wˈɛl təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Something like this for fall is casual but put together.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs fˈɔɹ fˈɔl ˈɪz kˈæʒəwəl bˈʌt pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I love doing three color outfits.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv dˈuɪŋ θɹˈi kˈʌlɚ ˈaʊtfˌɪts/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I feel like it makes an outfit look very clean and cohesive.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ fˈil lˈaɪk ˈɪt mˈeɪks ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt lˈʊk vˈɛɹi klˈin ənd koʊhˈisɪv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's very Upper East Side, New York.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi ˈʌpɚ ˈist sˈaɪd nˈu jˈɔɹk/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Because of the size of this bag, you can really dress it up as well.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv ðə sˈaɪz ˈʌv ðˈɪs bˈæɡ jˈu kˈæn ɹˈɪli dɹˈɛs ˈɪt ˈʌp ˈæz wˈɛl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's just small enough
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst smˈɔl ɪnˈʌf/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that it could be a really great date night purse for nice events.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt kˈʊd bˈi ə ɹˈɪli ɡɹˈeɪt dˈeɪt nˈaɪt pˈɝs fˈɔɹ nˈaɪs ɪvˈɛnts/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I think it's such a chameleon.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɪts sˈʌtʃ ə kəmˈiliən/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It works with your entire wardrobe, and it makes getting dressed and looking polished much easier.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɝks wˈɪð jˈɔɹ ɪntˈaɪɚ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd ˈɪt mˈeɪks ɡˈɛtɪŋ dɹˈɛst ənd lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt mˈʌtʃ ˈiziɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Thank you so much, Parisa Wong, for sponsoring this video.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ parisa wˈɔŋ fˈɔɹ spˈɑnsɚɪŋ ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I'll leave a link to the purse in my description.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈiv ə lˈɪŋk tˈu ðə pˈɝs ɪn mˈaɪ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: These are purses for a capsule wardrobe and pieces you'll love forever,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈiz ˈɑɹ pˈɝsɪz fˈɔɹ ə kˈæpsəl wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd pˈisəz jˈul lˈʌv fɚˈɛvɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: so definitely check them out if you're interested.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ dˈɛfənətli tʃˈɛk ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: All right, continuing with wardrobe.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt kəntˈɪnjuɪŋ wˈɪð wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Those who look put together don't necessarily have a huge wardrobe they just have a wardrobe
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈoʊz hˈu lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ dˈoʊnt nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli hˈæv ə hjˈudʒ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ðˈeɪ dʒˈʌst hˈæv ə wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that works well together.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɝks wˈɛl təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Each piece, or at least most pieces, match each other in color
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈitʃ pˈis ˈɔɹ ˈæt lˈist mˈoʊst pˈisəz mˈætʃ ˈitʃ ˈʌðɚ ɪn kˈʌlɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and style, so pairing them together, even
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd stˈaɪl sˈoʊ pˈɛɹɪŋ ðˈɛm təɡˈɛðɚ ˈivɪn/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: if you don't have a lot of time or not interested in dressing up,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm ˈɔɹ nˈɑt ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn dɹˈɛsɪŋ ˈʌp/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: it'll still look cohesive.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪtəl stˈɪl lˈʊk koʊhˈisɪv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: This is why capsule wardrobes are so popular and so powerful.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈaɪ kˈæpsəl wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊbz ˈɑɹ sˈoʊ pˈɑpjəlɚ ənd sˈoʊ pˈaʊɚfəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They really maximize how polished you can look with how few pieces you can have.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ɹˈɪli mˈæksəmˌaɪz hˈaʊ pˈɑlɪʃt jˈu kˈæn lˈʊk wˈɪð hˈaʊ fjˈu pˈisəz jˈu kˈæn hˈæv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Like with your jewelry, you really don't need a huge wardrobe of clothing.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /lˈaɪk wˈɪð jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi jˈu ɹˈɪli dˈoʊnt nˈid ə hjˈudʒ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ˈʌv klˈoʊðɪŋ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Honestly, that can make getting dressed overwhelming
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɑnəstli ðˈæt kˈæn mˈeɪk ɡˈɛtɪŋ dɹˈɛst ˌoʊvɚwˈɛlmɪŋ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and actually make it harder to look put together
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ˈæktʃˌuəli mˈeɪk ˈɪt hˈɑɹdɚ tˈu lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: because it can become too complex to make sure that an outfit looks fully cohesive.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn bɪkˈʌm tˈu kˈɑmplɛks tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt lˈʊks fˈʊli koʊhˈisɪv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Instead, you want to build your wardrobe so that it suits you.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˌɪnstˈɛd jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu bˈɪld jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb sˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪt sˈuts jˈu/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: There are certain, uh, universal rules in terms of looking polished.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ sˈɝtən ˈʌ jˌunəvˈɝsəl ɹˈulz ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: There's no unintentional holes, rips, or tears in your clothing, as well as really scuffed shoes.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz nˈoʊ ˌʌnɪntˈɛnʃənəl hˈoʊlz ɹˈɪps ˈɔɹ tˈɛɹz ɪn jˈɔɹ klˈoʊðɪŋ ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz ɹˈɪli skˈʌft ʃˈuz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: I think every girl or every person honestly should have a steamer in their wardrobe,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɛvɚi ɡˈɝl ˈɔɹ ˈɛvɚi pˈɝsən ˈɑnəstli ʃˈʊd hˈæv ə stˈimɚ ɪn ðˈɛɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: especially if you wear like silk, cotton, sometimes linen certain fabrics
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈu wˈɛɹ lˈaɪk sˈɪlk kˈɑtən səmtˈaɪmz lˈɪnən sˈɝtən fˈæbɹɪks/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that I think are very high quality.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈaɪ kwˈɑləti/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They can be a little temperamental in terms of wrinkling and creasing.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ kˈæn bˈi ə lˈɪtəl tˌɛmpɹəmˈɛntəl ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ɹˈɪŋkəlɪŋ ənd creasing/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Another thing is if you have pets, definitely have a lint roller in your wardrobe.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənˈʌðɚ θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv pˈɛts dˈɛfənətli hˈæv ə lˈɪnt ɹˈoʊlɚ ɪn jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Once we get past the basics, though, we want to focus on timeless clothing pieces.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈʌns wˈi ɡˈɛt pˈæst ðə bˈeɪsɪks ðˈoʊ wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn tˈaɪmləs klˈoʊðɪŋ pˈisəz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Timeless pieces tend to be fitted but not skin tight they often follow the natural silhouette.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /tˈaɪmləs pˈisəz tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɪtəd bˈʌt nˈɑt skˈɪn tˈaɪt ðˈeɪ ˈɔfən fˈɑloʊ ðə nˈætʃɚəl sˌɪləwˈɛt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: This can mean things like a-ine skirts, tailored blazers, and just pieces
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈæn mˈin θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk ˈeɪn skˈɝts tˈeɪlɚd blˈeɪzɚz ənd dʒˈʌst pˈisəz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that are not ultra tight or ultra baggy.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ nˈɑt ˈʌltɹə tˈaɪt ˈɔɹ ˈʌltɹə bˈæɡi/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's also very flattering to mix loose and tight pieces in your outfit.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ vˈɛɹi flˈætɚɪŋ tˈu mˈɪks lˈus ənd tˈaɪt pˈisəz ɪn jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Too many loose pieces, especially if you're curvy, can look shapeless,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /tˈu mˈɛni lˈus pˈisəz əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ kˈɝvi kˈæn lˈʊk ʃˈeɪpləs/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: whereas too many tight pieces, especially if you're less curvy
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wɛɹˈæz tˈu mˈɛni tˈaɪt pˈisəz əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈɛs kˈɝvi/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: or you don't feel comfortable in very tight clothing, can feel too stiff.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɔɹ jˈu dˈoʊnt fˈil kˈʌmfɚtəbəl ɪn vˈɛɹi tˈaɪt klˈoʊðɪŋ kˈæn fˈil tˈu stˈɪf/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: So instead, mixing the pieces tends to be the happy medium.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˌɪnstˈɛd mˈɪksɪŋ ðə pˈisəz tˈɛndz tˈu bˈi ðə hˈæpi mˈidiəm/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you're not sure where to put the tight and the loose pieces,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ʃˈʊɹ wˈɛɹ tˈu pˈʊt ðə tˈaɪt ənd ðə lˈus pˈisəz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: wear tight clothing in areas that you want to shrink
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɛɹ tˈaɪt klˈoʊðɪŋ ɪn ˈɛɹiəz ðˈæt jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu ʃɹˈɪŋk/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: or to exaggerate, like a dress that's tight at the waist and flares out.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɔɹ tˈu ɪɡzˈædʒɚˌeɪt lˈaɪk ə dɹˈɛs ðˈæts tˈaɪt ˈæt ðə wˈeɪst ənd flˈɛɹz ˈaʊt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: The area that you're emphasizing is your waist.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðə ˈɛɹiə ðˈæt jˈʊɹ ˈɛmfəsˌaɪzɪŋ ˈɪz jˈɔɹ wˈeɪst/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Loose, really unstructured, puffy pieces these just add volume.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /lˈus ɹˈɪli ənstɹˈʌkʃɚd pˈʌfi pˈisəz ðˈiz dʒˈʌst ˈæd vˈɑljum/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: So, if you like more volume around your shoulders, around your hips,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ vˈɑljum ɚˈaʊnd jˈɔɹ ʃˈoʊldɚz ɚˈaʊnd jˈɔɹ hˈɪps/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: this can be a really, uh, useful tool.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈæn bˈi ə ɹˈɪli ˈʌ jˈusfəl tˈul/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Whereas loose structured pieces, like a blazer with structured shoulders,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wɛɹˈæz lˈus stɹˈʌktʃɚd pˈisəz lˈaɪk ə blˈeɪzɚ wˈɪð stɹˈʌktʃɚd ʃˈoʊldɚz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: this is really great to streamline an area, make an area look very sleek and clean.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɹˈɪli ɡɹˈeɪt tˈu stɹˈimlˌaɪn ˈæn ˈɛɹiə mˈeɪk ˈæn ˈɛɹiə lˈʊk vˈɛɹi slˈik ənd klˈin/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Those that look put together will also dress in their best colors.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈoʊz ðˈæt lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ wˈɪl ˈɔlsoʊ dɹˈɛs ɪn ðˈɛɹ bˈɛst kˈʌlɚz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: This comes down a lot to your undertone.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈʌmz dˈaʊn ə lˈɑt tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you have a warmer undertone, choose warm, earthy shades whereas,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə wˈɔɹmɚ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn tʃˈuz wˈɔɹm ˈɝθi ʃˈeɪdz wɛɹˈæz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: if you have a cooler undertone, go for cooler, ashy shades.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə kˈulɚ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn ɡˈoʊ fˈɔɹ kˈulɚ ˈæʃi ʃˈeɪdz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you have a neutral undertone like personally, I'm more neutral
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə nˈutɹəl ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn lˈaɪk pˈɝsənəli ˈaɪm mˈɔɹ nˈutɹəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: then you can tap into both palettes.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɛn jˈu kˈæn tˈæp ˈɪntu bˈoʊθ palettes/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Another thing with colors is how bright and intense they are.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənˈʌðɚ θˈɪŋ wˈɪð kˈʌlɚz ˈɪz hˈaʊ bɹˈaɪt ənd ˌɪntˈɛns ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd ˈɑn jˈɔɹ kˈɑntɹæst lˈɛvəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If you're someone who's more high contrast, like personally I am higher contrast.

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Where you have darker hair and lighter skin, or darker hair
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɛɹ jˈu hˈæv dˈɑɹkɚ hˈɛɹ ənd lˈaɪtɚ skˈɪn ˈɔɹ dˈɑɹkɚ hˈɛɹ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd skˈɪn ðˈæt kˈɑntɹæsts ə lˈɑt wˈɪð ðə wˈaɪts ˈʌv jˈɔɹ ˈaɪz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: They don't have to necessarily be neons,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈeɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈu nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli bˈi nˈiˌɑnz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: but the intensity should be there to match your features.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə ɪntˈɛnsəti ʃˈʊd bˈi ðˈɛɹ tˈu mˈætʃ jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Compared to if you have very low contrast, especially with lighter complexions,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv vˈɛɹi lˈoʊ kˈɑntɹæst əspˈɛʃli wˈɪð lˈaɪtɚ kəmplˈɛkʃənz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: you often look best in more muted shades, as well as patterns and prints.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈu ˈɔfən lˈʊk bˈɛst ɪn mˈɔɹ mjˈutɪd ʃˈeɪdz ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz pˈætɚnz ənd pɹˈɪnts/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: you look your most radiant.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈu lˈʊk jˈɔɹ mˈoʊst ɹˈeɪdˌiənt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈivɪn wˈɛn jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ dˈʌn/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: So, if you are interested, I'll leave the link to my Substack in my description.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu ˈɑɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd ˈaɪl lˈiv ðə lˈɪŋk tˈu mˈaɪ substack ɪn mˈaɪ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Now, this last step is a little more nuanced, but it's very essential.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðˈɪs lˈæst stˈɛp ˈɪz ə lˈɪtəl mˈɔɹ nˈuɑnst bˈʌt ˈɪts vˈɛɹi ɛsˈɛnʃəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Even if you follow all my tips from the earlier part of this video,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf jˈu fˈɑloʊ ˈɔl mˈaɪ tˈɪps fɹˈʌm ðə ˈɝliɚ pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: but you neglect this last step, the whole thing can kind of fall apart.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu nəɡlˈɛkt ðˈɪs lˈæst stˈɛp ðə hˈoʊl θˈɪŋ kˈæn kˈaɪnd ˈʌv fˈɔl əpˈɑɹt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: You not only want to focus on a polished appearance, but also a composed demeanor.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈu nˈɑt ˈoʊnli wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn ə pˈɑlɪʃt əpˈɪɹəns bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ə kəmpˈoʊzd dɪmˈinɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: One of the easiest ways to look collected and composed is with your posture.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ˈiziəst wˈeɪz tˈu lˈʊk kəlˈɛktəd ənd kəmpˈoʊzd ˈɪz wˈɪð jˈɔɹ pˈɑstʃɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: You want to focus on having a straight back,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn hˈævɪŋ ə stɹˈeɪt bˈæk/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: your chest slightly lifted, your head level, and your shoulders up, back, and down.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /jˈɔɹ tʃˈɛst slˈaɪtli lˈɪftəd jˈɔɹ hˈɛd lˈɛvəl ənd jˈɔɹ ʃˈoʊldɚz ˈʌp bˈæk ənd dˈaʊn/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: It's very simple, but we can often forget and easily switch back to slouching,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi sˈɪmpəl bˈʌt wˈi kˈæn ˈɔfən fɚɡˈɛt ənd ˈizəli swˈɪtʃ bˈæk tˈu slˈaʊtʃɪŋ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: and this does wonders.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs dˈʌz wˈʌndɚz/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Whether you're sitting, you're standing, you're just how you move,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɛðɚ jˈʊɹ sˈɪtɪŋ jˈʊɹ stˈændɪŋ jˈʊɹ dʒˈʌst hˈaʊ jˈu mˈuv/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: whenever you catch yourself like
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wɛnˈɛvɚ jˈu kˈætʃ jɚsˈɛlf lˈaɪk/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: this, all you have to do is gently bring yourself back into alignment.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɔl jˈu hˈæv tˈu dˈu ˈɪz dʒˈɛntli bɹˈɪŋ jɚsˈɛlf bˈæk ˈɪntu əlˈaɪnmənt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Good posture makes all the difference in terms of looking put together.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ɡˈʊd pˈɑstʃɚ mˈeɪks ˈɔl ðə dˈɪfɚəns ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Even if the outfit you're wearing is somewhat basic
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf ðə ˈaʊtfˌɪt jˈʊɹ wˈɛɹɪŋ ˈɪz sˈʌmwˈʌt bˈeɪsɪk/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: or you don't have full glam makeup, it does help also to move slightly slower.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɔɹ jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv fˈʊl ɡlˈæm mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɪt dˈʌz hˈɛlp ˈɔlsoʊ tˈu mˈuv slˈaɪtli slˈoʊɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: When I say slower, you don't actually have to move like a turtle,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ sˈeɪ slˈoʊɚ jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli hˈæv tˈu mˈuv lˈaɪk ə tˈɝtəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: but especially if you're someone who's a little more anxious
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈʌt əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈuz ə lˈɪtəl mˈɔɹ ˈæŋkʃəs/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: or just want to come across as confident.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst wˈɑnt tˈu kˈʌm əkɹˈɔs ˈæz kˈɑnfədənt/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: One of the easiest ways is to move intentionally and not too frantically.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ˈiziəst wˈeɪz ˈɪz tˈu mˈuv ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli ənd nˈɑt tˈu fɹˈæntəkəli/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: If a person moves really frantically, then they not only make others around them uncomfortable,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ˈɪf ə pˈɝsən mˈuvz ɹˈɪli fɹˈæntəkəli ðˈɛn ðˈeɪ nˈɑt ˈoʊnli mˈeɪk ˈʌðɚz ɚˈaʊnd ðˈɛm ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: but it also signals to your own nervous system
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ sˈɪɡnəlz tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn nˈɝvəs sˈɪstəm/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: that you don't feel like things are together.
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt fˈil lˈaɪk θˈɪŋz ˈɑɹ təɡˈɛðɚ/

006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.text: Just by slowing things down slightly, doing things very intentionally by moving intentionally,
006bc931-d971-45b2-a143-31f43848b9ab.ipa: /dʒˈʌst bˈaɪ slˈoʊɪŋ θˈɪŋz dˈaʊn slˈaɪtli dˈuɪŋ θˈɪŋz vˈɛɹi ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli bˈaɪ mˈuvɪŋ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli/

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Exercise 3 in the restaurant.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ˈɛksɚsˌaɪz 3 ɪn ðə ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnt/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Bài tập 3 trong nhà hàng.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Listen to the conversation and take the items that the wife
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /lˈɪsən tˈu ðə kˌɑnvɚsˈeɪʃən ənd tˈeɪk ðə ˈaɪtəmz ðˈæt ðə wˈaɪf/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Nghe cuộc trò chuyện và ghi lại những món đồ mà người vợ

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: and husband ordered on the menu.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ənd hˈʌzbənd ˈɔɹdɚd ˈɑn ðə mˈɛnju/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: và chồng gọi món trong thực đơn.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Good evening. Would you like to order?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ɡˈʊd ˈivnɪŋ wˈʊd jˈu lˈaɪk tˈu ˈɔɹdɚ/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Chào buổi tối. Quý khách có muốn gọi món không?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Now, just a moment.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /nˈaʊ dʒˈʌst ə mˈoʊmənt/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Khoan đã, chờ một chút.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Can we see what you've got on the menu first?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /kˈæn wˈi sˈi wˈʌt jˈuv ɡˈɑt ˈɑn ðə mˈɛnju fˈɝst/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi có thể xem thực đơn trước được không?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: There is quite a good choice on the menu, isn't there, dear?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz kwˈaɪt ə ɡˈʊd tʃˈɔɪs ˈɑn ðə mˈɛnju ˈɪzənt ðˈɛɹ dˈɪɹ/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Thực đơn có khá nhiều lựa chọn ngon, phải không em yêu?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Yes. Do you want to order first?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /jˈɛs dˈu jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu ˈɔɹdɚ fˈɝst/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Vâng. Bạn muốn gọi món trước không?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: All right, I think I'll start with some apple juice,
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈaɪl stˈɑɹt wˈɪð sˈʌm ˈæpəl dʒˈus/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Được rồi, tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ bắt đầu với một ít nước ép táo,

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: but I can't decide whether to have salmon or roast beef.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ kˈænt dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈɛðɚ tˈu hˈæv sˈæmən ˈɔɹ ɹˈoʊst bˈif/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: nhưng tôi không thể quyết định nên ăn cá hồi hay thịt bò nướng.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Um, I remember I had fish last time we were here,
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ˈʌm ˈaɪ ɹɪmˈɛmbɚ ˈaɪ hˈæd fˈɪʃ lˈæst tˈaɪm wˈi wˈɝ hˈiɹ/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Um, tôi nhớ mình đã ăn cá lần trước chúng ta ở đây,

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: so I'll try the roast beef and, yes, and some carrots.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪl tɹˈaɪ ðə ɹˈoʊst bˈif ənd jˈɛs ənd sˈʌm kˈæɹəts/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Vậy tôi sẽ thử món thịt bò nướng và, vâng, một ít cà rốt.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: What about the sweet?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə swˈit/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Còn đồ ngọt thì sao?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Well, we can order that later, but I think I'll have some fruit salad.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /wˈɛl wˈi kˈæn ˈɔɹdɚ ðˈæt lˈeɪtɚ bˈʌt ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈaɪl hˈæv sˈʌm fɹˈut sˈæləd/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Chà, chúng ta có thể gọi món đó sau, nhưng tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ dùng một ít salad trái cây.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Shall I order some wine to go with the meal?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ʃˈæl ˈaɪ ˈɔɹdɚ sˈʌm wˈaɪn tˈu ɡˈoʊ wˈɪð ðə mˈil/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Tôi có nên gọi một ít rượu vang để dùng bữa không?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: Yes, that would be nice.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˈæt wˈʊd bˈi nˈaɪs/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Vâng, điều đó thật tuyệt.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: So, what are you going to have?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌt ˈɑɹ jˈu ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu hˈæv/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Vậy, bạn sẽ dùng gì?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: I'll start with chicken soup, and I love fish,
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ˈaɪl stˈɑɹt wˈɪð tʃˈɪkən sˈup ənd ˈaɪ lˈʌv fˈɪʃ/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ bắt đầu với súp gà, và tôi thích cá.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: so I think I'll have salmon and some peas.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈaɪl hˈæv sˈæmən ənd sˈʌm pˈiz/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Vậy tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ ăn cá hồi và một ít đậu Hà Lan.

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: What are you going to choose for dessert?
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /wˈʌt ˈɑɹ jˈu ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu tʃˈuz fˈɔɹ dɪzˈɝt/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Bạn sẽ chọn món tráng miệng gì?

2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.text: I think I'll have chocolate cake.
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈaɪl hˈæv tʃˈɔklət kˈeɪk/
2b887d4b-2314-4e4b-961e-d170c24840ae.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ ăn bánh sô cô la.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I like old things.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪk ˈoʊld θˈɪŋz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích những thứ cũ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I have seven film cameras, in NES, a rotary phone, a bunch of records.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈɛvən fˈɪlm kˈæmɚəz ɪn nˈɛs ə ɹˈoʊtɚi fˈoʊn ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv ɹəkˈɔɹdz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi có bảy máy ảnh phim, một máy chơi game NES, một điện thoại quay số, một đống đĩa nhạc.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Hello, I'm Johnny.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /həlˈoʊ ˈaɪm dʒˈɑni/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Xin chào, tôi là Johnny.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: My parents old Cass sets, a book of mechanical movements, devices
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /mˈaɪ pˈɛɹənts ˈoʊld kˈæs sˈɛts ə bˈʊk ˈʌv məkˈænɪkəl mˈuvmənts dɪvˈaɪsəz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Những bộ Cass cũ của bố mẹ tôi, một cuốn sách về chuyển động cơ học, các thiết bị

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and appliances from 1907, and a phonograph.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd əplˈaɪənsəz fɹˈʌm 1907 ənd ə fˈoʊnəɡɹˌæf/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và các thiết bị gia dụng từ năm 1907, và một máy hát đĩa.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I don't know exactly
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ ɪɡzˈæktli/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi không biết chính xác

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: how many other people in their early 20s like all this old analog stuff too,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /hˈaʊ mˈɛni ˈʌðɚ pˈipəl ɪn ðˈɛɹ ˈɝli 20s lˈaɪk ˈɔl ðˈɪs ˈoʊld ˈænəlˌɔɡ stˈʌf tˈu/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: còn bao nhiêu người khác ở độ tuổi 20 cũng thích những thứ analog cũ kỹ này nữa,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but it's definitely not zero.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts dˈɛfənətli nˈɑt zˈɪɹoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng chắc chắn không phải là không.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I've been seeing a bunch of ads recently for digital cameras
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪv bˈɪn sˈiɪŋ ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv ˈædz ɹˈisəntli fˈɔɹ dˈɪdʒətəl kˈæmɚəz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Gần đây tôi thấy rất nhiều quảng cáo về máy ảnh kỹ thuật số

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that are supposed to like film, and I've seen people online
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ səpˈoʊzd tˈu lˈaɪk fˈɪlm ənd ˈaɪv sˈin pˈipəl ˈɔnlˌaɪn/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: mà lẽ ra phải thích phim, và tôi đã thấy mọi người trên mạng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that are switching from smartphones back to flip phones because, you know, social media just sucks.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ swˈɪtʃɪŋ fɹˈʌm smˈɑɹtfˌoʊnz bˈæk tˈu flˈɪp fˈoʊnz bɪkˈɔz jˈu nˈoʊ sˈoʊʃəl mˈidiə dʒˈʌst sˈʌks/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: mà đang chuyển từ điện thoại thông minh trở lại điện thoại nắp gập vì, bạn biết đấy, mạng xã hội thật tệ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: And then, if you're talking about clothes I mean, thrifting is a huge industry.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ˈɪf jˈʊɹ tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt klˈoʊðz ˈaɪ mˈin thrifting ˈɪz ə hjˈudʒ ˈɪndəstɹi/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và sau đó, nếu bạn đang nói về quần áo, ý tôi là, mua đồ cũ là một ngành công nghiệp khổng lồ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I've seen so many people in my own generation whose whole personality is based on clothes
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪv sˈin sˈoʊ mˈɛni pˈipəl ɪn mˈaɪ ˈoʊn dʒˌɛnɚˈeɪʃən hˈuz hˈoʊl pˌɝsənˈælɪti ˈɪz bˈeɪst ˈɑn klˈoʊðz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã thấy rất nhiều người trong thế hệ của mình mà toàn bộ tính cách của họ dựa trên quần áo

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and culture from like the 60s, 70s, 80s, or 90s, even the 2000s.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd kˈʌltʃɚ fɹˈʌm lˈaɪk ðə 60s 70s 80s ˈɔɹ 90s ˈivɪn ðə 2000s/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và văn hóa từ những năm 60, 70, 80, hoặc 90, thậm chí cả những năm 2000.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Now there's no one right answer for why people like the things that they do.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðˈɛɹz nˈoʊ wˈʌn ɹˈaɪt ˈænsɚ fˈɔɹ wˈaɪ pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə θˈɪŋz ðˈæt ðˈeɪ dˈu/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Hiện tại không có một câu trả lời đúng duy nhất cho lý do tại sao mọi người thích những thứ họ thích.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I have my own reasons for liking old things other people might have their own reasons
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv mˈaɪ ˈoʊn ɹˈizənz fˈɔɹ lˈaɪkɪŋ ˈoʊld θˈɪŋz ˈʌðɚ pˈipəl mˈaɪt hˈæv ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn ɹˈizənz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi có lý do riêng để thích những thứ cũ kỹ, người khác có thể có lý do riêng của họ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: for liking old things, and this is a topic that can be talked about forever.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /fˈɔɹ lˈaɪkɪŋ ˈoʊld θˈɪŋz ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə tˈɑpɪk ðˈæt kˈæn bˈi tˈɔkt əbˈaʊt fɚˈɛvɚ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: vì thích những thứ cũ, và đây là một chủ đề có thể nói mãi không hết.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: But if you ask me why I like old things
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu ˈæsk mˈi wˈaɪ ˈaɪ lˈaɪk ˈoʊld θˈɪŋz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nhưng nếu bạn hỏi tôi tại sao tôi thích những thứ cũ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and why I think all these other people, all these other younger people,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd wˈaɪ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɔl ðˈiz ˈʌðɚ pˈipəl ˈɔl ðˈiz ˈʌðɚ jˈʌŋɡɚ pˈipəl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và tại sao tôi nghĩ tất cả những người khác, tất cả những người trẻ tuổi khác này,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: do too, I think the first thing I would mention is five the the five senses
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /dˈu tˈu ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðə fˈɝst θˈɪŋ ˈaɪ wˈʊd mˈɛnʃən ˈɪz fˈaɪv ðə ðə fˈaɪv sˈɛnsɪz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: tôi cũng vậy, tôi nghĩ điều đầu tiên tôi sẽ đề cập là năm, năm giác quan

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: you got sight, hearing, smell, touch, and okay, maybe maybe just the first four.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu ɡˈɑt sˈaɪt hˈiɹɪŋ smˈɛl tˈʌtʃ ənd ˌoʊkˈeɪ mˈeɪbi mˈeɪbi dʒˈʌst ðə fˈɝst fˈɔɹ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: bạn có thị giác, thính giác, khứu giác, xúc giác, và được rồi, có lẽ chỉ bốn cái đầu tiên thôi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Yeah, um, all this old stuff, at least when it comes to objects, they're tactile.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈæ ˈʌm ˈɔl ðˈɪs ˈoʊld stˈʌf ˈæt lˈist wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu ˈɑbdʒɛkts ðˈɛɹ tˈæktɪl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Vâng, ừm, tất cả những thứ cũ kỹ này, ít nhất là khi nói đến đồ vật, chúng đều có tính xúc giác.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: You can interact with them on a physical way, you know,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˌɪntɚˈækt wˈɪð ðˈɛm ˈɑn ə fˈɪzɪkəl wˈeɪ jˈu nˈoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bạn có thể tương tác với họ theo cách vật lý, bạn biết đấy,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: all the clicks and dials and buttons and doohickeys, thing, a Bobs whatchamacallit, whatever.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɔl ðə klˈɪks ənd dˈaɪəlz ənd bˈʌtənz ənd doohickeys θˈɪŋ ə bobs whatchamacallit wˌʌtˈɛvɚ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: tất cả các nút bấm, núm xoay, nút bấm và các bộ phận nhỏ, thứ, một cái gì đó, cái gì đó.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: And when you consider that I mostly grew up with this, it starts to make sense.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd wˈɛn jˈu kənsˈɪdɚ ðˈæt ˈaɪ mˈoʊstli ɡɹˈu ˈʌp wˈɪð ðˈɪs ˈɪt stˈɑɹts tˈu mˈeɪk sˈɛns/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và khi bạn xem xét rằng tôi chủ yếu lớn lên với điều này, nó bắt đầu có ý nghĩa.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Sometimes it can feel like the whole world is stuck behind glass
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪt kˈæn fˈil lˈaɪk ðə hˈoʊl wˈɝld ˈɪz stˈʌk bɪhˈaɪnd ɡlˈæs/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Đôi khi có cảm giác như cả thế giới bị mắc kẹt sau tấm kính

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: when I'm constantly on my phone, but when I use something that's older
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪm kˈɑnstəntli ˈɑn mˈaɪ fˈoʊn bˈʌt wˈɛn ˈaɪ jˈus sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæts ˈoʊldɚ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: khi tôi liên tục sử dụng điện thoại, nhưng khi tôi sử dụng thứ gì đó cũ hơn

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and analog, it kind of brings me back into the real world, you know?
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ˈænəlˌɔɡ ˈɪt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bɹˈɪŋz mˈi bˈæk ˈɪntu ðə ɹˈil wˈɝld jˈu nˈoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và analog, nó kiểu đưa tôi trở lại thế giới thực, bạn biết đấy?

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I think human beings are kind of just built for tactile feedback it's just the basics
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk hjˈumən bˈiɪŋz ˈɑɹ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv dʒˈʌst bˈɪlt fˈɔɹ tˈæktɪl fˈidbˌæk ˈɪts dʒˈʌst ðə bˈeɪsɪks/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ con người về cơ bản được tạo ra cho phản hồi xúc giác, đó chỉ là những điều cơ bản

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: of how we all interact with the world with our senses.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈʌv hˈaʊ wˈi ˈɔl ˌɪntɚˈækt wˈɪð ðə wˈɝld wˈɪð ˈaʊɚ sˈɛnsɪz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: về cách chúng ta tương tác với thế giới bằng các giác quan của mình.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Now I've had older people tell me, Oh,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈaɪv hˈæd ˈoʊldɚ pˈipəl tˈɛl mˈi ˈoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Giờ tôi đã từng nghe người lớn tuổi nói, Ồ,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: why would you want to go back and use all
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈaɪ wˈʊd jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu ɡˈoʊ bˈæk ənd jˈus ˈɔl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: tại sao bạn muốn quay lại và sử dụng tất cả

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that old junk I was forced to use when I was growing up?
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈoʊld dʒˈʌŋk ˈaɪ wˈɑz fˈɔɹst tˈu jˈus wˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: cái đống đồ cũ đó mà tôi bị bắt phải dùng khi còn bé?

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Things are so much better now.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /θˈɪŋz ˈɑɹ sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ bˈɛtɚ nˈaʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Mọi thứ giờ đã tốt hơn rất nhiều.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: You can access anything at any time, anywhere.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈæksˌɛs ˈɛniθˌɪŋ ˈæt ˈɛni tˈaɪm ˈɛniwˌɛɹ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bạn có thể truy cập bất cứ thứ gì vào bất cứ lúc nào, bất cứ nơi đâu.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Why would you ever want to revert back?
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈaɪ wˈʊd jˈu ˈɛvɚ wˈɑnt tˈu ɹɪvˈɝt bˈæk/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tại sao bạn lại muốn quay lại?

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Well, hurry up this way, Grandp.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɛl hˈɝi ˈʌp ðˈɪs wˈeɪ grandp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nhanh lên nào, ông ạ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Now all this unlimited information I mean, it's absolutely fantastic
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɔl ðˈɪs ənlˈɪmətɪd ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən ˈaɪ mˈin ˈɪts ˌæbsəlˈutli fæntˈæstɪk/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ tất cả thông tin không giới hạn này, ý tôi là, nó thực sự tuyệt vời

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but a lot of times it just, it feels like a monsoon.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪmz ˈɪt dʒˈʌst ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk ə mɑnsˈun/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng rất nhiều lần nó chỉ, nó giống như một cơn gió mùa.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: It's so much since you can know everything all at once it just can
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪts sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ sˈɪns jˈu kˈæn nˈoʊ ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈɔl ˈæt wˈʌns ˈɪt dʒˈʌst kˈæn/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Thật là nhiều thứ đến nỗi bạn có thể biết mọi thứ cùng một lúc, nó chỉ có thể

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: be a bit much.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈi ə bˈɪt mˈʌtʃ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: hơi quá.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Sometimes I feel like Ben Stiller in Night of the Museum
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈaɪ fˈil lˈaɪk bˈɛn stˈɪlɚ ɪn nˈaɪt ˈʌv ðə mjuzˈiəm/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Đôi khi tôi cảm thấy như Ben Stiller trong Đêm ở Bảo tàng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: when a of the Hunt is trying to rip him limb from limb.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɛn ə ˈʌv ðə hˈʌnt ˈɪz tɹˈaɪɪŋ tˈu ɹˈɪp hˈɪm lˈɪm fɹˈʌm lˈɪm/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: khi một trong những Thợ săn đang cố xé xác anh ta ra từng mảnh.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: It's just complete decision paralysis when it comes to the endless void of the Internet,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst kəmplˈit dɪsˈɪʒən pɚˈæləsəs wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu ðə ˈɛndləs vˈɔɪd ˈʌv ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Đó chỉ là sự tê liệt hoàn toàn trong việc đưa ra quyết định khi đối mặt với khoảng không vô tận của Internet,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but using things pre- internet it takes me away from that.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈuzɪŋ θˈɪŋz pɹˈi ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ˈɪt tˈeɪks mˈi əwˈeɪ fɹˈʌm ðˈæt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng sử dụng những thứ trước thời internet lại khiến tôi xa rời điều đó.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: It gives my mind a break, and all these things listening to music on vinyl,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd ə bɹˈeɪk ənd ˈɔl ðˈiz θˈɪŋz lˈɪsənɪŋ tˈu mjˈuzɪk ˈɑn vˈaɪnəl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nó giúp tâm trí tôi được nghỉ ngơi, và tất cả những điều này khi nghe nhạc trên đĩa vinyl.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: taking film photos, using a typewriter it just calms my mind
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /tˈeɪkɪŋ fˈɪlm fˈoʊtˌoʊz jˈuzɪŋ ə tˈaɪpɹˌaɪtɚ ˈɪt dʒˈʌst kˈɑmz mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: chụp ảnh phim, dùng máy chữ giúp tâm trí tôi bình yên

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and it takes it away from that ever widening dark pit
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ˈɪt tˈeɪks ˈɪt əwˈeɪ fɹˈʌm ðˈæt ˈɛvɚ wˈaɪdənɪŋ dˈɑɹk pˈɪt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và nó lấy đi khỏi cái hố đen ngày càng rộng đó

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that the Internet can sometimes be, which leads me into my next thing.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt kˈæn səmtˈaɪmz bˈi wˈɪtʃ lˈidz mˈi ˈɪntu mˈaɪ nˈɛkst θˈɪŋ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: mà Internet đôi khi có thể là, điều này dẫn tôi đến điều tiếp theo của tôi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: My dad used to tell me stories about
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /mˈaɪ dˈæd jˈuzd tˈu tˈɛl mˈi stˈɔɹiz əbˈaʊt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bố tôi từng kể cho tôi nghe những câu chuyện về

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: when he was my age he would buy all these cool old muscle cars for cheap.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɛn hˈi wˈɑz mˈaɪ ˈeɪdʒ hˈi wˈʊd bˈaɪ ˈɔl ðˈiz kˈul ˈoʊld mˈʌsəl kˈɑɹz fˈɔɹ tʃˈip/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Khi anh ấy ở tuổi tôi, anh ấy sẽ mua tất cả những chiếc xe cơ bắp cũ tuyệt vời này với giá rẻ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: You know, he had a Camaro and a smoking the ban of Trans Am
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ hˈi hˈæd ə kəmˈɛɹoʊ ənd ə smˈoʊkɪŋ ðə bˈæn ˈʌv tɹˈænz ˈæm/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bạn biết đấy, anh ấy có một chiếc Camaro và một việc hút thuốc cấm của Trans Am

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and he would swap the engine and fix up these cars right in my grandmother's driveway.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd hˈi wˈʊd swˈɑp ðə ˈɛndʒən ənd fˈɪks ˈʌp ðˈiz kˈɑɹz ɹˈaɪt ɪn mˈaɪ ɡɹˈændmˌʌðɚz dɹˈaɪvwˌeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và ông ấy sẽ thay động cơ và sửa chữa những chiếc xe này ngay tại lối vào nhà bà tôi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and As a little kid, my mind was always blown
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ˈæz ə lˈɪtəl kˈɪd mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd wˈɑz ˈɔlwˌeɪz blˈoʊn/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và khi còn nhỏ, tâm trí tôi luôn bị choáng ngợp

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that he could take an engine out of a car
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt hˈi kˈʊd tˈeɪk ˈæn ˈɛndʒən ˈaʊt ˈʌv ə kˈɑɹ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: rằng anh ta có thể lấy một động cơ ra khỏi xe

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and put a new one in, all just in a weekend.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd pˈʊt ə nˈu wˈʌn ɪn ˈɔl dʒˈʌst ɪn ə wˈikˌɛnd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và thay một cái mới vào, tất cả chỉ trong một cuối tuần.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: But then one day
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛn wˈʌn dˈeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nhưng rồi một ngày nọ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: he and I were walking through a field full of classic cars in a car show
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /hˈi ənd ˈaɪ wˈɝ wˈɔkɪŋ θɹˈu ə fˈild fˈʊl ˈʌv klˈæsɪk kˈɑɹz ɪn ə kˈɑɹ ʃˈoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Anh ấy và tôi đang đi bộ qua một cánh đồng đầy những chiếc xe cổ trong một buổi triển lãm xe hơi

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: you know, the kinds that he worked on when he was my age
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ ðə kˈaɪndz ðˈæt hˈi wˈɝkt ˈɑn wˈɛn hˈi wˈɑz mˈaɪ ˈeɪdʒ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: bạn biết đấy, những loại mà anh ấy đã làm khi anh ấy bằng tuổi tôi

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and I stopped and turned to a 1970s Corvette.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ stˈɑpt ənd tˈɝnd tˈu ə 1970s kɔɹvˈɛt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và tôi dừng lại và quay sang một chiếc Corvette đời 1970.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and The hood was open, so I looked down to the engine
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ðə hˈʊd wˈɑz ˈoʊpən sˈoʊ ˈaɪ lˈʊkt dˈaʊn tˈu ðə ˈɛndʒən/
