b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và mui xe đã mở, nên tôi nhìn xuống động cơ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and went, Huh, it's actually pretty empty I could actually see the ground through the engine
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd wˈɛnt hˈʌ ˈɪts ˈæktʃˌuəli pɹˈɪti ˈɛmpti ˈaɪ kˈʊd ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈi ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd θɹˈu ðə ˈɛndʒən/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và đi, Hả, nó thực sự khá trống rỗng Tôi thực sự có thể nhìn thấy mặt đất qua động cơ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: of the car Now I'm not saying
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈʌv ðə kˈɑɹ nˈaʊ ˈaɪm nˈɑt sˈeɪɪŋ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: của chiếc xe Bây giờ tôi không nói

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: what my dad did all those years ago wasn't impressive,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈʌt mˈaɪ dˈæd dˈɪd ˈɔl ðˈoʊz jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɑzənt ˌɪmpɹˈɛsɪv/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: những gì bố tôi đã làm trong suốt những năm qua không có gì ấn tượng,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but those older cars just appear
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈoʊz ˈoʊldɚ kˈɑɹz dʒˈʌst əpˈɪɹ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng những chiếc xe cũ đó cứ xuất hiện

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: to be so much simpler to work on compared to any car I've ever owned today.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /tˈu bˈi sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ sˈɪmpəlɚ tˈu wˈɝk ˈɑn kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ˈɛni kˈɑɹ ˈaɪv ˈɛvɚ ˈoʊnd tədˈeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: dễ làm việc hơn nhiều so với bất kỳ chiếc xe nào tôi từng sở hữu ngày nay.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: If you buy a new car now, it's almost impossible to work
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu bˈaɪ ə nˈu kˈɑɹ nˈaʊ ˈɪts ˈɔlmˌoʊst ˌɪmpˈɑsəbəl tˈu wˈɝk/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn mua một chiếc xe mới bây giờ, gần như không thể hoạt động được

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: on, but any of those older cars I mean you could read through the owner's manual
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɑn bˈʌt ˈɛni ˈʌv ðˈoʊz ˈoʊldɚ kˈɑɹz ˈaɪ mˈin jˈu kˈʊd ɹˈɛd θɹˈu ðə ˈoʊnɚz mˈænjuəl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: trên, nhưng bất kỳ chiếc xe cũ nào trong số đó, ý tôi là bạn có thể đọc qua sách hướng dẫn sử dụng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and fully understand your vehicle, like I actually found.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd fˈʊli ˌʌndɚstˈænd jˈɔɹ vˈihɪkəl lˈaɪk ˈaɪ ˈæktʃˌuəli fˈaʊnd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và hoàn toàn hiểu chiếc xe của bạn, như tôi thực sự đã tìm thấy.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: An old 1970s Corvette manual online, and it literally had a section titled Engine
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈæn ˈoʊld 1970s kɔɹvˈɛt mˈænjuəl ˈɔnlˌaɪn ənd ˈɪt lˈɪtɚəli hˈæd ə sˈɛkʃən tˈaɪtəld ˈɛndʒən/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Một cuốn sách hướng dẫn sử dụng Corvette cũ từ những năm 1970 trên mạng, và nó có hẳn một phần có tiêu đề là Động cơ

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and Engine Rebuilding where it showed you step by step
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ˈɛndʒən ɹibˈɪldɪŋ wˈɛɹ ˈɪt ʃˈoʊd jˈu stˈɛp bˈaɪ stˈɛp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và Đại tu Động cơ nơi nó chỉ cho bạn từng bước

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: how to take the engine apart, how to put it back together again,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /hˈaʊ tˈu tˈeɪk ðə ˈɛndʒən əpˈɑɹt hˈaʊ tˈu pˈʊt ˈɪt bˈæk təɡˈɛðɚ əɡˈɛn/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: cách tháo động cơ ra, cách lắp lại động cơ,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and along the way told you exactly what everything did.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd əlˈɔŋ ðə wˈeɪ tˈoʊld jˈu ɪɡzˈæktli wˈʌt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ dˈɪd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và trên đường đi đã cho bạn biết chính xác mọi thứ làm gì.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: In comparison, the owner's manual for my car from 2016 I mean,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ɪn kəmpˈɛɹəsən ðə ˈoʊnɚz mˈænjuəl fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ kˈɑɹ fɹˈʌm 2016 ˈaɪ mˈin/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: So với, sách hướng dẫn sử dụng của chiếc xe của tôi từ năm 2016 ý tôi là,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: it it's just it's just all legal jargon, and it says,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪts dʒˈʌst ˈɪts dʒˈʌst ˈɔl lˈiɡəl dʒˈɑɹɡən ənd ˈɪt sˈɛz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: đó chỉ là tất cả những thuật ngữ pháp lý, và nó nói rằng,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: If you have a problem, just take it to the dealership,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə pɹˈɑbləm dʒˈʌst tˈeɪk ˈɪt tˈu ðə dˈilɚʃˌɪp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn có vấn đề, cứ mang đến đại lý,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: take it to the dealership And in the same way
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /tˈeɪk ˈɪt tˈu ðə dˈilɚʃˌɪp ənd ɪn ðə sˈeɪm wˈeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: mang nó đến đại lý Và theo cách tương tự

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: as classic cars, any of these old cameras that I have behind me,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈæz klˈæsɪk kˈɑɹz ˈɛni ˈʌv ðˈiz ˈoʊld kˈæmɚəz ðˈæt ˈaɪ hˈæv bɪhˈaɪnd mˈi/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: như những chiếc xe cổ điển, bất kỳ chiếc máy ảnh cũ nào trong số này mà tôi có phía sau tôi,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: you know, like this or like this, this typewriter I have here,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs ˈɔɹ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs ðˈɪs tˈaɪpɹˌaɪtɚ ˈaɪ hˈæv hˈiɹ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: bạn biết đấy, như thế này hoặc như thế này, chiếc máy chữ tôi có ở đây,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I know how they work inside out and I can fix them
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ hˈaʊ ðˈeɪ wˈɝk ˌɪnsˈaɪd ˈaʊt ənd ˈaɪ kˈæn fˈɪks ðˈɛm/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi biết cách chúng hoạt động từ trong ra ngoài và tôi có thể sửa chúng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: if anything breaks, and it's such a nice feeling knowing
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɛniθˌɪŋ bɹˈeɪks ənd ˈɪts sˈʌtʃ ə nˈaɪs fˈilɪŋ nˈoʊɪŋ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nếu có bất cứ thứ gì bị hỏng, và đó là một cảm giác thật tuyệt vời khi biết

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that it feels like they're fully mine.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk ðˈɛɹ fˈʊli mˈaɪn/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: rằng chúng có cảm giác hoàn toàn thuộc về tôi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I think that pretty much sums it up.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈæt pɹˈɪti mˈʌtʃ sˈʌmz ˈɪt ˈʌp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ rằng điều đó đã tóm tắt khá đầy đủ.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: I found it at Spencer Gifts, streaming services Netflix, Spotify,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈaɪ fˈaʊnd ˈɪt ˈæt spˈɛnsɚ ɡˈɪfts stɹˈimɪŋ sˈɝvəsəz nˈɛtflɪks spˈɔtəfˌaɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi tìm thấy nó ở Spencer Gifts, các dịch vụ phát trực tuyến Netflix, Spotify,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Disney Plus, Peacock all of them that are way too expensive
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /dˈɪzni plˈʌs pˈikˌɑk ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈɛm ðˈæt ˈɑɹ wˈeɪ tˈu ɪkspˈɛnsɪv/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Disney Plus, Peacock tất cả chúng đều quá đắt

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and really annoying in a lot of ways.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ɹˈɪli ənˈɔɪɪŋ ɪn ə lˈɑt ˈʌv wˈeɪz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và thực sự khó chịu theo nhiều cách.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: they're great I mean, who doesn't want everything on demand?
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ɡɹˈeɪt ˈaɪ mˈin hˈu dˈʌzənt wˈɑnt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈɑn dɪmˈænd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: họ tuyệt vời tôi nói này, ai mà không muốn mọi thứ theo yêu cầu chứ?

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: But in recent years they've been adding more ads
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ɪn ɹˈisənt jˈɪɹz ðˈeɪv bˈɪn ˈædɪŋ mˈɔɹ ˈædz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nhưng trong những năm gần đây, họ đã thêm nhiều quảng cáo hơn

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and raising the prices and then adding more ads on top
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ɹˈeɪzɪŋ ðə pɹˈaɪsəz ənd ðˈɛn ˈædɪŋ mˈɔɹ ˈædz ˈɑn tˈɑp/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và tăng giá rồi thêm nhiều quảng cáo nữa

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: of that, and it's all just kind of culminating into
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈʌv ðˈæt ənd ˈɪts ˈɔl dʒˈʌst kˈaɪnd ˈʌv kˈʌlmənˌeɪtɪŋ ˈɪntu/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: của điều đó, và tất cả chỉ đang dần đi đến

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: what cable TV used to be, but in a way more expensive way.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈʌt kˈeɪbəl tˈivˈi jˈuzd tˈu bˈi bˈʌt ɪn ə wˈeɪ mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɛnsɪv wˈeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: truyền hình cáp từng như thế nào, nhưng theo một cách đắt đỏ hơn.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: And the best part is, at any time your favorite comfort movie,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ðə bˈɛst pˈɑɹt ˈɪz ˈæt ˈɛni tˈaɪm jˈɔɹ fˈeɪvɚɪt kˈʌmfɚt mˈuvi/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và điều tuyệt vời nhất là, bất cứ lúc nào bộ phim yêu thích mang lại sự thoải mái cho bạn,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Gone that song your parents used to sing
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ɡˈɔn ðˈæt sˈɔŋ jˈɔɹ pˈɛɹənts jˈuzd tˈu sˈɪŋ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bài hát mà bố mẹ bạn từng hát đã trôi vào dĩ vãng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: to you when you were a little kid,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /tˈu jˈu wˈɛn jˈu wˈɝ ə lˈɪtəl kˈɪd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: cho bạn khi bạn còn nhỏ,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: did removed you don't have control over whatever is on one of these platforms.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /dˈɪd ɹimˈuvd jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv kəntɹˈoʊl ˈoʊvɚ wˌʌtˈɛvɚ ˈɪz ˈɑn wˈʌn ˈʌv ðˈiz plˈætfˌɔɹmz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: bạn đã xóa bạn không có quyền kiểm soát bất cứ thứ gì trên một trong những nền tảng này.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: So for me, and I think a lot of other people,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /sˈoʊ fˈɔɹ mˈi ənd ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈʌðɚ pˈipəl/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, đối với tôi, và tôi nghĩ là đối với nhiều người khác,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: it's nice to know that if I buy a vinyl record
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪts nˈaɪs tˈu nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪf ˈaɪ bˈaɪ ə vˈaɪnəl ɹəkˈɔɹd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: thật tuyệt khi biết rằng nếu tôi mua một đĩa than

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: or an old VHS or DVD of a movie, no one's coming to take that away.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ˈæn ˈoʊld vhs ˈɔɹ dˌivˌidˈi ˈʌv ə mˈuvi nˈoʊ wˈʌnz kˈʌmɪŋ tˈu tˈeɪk ðˈæt əwˈeɪ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: hoặc một cuốn băng VHS hoặc DVD cũ của một bộ phim, không ai đến lấy nó đi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: And going back to physical objects, it's nice to know
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd ɡˈoʊɪŋ bˈæk tˈu fˈɪzɪkəl ˈɑbdʒɛkts ˈɪts nˈaɪs tˈu nˈoʊ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và quay trở lại với các vật thể vật lý, thật tuyệt khi biết rằng

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that a movie or any music you own physically exists in the world apart
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ə mˈuvi ˈɔɹ ˈɛni mjˈuzɪk jˈu ˈoʊn fˈɪzɪkəli ɪɡzˈɪsts ɪn ðə wˈɝld əpˈɑɹt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: rằng một bộ phim hoặc bất kỳ bản nhạc nào bạn sở hữu về mặt vật lý tồn tại trên thế giới ngoài

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: from it being just some artistic concept that's somewhere out on the Internet
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ˈɪt bˈiɪŋ dʒˈʌst sˈʌm ɑɹtˈɪstɪk kˈɑnsɛpt ðˈæts sˈʌmwˌɛɹ ˈaʊt ˈɑn ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: từ việc nó chỉ là một khái niệm nghệ thuật nào đó nằm đâu đó trên Internet

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: it's actually in your possession.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈæktʃˌuəli ɪn jˈɔɹ pəzˈɛʃən/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nó thực sự nằm trong tay bạn.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: You can hold it because the Internet is great,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn hˈoʊld ˈɪt bɪkˈɔz ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ˈɪz ɡɹˈeɪt/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bạn có thể giữ nó vì Internet rất tuyệt vời,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but you don't really know when things are going to change.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu dˈoʊnt ɹˈɪli nˈoʊ wˈɛn θˈɪŋz ˈɑɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu tʃˈeɪndʒ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng bạn không thực sự biết khi nào mọi thứ sẽ thay đổi.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Nostalgia, I think, is the biggest reason for all this.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /nɔstˈældʒə ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɪz ðə bˈɪɡəst ɹˈizən fˈɔɹ ˈɔl ðˈɪs/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ, nỗi nhớ là lý do lớn nhất cho tất cả những điều này.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: Because I mean, who doesn't want to relive a happy memory you had
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ mˈin hˈu dˈʌzənt wˈɑnt tˈu ɹilˈɪv ə hˈæpi mˈɛmɚi jˈu hˈæd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Bởi vì tôi muốn nói, ai mà không muốn trải lại một ký ức hạnh phúc mà bạn đã có.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: from when you were a kid?
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /fɹˈʌm wˈɛn jˈu wˈɝ ə kˈɪd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: từ khi bạn còn nhỏ?

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: There's pretty much an entire industry of nostalgia, especially recently,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz pɹˈɪti mˈʌtʃ ˈæn ɪntˈaɪɚ ˈɪndəstɹi ˈʌv nɔstˈældʒə əspˈɛʃli ɹˈisəntli/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Có gần như cả một ngành công nghiệp hoài niệm, đặc biệt là gần đây,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: with all these NeverEnding movies, remakes, and reboots being made.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɪð ˈɔl ðˈiz neverending mˈuviz ɹˈimˈeɪks ənd ɹibˈuts bˈiɪŋ mˈeɪd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: với tất cả những bộ phim không bao giờ kết thúc, làm lại và khởi động lại này đang được thực hiện.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: It's a huge reason why the phrase what's old is new exists,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɪts ə hjˈudʒ ɹˈizən wˈaɪ ðə fɹˈeɪz wˈʌts ˈoʊld ˈɪz nˈu ɪɡzˈɪsts/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Đó là lý do to lớn tại sao cụm từ "cái cũ lại thành cái mới" tồn tại,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: and my generation is just getting to the age
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd mˈaɪ dʒˌɛnɚˈeɪʃən ˈɪz dʒˈʌst ɡˈɛtɪŋ tˈu ðə ˈeɪdʒ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: và thế hệ của tôi vừa mới đến tuổi

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: where we're starting to reminisce about our childhood.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /wˈɛɹ wˈiɹ stˈɑɹtɪŋ tˈu ɹˌɛmənˈɪs əbˈaʊt ˈaʊɚ tʃˈaɪldhˌʊd/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nơi chúng ta bắt đầu hồi tưởng về thời thơ ấu của mình.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: But it doesn't fully explain why we seem to like things older than our own memories.
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt dˈʌzənt fˈʊli ɪksplˈeɪn wˈaɪ wˈi sˈim tˈu lˈaɪk θˈɪŋz ˈoʊldɚ ðˈæn ˈaʊɚ ˈoʊn mˈɛmɚiz/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Nhưng nó không giải thích đầy đủ tại sao chúng ta dường như thích những thứ cũ hơn ký ức của chính mình.

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: And my answer to that is I think there's just something about using a thing
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ənd mˈaɪ ˈænsɚ tˈu ðˈæt ˈɪz ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈɛɹz dʒˈʌst sˈʌmθɪŋ əbˈaʊt jˈuzɪŋ ə θˈɪŋ/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: Và câu trả lời của tôi cho điều đó là tôi nghĩ có điều gì đó về việc sử dụng một thứ gì đó

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that was part of of everyday history from 50
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɑz pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈʌv ˈɛvɹidˈeɪ hˈɪstɚi fɹˈʌm 50/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: đó là một phần của lịch sử đời thường từ những năm 50

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: or 100 years ago that allows you to live the same experience
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ˈɔɹ 100 jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ ðˈæt əlˈaʊz jˈu tˈu lˈaɪv ðə sˈeɪm ɪkspˈɪɹiəns/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: hoặc 100 năm trước cho phép bạn sống cùng một trải nghiệm

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that the original owner of that thing would experience in a time
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ɚˈɪdʒənəl ˈoʊnɚ ˈʌv ðˈæt θˈɪŋ wˈʊd ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ɪn ə tˈaɪm/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: mà chủ sở hữu ban đầu của thứ đó sẽ trải qua theo thời gian

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: that is now part of history,
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz nˈaʊ pˈɑɹt ˈʌv hˈɪstɚi/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: điều đó giờ đã là một phần của lịch sử,

b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.text: but at one time you know it was just life, and that's a cool feeling. a
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈæt wˈʌn tˈaɪm jˈu nˈoʊ ˈɪt wˈɑz dʒˈʌst lˈaɪf ənd ðˈæts ə kˈul fˈilɪŋ ə/
b7f70acb-923d-4ecc-a6bb-29653a29df82.vietnamese_text: nhưng vào một thời điểm nào đó, bạn biết đấy, đó chỉ là cuộc sống, và đó là một cảm giác tuyệt vời. a

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Mark Zuckerberg, a journalist was asking him a question about the news feed.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /mˈɑɹk zˈʌkɚbˌɝɡ ə dʒˈɝnələst wˈɑz ˈæskɪŋ hˈɪm ə kwˈɛstʃən əbˈaʊt ðə nˈuz fˈid/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Mark Zuckerberg, một nhà báo đang hỏi ông ấy một câu hỏi về bảng tin.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And the journalist was asking him, "Why is this so important"
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðə dʒˈɝnələst wˈɑz ˈæskɪŋ hˈɪm wˈaɪ ˈɪz ðˈɪs sˈoʊ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Và nhà báo hỏi ông ấy, "Tại sao điều này lại quan trọng đến vậy"

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And Zuckerberg said, "A squirrel dying in your front yard may be more relevant
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd zˈʌkɚbˌɝɡ sˈɛd ə skwˈɝəl dˈaɪɪŋ ɪn jˈɔɹ fɹˈʌnt jˈɑɹd mˈeɪ bˈi mˈɔɹ ɹˈɛləvənt/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Và Zuckerberg nói: "Một con sóc chết trước sân nhà bạn có thể liên quan hơn

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: to your interests right now than people dying in Africa"
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈɪntɹəsts ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ ðˈæn pˈipəl dˈaɪɪŋ ɪn ˈæfɹəkɑ/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: vào sở thích của bạn ngay bây giờ hơn là người chết ở châu Phi"

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And I want to talk about what a Web based
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɑnt tˈu tˈɔk əbˈaʊt wˈʌt ə wˈɛb bˈeɪst/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Và tôi muốn nói về một cái dựa trên Web

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: on that idea of relevance might look like.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɑn ðˈæt aɪdˈiə ˈʌv ɹˈɛləvəns mˈaɪt lˈʊk lˈaɪk/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: ý tưởng về sự liên quan đó có thể trông như thế nào.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So when I was growing up in a really rural area in Maine,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp ɪn ə ɹˈɪli ɹˈʊɹəl ˈɛɹiə ɪn mˈeɪn/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Vậy khi tôi lớn lên ở một vùng nông thôn hẻo lánh ở Maine,

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: the Internet meant something very different to me.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt mˈɛnt sˈʌmθɪŋ vˈɛɹi dˈɪfɚənt tˈu mˈi/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Internet có ý nghĩa rất khác đối với tôi.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: It meant a connection to the world.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt mˈɛnt ə kənˈɛkʃən tˈu ðə wˈɝld/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Nó có nghĩa là một sự kết nối với thế giới.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: It meant something that would connect us all together.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt mˈɛnt sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈʊd kənˈɛkt ˈʌs ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Nó có nghĩa là một điều gì đó sẽ kết nối tất cả chúng ta lại với nhau.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And I was sure that it was going to be great for democracy
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɑz ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ˈɪt wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈi ɡɹˈeɪt fˈɔɹ dɪmˈɑkɹəsi/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Và tôi đã chắc chắn rằng điều đó sẽ rất tốt cho nền dân chủ

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and for our society.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ səsˈaɪəti/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: và cho xã hội của chúng ta.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But there's this shift in how information is flowing online, and it's invisible.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛɹz ðˈɪs ʃˈɪft ɪn hˈaʊ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən ˈɪz flˈoʊɪŋ ˈɔnlˌaɪn ənd ˈɪts ˌɪnvˈɪzəbəl/
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.vietnamese_text: Nhưng có một sự thay đổi trong cách thông tin lan truyền trên mạng, và nó vô hình.

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And if we don't pay attention to it, it could be a real problem.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf wˈi dˈoʊnt pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃən tˈu ˈɪt ˈɪt kˈʊd bˈi ə ɹˈil pɹˈɑbləm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So I first noticed this in a place I spend a lot
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ fˈɝst nˈoʊtəst ðˈɪs ɪn ə plˈeɪs ˈaɪ spˈɛnd ə lˈɑt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: of time my Facebook page.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈʌv tˈaɪm mˈaɪ fˈeɪsbˌʊk pˈeɪdʒ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: I'm progressive, politically, big surprise, but I've always gone out of my way to meet conservatives.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈaɪm pɹəɡɹˈɛsɪv pəlˈɪtɪkəli bˈɪɡ sɚpɹˈaɪz bˈʌt ˈaɪv ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɡˈɔn ˈaʊt ˈʌv mˈaɪ wˈeɪ tˈu mˈit kənsˈɝvətɪvz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: I like hearing what they're thinking about; I like seeing
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪk hˈiɹɪŋ wˈʌt ðˈɛɹ θˈɪŋkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ˈaɪ lˈaɪk sˈiɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: what they link to; I like learning a thing or two.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ lˈɪŋk tˈu ˈaɪ lˈaɪk lˈɝnɪŋ ə θˈɪŋ ˈɔɹ tˈu/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And so I was surprised when I noticed one day
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ ˈaɪ wˈɑz sɚpɹˈaɪzd wˈɛn ˈaɪ nˈoʊtəst wˈʌn dˈeɪ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that the conservatives had disappeared from my Facebook feed.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə kənsˈɝvətɪvz hˈæd dˌɪsəpˈɪɹd fɹˈʌm mˈaɪ fˈeɪsbˌʊk fˈid/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And what it turned out was going
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt ˈɪt tˈɝnd ˈaʊt wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: on was that Facebook was looking at which links I clicked
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈɑz ðˈæt fˈeɪsbˌʊk wˈɑz lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt wˈɪtʃ lˈɪŋks ˈaɪ klˈɪkt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: on, and it was noticing that, actually,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɑn ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz nˈoʊtɪsɪŋ ðˈæt ˈæktʃˌuəli/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: I was clicking more on my liberal friends' links than on my conservative friends' links.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz klˈɪkɪŋ mˈɔɹ ˈɑn mˈaɪ lˈɪbˌɝəl fɹˈɛndz lˈɪŋks ðˈæn ˈɑn mˈaɪ kənsˈɝvətɪv fɹˈɛndz lˈɪŋks/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And without consulting me about it, it had edited them out. They disappeared.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wɪθˈaʊt kənsˈʌltɪŋ mˈi əbˈaʊt ˈɪt ˈɪt hˈæd ˈɛdətəd ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ðˈeɪ dˌɪsəpˈɪɹd/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So Facebook isn't the only place that's doing this kind of invisible,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ fˈeɪsbˌʊk ˈɪzənt ðə ˈoʊnli plˈeɪs ðˈæts dˈuɪŋ ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ˌɪnvˈɪzəbəl/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: algorithmic editing of the Web.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk ˈɛdətɪŋ ˈʌv ðə wˈɛb/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Google's doing it too.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɡˈuɡəlz dˈuɪŋ ˈɪt tˈu/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: If I search for something, and you search for something,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ sˈɝtʃ fˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ ənd jˈu sˈɝtʃ fˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: even right now at the very same time, we may get very different search results.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈivɪn ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ ˈæt ðə vˈɛɹi sˈeɪm tˈaɪm wˈi mˈeɪ ɡˈɛt vˈɛɹi dˈɪfɚənt sˈɝtʃ ɹɪzˈʌlts/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Even if you're logged out, one engineer told me,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈɔɡd ˈaʊt wˈʌn ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹ tˈoʊld mˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: there are 57 signals that Google looks at everything
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ 57 sˈɪɡnəlz ðˈæt ɡˈuɡəl lˈʊks ˈæt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: from what kind of computer you're
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /fɹˈʌm wˈʌt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv kəmpjˈutɚ jˈʊɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: on to what kind of browser you're using to where you're located
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɑn tˈu wˈʌt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bɹˈaʊzɚ jˈʊɹ jˈuzɪŋ tˈu wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹ lˈoʊkˌeɪtəd/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that it uses to personally tailor your query results.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt jˈusəz tˈu pˈɝsənəli tˈeɪlɚ jˈɔɹ kwˈiɹi ɹɪzˈʌlts/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Think about it for a second: there is no standard Google anymore.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ˈɪt fˈɔɹ ə sˈɛkənd ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz nˈoʊ stˈændɚd ɡˈuɡəl ˌɛnimˈɔɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And you know, the funny thing about this is that it's hard to see.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd jˈu nˈoʊ ðə fˈʌni θˈɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðˈæt ˈɪts hˈɑɹd tˈu sˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: You can't see how different your search results are.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /jˈu kˈænt sˈi hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt jˈɔɹ sˈɝtʃ ɹɪzˈʌlts ˈɑɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: From anyone else's.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ˈɛniwˌʌn ˈɛlsɪz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But a couple of weeks ago, I asked a bunch of friends to Google "Egypt"
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt ə kˈʌpəl ˈʌv wˈiks əɡˈoʊ ˈaɪ ˈæskt ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv fɹˈɛndz tˈu ɡˈuɡəl ˈidʒəpt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and to send me screen shots of what they got.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd tˈu sˈɛnd mˈi skɹˈin ʃˈɑts ˈʌv wˈʌt ðˈeɪ ɡˈɑt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So here's my friend Scott's screen shot, and here's my friend Daniel's screen shot.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈɪɹz mˈaɪ fɹˈɛnd skˈɑts skɹˈin ʃˈɑt ənd hˈɪɹz mˈaɪ fɹˈɛnd dˈænjəlz skɹˈin ʃˈɑt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: When you put them side-by-side, you don't even have to read the links to see
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈɛn jˈu pˈʊt ðˈɛm sidebyside jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn hˈæv tˈu ɹˈɛd ðə lˈɪŋks tˈu sˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: how different these two pages are.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt ðˈiz tˈu pˈeɪdʒəz ˈɑɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But when you do read the links, it's really quite remarkable.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈɛn jˈu dˈu ɹˈɛd ðə lˈɪŋks ˈɪts ɹˈɪli kwˈaɪt ɹɪmˈɑɹkəbəl/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Daniel didn't get anything about the protests in Egypt at all in his first page
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /dˈænjəl dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðə pɹˈoʊtˌɛsts ɪn ˈidʒəpt ˈæt ˈɔl ɪn hˈɪz fˈɝst pˈeɪdʒ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: of Google results Scott's results were full of them,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈʌv ɡˈuɡəl ɹɪzˈʌlts skˈɑts ɹɪzˈʌlts wˈɝ fˈʊl ˈʌv ðˈɛm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and this was the big story of the day at that time.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs wˈɑz ðə bˈɪɡ stˈɔɹi ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ ˈæt ðˈæt tˈaɪm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: That's how different these results are becoming.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæts hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt ðˈiz ɹɪzˈʌlts ˈɑɹ bɪkˈʌmɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So it's not just Google and Facebook either.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ɡˈuɡəl ənd fˈeɪsbˌʊk ˈiðɚ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: This is something that's sweeping the web.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæts swˈipɪŋ ðə wˈɛb/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: There are a whole host of companies
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ə hˈoʊl hˈoʊst ˈʌv kˈʌmpənˌiz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that are doing this kind of personalization Yahoo News,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ dˈuɪŋ ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pˌɝsənələzˈeɪʃən jˈɑhˌu nˈuz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: the biggest news site on the Internet,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðə bˈɪɡəst nˈuz sˈaɪt ˈɑn ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: is now personalized different people get different things Huffington Post,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪz nˈaʊ pˈɝsənəlˌaɪzd dˈɪfɚənt pˈipəl ɡˈɛt dˈɪfɚənt θˈɪŋz hˈʌfɪŋtən pˈoʊst/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: the Washington Post, the New York Times all flirting with personalization in various ways.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðə wˈɑʃɪŋtən pˈoʊst ðə nˈu jˈɔɹk tˈaɪmz ˈɔl flˈɝtɪŋ wˈɪð pˌɝsənələzˈeɪʃən ɪn vˈɛɹiəs wˈeɪz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And this moves us very quickly toward a world
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs mˈuvz ˈʌs vˈɛɹi kwˈɪkli təwˈɔɹd ə wˈɝld/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: in which the Internet is showing us what it thinks we want to see,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɪn wˈɪtʃ ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ˈɪz ʃˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌs wˈʌt ˈɪt θˈɪŋks wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu sˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: but not necessarily what we need to see.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt nˈɑt nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli wˈʌt wˈi nˈid tˈu sˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: As Eric Schmidt said, "It will be very hard for people to watch
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈæz ˈɛɹɪk ʃmˈɪt sˈɛd ˈɪt wˈɪl bˈi vˈɛɹi hˈɑɹd fˈɔɹ pˈipəl tˈu wˈɑtʃ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: or consume something that has not, in some sense, been tailored for them."
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɔɹ kənsˈum sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt hˈæz nˈɑt ɪn sˈʌm sˈɛns bˈɪn tˈeɪlɚd fˈɔɹ ðˈɛm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So I do think this is a problem, and I think,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ dˈu θˈɪŋk ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə pɹˈɑbləm ənd ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: if you take all of these filters together, you take all these algorithms,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu tˈeɪk ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈiz fˈɪltɚz təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu tˈeɪk ˈɔl ðˈiz ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: you get what I call a filter bubble.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /jˈu ɡˈɛt wˈʌt ˈaɪ kˈɔl ə fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And Your filter bubble is your own personal, unique universe of information
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd jˈɔɹ fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl ˈɪz jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn pˈɝsɪnəl junˈik jˈunəvˌɝs ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that you live in online, and what's in your filter bubble depends
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu lˈaɪv ɪn ˈɔnlˌaɪn ənd wˈʌts ɪn jˈɔɹ fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl dɪpˈɛndz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: on who you are and it depends on what you do.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɑn hˈu jˈu ˈɑɹ ənd ˈɪt dɪpˈɛndz ˈɑn wˈʌt jˈu dˈu/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But the thing is that you don't decide what gets
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt ɡˈɛts/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: in, and more importantly, you don't actually see what gets edited out.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɪn ənd mˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtəntli jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈi wˈʌt ɡˈɛts ˈɛdətəd ˈaʊt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So one of the problems with the filter bubble was discovered by some researchers at Netflix,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə pɹˈɑbləmz wˈɪð ðə fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl wˈɑz dɪskˈʌvɚd bˈaɪ sˈʌm ɹˈisɚtʃɚz ˈæt nˈɛtflɪks/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and they were looking at the Netflix queues
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ wˈɝ lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt ðə nˈɛtflɪks kjˈuz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and they noticed something kind of funny that a lot of us probably have noticed,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ nˈoʊtəst sˈʌmθɪŋ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv fˈʌni ðˈæt ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈʌs pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈæv nˈoʊtəst/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: which is there are some movies that just sort of zip right up
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ sˈʌm mˈuviz ðˈæt dʒˈʌst sˈɔɹt ˈʌv zˈɪp ɹˈaɪt ˈʌp/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and out to our houses.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈaʊt tˈu ˈaʊɚ hˈaʊsəz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: They enter the queue they just zip right out.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɛntɚ ðə kjˈu ðˈeɪ dʒˈʌst zˈɪp ɹˈaɪt ˈaʊt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So "Iron Man" zips right out.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪɚn mˈæn zˈɪps ɹˈaɪt ˈaʊt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And "Waiting for Superman" can wait for a really long time.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wˈeɪtɪŋ fˈɔɹ sˈupɚmən kˈæn wˈeɪt fˈɔɹ ə ɹˈɪli lˈɔŋ tˈaɪm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: What they discovered was that in our Netflix queues
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ dɪskˈʌvɚd wˈɑz ðˈæt ɪn ˈaʊɚ nˈɛtflɪks kjˈuz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: there's this epic struggle going on between our future aspirational selves
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz ðˈɪs ˈɛpɪk stɹˈʌɡəl ɡˈoʊɪŋ ˈɑn bɪtwˈin ˈaʊɚ fjˈutʃɚ aspirational sˈɛlvz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and our more impulsive present selves.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈaʊɚ mˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈʌlsɪv pɹˈɛzənt sˈɛlvz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: You know, we all want to be someone who has watched "Rashomon,"
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ wˈi ˈɔl wˈɑnt tˈu bˈi sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu hˈæz wˈɑtʃt rashomon/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: but right now we want to watch "Ace Ventura" for the fourth time.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu wˈɑtʃ ˈeɪs vɛntʃˈɝə fˈɔɹ ðə fˈɔɹθ tˈaɪm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: (Laughter) So the best editing gives us a bit of both.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /lˈæftɚ sˈoʊ ðə bˈɛst ˈɛdətɪŋ ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə bˈɪt ˈʌv bˈoʊθ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: It gives us a little bit of Justin Bieber and a little bit of Afghanistan.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv dʒˈʌstən bˈibɚ ənd ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv æfɡˈænəstˌæn/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: It gives us some information vegetables; it gives us some information dessert.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən vˈɛdʒtəbəlz ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dɪzˈɝt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And the challenge with these kinds of algorithmic filters, these personalized filters,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðə tʃˈæləndʒ wˈɪð ðˈiz kˈaɪndz ˈʌv ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk fˈɪltɚz ðˈiz pˈɝsənəlˌaɪzd fˈɪltɚz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: is that, because they're mainly looking at what you click on first,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪz ðˈæt bɪkˈɔz ðˈɛɹ mˈeɪnli lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt wˈʌt jˈu klˈɪk ˈɑn fˈɝst/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: it can throw off that balance.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt kˈæn θɹˈoʊ ˈɔf ðˈæt bˈæləns/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And instead of a balanced information diet, you can end up surrounded by information junk food.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv ə bˈælənst ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dˈaɪət jˈu kˈæn ˈɛnd ˈʌp sɚˈaʊndɪd bˈaɪ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dʒˈʌŋk fˈud/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: What this suggests is actually that we may have the story about the Internet wrong.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈɪs sədʒˈɛsts ˈɪz ˈæktʃˌuəli ðˈæt wˈi mˈeɪ hˈæv ðə stˈɔɹi əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ɹˈɔŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: In a broadcast society this is how the founding mythology goes in a broadcast society,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti ðˈɪs ˈɪz hˈaʊ ðə fˈaʊndɪŋ məθˈɑlədʒˌi ɡˈoʊz ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: there were these gatekeepers, the editors, and they controlled the flows of information.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɝ ðˈiz ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz ənd ðˈeɪ kəntɹˈoʊld ðə flˈoʊz ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And along came the Internet and it swept them out of the way,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd əlˈɔŋ kˈeɪm ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ənd ˈɪt swˈɛpt ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə wˈeɪ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and it allowed all of us to connect together, and it was awesome.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈɪt əlˈaʊd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈʌs tˈu kənˈɛkt təɡˈɛðɚ ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz ˈɑsəm/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But that's not actually what's happening right now.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈæts nˈɑt ˈæktʃˌuəli wˈʌts hˈæpənɪŋ ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: What we're seeing is more of a passing of the torch from human
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈʌt wˈiɹ sˈiɪŋ ˈɪz mˈɔɹ ˈʌv ə pˈæsɪŋ ˈʌv ðə tˈɔɹtʃ fɹˈʌm hjˈumən/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: gatekeepers to algorithmic ones.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk wˈʌnz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And the thing is that the algorithms don't yet have the kind of embedded ethics
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt ðə ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz dˈoʊnt jˈɛt hˈæv ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɛmbˈɛdɪd ˈɛθɪks/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that the editors did.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz dˈɪd/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: So if algorithms are going to curate the world for us,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz ˈɑɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kjˈʊɹət ðə wˈɝld fˈɔɹ ˈʌs/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: if they're going to decide what we get to see
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt wˈi ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and what we don't get to see, then we need to make sure
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt wˈi dˈoʊnt ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi ðˈɛn wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that they're not just keyed to relevance.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ nˈɑt dʒˈʌst kˈid tˈu ɹˈɛləvəns/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: We need to make sure that they also show us things
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ʃˈoʊ ˈʌs θˈɪŋz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that are uncomfortable or challenging or important.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl ˈɔɹ tʃˈæləndʒɪŋ ˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: This is what TED does other points of view.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌt tˈɛd dˈʌz ˈʌðɚ pˈɔɪnts ˈʌv vjˈu/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And the thing is, we've actually been here before as a society.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz wˈiv ˈæktʃˌuəli bˈɪn hˈiɹ bɪfˈɔɹ ˈæz ə səsˈaɪəti/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: In 1915, it's not like newspapers were sweating a lot about their civic responsibilities.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ɪn 1915 ˈɪts nˈɑt lˈaɪk nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ swˈɛtɪŋ ə lˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðˈɛɹ sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪlətiz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Then people noticed that they were doing something really important
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈɛn pˈipəl nˈoʊtəst ðˈæt ðˈeɪ wˈɝ dˈuɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that, in fact, you couldn't have a functioning democracy
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ɪn fˈækt jˈu kˈʊdənt hˈæv ə fˈʌŋkʃənɪŋ dɪmˈɑkɹəsi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: if citizens didn't get a good flow of information,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪf sˈɪtəzənz dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ə ɡˈʊd flˈoʊ ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that the newspapers were critical because they were acting as the filter,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ kɹˈɪtɪkəl bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ˈæktɪŋ ˈæz ðə fˈɪltɚ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and then journalistic ethics developed.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dʒˌɝnəlˈɪstɪk ˈɛθɪks dɪvˈɛləpt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: It wasn't perfect, but it got us through the last century.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑzənt pɚfˈɛkt bˈʌt ˈɪt ɡˈɑt ˈʌs θɹˈu ðə lˈæst sˈɛntʃɚi/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And so now, we're kind of back in 1915 on the Web.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ nˈaʊ wˈiɹ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bˈæk ɪn 1915 ˈɑn ðə wˈɛb/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And we need the new gatekeepers to encode
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid ðə nˈu ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ɛnkˈoʊd/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that kind of responsibility into the code that they're writing.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti ˈɪntu ðə kˈoʊd ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: I know that there are a lot of people here from Facebook
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl hˈiɹ fɹˈʌm fˈeɪsbˌʊk/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: and from Google Larry and Sergey people who have helped build the Web
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd fɹˈʌm ɡˈuɡəl lˈɛɹi ənd sˈɛɹdʒi pˈipəl hˈu hˈæv hˈɛlpt bˈɪld ðə wˈɛb/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: as it is, and I'm grateful for that.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ˈæz ˈɪt ˈɪz ənd ˈaɪm ɡɹˈeɪtfəl fˈɔɹ ðˈæt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: But we really need you to make sure
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that these algorithms have encoded in them a sense of the public life,
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈiz ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz hˈæv ɛnkˈoʊdɪd ɪn ðˈɛm ə sˈɛns ˈʌv ðə pˈʌblɪk lˈaɪf/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: a sense of civic responsibility.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ə sˈɛns ˈʌv sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: We need you to make sure that they're transparent enough
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ tɹænspˈɛɹənt ɪnˈʌf/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that we can see what the rules are that determine what gets through our filters.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn sˈi wˈʌt ðə ɹˈulz ˈɑɹ ðˈæt dətˈɝmən wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ˈaʊɚ fˈɪltɚz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And we need you to give us some control
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu ɡˈɪv ˈʌs sˈʌm kəntɹˈoʊl/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: so that we can decide what gets through and what doesn't.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ənd wˈʌt dˈʌzənt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: Because I think we really need the Internet
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: to be that thing that we all dreamed of it being.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /tˈu bˈi ðˈæt θˈɪŋ ðˈæt wˈi ˈɔl dɹˈimd ˈʌv ˈɪt bˈiɪŋ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: We need it to connect us all together.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈi nˈid ˈɪt tˈu kənˈɛkt ˈʌs ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: We need it to introduce us to new ideas and new people and different perspectives.
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /wˈi nˈid ˈɪt tˈu ˌɪntɹədˈus ˈʌs tˈu nˈu aɪdˈiəz ənd nˈu pˈipəl ənd dˈɪfɚənt pɚspˈɛktɪvz/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: And it's not going to do
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts nˈɑt ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu dˈu/

bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.text: that if it leaves us all isolated in a Web of one. Thank you. (Applause)
bd92705b-2822-468f-822b-521d77457557.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪf ˈɪt lˈivz ˈʌs ˈɔl ˈaɪsəlˌeɪtəd ɪn ə wˈɛb ˈʌv wˈʌn θˈæŋk jˈu əplˈɔz/

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: Don’t wanna make up.
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /dont wˈɑnə mˈeɪk ˈʌp/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: Không muốn làm hòa.

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: Headstrong. Gonna wake up.
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /hˈɛdstɹˌɔŋ ɡˈɑnə wˈeɪk ˈʌp/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: Cứng đầu. Sẽ thức dậy.

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: So long, I kinda died hard and grew, seeing
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /sˈoʊ lˈɔŋ ˈaɪ kˈɪndə dˈaɪd hˈɑɹd ənd ɡɹˈu sˈiɪŋ/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: Tạm biệt, tôi đã chết đi sống lại và trưởng thành, nhìn thấy

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: that part of you I never knew love.
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /ðˈæt pˈɑɹt ˈʌv jˈu ˈaɪ nˈɛvɚ nˈu lˈʌv/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: phần đó của em anh chưa từng biết yêu.

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: Somehow pretty sick of that vow, swallow it down, that pain, wearing that crown, unchained.
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /sˈʌmhˌaʊ pɹˈɪti sˈɪk ˈʌv ðˈæt vˈaʊ swˈɑloʊ ˈɪt dˈaʊn ðˈæt pˈeɪn wˈɛɹɪŋ ðˈæt kɹˈaʊn unchained/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: Bằng cách nào đó khá mệt mỏi với lời thề đó, nuốt nó xuống, nỗi đau đó, đội chiếc vương miện đó, không xiềng xích.

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: Closing my eyes, I hear your sigh, oh catching the light,
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /klˈoʊzɪŋ mˈaɪ ˈaɪz ˈaɪ hˈiɹ jˈɔɹ sˈaɪ ˈoʊ kˈætʃɪŋ ðə lˈaɪt/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: Nhắm mắt lại, tôi nghe tiếng thở dài của em, ôi bắt lấy ánh sáng,

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.text: still hear your whine, oh watching you lie, losing my mind, oh wishing you’d die.
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /stˈɪl hˈiɹ jˈɔɹ wˈaɪn ˈoʊ wˈɑtʃɪŋ jˈu lˈaɪ lˈuzɪŋ mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd ˈoʊ wˈɪʃɪŋ youd dˈaɪ/
57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.vietnamese_text: vẫn nghe tiếng rên rỉ của bạn, ôi đang xem bạn nói dối, mất trí, ôi ước bạn chết.

57b13dca-a11f-4a94-a207-7d9f3203c2e7.ipa: /dont ˈivɪn tɹˈaɪ ˈoʊ ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɡˌʊdbˈaɪ dɹˈaɪɪŋ mˈaɪ tˈɛɹ/

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's very common to have stools in bars or in your kitchen around the counter.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi kˈɑmən tˈu hˈæv stˈulz ɪn bˈɑɹz ˈɔɹ ɪn jˈɔɹ kˈɪtʃən ɚˈaʊnd ðə kˈaʊntɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ghế đẩu rất phổ biến ở các quán bar hoặc trong bếp của bạn quanh quầy.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: However, these stools are very short.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /hˌaʊˈɛvɚ ðˈiz stˈulz ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi ʃˈɔɹt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tuy nhiên, những chiếc ghế đẩu này rất thấp.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: You can see how much shorter they are compared to a regular-sized stool.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn sˈi hˈaʊ mˈʌtʃ ʃˈɔɹtɚ ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ə regularsized stˈul/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn có thể thấy chúng ngắn hơn bao nhiêu so với một chiếc ghế đẩu cỡ bình thường.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So in my experience in Asia, the stools are a lot smaller
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ ɪn mˈaɪ ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ɪn ˈeɪʒə ðə stˈulz ˈɑɹ ə lˈɑt smˈɔlɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Theo kinh nghiệm của tôi ở châu Á, bồn cầu bệt nhỏ hơn nhiều

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: because people just sit very low to the ground.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz pˈipəl dʒˈʌst sˈɪt vˈɛɹi lˈoʊ tˈu ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: vì mọi người ngồi rất sát đất.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: They sit very low to the ground.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈeɪ sˈɪt vˈɛɹi lˈoʊ tˈu ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Chúng ngồi rất thấp so với mặt đất.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: In the West, we do not sit that low to the ground at all.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ɪn ðə wˈɛst wˈi dˈu nˈɑt sˈɪt ðˈæt lˈoʊ tˈu ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd ˈæt ˈɔl/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ở phương Tây, chúng tôi không ngồi thấp sát đất như vậy chút nào.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So it is like a little uncomfortable to sit like
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪt ˈɪz lˈaɪk ə lˈɪtəl ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl tˈu sˈɪt lˈaɪk/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, ngồi như thế này hơi khó chịu một chút

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: that for extended periods of time, but it's not too bad if I'm being honest.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈæt fˈɔɹ ɪkstˈɛndəd pˈɪɹiədz ˈʌv tˈaɪm bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt tˈu bˈæd ˈɪf ˈaɪm bˈiɪŋ ˈɑnəst/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: điều đó trong thời gian dài, nhưng thành thật mà nói thì cũng không tệ lắm.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So if you look over here, this is I guess
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu lˈʊk ˈoʊvɚ hˈiɹ ðˈɪs ˈɪz ˈaɪ ɡˈɛs/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vậy nếu bạn nhìn sang đây, tôi đoán

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: what a typical area in District 1 looks like in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈʌt ə tˈɪpəkəl ˈɛɹiə ɪn dˈɪstɹɪkt 1 lˈʊks lˈaɪk ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: một khu vực điển hình ở Quận 1 trông như thế nào ở Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Currently, we are in District 1, which is the most famous district for tourists in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /kˈɝəntli wˈi ˈɑɹ ɪn dˈɪstɹɪkt 1 wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðə mˈoʊst fˈeɪməs dˈɪstɹɪkt fˈɔɹ tˈʊɹəsts ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Hiện tại, chúng tôi đang ở Quận 1, quận nổi tiếng nhất đối với khách du lịch ở Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: You can see many vehicles here, which is surprising.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn sˈi mˈɛni vˈihɪkəlz hˈiɹ wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz sɚpɹˈaɪzɪŋ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn có thể thấy nhiều phương tiện ở đây, điều này thật đáng ngạc nhiên.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Usually, you see a lot more scooters, but inside this area right here,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈuʒəwəli jˈu sˈi ə lˈɑt mˈɔɹ skˈutɚz bˈʌt ˌɪnsˈaɪd ðˈɪs ˈɛɹiə ɹˈaɪt hˈiɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Thông thường, bạn sẽ thấy nhiều xe tay ga hơn, nhưng bên trong khu vực này ngay tại đây,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: there are just scooters.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ dʒˈʌst skˈutɚz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: chỉ có xe tay ga.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: but yeah, they just have scooters there.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈæ ðˈeɪ dʒˈʌst hˈæv skˈutɚz ðˈɛɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: nhưng ừm, họ chỉ có xe tay ga ở đó thôi.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Over here, we have a tree and there are many trees along this road.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈoʊvɚ hˈiɹ wˈi hˈæv ə tɹˈi ənd ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɛni tɹˈiz əlˈɔŋ ðˈɪs ɹˈoʊd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ở đây, chúng ta có một cái cây và có nhiều cây dọc theo con đường này.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And here, we have cardboard boxes that have been opened up
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd hˈiɹ wˈi hˈæv kˈɑɹdbˌɔɹd bˈɑksəz ðˈæt hˈæv bˈɪn ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và ở đây, chúng ta có những chiếc hộp carton đã được mở ra

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: and flattened and placed on this cart.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd flˈætənd ənd plˈeɪst ˈɑn ðˈɪs kˈɑɹt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: và được làm phẳng và đặt trên xe đẩy này.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: The person that owns this will probably sell it later.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðə pˈɝsən ðˈæt ˈoʊnz ðˈɪs wˈɪl pɹˈɑbəblˌi sˈɛl ˈɪt lˈeɪtɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Người sở hữu cái này có lẽ sẽ bán nó sau này.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: But if you go over here, you can see the cafe apartments.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu ɡˈoʊ ˈoʊvɚ hˈiɹ jˈu kˈæn sˈi ðə kəfˈeɪ əpˈɑɹtmənts/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhưng nếu bạn đi sang đây, bạn có thể thấy các căn hộ quán cà phê.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: The cafe apartments, and we are about to go over there
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðə kəfˈeɪ əpˈɑɹtmənts ənd wˈi ˈɑɹ əbˈaʊt tˈu ɡˈoʊ ˈoʊvɚ ðˈɛɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Các căn hộ cafe, và chúng ta sắp đến đó

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: and check out the view and drink a coffee.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd tʃˈɛk ˈaʊt ðə vjˈu ənd dɹˈɪŋk ə kˈɑfi/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: và ngắm cảnh và uống cà phê.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: This is not our first day in Ho Chi Minh.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz nˈɑt ˈaʊɚ fˈɝst dˈeɪ ɪn hˈoʊ kˈaɪ mˈɪn/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đây không phải là ngày đầu tiên của chúng tôi ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: We've been here for a few days, but this is the first time we're filming.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈiv bˈɪn hˈiɹ fˈɔɹ ə fjˈu dˈeɪz bˈʌt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə fˈɝst tˈaɪm wˈiɹ fˈɪlmɪŋ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi đã ở đây vài ngày, nhưng đây là lần đầu tiên chúng tôi quay phim.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And we're just going to explore all the tourist sites
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd wˈiɹ dʒˈʌst ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu ɪksplˈɔɹ ˈɔl ðə tˈʊɹəst sˈaɪts/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và chúng ta sẽ khám phá tất cả các địa điểm du lịch

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: and just explore Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst ɪksplˈɔɹ hˈoʊ kˈaɪ mˈɪn sˈɪti ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: và chỉ khám phá Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh ở Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: This is our second time in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ˈaʊɚ sˈɛkənd tˈaɪm ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đây là lần thứ hai chúng tôi đến Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: The last time I was here was with my younger brother.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðə lˈæst tˈaɪm ˈaɪ wˈɑz hˈiɹ wˈɑz wˈɪð mˈaɪ jˈʌŋɡɚ bɹˈʌðɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Lần cuối tôi ở đây là với em trai tôi.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: That was three years ago.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɑz θɹˈi jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đó là ba năm trước.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: This time, I'm here with my older brother three years later.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɪs tˈaɪm ˈaɪm hˈiɹ wˈɪð mˈaɪ ˈoʊldɚ bɹˈʌðɚ θɹˈi jˈɪɹz lˈeɪtɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Lần này, tôi ở đây cùng anh trai tôi ba năm sau.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: But I am excited to be in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ ˈæm ɪksˈaɪtəd tˈu bˈi ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhưng tôi rất hào hứng khi ở Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Vietnamese food is some of my favorite food.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /viˌɛtnɑmˈis fˈud ˈɪz sˈʌm ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt fˈud/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ẩm thực Việt Nam là một trong những món ăn yêu thích của tôi.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And we have been indulging heavily in that food, haven't we?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd wˈi hˈæv bˈɪn ˌɪndˈʌldʒɪŋ hˈɛvəli ɪn ðˈæt fˈud hˈævənt wˈi/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và chúng ta đã ăn món đó rất nhiều, phải không?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Yeah, we have.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈæ wˈi hˈæv/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vâng, chúng tôi đã có.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: We had some good Vietnamese hamburgers last night.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈi hˈæd sˈʌm ɡˈʊd viˌɛtnɑmˈis hˈæmbɚɡɚz lˈæst nˈaɪt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tối qua chúng tôi đã ăn một vài chiếc bánh mì kẹp thịt Việt Nam ngon.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: look up there, dude.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈʊk ˈʌp ðˈɛɹ dˈud/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhìn lên đó đi, bạn.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: To me, that looks like the Avengers Tower.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /tˈu mˈi ðˈæt lˈʊks lˈaɪk ðə avengers tˈaʊɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đối với tôi, đó trông giống như Tháp Avengers.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: If you put like an A on it, like the Avengers logo,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu pˈʊt lˈaɪk ˈæn ə ˈɑn ˈɪt lˈaɪk ðə avengers lˈoʊɡoʊ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn đặt một chữ A lên đó, giống như logo của Avengers,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: dude, that would literally look like the Avengers Tower.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /dˈud ðˈæt wˈʊd lˈɪtɚəli lˈʊk lˈaɪk ðə avengers tˈaʊɚ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Anh bạn, trông nó cứ như Tháp Avengers vậy đó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Anyways, today, we'll be talking at a normal, natural English pace,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɛniwˌeɪz tədˈeɪ wˈil bˈi tˈɔkɪŋ ˈæt ə nˈɔɹməl nˈætʃɚəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ pˈeɪs/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Dù sao đi nữa, hôm nay, chúng ta sẽ nói chuyện với tốc độ tiếng Anh bình thường, tự nhiên,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: at a normal, natural English pace, but we'll be talking clearly.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈæt ə nˈɔɹməl nˈætʃɚəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ pˈeɪs bˈʌt wˈil bˈi tˈɔkɪŋ klˈɪɹli/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: với tốc độ tiếng Anh bình thường, tự nhiên, nhưng chúng ta sẽ nói rõ ràng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So, try your best to follow along and shadow.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ tɹˈaɪ jˈɔɹ bˈɛst tˈu fˈɑloʊ əlˈɔŋ ənd ʃˈædˌoʊ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, hãy cố gắng hết sức để theo dõi và lặp lại.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And if there are moments you don't understand something, just rewind a few seconds.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈoʊmənts jˈu dˈoʊnt ˌʌndɚstˈænd sˈʌmθɪŋ dʒˈʌst ɹˈiwaɪnd ə fjˈu sˈɛkəndz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và nếu có những lúc bạn không hiểu điều gì đó, chỉ cần tua lại vài giây.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: You can also turn on captions in the corner by clicking the CC button.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ tˈɝn ˈɑn kˈæpʃənz ɪn ðə kˈɔɹnɚ bˈaɪ klˈɪkɪŋ ðə sˌisˈi bˈʌtən/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn cũng có thể bật phụ đề ở góc bằng cách nhấp vào nút CC.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And you can follow along there as well, if you want captions.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd jˈu kˈæn fˈɑloʊ əlˈɔŋ ðˈɛɹ ˈæz wˈɛl ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt kˈæpʃənz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và bạn cũng có thể theo dõi ở đó, nếu bạn muốn phụ đề.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: But anyways, we are walking on the sidewalk here in Ho Chi Minh City.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɛniwˌeɪz wˈi ˈɑɹ wˈɔkɪŋ ˈɑn ðə sˈaɪdwˌɔk hˈiɹ ɪn hˈoʊ kˈaɪ mˈɪn sˈɪti/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhưng dù sao thì, chúng tôi đang đi bộ trên vỉa hè ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's not too hot today, but it still is hot compared to Canada.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts nˈɑt tˈu hˈɑt tədˈeɪ bˈʌt ˈɪt stˈɪl ˈɪz hˈɑt kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu kˈænədə/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Hôm nay không quá nóng, nhưng vẫn nóng so với Canada.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So, I just opened up my weather app,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp mˈaɪ wˈɛðɚ ˈæp/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vậy là, tôi vừa mở ứng dụng thời tiết của mình,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: and it's currently 30 degrees Celsius in Ho Chi Minh City,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts kˈɝəntli 30 dɪɡɹˈiz sˈɛlsiəs ɪn hˈoʊ kˈaɪ mˈɪn sˈɪti/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: và hiện tại là 30 độ C ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: but it feels like 34 degrees.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt fˈilz lˈaɪk 34 dɪɡɹˈiz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: nhưng cảm giác như 34 độ.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: But it's only 11 a.m.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts ˈoʊnli 11 ˈæm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhưng mới chỉ 11 giờ sáng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's not the hottest time of day yet.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts nˈɑt ðə hˈɑtəst tˈaɪm ˈʌv dˈeɪ jˈɛt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đó chưa phải là thời điểm nóng nhất trong ngày.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Around noon, 1 p.m., 2 p.m., that is when it will be the hottest.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ɚˈaʊnd nˈun 1 pˈiˈɛm 2 pˈiˈɛm ðˈæt ˈɪz wˈɛn ˈɪt wˈɪl bˈi ðə hˈɑtəst/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Khoảng trưa, 1 giờ chiều, 2 giờ chiều, đó là lúc nóng nhất.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And today, there is a high of 35 degrees, so it will be very hot today.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd tədˈeɪ ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə hˈaɪ ˈʌv 35 dɪɡɹˈiz sˈoʊ ˈɪt wˈɪl bˈi vˈɛɹi hˈɑt tədˈeɪ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và hôm nay, nhiệt độ cao nhất là 35 độ, vì vậy hôm nay sẽ rất nóng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: What about rain?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ɹˈeɪn/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Còn mưa thì sao?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Rain, no rain, but it is very sunny.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ɹˈeɪn nˈoʊ ɹˈeɪn bˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɪz vˈɛɹi sˈʌni/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Mưa, không mưa, nhưng trời rất nắng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I wish I brought my umbrella.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɪʃ ˈaɪ bɹˈɔt mˈaɪ əmbɹˈɛlə/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ước gì tôi đã mang ô.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I low-key need it.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ lowkey nˈid ˈɪt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi thầm cần nó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Look at the sidewalk here.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈʊk ˈæt ðə sˈaɪdwˌɔk hˈiɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhìn vỉa hè ở đây này.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's very stained, eh? Yeah.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi stˈeɪnd ˈɛ jˈæ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nó bị ố nhiều quá, nhỉ? Ừ.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's very, very stained.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi vˈɛɹi stˈeɪnd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nó bị ố rất, rất nhiều.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's like stained like black almost.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts lˈaɪk stˈeɪnd lˈaɪk blˈæk ˈɔlmˌoʊst/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nó trông như bị nhuộm đen gần như vậy.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I wonder what that is.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈʌndɚ wˈʌt ðˈæt ˈɪz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi tự hỏi đó là cái gì.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Do you have any guesses?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /dˈu jˈu hˈæv ˈɛni ɡˈɛsəz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn có bất kỳ phỏng đoán nào không?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Honestly, I don't know.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɑnəstli ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Thật tình thì tôi không biết.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Like, it's not sticky.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈaɪk ˈɪts nˈɑt stˈɪki/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Giống như, nó không dính.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I think it's from food, like cooking oil maybe.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɪts fɹˈʌm fˈud lˈaɪk kˈʊkɪŋ ˈɔɪl mˈeɪbi/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ nó đến từ thức ăn, có lẽ là dầu ăn chẳng hạn.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Oil. Yeah, okay, oil.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɔɪl jˈæ ˌoʊkˈeɪ ˈɔɪl/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Dầu. Vâng, được rồi, dầu.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's kind of like darker, and that's what oil looks when it stains something.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts kˈaɪnd ˈʌv lˈaɪk dˈɑɹkɚ ənd ðˈæts wˈʌt ˈɔɪl lˈʊks wˈɛn ˈɪt stˈeɪnz sˈʌmθɪŋ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nó hơi tối hơn, và đó là cái mà dầu trông như thế nào khi nó làm bẩn thứ gì đó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Anyways, can you guys tell me why this wall is here?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɛniwˌeɪz kˈæn jˈu ɡˈaɪz tˈɛl mˈi wˈaɪ ðˈɪs wˈɔl ˈɪz hˈiɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Dù sao thì, các bạn có thể cho tôi biết tại sao bức tường này lại ở đây không?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: This wall is to hide the construction on the other side.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɪs wˈɔl ˈɪz tˈu hˈaɪd ðə kənstɹˈʌkʃən ˈɑn ðə ˈʌðɚ sˈaɪd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bức tường này dùng để che khuất công trình xây dựng ở phía bên kia.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: So currently, they are probably building something on the other side
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /sˈoʊ kˈɝəntli ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ pɹˈɑbəblˌi bˈɪldɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɑn ðə ˈʌðɚ sˈaɪd/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, hiện tại, họ có lẽ đang xây dựng một cái gì đó ở phía bên kia

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: of this, and they put this wall here to hide it.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈʌv ðˈɪs ənd ðˈeɪ pˈʊt ðˈɪs wˈɔl hˈiɹ tˈu hˈaɪd ˈɪt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: của cái này, và họ dựng bức tường này ở đây để che giấu nó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I guess this is what they're building.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɡˈɛs ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌt ðˈɛɹ bˈɪldɪŋ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi đoán đây là thứ họ đang xây dựng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: A mall with a pool, like a rooftop pool.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ə mˈɔl wˈɪð ə pˈul lˈaɪk ə ɹˈuftˌɑp pˈul/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Một trung tâm thương mại có hồ bơi, giống như một hồ bơi trên tầng thượng.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: That's what they're building here.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈæts wˈʌt ðˈɛɹ bˈɪldɪŋ hˈiɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Đó là những gì họ đang xây dựng ở đây.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: But I do really like the vibe in Vietnam.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ dˈu ɹˈɪli lˈaɪk ðə vˈaɪb ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nhưng tôi thực sự thích không khí ở Việt Nam.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I love it. It's nice.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ˈɪt ˈɪts nˈaɪs/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích nó. Nó thật hay.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Like, look, just look.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈaɪk lˈʊk dʒˈʌst lˈʊk/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Giống như, nhìn, chỉ cần nhìn.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I just like looking out at stuff.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk lˈʊkɪŋ ˈaʊt ˈæt stˈʌf/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi chỉ thích nhìn ra ngoài.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Although, I will say one thing, there is a lot of noise pollution.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ ˈaɪ wˈɪl sˈeɪ wˈʌn θˈɪŋ ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə lˈɑt ˈʌv nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Mặc dù vậy, tôi sẽ nói một điều, có rất nhiều ô nhiễm tiếng ồn.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Noise pollution is a term that refers to like the sounds of a city.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən ˈɪz ə tˈɝm ðˈæt ɹəfˈɝz tˈu lˈaɪk ðə sˈaʊndz ˈʌv ə sˈɪti/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ô nhiễm tiếng ồn là một thuật ngữ dùng để chỉ những âm thanh của một thành phố.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: It's honking, like you hear all that honking, the sounds of vehicles,
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪts hˈɔŋkɪŋ lˈaɪk jˈu hˈiɹ ˈɔl ðˈæt hˈɔŋkɪŋ ðə sˈaʊndz ˈʌv vˈihɪkəlz/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Nó đang bóp còi, như bạn nghe thấy tất cả tiếng bóp còi, tiếng xe cộ,

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: the sounds of people working. Noise pollution.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðə sˈaʊndz ˈʌv pˈipəl wˈɝkɪŋ nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: tiếng ồn của người lao động. Ô nhiễm tiếng ồn.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: There is a lot of noise pollution that you have to get used to.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə lˈɑt ˈʌv nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən ðˈæt jˈu hˈæv tˈu ɡˈɛt jˈuzd tˈu/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Có rất nhiều ô nhiễm tiếng ồn mà bạn phải quen với nó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: And in Vietnam, people park their scooters everywhere.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ənd ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm pˈipəl pˈɑɹk ðˈɛɹ skˈutɚz ˈɛvɹiwˌɛɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Và ở Việt Nam, người ta đậu xe máy khắp nơi.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: All along the sidewalks, you'll see scooters parked.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɔl əlˈɔŋ ðə sˈaɪdwˌɔks jˈul sˈi skˈutɚz pˈɑɹkt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Dọc theo các vỉa hè, bạn sẽ thấy những chiếc xe tay ga được đậu.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Like, look at this.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈaɪk lˈʊk ˈæt ðˈɪs/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Giống như, nhìn cái này đi.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Everywhere you look, there are scooters parked.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɛvɹiwˌɛɹ jˈu lˈʊk ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ skˈutɚz pˈɑɹkt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Khắp nơi bạn nhìn, đều có những chiếc xe tay ga đậu.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Isn't there a stat that there are more scooters than people in Vietnam?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɪzənt ðˈɛɹ ə stˈæt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ skˈutɚz ðˈæn pˈipəl ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Không có thống kê nào cho rằng số lượng xe máy ở Việt Nam nhiều hơn số dân sao?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Yeah, it's like 2 to 1 or something.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈæ ˈɪts lˈaɪk 2 tˈu 1 ˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vâng, nó giống như 2 ăn 1 hay gì đó.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: We should lowkey eat something, eh? You hungry?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈi ʃˈʊd lowkey ˈit sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɛ jˈu hˈʌŋɡɹi/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta nên ăn gì đó một cách kín đáo, nhỉ? Bạn đói không?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I thought you said you weren't hungry today.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɔt jˈu sˈɛd jˈu wˈɝənt hˈʌŋɡɹi tədˈeɪ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã nghĩ bạn nói hôm nay bạn không đói.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Oh, I'm hungry every day.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈoʊ ˈaɪm hˈʌŋɡɹi ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi đói mỗi ngày.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I'm not hungry for dinner, though.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪm nˈɑt hˈʌŋɡɹi fˈɔɹ dˈɪnɚ ðˈoʊ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi không đói cho bữa tối, mặc dù vậy.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Let's see if we find anything good along the street.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /lˈɛts sˈi ˈɪf wˈi fˈaɪnd ˈɛniθˌɪŋ ɡˈʊd əlˈɔŋ ðə stɹˈit/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Hãy xem chúng ta có tìm thấy gì hay ho dọc con phố không.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Yeah, if we see something good, we'll definitely stop by.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /jˈæ ˈɪf wˈi sˈi sˈʌmθɪŋ ɡˈʊd wˈil dˈɛfənətli stˈɑp bˈaɪ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Vâng, nếu chúng tôi thấy thứ gì đó hay, chúng tôi chắc chắn sẽ ghé qua.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: What about the Sony Fujifilm Nikon Canon store?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə sˈoʊni fujifilm nˈaɪkˌɑn kˈænən stˈɔɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Còn cửa hàng Sony Fujifilm Nikon Canon thì sao?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Oh, I think this whole street is cameras What do you think they sell there?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈɪs hˈoʊl stɹˈit ˈɪz kˈæmɚəz wˈʌt dˈu jˈu θˈɪŋk ðˈeɪ sˈɛl ðˈɛɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Ồ, tôi nghĩ cả con phố này đều là máy quay. Bạn nghĩ họ bán gì ở đó?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I think they sell Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm and Sony.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈeɪ sˈɛl kˈænən nˈaɪkˌɑn fujifilm ənd sˈoʊni/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ họ bán Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm và Sony.

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: Are you sure?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈɑɹ jˈu ʃˈʊɹ/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn có chắc không?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: What makes you say that?
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /wˈʌt mˈeɪks jˈu sˈeɪ ðˈæt/
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.vietnamese_text: Bạn nói vậy là vì sao?

ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.text: I don't know.
ee7ae307-6448-407e-975f-ed03cf0b30ee.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt nˈoʊ/
