c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Những người ở Hải quân đã sử dụng một hình chữ nhật màu hồng.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: The Universal Postal Convention used a white staff-and-snake on a violet background.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðə jˌunəvˈɝsəl pˈoʊstəl kənvˈɛnʃən jˈuzd ə wˈaɪt staffandsnake ˈɑn ə vˈaɪəlɪt bˈækɡɹˌaʊnd/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Công ước Bưu chính Toàn cầu sử dụng một cây gậy và rắn màu trắng trên nền tím.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: There was no consistency in the visual language used to communicate risk.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz nˈoʊ kənsˈɪstənsi ɪn ðə vˈɪʒəwəl lˈæŋɡwədʒ jˈuzd tˈu kəmjˈunəkˌeɪt ɹˈɪsk/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Không có sự nhất quán trong ngôn ngữ hình ảnh được sử dụng để truyền đạt rủi ro.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: That was dangerous, and could lead to accidental infections.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɑz dˈeɪndʒɚəs ənd kˈʊd lˈɛd tˈu ˌæksədˈɛntəl ˌɪnfˈɛkʃənz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Điều đó thật nguy hiểm và có thể dẫn đến nhiễm trùng ngoài ý muốn.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: So in 1966, a group of engineers
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ ɪn 1966 ə ɡɹˈup ˈʌv ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Vậy là vào năm 1966, một nhóm kỹ sư

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and designers at Dow Chemical set out to create the best possible icon for biohazardous materials.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd dɪzˈaɪnɚz ˈæt dˈaʊ kˈɛməkəl sˈɛt ˈaʊt tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ðə bˈɛst pˈɑsəbəl ˈaɪkɑn fˈɔɹ biohazardous mətˈɪɹiəlz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: và các nhà thiết kế tại Dow Chemical đã bắt tay vào tạo ra biểu tượng tốt nhất có thể cho các vật liệu nguy hiểm sinh học.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: They laid out six design criteria.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈeɪ lˈeɪd ˈaʊt sˈɪks dɪzˈaɪn kɹaɪtˈɪɹiə/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Họ đã đưa ra sáu tiêu chí thiết kế.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: First, it needed to be visually striking, so that it would draw immediate attention.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /fˈɝst ˈɪt nˈidəd tˈu bˈi vˈɪʒwəli stɹˈaɪkɪŋ sˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪt wˈʊd dɹˈɔ ˌɪmˈidˌiət ətˈɛnʃən/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Đầu tiên, nó cần phải bắt mắt về mặt thị giác, để thu hút sự chú ý ngay lập tức.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: That ruled out simple shapes like those from the Navy and Army.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt ɹˈuld ˈaʊt sˈɪmpəl ʃˈeɪps lˈaɪk ðˈoʊz fɹˈʌm ðə nˈeɪvi ənd ˈɑɹmi/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Điều đó đã loại trừ các hình dạng đơn giản như của Hải quân và Lục quân.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: It also had to be unique and unambiguous,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ hˈæd tˈu bˈi junˈik ənd ˌʌnæmbˈɪɡjəwəs/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Nó cũng phải độc đáo và rõ ràng,

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: in order not to be confused with symbols used for other purposes.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ɪn ˈɔɹdɚ nˈɑt tˈu bˈi kənfjˈuzd wˈɪð sˈɪmbəlz jˈuzd fˈɔɹ ˈʌðɚ pˈɝpəsəz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: để không bị nhầm lẫn với các ký hiệu được sử dụng cho các mục đích khác.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: That ruled out the snake-and-staff, which has multiple versions
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt ɹˈuld ˈaʊt ðə snakeandstaff wˈɪtʃ hˈæz mˈʌltəpəl vˈɝʒənz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Điều đó đã loại trừ biểu tượng con rắn và cây gậy, vốn có nhiều phiên bản

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and has a pretty vague meaning as a general symbol for medicine.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd hˈæz ə pɹˈɪti vˈeɪɡ mˈinɪŋ ˈæz ə dʒˈɛnɚəl sˈɪmbəl fˈɔɹ mˈɛdəsən/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: và có một ý nghĩa khá mơ hồ như một biểu tượng chung cho y học.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: On top of that, it had to be quickly recognizable and easily recalled.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɑn tˈɑp ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪt hˈæd tˈu bˈi kwˈɪkli ɹˌɛkəɡnˈaɪzəbəl ənd ˈizəli ɹɪkˈɔld/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Thêm vào đó, nó phải dễ dàng nhận biết và dễ nhớ.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Had to be easy to stencil.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /hˈæd tˈu bˈi ˈizi tˈu stˈɛnsɪl/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Dễ dàng để vẽ khuôn.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And rotationally symmetrical, in order to appear identical from all angles.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd ɹoʊtˈeɪʃənəli səmˈɛtɹɪkəl ɪn ˈɔɹdɚ tˈu əpˈɪɹ aɪdˈɛntɪkəl fɹˈʌm ˈɔl ˈæŋɡəlz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Và đối xứng quay, để trông giống nhau từ mọi góc độ.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And lastly, it had to be acceptable to groups of all backgrounds.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd lˈæstli ˈɪt hˈæd tˈu bˈi æksˈɛptəbəl tˈu ɡɹˈups ˈʌv ˈɔl bˈækɡɹˌaʊndz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Và cuối cùng, nó phải được chấp nhận bởi các nhóm thuộc mọi tầng lớp.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: So the Dow Chemical team designed an experiment.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðə dˈaʊ kˈɛməkəl tˈim dɪzˈaɪnd ˈæn ɪkspˈɛɹəmənt/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, đội ngũ của Dow Chemical đã thiết kế một thí nghiệm.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Charles Baldwin, an environmental health engineer behind the experiment, said
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /tʃˈɑɹlz bˈɔldwən ˈæn ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl hˈɛlθ ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹ bɪhˈaɪnd ðə ɪkspˈɛɹəmənt sˈɛd/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Charles Baldwin, một kỹ sư sức khỏe môi trường đứng sau thí nghiệm, cho biết

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: that the team “wanted something that was memorable but meaningless
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə tˈim wˈɔntɪd sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈɑz mˈɛmɚəbəl bˈʌt mˈinɪŋləs/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: rằng đội "muốn một cái gì đó đáng nhớ nhưng vô nghĩa

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: so we could educate people as to what it means."
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈi kˈʊd ˈɛdʒəkˌeɪt pˈipəl ˈæz tˈu wˈʌt ˈɪt mˈinz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: vì vậy chúng ta có thể giáo dục mọi người về ý nghĩa của nó."

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: They showed a set of 24 symbols to 300 people from 25 American cities.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ʃˈoʊd ə sˈɛt ˈʌv 24 sˈɪmbəlz tˈu 300 pˈipəl fɹˈʌm 25 əmˈɛɹəkən sˈɪtiz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Họ đã cho 300 người từ 25 thành phố của Mỹ xem một bộ gồm 24 ký hiệu.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: There were 6 newly-designed biohazard markers, and 18 common symbols things like Mr.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɝ 6 newlydesigned bˌaɪoʊhˈæzɚd mˈɑɹkɚz ənd 18 kˈɑmən sˈɪmbəlz θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk mˈɪstɚ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Có 6 dấu hiệu an toàn sinh học mới được thiết kế, và 18 biểu tượng thông thường như ông.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Peanut, the Texaco star, the Shell Oil symbol, the Red Cross, and a swastika.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /pˈinət ðə tˈɛksəkoʊ stˈɑɹ ðə ʃˈɛl ˈɔɪl sˈɪmbəl ðə ɹˈɛd kɹˈɔs ənd ə swˈɑstɪkə/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Đậu phộng, ngôi sao Texaco, biểu tượng Shell Oil, Chữ thập đỏ và một chữ ngoặc ngoèo.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Participants were asked to guess the meaning of each one,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /pɑɹtˈɪsəpənts wˈɝ ˈæskt tˈu ɡˈɛs ðə mˈinɪŋ ˈʌv ˈitʃ wˈʌn/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Những người tham gia được yêu cầu đoán nghĩa của từng từ,

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: which was used to assign each one a “meaningfulness score.” A week later,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz jˈuzd tˈu əsˈaɪn ˈitʃ wˈʌn ə meaningfulness skˈɔɹ ə wˈik lˈeɪtɚ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: được sử dụng để gán cho mỗi người một "điểm ý nghĩa". Một tuần sau,

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: the same participants were shown those original 24 symbols, plus 36 more.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm pɑɹtˈɪsəpənts wˈɝ ʃˈoʊn ðˈoʊz ɚˈɪdʒənəl 24 sˈɪmbəlz plˈʌs 36 mˈɔɹ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: những người tham gia giống nhau đã được xem 24 biểu tượng gốc đó, cộng thêm 36 biểu tượng nữa.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: They were asked to identify
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ˈæskt tˈu aɪdˈɛntəfˌaɪ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Họ được yêu cầu xác định

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: which symbols they remembered seeing in the previous round of the study.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ sˈɪmbəlz ðˈeɪ ɹɪmˈɛmbɚd sˈiɪŋ ɪn ðə pɹˈiviəs ɹˈaʊnd ˈʌv ðə stˈʌdi/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: những biểu tượng nào họ nhớ đã nhìn thấy trong vòng nghiên cứu trước đó.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Among the six competing biohazard designs, this one stood out.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /əmˈʌŋ ðə sˈɪks kəmpˈitɪŋ bˌaɪoʊhˈæzɚd dɪzˈaɪnz ðˈɪs wˈʌn stˈʊd ˈaʊt/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Trong sáu thiết kế biohazard cạnh tranh, thiết kế này nổi bật.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: It scored the highest in memorability, but the lowest in meaningfulness.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɪt skˈɔɹd ðə hˈaɪəst ɪn memorability bˈʌt ðə lˈoʊəst ɪn meaningfulness/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Nó đạt điểm cao nhất về khả năng ghi nhớ, nhưng thấp nhất về ý nghĩa.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: So it was unforgettable, but also a totally blank slate for designers
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪt wˈɑz ˌʌnfɚɡˈɛtəbəl bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ə tˈoʊtəli blˈæŋk slˈeɪt fˈɔɹ dɪzˈaɪnɚz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, đó là một điều không thể quên, nhưng cũng là một khởi đầu hoàn toàn mới cho các nhà thiết kế

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: who wanted to give it meaning.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /hˈu wˈɔntɪd tˈu ɡˈɪv ˈɪt mˈinɪŋ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: ai muốn cho nó ý nghĩa.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And with that, it became a national standard.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd wˈɪð ðˈæt ˈɪt bɪkˈeɪm ə nˈæʃənəl stˈændɚd/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Và với điều đó, nó đã trở thành một tiêu chuẩn quốc gia.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: It’s easy to overlook how much visual communication work these symbols are doing.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈizi tˈu ˈoʊvɚlˌʊk hˈaʊ mˈʌtʃ vˈɪʒəwəl kəmjˌunəkˈeɪʃən wˈɝk ðˈiz sˈɪmbəlz ˈɑɹ dˈuɪŋ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Thật dễ dàng bỏ qua việc những biểu tượng này đang thực hiện bao nhiêu công việc truyền thông bằng hình ảnh.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: They’re simple you only need a straightedge and a compass to recreate them.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /theyre sˈɪmpəl jˈu ˈoʊnli nˈid ə stɹˈeɪtˌɛdʒ ənd ə kˈʌmpəs tˈu ɹˈɛkɹiˌeɪt ðˈɛm/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Chúng rất đơn giản, bạn chỉ cần một thước thẳng và một compa để tái tạo chúng.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And unlike most other hazard symbols, they don’t reference an existing physical object or idea.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd ənlˈaɪk mˈoʊst ˈʌðɚ hˈæzɚd sˈɪmbəlz ðˈeɪ dont ɹˈɛfɚəns ˈæn ɪɡzˈɪstɪŋ fˈɪzɪkəl ˈɑbdʒɛkt ˈɔɹ aɪdˈiə/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Và không giống như hầu hết các ký hiệu nguy hiểm khác, chúng không đề cập đến một vật thể hoặc ý tưởng vật lý hiện có.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: But they’ve remained iconic for decades, helping people recognize serious dangers
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈʌt theyve ɹɪmˈeɪnd ˌaɪkˈɑnɪk fˈɔɹ dɛkˈeɪdz hˈɛlpɪŋ pˈipəl ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz sˈɪɹiəs dˈeɪndʒɚz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Nhưng chúng đã trở thành biểu tượng trong nhiều thập kỷ, giúp mọi người nhận ra những nguy hiểm nghiêm trọng

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: that may remain a threat for thousands of years to come.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt mˈeɪ ɹɪmˈeɪn ə θɹˈɛt fˈɔɹ θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv jˈɪɹz tˈu kˈʌm/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: có thể vẫn là một mối đe dọa trong hàng nghìn năm tới.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And that raises the question: could the meaning of those symbols stand the test of time?
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd ðˈæt ɹˈeɪzəz ðə kwˈɛstʃən kˈʊd ðə mˈinɪŋ ˈʌv ðˈoʊz sˈɪmbəlz stˈænd ðə tˈɛst ˈʌv tˈaɪm/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Và điều đó đặt ra câu hỏi: liệu ý nghĩa của những biểu tượng đó có thể vượt qua thử thách của thời gian?

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Few people have pondered that question quite like Gregory Benford.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /fjˈu pˈipəl hˈæv pˈɑndɚd ðˈæt kwˈɛstʃən kwˈaɪt lˈaɪk ɡɹˈɛɡɚi bˈɛnfɚd/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Ít người đã suy ngẫm về câu hỏi đó như Gregory Benford.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: He’s a physicist and science fiction author.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /hes ə fˈɪzɪsɪst ənd sˈaɪəns fˈɪkʃən ˈɔθɚ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy là một nhà vật lý và tác giả khoa học viễn tưởng.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: In the 1990s, he was invited to work on the Waste Isolation Pilot Project, or WIPP.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ɪn ðə 1990s hˈi wˈɑz ˌɪnvˈaɪtəd tˈu wˈɝk ˈɑn ðə wˈeɪst ˌaɪsəlˈeɪʃən pˈaɪlət pɹˈɑdʒɛkt ˈɔɹ wipp/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Vào những năm 1990, ông được mời tham gia Dự án Thí điểm Cô lập Chất thải, hay WIPP.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: The WIPP is a massive storage site for radioactive waste in the southeastern plains of New
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðə wipp ˈɪz ə mˈæsɪv stˈɔɹədʒ sˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ɹˌeɪdioʊˈæktɪv wˈeɪst ɪn ðə sˌaʊθˈistɚn plˈeɪnz ˈʌv nˈu/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: WIPP là một địa điểm lưu trữ khổng lồ chất thải phóng xạ ở vùng đồng bằng đông nam New

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Mexico, organized by the US Department of Energy.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /mˈɛksəkˌoʊ ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzd bˈaɪ ðə ˈʌs dɪpˈɑɹtmənt ˈʌv ˈɛnɚdʒi/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Mexico, được tổ chức bởi Bộ Năng lượng Hoa Kỳ.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Benford was brought in to help calculate the probability that someone
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈɛnfɚd wˈɑz bɹˈɔt ɪn tˈu hˈɛlp kˈælkjəlˌeɪt ðə pɹˌɑbəbˈɪlətˌi ðˈæt sˈʌmwˌʌn/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Benford được đưa vào để giúp tính toán xác suất mà một người nào đó

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: or something would intrude on the site for as long
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ wˈʊd ˌɪntɹˈud ˈɑn ðə sˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ˈæz lˈɔŋ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: hoặc thứ gì đó sẽ xâm phạm địa điểm trong một thời gian dài

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: as it remains dangerous approximately the next 10,000 years.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈæz ˈɪt ɹɪmˈeɪnz dˈeɪndʒɚəs əpɹˈɑksəmətli ðə nˈɛkst 10000 jˈɪɹz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: vì nó vẫn nguy hiểm trong khoảng 10.000 năm tới.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: “Well, name anything that has persisted for 10,000 years.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈɛl nˈeɪm ˈɛniθˌɪŋ ðˈæt hˈæz pɚsˈɪstɪd fˈɔɹ 10000 jˈɪɹz/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Nào, hãy kể tên bất cứ thứ gì đã tồn tại trong 10.000 năm.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Any institution. There isn't any.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɛni ˌɪnstɪtˈuʃən ðˈɛɹ ˈɪzənt ˈɛni/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Bất kỳ tổ chức nào. Không có tổ chức nào cả.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: The record is probably something like the Catholic Church
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðə ɹəkˈɔɹd ˈɪz pɹˈɑbəblˌi sˈʌmθɪŋ lˈaɪk ðə kˈæθlɪk tʃˈɝtʃ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Kỷ lục có lẽ là cái gì đó giống như Giáo hội Công giáo

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: or the core of the Jewish religion, which tells us something about
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðə kˈɔɹ ˈʌv ðə dʒˈuɪʃ ɹɪlˈɪdʒən wˈɪtʃ tˈɛlz ˈʌs sˈʌmθɪŋ əbˈaʊt/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: hoặc cốt lõi của tôn giáo Do Thái, điều này cho chúng ta biết điều gì đó về

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: what really lasts.” The meaning of a symbol can change over time.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈʌt ɹˈɪli lˈæsts ðə mˈinɪŋ ˈʌv ə sˈɪmbəl kˈæn tʃˈeɪndʒ ˈoʊvɚ tˈaɪm/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: điều gì thực sự tồn tại mãi mãi.” Ý nghĩa của một biểu tượng có thể thay đổi theo thời gian.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Like the Jolly Roger, which wouldn't work for the radioactive threat at the WIPP.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /lˈaɪk ðə dʒˈɑli ɹˈɑdʒɚ wˈɪtʃ wˈʊdənt wˈɝk fˈɔɹ ðə ɹˌeɪdioʊˈæktɪv θɹˈɛt ˈæt ðə wipp/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Giống như cờ Jolly Roger, thứ sẽ không hiệu quả đối với mối đe dọa phóng xạ tại WIPP.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: "If you're approaching the WIPP facility and you see a skull
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ əpɹˈoʊtʃɪŋ ðə wipp fəsˈɪlɪti ənd jˈu sˈi ə skˈʌl/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn đang đến cơ sở WIPP và bạn thấy một hộp sọ

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and crossbones you might think, ‘Hey
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd kɹˈɔsbˌoʊnz jˈu mˈaɪt θˈɪŋk hˈeɪ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: và xương chéo bạn có thể nghĩ, 'Này

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: this is where the pirates buried their treasure.’”
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈɛɹ ðə pˈaɪɹəts bˈɛɹid ðˈɛɹ tɹˈɛʒɚ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: "đây là nơi bọn cướp biển chôn kho báu của chúng."

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: So how do you indicate a long lasting danger across any language?
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈaʊ dˈu jˈu ˈɪndəkˌeɪt ə lˈɔŋ lˈæstɪŋ dˈeɪndʒɚ əkɹˈɔs ˈɛni lˈæŋɡwədʒ/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Vậy làm thế nào để bạn chỉ ra một mối nguy hiểm kéo dài qua bất kỳ ngôn ngữ nào?

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Since the 1970s, engineers, anthropologists, physicists, and behavioral scientists have proposed different solutions to that problem.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈɪns ðə 1970s ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹz ˌænθɹəpˈɑlədʒəsts fˈɪzɪsɪsts ənd bɪhˈeɪvjɚəl sˈaɪəntɪsts hˈæv pɹəpˈoʊzd dˈɪfɚənt səlˈuʃənz tˈu ðˈæt pɹˈɑbləm/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Kể từ những năm 1970, các kỹ sư, nhà nhân chủng học, nhà vật lý và các nhà khoa học hành vi đã đề xuất các giải pháp khác nhau cho vấn đề đó.

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: One strategy was to add context to the symbol.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈʌn stɹˈætədʒi wˈɑz tˈu ˈæd kˈɑntɛkst tˈu ðə sˈɪmbəl/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: By illustrating cause and effect in a three-part cartoon like
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈaɪ ˈɪləstɹˌeɪtɪŋ kˈɑz ənd ɪfˈɛkt ɪn ə threepart kɑɹtˈun lˈaɪk/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: this, designers could communicate the idea even if the symbol lost its meaning.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈɪs dɪzˈaɪnɚz kˈʊd kəmjˈunəkˌeɪt ðə aɪdˈiə ˈivɪn ˈɪf ðə sˈɪmbəl lˈɔst ˈɪts mˈinɪŋ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: But this kind of visual communication still made a lot of assumptions about the user:
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv vˈɪʒəwəl kəmjˌunəkˈeɪʃən stˈɪl mˈeɪd ə lˈɑt ˈʌv əsˈʌmpʃənz əbˈaʊt ðə jˈuzɚ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: that they would read left to right, that they would understand causality between frames
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈeɪ wˈʊd ɹˈɛd lˈɛft tˈu ɹˈaɪt ðˈæt ðˈeɪ wˈʊd ˌʌndɚstˈænd kˌɔzˈɑlɪti bɪtwˈin fɹˈeɪmz/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and, of course, that the drawing itself would last millennia of wear and tear.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd ˈʌv kˈɔɹs ðˈæt ðə dɹˈɔɪŋ ˌɪtsˈɛlf wˈʊd lˈæst məlˈɛniə ˈʌv wˈɛɹ ənd tˈɛɹ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: So other designers started to focus on creating a warning without inscribed communication,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈʌðɚ dɪzˈaɪnɚz stˈɑɹtɪd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ə wˈɔɹnɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˌɪnskɹˈaɪbd kəmjˌunəkˈeɪʃən/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: by altering the shape of the location itself.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈaɪ ˈɔltɚɪŋ ðə ʃˈeɪp ˈʌv ðə loʊkˈeɪʃən ˌɪtsˈɛlf/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And that yielded designs like this.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd ðˈæt jˈildɪd dɪzˈaɪnz lˈaɪk ðˈɪs/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Spike fields, forbidding blocks, giant pyramids: these designs capitalized on natural instincts of fear
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /spˈaɪk fˈildz fɚbˈɪdɪŋ blˈɑks dʒˈaɪənt pˈɪɹəmɪdz ðˈiz dɪzˈaɪnz kˈæpɪtəlˌaɪzd ˈɑn nˈætʃɚəl ˈɪnstɪŋkts ˈʌv fˈɪɹ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and discomfort to keep people away.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd dɪskˈʌmfɚt tˈu kˈip pˈipəl əwˈeɪ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: But even then, they weren’t foolproof.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈivɪn ðˈɛn ðˈeɪ werent fˈulpɹˌuf/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Designers couldn’t be sure whether they would be perceived as terrifying or fascinating.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /dɪzˈaɪnɚz couldnt bˈi ʃˈʊɹ wˈɛðɚ ðˈeɪ wˈʊd bˈi pɚsˈivd ˈæz tˈɛɹəfˌaɪɪŋ ˈɔɹ fˈæsənˌeɪtɪŋ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: “Conflict between these two urges: you want people to notice
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /kˈɑnflɪkt bɪtwˈin ðˈiz tˈu ˈɝdʒəz jˈu wˈɑnt pˈipəl tˈu nˈoʊtəs/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: it but you don't want people to go there.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈɪt bˈʌt jˈu dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈoʊ ðˈɛɹ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Those are always going to fight each other.” So without symbols,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈoʊz ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu fˈaɪt ˈitʃ ˈʌðɚ sˈoʊ wɪθˈaʊt sˈɪmbəlz/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: without basic illustrations, or physical structures, how can you effectively communicate a warning?
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wɪθˈaʊt bˈeɪsɪk ˌɪləstɹˈeɪʃənz ˈɔɹ fˈɪzɪkəl stɹˈ��ktʃɚz hˈaʊ kˈæn jˈu ɪfˈɛktɪvli kəmjˈunəkˌeɪt ə wˈɔɹnɪŋ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: That’s where the more philosophical design solutions come in.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /thats wˈɛɹ ðə mˈɔɹ fˌɪləsˈɑfɪkəl dɪzˈaɪn səlˈuʃənz kˈʌm ɪn/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: In 1984, the German Journal of Semiotics published a series of solutions from various scholars.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ɪn 1984 ðə dʒˈɝmən dʒˈɝnəl ˈʌv sˌɛmiˈɑtɪks pˈʌblɪʃt ə sˈɪɹiz ˈʌv səlˈuʃənz fɹˈʌm vˈɛɹiəs skˈɑlɚz/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Linguist Thomas Sebeok proposed creating an atomic priesthood,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /lˈɪŋɡwɪst tˈɑməs sebeok pɹəpˈoʊzd kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ˈæn ətˈɑmɪk pɹˈisthʊd/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: where an exclusive political group would use its own rituals
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈɛɹ ˈæn ɪksklˈusɪv pəlˈɪtəkəl ɡɹˈup wˈʊd jˈus ˈɪts ˈoʊn ɹˈɪtʃuəlz/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: and myths to preserve information about the radioactive areas.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd mˈɪθs tˈu pɹəzˈɝv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə ɹˌeɪdioʊˈæktɪv ˈɛɹiəz/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: And philosophers François Bastide and Paolo Fabbri proposed to genetically engineer bioluminescent cats
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ənd fəlˈɑsəfɚz franois bastide ənd pˈaʊloʊ fˈæbɹi pɹəpˈoʊzd tˈu dʒənˈɛtɪkli ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹ bioluminescent kˈæts/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: that would glow in the presence of radioactivity.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈʊd ɡlˈoʊ ɪn ðə pɹˈɛzəns ˈʌv ɹˈeɪdioʊˌæktˌɪvətˌi/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: By creating songs and traditions about the danger of glowing cats,
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈaɪ kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ sˈɔŋz ənd tɹədˈɪʃənz əbˈaʊt ðə dˈeɪndʒɚ ˈʌv ɡlˈoʊɪŋ kˈæts/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: the warning could last as long as the oldest relics of civilization we have: culture.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ðə wˈɔɹnɪŋ kˈʊd lˈæst ˈæz lˈɔŋ ˈæz ðə ˈoʊldəst ɹˈɛlɪks ˈʌv sˌɪvəlɪzˈeɪʃən wˈi hˈæv kˈʌltʃɚ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: There’s no definitive solution for warning people far into the future.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /theres nˈoʊ dɪfˈɪnɪtɪv səlˈuʃən fˈɔɹ wˈɔɹnɪŋ pˈipəl fˈɑɹ ˈɪntu ðə fjˈutʃɚ/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: But designing clear, inclusive symbols will continue to be a fundamental part
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /bˈʌt dɪzˈaɪnɪŋ klˈɪɹ ˌɪnklˈusɪv sˈɪmbəlz wˈɪl kəntˈɪnju tˈu bˈi ə fˌʌndəmˈɛntəl pˈɑɹt/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: of how we keep people safe.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈʌv hˈaʊ wˈi kˈip pˈipəl sˈeɪf/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: We will change, and so will the ways we communicate visually.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /wˈi wˈɪl tʃˈeɪndʒ ənd sˈoʊ wˈɪl ðə wˈeɪz wˈi kəmjˈunəkˌeɪt vˈɪʒwəli/

c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.text: Our warning symbols will have to change along with us.
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.ipa: /ˈaʊɚ wˈɔɹnɪŋ sˈɪmbəlz wˈɪl hˈæv tˈu tʃˈeɪndʒ əlˈɔŋ wˈɪð ˈʌs/
c86694a5-9f2a-48b5-afb5-00df8e11bbe9.vietnamese_text: Các biểu tượng cảnh báo của chúng ta sẽ phải thay đổi cùng với chúng ta.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Good evening. Thank you.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɡˈʊd ˈivnɪŋ θˈæŋk jˈu/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Chào buổi tối. Cảm ơn bạn.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: One year ago, I introduced my father when he declared his candidacy.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈʌn jˈɪɹ əɡˈoʊ ˈaɪ ˌɪntɹədˈust mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ wˈɛn hˈi dɪklˈɛɹd hˈɪz kˈændɪdəsi/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Một năm trước, tôi đã giới thiệu cha tôi khi ông tuyên bố tranh cử.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: In his own way, and through his own sheer force of will,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɪn hˈɪz ˈoʊn wˈeɪ ənd θɹˈu hˈɪz ˈoʊn ʃˈɪɹ fˈɔɹs ˈʌv wˈɪl/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Theo cách riêng của mình, và bằng ý chí sắt đá của riêng mình,

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: he sacrificed greatly to enter the political arena as an outsider.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi sˈækɹəfˌaɪst ɡɹˈeɪtli tˈu ˈɛntɚ ðə pəlˈɪtəkəl ɚˈinə ˈæz ˈæn aʊtsˈaɪdɚ/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Ông đã hy sinh rất nhiều để bước vào chính trường với tư cách là người ngoài cuộc.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And he prevailed against a field of 16 very talented competitors.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd hˈi pɹɪvˈeɪld əɡˈɛnst ə fˈild ˈʌv 16 vˈɛɹi tˈæləntɪd kəmpˈɛtətɚz/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Và anh ấy đã chiến thắng trước 16 đối thủ rất tài năng.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: For more than a year, Donald Trump has been the people’s champion,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /fˈɔɹ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ə jˈɪɹ dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp hˈæz bˈɪn ðə pˈipəlz tʃˈæmpiən/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Trong hơn một năm, Donald Trump đã là nhà vô địch của nhân dân,

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and tonight he’s the people’s nominee.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd tənˈaɪt hes ðə pˈipəlz nˌɑmənˈi/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: và đêm nay ông ấy là ứng cử viên của nhân dân.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Like many of my fellow millenials, I do not consider myself categorically Republican or Democrat.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /lˈaɪk mˈɛni ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈɛloʊ millenials ˈaɪ dˈu nˈɑt kənsˈɪdɚ mˌaɪsˈɛlf kˌætəɡˈɑɹɪkli ɹɪpˈʌblɪkən ˈɔɹ dˈɛməkɹˌæt/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Giống như nhiều người thuộc thế hệ thiên niên kỷ của tôi, tôi không coi mình là người theo Đảng Cộng hòa hay Đảng Dân chủ một cách rõ ràng.

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: More than party affiliation, I vote on based
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈɔɹ ðˈæn pˈɑɹti əfˌɪliˈeɪʃən ˈaɪ vˈoʊt ˈɑn bˈeɪst/
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.vietnamese_text: Hơn cả đảng phái, tôi bỏ phiếu dựa trên

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: on what I believe is right, for my family and for my country.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈʌt ˈaɪ bɪlˈiv ˈɪz ɹˈaɪt fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ fˈæməli ənd fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ kˈʌntɹi/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Sometimes it’s a tough choice.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪts ə tˈʌf tʃˈɔɪs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: That is not the case this time.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz nˈɑt ðə kˈeɪs ðˈɪs tˈaɪm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: As the proud daughter of your nominee, I am here
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæz ðə pɹˈaʊd dˈɔtɚ ˈʌv jˈɔɹ nˌɑmənˈi ˈaɪ ˈæm hˈiɹ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: to tell you that this is the moment
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /tˈu tˈɛl jˈu ðˈæt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə mˈoʊmənt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and Donald Trump is the person to make America great again.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp ˈɪz ðə pˈɝsən tˈu mˈeɪk əmˈɛɹəkə ɡɹˈeɪt əɡˈɛn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Real change, the kind we have not seen in decades is only going to come
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɹˈil tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə kˈaɪnd wˈi hˈæv nˈɑt sˈin ɪn dɛkˈeɪdz ˈɪz ˈoʊnli ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kˈʌm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: from outside the system.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ˈaʊtsˈaɪd ðə sˈɪstəm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And it’s only going to come from a man who’s spent his entire life doing
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts ˈoʊnli ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kˈʌm fɹˈʌm ə mˈæn whos spˈɛnt hˈɪz ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈaɪf dˈuɪŋ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: what others said could not be done.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈʌt ˈʌðɚz sˈɛd kˈʊd nˈɑt bˈi dˈʌn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father is a fighter.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ ˈɪz ə fˈaɪtɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: When the primaries got tough and they were tough, he did what any great leader does.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɛn ðə pɹˈaɪmˌɛɹiz ɡˈɑt tˈʌf ənd ðˈeɪ wˈɝ tˈʌf hˈi dˈɪd wˈʌt ˈɛni ɡɹˈeɪt lˈidɚ dˈʌz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He dug deeper, worked harder, got better and became stronger.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi dˈʌɡ dˈipɚ wˈɝkt hˈɑɹdɚ ɡˈɑt bˈɛtɚ ənd bɪkˈeɪm stɹˈɔŋɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I have seen him fight for his family.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz fˈæməli/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I have seen him fight for his employees.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz ɛmplˈɔɪiz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I have seen him fight for his company.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz kˈʌmpənˌi/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And now, I am seeing him fight for our country.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ ˈaɪ ˈæm sˈiɪŋ hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ kˈʌntɹi/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: It’s been the story of his life and more recently the spirit of his campaign.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn ðə stˈɔɹi ˈʌv hˈɪz lˈaɪf ənd mˈɔɹ ɹˈisəntli ðə spˈɪɹət ˈʌv hˈɪz kæmpˈeɪn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: It’s also a prelude to reaching the goal that unites us all.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ ə pɹˈeɪlˌud tˈu ɹˈitʃɪŋ ðə ɡˈoʊl ðˈæt junˈaɪts ˈʌs ˈɔl/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: When this party and better still this country knows what it is like to win again.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɛn ðˈɪs pˈɑɹti ənd bˈɛtɚ stˈɪl ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi nˈoʊz wˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɪz lˈaɪk tˈu wˈɪn əɡˈɛn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: If it’s possible to be famous and yet not really well done,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɪts pˈɑsəbəl tˈu bˈi fˈeɪməs ənd jˈɛt nˈɑt ɹˈɪli wˈɛl dˈʌn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: that describes the father who raised me.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈæt dɪskɹˈaɪbz ðə fˈɑðɚ hˈu ɹˈeɪzd mˈi/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: In the same office in Trump Tower, where we now work together,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɪn ðə sˈeɪm ˈɔfɪs ɪn tɹˈʌmp tˈaʊɚ wˈɛɹ wˈi nˈaʊ wˈɝk təɡˈɛðɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I remember playing on the floor by my father’s desk,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹɪmˈɛmbɚ plˈeɪɪŋ ˈɑn ðə flˈɔɹ bˈaɪ mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz dˈɛsk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: constructing miniature buildings with Legos and Erector sets,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /kənstɹˈʌktɪŋ mˈɪniətʃˌʊɹ bˈɪldɪŋz wˈɪð legos ənd ɪɹˈɛktɚ sˈɛts/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: while he did the same with concrete steel and glass.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈaɪl hˈi dˈɪd ðə sˈeɪm wˈɪð kənkɹˈit stˈil ənd ɡlˈæs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father taught my siblings and me the importance of positive values
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ tˈɔt mˈaɪ sˈɪblɪŋz ənd mˈi ðə ˌɪmpˈɔɹtəns ˈʌv pˈɑzətɪv vˈæljuz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and a strong ethical compass.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ə stɹˈɔŋ ˈɛθɪkəl kˈʌmpəs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He showed us how to be resilient, how to deal with challenges
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi ʃˈoʊd ˈʌs hˈaʊ tˈu bˈi ɹɪzˈɪljənt hˈaʊ tˈu dˈil wˈɪð tʃˈæləndʒɪz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and how to strive for excellence in all that we do.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd hˈaʊ tˈu stɹˈaɪv fˈɔɹ ˈɛksələns ɪn ˈɔl ðˈæt wˈi dˈu/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He taught us that there’s nothing that we cannot accomplish,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi tˈɔt ˈʌs ðˈæt theres nˈʌθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈi kˈænɑt əkˈɑmplɪʃ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: if we marry vision and passion with an enduring work ethic.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪf wˈi mˈɛɹi vˈɪʒən ənd pˈæʃən wˈɪð ˈæn ɛndjˈʊɹɪŋ wˈɝk ˈɛθɪk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: One of my father’s greatest talents is the ability to see potential in people,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz ɡɹˈeɪtəst tˈælənts ˈɪz ðə əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈi pətˈɛnʃəl ɪn pˈipəl/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: before they see it in themselves.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ðˈeɪ sˈi ˈɪt ɪn ðɛmsˈɛlvz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: It was like that for us to growing up.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz lˈaɪk ðˈæt fˈɔɹ ˈʌs tˈu ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He taught us that potential vanishes into nothing without effort.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi tˈɔt ˈʌs ðˈæt pətˈɛnʃəl vˈænɪʃɪz ˈɪntu nˈʌθɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛfɚt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And like him, we each had a responsibility to work,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd lˈaɪk hˈɪm wˈi ˈitʃ hˈæd ə ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti tˈu wˈɝk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: not just for ourselves but for the betterment of the world around us.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /nˈɑt dʒˈʌst fˈɔɹ aʊɚsˈɛlvz bˈʌt fˈɔɹ ðə bˈɛtɚmənt ˈʌv ðə wˈɝld ɚˈaʊnd ˈʌs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Over the years, on too many occasions to count,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈoʊvɚ ðə jˈɪɹz ˈɑn tˈu mˈɛni əkˈeɪʒənz tˈu kˈaʊnt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I saw my father tear stories out of the newspaper about people whom he had never
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ sˈɔ mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ tˈɛɹ stˈɔɹiz ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə nˈuzpˌeɪpɚ əbˈaʊt pˈipəl hˈum hˈi hˈæd nˈɛvɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: met, who were facing some injustice or hardship.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈɛt hˈu wˈɝ fˈeɪsɪŋ sˈʌm ˌɪndʒˈʌstɪs ˈɔɹ hˈɑɹdʃɪp/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He’d write a note to his assistant, in a signature black felt tip pen,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hed ɹˈaɪt ə nˈoʊt tˈu hˈɪz əsˈɪstənt ɪn ə sˈɪɡnətʃɚ blˈæk fˈɛlt tˈɪp pˈɛn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and request that the person be found and invited to Trump Tower to meet with him.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ɹɪkwˈɛst ðˈæt ðə pˈɝsən bˈi fˈaʊnd ənd ˌɪnvˈaɪtəd tˈu tɹˈʌmp tˈaʊɚ tˈu mˈit wˈɪð hˈɪm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He would talk to them
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi wˈʊd tˈɔk tˈu ðˈɛm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and then draw upon his extensive network to find them a job
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dɹˈɔ əpˈɑn hˈɪz ɪkstˈɛnsɪv nˈɛtwˌɝk tˈu fˈaɪnd ðˈɛm ə dʒˈɑb/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: or get them a break.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ɡˈɛt ðˈɛm ə bɹˈeɪk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And they would leave his office, as people so often do
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ wˈʊd lˈiv hˈɪz ˈɔfɪs ˈæz pˈipəl sˈoʊ ˈɔfən dˈu/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: after having been with Donald Trump, feeling that life could be great again.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæftɚ hˈævɪŋ bˈɪn wˈɪð dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp fˈilɪŋ ðˈæt lˈaɪf kˈʊd bˈi ɡɹˈeɪt əɡˈɛn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Throughout my entire life, I have witnessed his empathy and generosity towards other,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /θɹuˈaʊt mˈaɪ ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈaɪf ˈaɪ hˈæv wˈɪtnəst hˈɪz ˈɛmpəθi ənd dʒˌɛnɚˈɑsəti təwˈɔɹdz ˈʌðɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: especially those who are suffering.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /əspˈɛʃli ðˈoʊz hˈu ˈɑɹ sˈʌfɚɪŋ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: It is just his way of being in your corner when you’re down.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz dʒˈʌst hˈɪz wˈeɪ ˈʌv bˈiɪŋ ɪn jˈɔɹ kˈɔɹnɚ wˈɛn youre dˈaʊn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father not only has the strength and ability necessary to be our next President,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ nˈɑt ˈoʊnli hˈæz ðə stɹˈɛŋkθ ənd əbˈɪlətˌi nˈɛsəsˌɛɹi tˈu bˈi ˈaʊɚ nˈɛkst pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: but also the kindness and compassion that will enable him to be the leader
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ðə kˈaɪndnəs ənd kəmpˈæʃən ðˈæt wˈɪl ɛnˈeɪbəl hˈɪm tˈu bˈi ðə lˈidɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: that this country needs.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi nˈidz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father has a sense of fairness that touches every conviction he’s hold.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz ə sˈɛns ˈʌv fˈɛɹnəs ðˈæt tˈʌtʃəz ˈɛvɚi kənvˈɪkʃən hes hˈoʊld/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I worked along side of him for now more than a decade now at the Trump
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɝkt əlˈɔŋ sˈaɪd ˈʌv hˈɪm fˈɔɹ nˈaʊ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ə dɛkˈeɪd nˈaʊ ˈæt ðə tɹˈʌmp/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Organization and I’ve seen how he operates as a leader.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˌɔɹɡənəzˈeɪʃən ənd ive sˈin hˈaʊ hˈi ˈɑpɚˌeɪts ˈæz ə lˈidɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Making important decisions that shape careers and that change lives.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈeɪkɪŋ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt dɪsˈɪʒənz ðˈæt ʃˈeɪp kɚˈɪɹz ənd ðˈæt tʃˈeɪndʒ lˈɪvz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: I’ve learned a lot about the world from walking construction jobs by his side.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ive lˈɝnd ə lˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈɝld fɹˈʌm wˈɔkɪŋ kənstɹˈʌkʃən dʒˈɑbz bˈaɪ hˈɪz sˈaɪd/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: When run properly, construction sites are true meritocracies.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɛn ɹˈʌn pɹˈɑpɚli kənstɹˈʌkʃən sˈaɪts ˈɑɹ tɹˈu meritocracies/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Competence in the building trades is easy to spot and incompetence is impossible to hide.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /kˈɑmpətɪns ɪn ðə bˈɪldɪŋ tɹˈeɪdz ˈɪz ˈizi tˈu spˈɑt ənd ˌɪnkˈɑmpətəns ˈɪz ˌɪmpˈɑsəbəl tˈu hˈaɪd/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: These sites are also incredible melting pots, gathering people from all walks of life
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈiz sˈaɪts ˈɑɹ ˈɔlsoʊ ˌɪnkɹˈɛdəbəl mˈɛltɪŋ pˈɑts ɡˈæðɚɪŋ pˈipəl fɹˈʌm ˈɔl wˈɔks ˈʌv lˈaɪf/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and uniting them to work towards a single mission.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd junˈaɪtɪŋ ðˈɛm tˈu wˈɝk təwˈɔɹdz ə sˈɪŋɡəl mˈɪʃən/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: There have always been men of all background and ethnicities on my father’s job sites.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ hˈæv ˈɔlwˌeɪz bˈɪn mˈɛn ˈʌv ˈɔl bˈækɡɹˌaʊnd ənd ethnicities ˈɑn mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz dʒˈɑb sˈaɪts/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And long before it was common place, you also saw women.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd lˈɔŋ bɪfˈɔɹ ˈɪt wˈɑz kˈɑmən plˈeɪs jˈu ˈɔlsoʊ sˈɔ wˈɪmən/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father values talent.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ vˈæljuz tˈælənt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He recognizes real knowledge and skill when he finds it.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzəz ɹˈil nˈɑlədʒ ənd skˈɪl wˈɛn hˈi fˈaɪndz ˈɪt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He is color blind and gender neutral.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi ˈɪz kˈʌlɚ blˈaɪnd ənd dʒˈɛndɚ nˈutɹəl/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: He hires the best person for the job, period.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈi hˈaɪɚz ðə bˈɛst pˈɝsən fˈɔɹ ðə dʒˈɑb pˈɪɹiəd/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Words and promises, no matter visionary they sound will only get you so far.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɝdz ənd pɹˈɑməsəz nˈoʊ mˈætɚ vˈɪʒənˌɛɹi ðˈeɪ sˈaʊnd wˈɪl ˈoʊnli ɡˈɛt jˈu sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: In our business, you’re not a builder,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɪn ˈaʊɚ bˈɪznəs youre nˈɑt ə bˈɪldɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: unless you’ve got a building to show for it, or in my father’s case, city skylines.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənlˈɛs youve ɡˈɑt ə bˈɪldɪŋ tˈu ʃˈoʊ fˈɔɹ ˈɪt ˈɔɹ ɪn mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz kˈeɪs sˈɪti skˈaɪlˌaɪnz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Most people strive their entire lives to achieve great success in a single industry.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈoʊst pˈipəl stɹˈaɪv ðˈɛɹ ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈɪvz tˈu ətʃˈiv ɡɹˈeɪt səksˈɛs ɪn ə sˈɪŋɡəl ˈɪndəstɹi/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father has succeeded in many on the highest level and on a global scale.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz səksˈidɪd ɪn mˈɛni ˈɑn ðə hˈaɪəst lˈɛvəl ənd ˈɑn ə ɡlˈoʊbəl skˈeɪl/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: One of the reasons he has thrived as an entrepreneur is because he listens to everyone.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ɹˈizənz hˈi hˈæz θɹˈaɪvd ˈæz ˈæn ˌɑntɹəpɹənˈɝ ˈɪz bɪkˈɔz hˈi lˈɪsənz tˈu ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Billionaire executives don’t usually ask the people doing the work for their opinion of the work.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /bˌɪljənˈɛɹ ɪɡzˈɛkjətɪvz dont jˈuʒəwəli ˈæsk ðə pˈipəl dˈuɪŋ ðə wˈɝk fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ əpˈɪnjən ˈʌv ðə wˈɝk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: My father is an exception.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ ˈɪz ˈæn ɪksˈɛpʃən/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: TRUMP: On every one of his projects, you’ll see him talking to the super,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /tɹˈʌmp ˈɑn ˈɛvɚi wˈʌn ˈʌv hˈɪz pɹˈɑdʒɛkts youll sˈi hˈɪm tˈɔkɪŋ tˈu ðə sˈupɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: the painter, the engineers, the electricians, he’ll ask them for their feedback,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðə pˈeɪntɚ ðə ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹz ðə ɪlɛktɹˈɪʃənz hˈɛl ˈæsk ðˈɛm fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈidbˌæk/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: if they think something should be done differently, or could be done better.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈeɪ θˈɪŋk sˈʌmθɪŋ ʃˈʊd bˈi dˈʌn dˈɪfɹəntli ˈɔɹ kˈʊd bˈi dˈʌn bˈɛtɚ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: When Donald Trump is in charge, all that counts is ability, effort and excellence.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɛn dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp ˈɪz ɪn tʃˈɑɹdʒ ˈɔl ðˈæt kˈaʊnts ˈɪz əbˈɪlətˌi ˈɛfɚt ənd ˈɛksələns/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: This has long been the philosophy at the Trump Organization.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz lˈɔŋ bˈɪn ðə fəlˈɑsəfi ˈæt ðə tɹˈʌmp ˌɔɹɡənəzˈeɪʃən/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: At my father’s company, there are more female than male executives.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz kˈʌmpənˌi ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ fˈimˌeɪl ðˈæn mˈeɪl ɪɡzˈɛkjətɪvz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Women are paid equally for the work that we do
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɪmən ˈɑɹ pˈeɪd ˈikwəli fˈɔɹ ðə wˈɝk ðˈæt wˈi dˈu/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: and when a woman becomes a mother, she is supported, not shut out.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ə wˈʊmən bɪkˈʌmz ə mˈʌðɚ ʃˈi ˈɪz səpˈɔɹtɪd nˈɑt ʃˈʌt ˈaʊt/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Women represent 46 percent of the total U.S.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɪmən ɹˌɛpɹɪzˈɛnt 46 pɚsˈɛnt ˈʌv ðə tˈoʊtəl ˈʌs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: labor force, and 40 percent of American households have female primary breadwinners.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /lˈeɪbɚ fˈɔɹs ənd 40 pɚsˈɛnt ˈʌv əmˈɛɹəkən hˈaʊshˌoʊldz hˈæv fˈimˌeɪl pɹˈaɪmˌɛɹi bɹˈɛdwˌɪnɚz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: In 2014, women made 83 cents for every dollar made by a man.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ɪn 2014 wˈɪmən mˈeɪd 83 sˈɛnts fˈɔɹ ˈɛvɚi dˈɑlɚ mˈeɪd bˈaɪ ə mˈæn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Single women without children earn 94 cents for each dollar earned by a man,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /sˈɪŋɡəl wˈɪmən wɪθˈaʊt tʃˈɪldɹən ˈɝn 94 sˈɛnts fˈɔɹ ˈitʃ dˈɑlɚ ˈɝnd bˈaɪ ə mˈæn/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: whereas married mothers made only 77 cents.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wɛɹˈæz mˈɛɹid mˈʌðɚz mˈeɪd ˈoʊnli 77 sˈɛnts/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: As researchers have noted,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæz ɹˈisɚtʃɚz hˈæv nˈoʊtəd/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: gender is no longer the factor creating the greatest wage discrepancy in this country, motherhood is.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /dʒˈɛndɚ ˈɪz nˈoʊ lˈɔŋɡɚ ðə fˈæktɚ kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ðə ɡɹˈeɪtəst wˈeɪdʒ dɪskɹˈɛpənsi ɪn ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi mˈʌðɚhˌʊd ˈɪz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: As President, my father will change the labor laws
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæz pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ wˈɪl tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə lˈeɪbɚ lˈɔz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: that were put into place at a time
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɝ pˈʊt ˈɪntu plˈeɪs ˈæt ə tˈaɪm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: when women were not a significant portion of the workforce.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /wˈɛn wˈɪmən wˈɝ nˈɑt ə səɡnˈɪfɪkənt pˈɔɹʃən ˈʌv ðə wˈɝkfˌɔɹs/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And he will focus on making quality childcare affordable and accessible for all.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd hˈi wˈɪl fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn mˈeɪkɪŋ kwˈɑləti tʃˈaɪldkˌɛɹ əfˈɔɹdəbəl ənd æksˈɛsəbəl fˈɔɹ ˈɔl/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: As a mother myself, of three young children, I know
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ˈæz ə mˈʌðɚ mˌaɪsˈɛlf ˈʌv θɹˈi jˈʌŋ tʃˈɪldɹən ˈaɪ nˈoʊ/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: how hard it is to work while raising a family.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /hˈaʊ hˈɑɹd ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈu wˈɝk wˈaɪl ɹˈeɪzɪŋ ə fˈæməli/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: And I also know that I’m far more fortunate than most.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ ˈɔlsoʊ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪm fˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ fˈɔɹtʃənət ðˈæn mˈoʊst/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: American families need relief.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /əmˈɛɹəkən fˈæməliz nˈid ɹɪlˈif/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Policies that allow women with children to thrive should not be novelties,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /pˈɑləsiz ðˈæt əlˈaʊ wˈɪmən wˈɪð tʃˈɪldɹən tˈu θɹˈaɪv ʃˈʊd nˈɑt bˈi nˈɑvəltiz/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: they should be the norm.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ʃˈʊd bˈi ðə nˈɔɹm/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: Politicians talk about wage equality,
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz tˈɔk əbˈaʊt wˈeɪdʒ ɪkwˈɑləti/

c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.text: but my father has made it a practice at his company throughout his entire career.
c370a6bb-2c53-46f9-97d5-8facfa9c5335.ipa: /bˈʌt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz mˈeɪd ˈɪt ə pɹˈæktəs ˈæt hˈɪz kˈʌmpənˌi θɹuˈaʊt hˈɪz ɪntˈaɪɚ kɚˈɪɹ/

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: From VAA Learning English, this is the agriculture report.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /fɹˈʌm vaa lˈɝnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə ˈæɡɹɪkˌʌltʃɚ ɹipˈɔɹt/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Từ VAA Learning English, đây là bản tin nông nghiệp.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Vietnam is working to meet goals for food production and food security.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /viˌɛtnˈɑm ˈɪz wˈɝkɪŋ tˈu mˈit ɡˈoʊlz fˈɔɹ fˈud pɹədˈʌkʃən ənd fˈud sɪkjˈʊɹəti/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Việt Nam đang nỗ lực để đạt được các mục tiêu về sản xuất lương thực và an ninh lương thực.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: In doing so, the government supports use of pesticides and other chemicals on crops.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ɪn dˈuɪŋ sˈoʊ ðə ɡˈʌvɚmənt səpˈɔɹts jˈus ˈʌv pˈɛstəsˌaɪdz ənd ˈʌðɚ kˈɛmɪkəlz ˈɑn kɹˈɑps/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Bằng cách đó, chính phủ ủng hộ việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu và các hóa chất khác trên cây trồng.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Farmers use these substances to help crops grow and protect them from insects and other threats.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /fˈɑɹmɚz jˈus ðˈiz sˈʌbstənsəz tˈu hˈɛlp kɹˈɑps ɡɹˈoʊ ənd pɹətˈɛkt ðˈɛm fɹˈʌm ˈɪnsˌɛkts ənd ˈʌðɚ θɹˈɛts/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Nông dân sử dụng các chất này để giúp cây trồng phát triển và bảo vệ chúng khỏi côn trùng và các mối đe dọa khác.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Signs along roads in Vietnam say, Do not abuse pesticides,
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /sˈaɪnz əlˈɔŋ ɹˈoʊdz ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm sˈeɪ dˈu nˈɑt əbjˈus pˈɛstəsˌaɪdz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Biển báo dọc đường ở Việt Nam ghi: Không lạm dụng thuốc trừ sâu.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: think of the buyer But the government has few rules restricting the use of pesticides.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /θˈɪŋk ˈʌv ðə bˈaɪɚ bˈʌt ðə ɡˈʌvɚmənt hˈæz fjˈu ɹˈulz ɹistɹˈɪktɪŋ ðə jˈus ˈʌv pˈɛstəsˌaɪdz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Hãy nghĩ đến người mua Nhưng chính phủ có ít quy định hạn chế việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Some Vietnamese are so worried about the issue
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /sˈʌm viˌɛtnɑmˈis ˈɑɹ sˈoʊ wˈɝid əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɪʃu/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Một số người Việt Nam rất lo lắng về vấn đề này

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: that they buy food only from growers they know.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈeɪ bˈaɪ fˈud ˈoʊnli fɹˈʌm ɡɹˈoʊɚz ðˈeɪ nˈoʊ/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: rằng họ chỉ mua thực phẩm từ những người trồng trọt mà họ biết.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: There is a website that can help food shoppers it list stores in Hanoi
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə wˈɛbsˌaɪt ðˈæt kˈæn hˈɛlp fˈud ʃˈɑpɚz ˈɪt lˈɪst stˈɔɹz ɪn hˈænɔɪ/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Có một trang web có thể giúp người mua sắm thực phẩm, trang web này liệt kê các cửa hàng ở Hà Nội.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: that sell safe vegetables.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðˈæt sˈɛl sˈeɪf vˈɛdʒtəbəlz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: bán rau an toàn.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: The Vietnamese buyers group Vastas set up the website in 2011.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðə viˌɛtnɑmˈis bˈaɪɚz ɡɹˈup vastas sˈɛt ˈʌp ðə wˈɛbsˌaɪt ɪn 2011/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Nhóm người mua Việt Nam Vastas đã thiết lập trang web vào năm 2011.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Dongen is part of the team that runs the site.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /dˈɔŋɡən ˈɪz pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðə tˈim ðˈæt ɹˈʌnz ðə sˈaɪt/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Dongen là một phần của đội ngũ vận hành trang web.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: She says stores have to meet requirements to be included on the website for example,
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛz stˈɔɹz hˈæv tˈu mˈit ɹɪkwˈaɪɹmənts tˈu bˈi ˌɪnklˈudəd ˈɑn ðə wˈɛbsˌaɪt fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Cô ấy nói các cửa hàng phải đáp ứng các yêu cầu để được đưa lên trang web, ví dụ,

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: they must prove they get their vegetables from farmers who do not use chemicals.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðˈeɪ mˈʌst pɹˈuv ðˈeɪ ɡˈɛt ðˈɛɹ vˈɛdʒtəbəlz fɹˈʌm fˈɑɹmɚz hˈu dˈu nˈɑt jˈus kˈɛmɪkəlz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: họ phải chứng minh họ lấy rau từ những người nông dân không sử dụng hóa chất.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Miss Dong says a store will be removed from the list
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /mˈɪs dˈɔŋ sˈɛz ə stˈɔɹ wˈɪl bˈi ɹimˈuvd fɹˈʌm ðə lˈɪst/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Cô Đông nói một cửa hàng sẽ bị xóa khỏi danh sách

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: if it does not obey the rules.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɪt dˈʌz nˈɑt oʊbˈeɪ ðə ɹˈulz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: nếu nó không tuân theo các quy tắc.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Eduardo Sao is with VICO, a Belgian non-government agricultural group.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ɛdwˈɑɹdoʊ sˈaʊ ˈɪz wˈɪð vico ə bˈɛldʒən nɑnɡˈʌvɚnmənt ˌæɡɹəkˈʌltʃɚəl ɡɹˈup/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Eduardo Sao thuộc VICO, một nhóm nông nghiệp phi chính phủ của Bỉ.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: It supports the local website. Mr.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ˈɪt səpˈɔɹts ðə lˈoʊkəl wˈɛbsˌaɪt mˈɪstɚ/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Nó hỗ trợ trang web địa phương. Ông.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Sabio says pesticide misuse in Vietnam is a real problem.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /sabio sˈɛz pˈɛstəsˌaɪd mɪsjˈuz ɪn viˌɛtnˈɑm ˈɪz ə ɹˈil pɹˈɑbləm/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Sabio cho biết việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu sai cách ở Việt Nam là một vấn đề thực sự.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: He says there is a process to confirm
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /hˈi sˈɛz ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə pɹˈɑsˌɛs tˈu kənfˈɝm/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Anh ấy nói có một quy trình để xác nhận

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: that products are free of man-made chemicals, but he says it is too costly for farmers.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðˈæt pɹˈɑdəkts ˈɑɹ fɹˈi ˈʌv mˈænmˈeɪd kˈɛmɪkəlz bˈʌt hˈi sˈɛz ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈu kˈɑstli fˈɔɹ fˈɑɹmɚz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: những sản phẩm đó không chứa hóa chất nhân tạo, nhưng ông nói rằng điều đó quá tốn kém đối với nông dân.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Mr. Savio says the safe food website uses what is known
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /mˈɪstɚ sˈɑvioʊ sˈɛz ðə sˈeɪf fˈud wˈɛbsˌaɪt jˈusəz wˈʌt ˈɪz nˈoʊn/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Ông Savio nói rằng trang web thực phẩm an toàn sử dụng những gì được biết

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: as the participatory guidance system it supervises food safety through quality reports from farmers,
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ˈæz ðə pˌɑɹtˈɪsəpətˌɔɹi ɡˈaɪdəns sˈɪstəm ˈɪt sˈupɚvˌaɪzɪz fˈud sˈeɪfti θɹˈu kwˈɑləti ɹɪpˈɔɹts fɹˈʌm fˈɑɹmɚz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: với tư cách là hệ thống hướng dẫn có sự tham gia, nó giám sát an toàn thực phẩm thông qua các báo cáo chất lượng từ nông dân,

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: groups, traders, and local officials.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ɡɹˈups tɹˈeɪdɚz ənd lˈoʊkəl əfˈɪʃəlz/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: các nhóm, thương nhân và quan chức địa phương.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: The system is used in more than 20 countries around the world, and Mr.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /ðə sˈɪstəm ˈɪz jˈuzd ɪn mˈɔɹ ðˈæn 20 kˈʌntɹiz ɚˈaʊnd ðə wˈɝld ənd mˈɪstɚ/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Hệ thống được sử dụng ở hơn 20 quốc gia trên thế giới, và ông

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: Sabio says Vietnamese farmers keep detailed notes about their pesticide use.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /sabio sˈɛz viˌɛtnɑmˈis fˈɑɹmɚz kˈip dɪtˈeɪld nˈoʊts əbˈaʊt ðˈɛɹ pˈɛstəsˌaɪd jˈus/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Sabio cho biết nông dân Việt Nam ghi chép chi tiết về việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu của họ.

e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.text: For VAA Learning English, I'm Carla Bab.
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.ipa: /fˈɔɹ vaa lˈɝnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈaɪm kˈɑɹlɑ bˈæb/
e5532771-3970-42f0-8e39-841924afa5d5.vietnamese_text: Đối với VAA Learning English, tôi là Carla Bab.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Unit five, trees in the forest.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Bài năm, cây cối trong rừng.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: There are many forests in North America.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɛni fˈɔɹəsts ɪn nˈɔɹθ əmˈɛɹəkə/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Có nhiều rừng ở Bắc Mỹ.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: There are many trees in these forests.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɛni tɹˈiz ɪn ðˈiz fˈɔɹəsts/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Có rất nhiều cây trong những khu rừng này.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Some of these trees are more than 200 ft tall.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /sˈʌm ˈʌv ðˈiz tɹˈiz ˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn 200 ft tˈɔl/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Một số cây này cao hơn 200 ft.
Một số có tuổi đời hơn 500 năm.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Several kinds of trees grow in these forests.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /sˈɛvɹəl kˈaɪndz ˈʌv tɹˈiz ɡɹˈoʊ ɪn ðˈiz fˈɔɹəsts/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Nhiều loại cây mọc trong những khu rừng này.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Fur, cedar, and pine are three.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Lông, tuyết tùng và thông là ba.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: These trees grow in different areas.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Những cây này mọc ở những khu vực khác nhau.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: People who lived in this place long ago used these trees to make
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /pˈipəl hˈu lˈɪvd ɪn ðˈɪs plˈeɪs lˈɔŋ əɡˈoʊ jˈuzd ðˈiz tɹˈiz tˈu mˈeɪk/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Người dân sống ở nơi này từ lâu đã dùng những cây này để làm

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Many of these trees are now in special areas.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /mˈɛni ˈʌv ðˈiz tɹˈiz ˈɑɹ nˈaʊ ɪn spˈɛʃəl ˈɛɹiəz/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Nhiều cây trong số này hiện đang ở trong các khu vực đặc biệt.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: These areas are called forest reserves or national parks.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /ðˈiz ˈɛɹiəz ˈɑɹ kˈɔld fˈɔɹəst ɹɪzˈɝvz ˈɔɹ nˈæʃənəl pˈɑɹks/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Những khu vực này được gọi là khu bảo tồn rừng hoặc vườn quốc gia.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Some parks charge a small entrance fee.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /sˈʌm pˈɑɹks tʃˈɑɹdʒ ə smˈɔl ˈɛntɹəns fˈi/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Một số công viên thu phí vào cửa nhỏ.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Visitors must pay the fee to enter the parks.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /vˈɪzɪtɚz mˈʌst pˈeɪ ðə fˈi tˈu ˈɛntɚ ðə pˈɑɹks/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Du khách phải trả phí để vào công viên.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: Then they can walk among the beautiful old trees.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðˈeɪ kˈæn wˈɔk əmˈʌŋ ðə bjˈutəfəl ˈoʊld tɹˈiz/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Sau đó, họ có thể đi dạo giữa những cây cổ thụ xinh đẹp.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: They must take care not to damage the trees.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /ðˈeɪ mˈʌst tˈeɪk kˈɛɹ nˈɑt tˈu dˈæmədʒ ðə tɹˈiz/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Họ phải cẩn thận để không làm hỏng cây.

4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.text: We should all take care of forests.
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.ipa: /wˈi ʃˈʊd ˈɔl tˈeɪk kˈɛɹ ˈʌv fˈɔɹəsts/
4a45ab43-418f-4f18-8e84-944fb4994eed.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta nên chăm sóc rừng.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Cambridge, could you imagine a more idyllic university town?
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ kˈʊd jˈu ˌɪmˈædʒən ə mˈɔɹ aɪdˈɪlɪk jˌunəvˈɝsəti tˈaʊn/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Cambridge, bạn có thể tưởng tượng một thị trấn đại học nào đẹp hơn thế này không?

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: With its narrow medieval passageways and 801-year-old university this small English city it packed with history.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /wˈɪð ˈɪts nˈɛɹoʊ mɪdˈivəl passageways ənd 801yearold jˌunəvˈɝsəti ðˈɪs smˈɔl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ sˈɪti ˈɪt pˈækt wˈɪð hˈɪstɚi/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Với những con đường nhỏ hẹp thời trung cổ và trường đại học 801 năm tuổi, thành phố nhỏ bé này của Anh chứa đầy lịch sử.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: But Cambridge is embracing the new, its restaurant scene has moving on from pub grub
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈʌt kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ ˈɪz ɛmbɹˈeɪsɪŋ ðə nˈu ˈɪts ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnt sˈin hˈæz mˈuvɪŋ ˈɑn fɹˈʌm pˈʌb ɡɹˈʌb/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Nhưng Cambridge đang đón nhận những điều mới mẻ, cảnh quan nhà hàng của nó đã vượt ra khỏi những món ăn quán rượu thông thường.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: And has something exciting, yet still traditional, to offer.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd hˈæz sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ jˈɛt stˈɪl tɹədˈɪʃənəl tˈu ˈɔfɚ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Và có điều gì đó thú vị, nhưng vẫn truyền thống, để cung cấp.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Welcome to Cambridge.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /wˈɛlkəm tˈu kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Chào mừng đến Cambridge.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Cambridge is less than an hour from London by train.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ ˈɪz lˈɛs ðˈæn ˈæn ˈaʊɚ fɹˈʌm lˈʌndən bˈaɪ tɹˈeɪn/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Cambridge cách London chưa đầy một giờ đi tàu.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: And once you’ve arrived, you’re going to want to do
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd wˈʌns youve ɚˈaɪvd youre ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu wˈɑnt tˈu dˈu/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Và một khi bạn đã đến nơi, bạn sẽ muốn làm

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: what the locals do and get yourself a bike.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /wˈʌt ðə lˈoʊkəlz dˈu ənd ɡˈɛt jɚsˈɛlf ə bˈaɪk/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: những gì người dân địa phương làm và thuê cho mình một chiếc xe đạp.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Cambridge is considered the cycling capital of the UK they're everywhere.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ ˈɪz kənsˈɪdɚd ðə sˈaɪkəlɪŋ kˈæpətəl ˈʌv ðə jˌukˈeɪ ðˈɛɹ ˈɛvɹiwˌɛɹ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Cambridge được coi là thủ đô xe đạp của Vương quốc Anh, chúng có mặt ở khắp mọi nơi.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Bike hire shops are peppered around and parking is easy but be warned.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈaɪk hˈaɪɚ ʃˈɑps ˈɑɹ pˈɛpɚd ɚˈaʊnd ənd pˈɑɹkɪŋ ˈɪz ˈizi bˈʌt bˈi wˈɔɹnd/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Các cửa hàng cho thuê xe đạp có ở khắp nơi và việc đỗ xe rất dễ dàng nhưng hãy cẩn thận.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: In 2017 the Cambridge district had one of the highest rates of bike theft in England
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ɪn 2017 ðə kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ dˈɪstɹɪkt hˈæd wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə hˈaɪəst ɹˈeɪts ˈʌv bˈaɪk θˈɛft ɪn ˈɪŋɡlənd/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Vào năm 2017, quận Cambridge có tỷ lệ trộm cắp xe đạp cao nhất ở Anh.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and Wales so lock it up.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd wˈeɪlz sˈoʊ lˈɑk ˈɪt ˈʌp/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và xứ Wales nên khóa nó lại.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: In the centre of Cambridge is one of the world’s most well known and respected Universities.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ɪn ðə sˈɛntɚ ˈʌv kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz mˈoʊst wˈɛl nˈoʊn ənd ɹɪspˈɛktɪd jˌunəvˈɝsətiz/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Ở trung tâm của Cambridge là một trong những trường Đại học nổi tiếng và được kính trọng nhất thế giới.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Founded in 1208, it's the fourth oldest university in the world still teaching.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /fˈaʊndɪd ɪn 1208 ˈɪts ðə fˈɔɹθ ˈoʊldəst jˌunəvˈɝsəti ɪn ðə wˈɝld stˈɪl tˈitʃɪŋ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Được thành lập vào năm 1208, đây là trường đại học lâu đời thứ tư trên thế giới vẫn còn giảng dạy.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: One of the jewels in the university’s crown is its libraries
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə dʒˈuəlz ɪn ðə universitys kɹˈaʊn ˈɪz ˈɪts lˈaɪbɹɛɹˌiz/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Một trong những viên ngọc quý của trường đại học là các thư viện của trường

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and this is the big one.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə bˈɪɡ wˈʌn/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và đây là cái lớn nhất.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Cambridge University Library holds around 8 million books, manuscripts, maps
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /kˈeɪmbɹɪdʒ jˌunəvˈɝsəti lˈaɪbɹɛɹˌi hˈoʊldz ɚˈaʊnd 8 mˈɪljən bˈʊks mˈænjəskɹˌɪpts mˈæps/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Thư viện Đại học Cambridge lưu giữ khoảng 8 triệu đầu sách, bản thảo, bản đồ

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and journals and it was thought some more salacious material.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd dʒˈɝnəlz ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz θˈɔt sˈʌm mˈɔɹ səlˈeɪʃəs mətˈɪɹiəl/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và các tạp chí và người ta cho rằng có một số tài liệu giật gân hơn.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: For a long time it was undergraduate folklore
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ə lˈɔŋ tˈaɪm ˈɪt wˈɑz ˌʌndɚɡɹˈædʒəwət fˈoʊklˌɔɹ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Trong một thời gian dài, đó là truyền thuyết của sinh viên đại học

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: that the library tower held a vast stockpile of Victorian age pornography.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə lˈaɪbɹɛɹˌi tˈaʊɚ hˈɛld ə vˈæst stˈɑkpˌaɪl ˈʌv vɪktˈɔɹiən ˈeɪdʒ pɔɹnˈɑɡɹəfi/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: tháp thư viện chứa một kho chứa lớn sách khiêu dâm thời Victoria.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: But no… This year the tower’s opened up its secrets
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈʌt nˈoʊ ðˈɪs jˈɪɹ ðə tˈaʊɚz ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp ˈɪts sˈikɹəts/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Nhưng không… Năm nay tòa tháp đã mở ra những bí mật của nó

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and revealed its was used to store books
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd ɹɪvˈild ˈɪts wˈɑz jˈuzd tˈu stˈɔɹ bˈʊks/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và tiết lộ nó được dùng để cất giữ sách

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and other items thought not good enough for the main building.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd ˈʌðɚ ˈaɪtəmz θˈɔt nˈɑt ɡˈʊd ɪnˈʌf fˈɔɹ ðə mˈeɪn bˈɪldɪŋ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và các vật phẩm khác được cho là không đủ tốt cho tòa nhà chính.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: This material is now regarded
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈɪs mətˈɪɹiəl ˈɪz nˈaʊ ɹɪɡˈɑɹdɪd/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Tài liệu này hiện được coi là

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: as an important resource One of the best ways to see Cambridge’s hidden spots
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ˈæz ˈæn ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt ɹˈisɔɹs wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst wˈeɪz tˈu sˈi cambridges hˈɪdən spˈɑts/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: là một nguồn tài nguyên quan trọng Một trong những cách tốt nhất để khám phá những địa điểm ẩn mình của Cambridge

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: is by boat, or punt, to be exact.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ˈɪz bˈaɪ bˈoʊt ˈɔɹ pˈʌnt tˈu bˈi ɪɡzˈækt/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: bằng thuyền, hoặc xuồng, chính xác hơn.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Punting began in the early 20th century
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /punting bɪɡˈæn ɪn ðə ˈɝli 20th sˈɛntʃɚi/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Đá bóng bắt đầu vào đầu thế kỷ 20

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: And remains the best way to explore the River Cam
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd ɹɪmˈeɪnz ðə bˈɛst wˈeɪ tˈu ɪksplˈɔɹ ðə ɹˈɪvɚ kˈæm/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Và vẫn là cách tốt nhất để khám phá Sông Cam

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: and it’s many bridges 25 in all.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ənd ˈɪts mˈɛni bɹˈɪdʒəz 25 ɪn ˈɔl/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: và những cây cầu của nó, 25 cây tất cả.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: This is the Mathematical Bridge.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə mˌæθəmˈætɪkəl bɹˈɪdʒ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Đây là Cầu Toán học.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Despite looking curved it’s made entirely of straight timber.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /dɪspˈaɪt lˈʊkɪŋ kˈɝvd ˈɪts mˈeɪd ɪntˈaɪɚli ˈʌv stɹˈeɪt tˈɪmbɚ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Mặc dù trông cong nhưng nó được làm hoàn toàn bằng gỗ thẳng.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Safely on dry land it’s time of a pint.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /sˈeɪfli ˈɑn dɹˈaɪ lˈænd ˈɪts tˈaɪm ˈʌv ə pˈaɪnt/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: An toàn trên đất liền, đã đến lúc uống một ly bia.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: This is The Eagle It was there 1953 Francis Crick charged
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə ˈiɡəl ˈɪt wˈɑz ðˈɛɹ 1953 fɹˈænsəs kɹˈɪk tʃˈɑɹdʒd/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Đây là The Eagle. Nó ở đó năm 1953. Francis Crick đã tính phí.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: in, interrupting lunchtime service, to announce
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ɪn ˌɪntɚˈʌptɪŋ lˈʌntʃtˌaɪm sˈɝvəs tˈu ənˈaʊns/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: trong giờ ăn trưa, để thông báo

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: that he and James Watson had "discovered the secret of life".
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈæt hˈi ənd dʒˈeɪmz wˈɑtsən hˈæd dɪskˈʌvɚd ðə sˈikɹət ˈʌv lˈaɪf/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: rằng ông và James Watson đã "khám phá ra bí mật của sự sống".

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: How DNA carries genetic information.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈiˌɛnˈeɪ kˈæɹiz dʒənˈɛtɪk ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: DNA mang thông tin di truyền như thế nào.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: I hope someone offered him a drink.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈoʊp sˈʌmwˌʌn ˈɔfɚd hˈɪm ə dɹˈɪŋk/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Tôi hy vọng ai đó đã mời anh ấy một ly đồ uống.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Keeping with tradition, just a few meters down the road is Chop House.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /kˈipɪŋ wˈɪð tɹədˈɪʃən dʒˈʌst ə fjˈu mˈitɚz dˈaʊn ðə ɹˈoʊd ˈɪz tʃˈɑp hˈaʊs/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Theo truyền thống, cách đó vài mét là Chop House.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: This no-nonsense steak restaurant has a classic English menu.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈɪs nononsense stˈeɪk ɹˈɛstɚˌɑnt hˈæz ə klˈæsɪk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ mˈɛnju/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Nhà hàng bít tết không cầu kỳ này có thực đơn cổ điển kiểu Anh.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Try the Sticky Toffee Pudding if you have room.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ ðə stˈɪki tˈɑfi pˈʊdɪŋ ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ɹˈum/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Hãy thử món Pudding Toffee Dính nếu bạn còn chỗ.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: But it not all old England, this is Pint Shop,
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt nˈɑt ˈɔl ˈoʊld ˈɪŋɡlənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz pˈaɪnt ʃˈɑp/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Nhưng đây không phải là nước Anh cổ kính, đây là Pint Shop,

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: offering 23-tap craft beer and 100 gin options.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ˈɔfɚɪŋ 23tap kɹˈæft bˈɪɹ ənd 100 dʒˈɪn ˈɑpʃənz/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: cung cấp 23 loại bia thủ công và 100 loại rượu gin.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: There are plenty of places to stay in the city
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ plˈɛnti ˈʌv plˈeɪsəz tˈu stˈeɪ ɪn ðə sˈɪti/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: Có rất nhiều nơi để ở trong thành phố

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: but if you want to get some country air,
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu ɡˈɛt sˈʌm kˈʌntɹi ˈɛɹ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: nhưng nếu bạn muốn hít thở không khí đồng quê,

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: just a short drive out of town is Clopton Courtyard Here you can rent your own
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /dʒˈʌst ə ʃˈɔɹt dɹˈaɪv ˈaʊt ˈʌv tˈaʊn ˈɪz klˈɑptən kˈɔɹtjˌɑɹd hˈiɹ jˈu kˈæn ɹˈɛnt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: chỉ một quãng lái xe ngắn ra khỏi thị trấn là Clopton Courtyard. Tại đây bạn có thể thuê của riêng mình

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: barn, there are six to choose from and enjoy the quintessentially English countryside surrounding.
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /bˈɑɹn ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ sˈɪks tˈu tʃˈuz fɹˈʌm ənd ˌɛndʒˈɔɪ ðə kwˌɪntəsˈɛnʃəli ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ kˈʌntɹisˌaɪd sɚˈaʊndɪŋ/
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.vietnamese_text: nhà kho, có sáu lựa chọn và tận hưởng vùng nông thôn nước Anh đặc trưng xung quanh.

980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.text: Not a bad spot to finish off your day…
980f251c-d5da-480c-af48-b8ebec8d1fbe.ipa: /nˈɑt ə bˈæd spˈɑt tˈu fˈɪnɪʃ ˈɔf jˈɔɹ dˈeɪ/
