5imI0ivA86Q.vietnamese_text: cũng như Thị trấn của Mitchell.

5imI0ivA86Q.text: If you're after a more classical feel,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/
5imI0ivA86Q.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn có cảm giác cổ điển hơn,

5imI0ivA86Q.text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/
5imI0ivA86Q.vietnamese_text: The Caroline Singers có xu hướng tập trung vào các bản madrigal, đó là hát không có nhạc đệm, không có nhạc cụ nào.

5imI0ivA86Q.text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: or make friends that's on offer.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You could win a gold medal, too.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody competition in Atlanta,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: And if all of that isn't enough,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Before you hear the rest of the program,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ jˈu hˈiɹ ðə ɹˈɛst ˈʌv ðə pɹˈoʊɡɹˌæm/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: you have some time to look at questions 16 to 20.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu h��æv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 16 tˈu 20/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Now listen and answer questions.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You may feel unable to join a choir
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because of work or family commitments.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: This has been done in companies large and small,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: of some people's mind, it's having the opportunity to switch off
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and focus on something completely different that they're after.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: with because, naturally enough, people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: which is just common sense really.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: They started off four years ago with just five people that's now risen to 19,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈ��ɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The same is true for late afternoon.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: free of charge, to members of the choir.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end of section two.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd ˈʌv sˈɛkʃən tˈu/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You now have half a minute,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu nˈaʊ hˈæv hˈæf ə mˈɪnət/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and for our regular spot on things to do in town, here's our reporter, Samuel Cooper.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ spˈɑt ˈɑn θˈɪŋz tˈu dˈu ɪn tˈaʊn hˈɪɹz ˈaʊɚ ɹɪpˈɔɹtɚ sˈæmjul kˈupɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: It's been fun to write about joining some of our local choirs.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn fˈʌn tˈu ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ lˈoʊkəl kwˈaɪɹz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Thank you. Well, feeling a bit apprehensive.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu wˈɛl fˈilɪŋ ə bˈɪt ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: About my ability to sing in tune,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /əbˈaʊt mˈaɪ əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈɪŋ ɪn tˈun/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: I recently headed off for rehearsals at the town's three biggest choirs Mitchell's Town Choir,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli hˈɛdəd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈæt ðə tˈaʊnz θɹˈi bˈɪɡəst kwˈaɪɹz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: the Black Bell Male Voice Choir, and the Caroline Singers.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə blˈæk bˈɛl mˈeɪl vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ ənd ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: I received a very warm welcome at all three choirs.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹəsˈivd ə vˈɛɹi wˈɔɹm wˈɛlkəm ˈæt ˈɔl θɹˈi kwˈaɪɹz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: They are always on the lookout for new and enthusiastic singers.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ˈɔlwˌeɪz ˈɑn ðə lˈʊkˌaʊt fˈɔɹ nˈu ənd ɪnθˌuziˈæstɪk sˈɪŋɚz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Now, obviously, deciding which choir to join will depend to some extent
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɑbviəsli dˌɪsˈaɪdɪŋ wˈɪtʃ kwˈaɪɚ tˈu dʒˈɔɪn wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: on your taste in music.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɑn jˈɔɹ tˈeɪst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Black Bell caters for most musical taste, as it has a hugely varied repertoire,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /blˈæk bˈɛl kˈeɪtɚz fˈɔɹ mˈoʊst mjˈuzɪkəl tˈeɪst ˈæz ˈɪt hˈæz ə hjˈudʒli vˈɛɹid ɹˈɛpɚtwˌɑɹ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: as does Mitchell's Town.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈæz dˈʌz mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: If you're after a more classical feel,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈæftɚ ə mˈɔɹ klˈæsɪkəl fˈil/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: the Caroline Singers tend to focus on madreals that's unaccompanied singing without any instruments.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz tˈɛnd tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn madreals ðˈæts ˌʌnəkˈʌmpənid sˈɪŋɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛni ˈɪnstɹəmənts/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: If you want to meet people who share an interest in music,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu mˈit pˈipəl hˈu ʃˈɛɹ ˈæn ˈɪntɹəst ɪn mjˈuzɪk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town Choir is a good place to start.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd plˈeɪs tˈu stˈɑɹt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Apart from their own performances, they also arrange group visits to see operas
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /əpˈɑɹt fɹˈʌm ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pɚfˈɔɹmənsəz ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɚˈeɪndʒ ɡɹˈup vˈɪzɪts tˈu sˈi ˈɑpɹəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and attend music festivals, so it can be a great way to make friends.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ətˈɛnd mjˈuzɪk fˈɛstəvəlz sˈoʊ ˈɪt kˈæn bˈi ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: But it's not just a chance to develop a skill, travel,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ə tʃˈæns tˈu dɪvˈɛləp ə skˈɪl tɹˈævəl/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: or make friends that's on offer.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɔɹ mˈeɪk fɹˈɛndz ðˈæts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You could win a gold medal, too.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈʊd wˈɪn ə ɡˈoʊld mˈɛdəl tˈu/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town are hoping to get to the final at the Melody Competition in Atlanta,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ˈɑɹ hˈoʊpɪŋ tˈu ɡˈɛt tˈu ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈæt ðə mˈɛlədi kˌɑmpətˈɪʃən ɪn ætlˈæntə/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and Blackbell are the current holders of the Countermail Voice Choir Award,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd blackbell ˈɑɹ ðə kˈɝənt hˈoʊldɚz ˈʌv ðə countermail vˈɔɪs kwˈaɪɚ əwˈɔɹd/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: which was presented to them by the director of the London Opera just last month.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz pɹizˈɛntɪd tˈu ðˈɛm bˈaɪ ðə dɚˈɛktɚ ˈʌv ðə lˈʌndən ˈɑpɹə dʒˈʌst lˈæst mˈʌnθ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You can also be a part of a recording deal.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈi ə pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ə ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ dˈil/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town has just joined Blackbell and Caroline Singers
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn hˈæz dʒˈʌst dʒˈɔɪnd blackbell ənd kˈɛɹəlˌaɪn sˈɪŋɚz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: as recording artists for their first CD due in shops in December.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈæz ɹəkˈɔɹdɪŋ ˈɑɹtɪsts fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈɝst sˌidˈi dˈu ɪn ʃˈɑps ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: And if all of that isn't enough,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈæt ˈɪzənt ɪnˈʌf/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: you can also benefit the local community by helping to raise funds for good causes.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn ˈɔlsoʊ bˈɛnəfɪt ðə lˈoʊkəl kəmjˈunəti bˈaɪ hˈɛlpɪŋ tˈu ɹˈeɪz fˈʌndz fˈɔɹ ɡˈʊd kˈɑzəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Mitchell's Town regularly performs its functions, helping the disabled and the elderly,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɪtʃəlz tˈaʊn ɹˈɛɡjəlɚli pɚfˈɔɹmz ˈɪts fˈʌŋkʃənz hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ðə ˈɛldɚli/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: while Blackbell donates a percentage of its profits to certain local charities.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈaɪl blackbell dˈoʊnˌeɪts ə pɚsˈɛntədʒ ˈʌv ˈɪts pɹˈɑfɪts tˈu sˈɝtən lˈoʊkəl tʃˈɛɹətiz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: You may feel unable to join a choir
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /jˈu mˈeɪ fˈil ənˈeɪbəl tˈu dʒˈɔɪn ə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because you're worried you'd struggle to find the time to attend rehearsals
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈʊɹ wˈɝid jˈud stɹˈʌɡəl tˈu fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ətˈɛnd ɹɪhˈɝsəlz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because of work or family commitments.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv wˈɝk ˈɔɹ fˈæməli kəmˈɪtmənts/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Well, there is a solution to that start your own choir at work.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɛl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə səlˈuʃən tˈu ðˈæt stˈɑɹt jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn kwˈaɪɚ ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: This has been done in companies large and small.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz bˈɪn dˈʌn ɪn kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈɑɹdʒ ənd smˈɔl/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: And I went to find out about the one at the accountant's John White.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɛnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈʌn ˈæt ðə əkˈaʊntənts dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The choir's organizer, Elizabeth Arnold, told me the reason she thinks people like the choir.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə choir's ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɚ ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld tˈoʊld mˈi ðə ɹˈizən ʃˈi θˈɪŋks pˈipəl lˈaɪk ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: She said that while the thought of a big networking opportunities might be at the back
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ʃˈi sˈɛd ðˈæt wˈaɪl ðə θˈɔt ˈʌv ə bˈɪɡ nˈɛtwˌɝkɪŋ ˌɑpɚtˈunətiz mˈaɪt bˈi ˈæt ðə bˈæk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: of some people's mind...
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈʌv sˈʌm pˈipəlz mˈaɪnd/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: It's having the opportunity to switch off and focus on something completely different that they're after.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈɪts hˈævɪŋ ðə ˌɑpɚtˈunəti tˈu swˈɪtʃ ˈɔf ənd fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn sˈʌmθɪŋ kəmplˈitli dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈæftɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The people that join tend to be fairly competent singers to start
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə pˈipəl ðˈæt dʒˈɔɪn tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɛɹli kˈɑmpətɪnt sˈɪŋɚz tˈu stˈɑɹt/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: with, because naturally enough people don't want to look bad in front of their colleagues.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪð bɪkˈɔz nˈætʃɚəli ɪnˈʌf pˈipəl dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk bˈæd ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv ðˈɛɹ kˈɑliɡz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Companies like John White encourage their employees to set up choirs at work,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /kˈʌmpənˌiz lˈaɪk dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒ ðˈɛɹ ɛmplˈɔɪiz tˈu sˈɛt ˈʌp kwˈaɪɹz ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because it can help to create a healthier working atmosphere.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn hˈɛlp tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ə hˈɛlθiɚ wˈɝkɪŋ ˈætməsfˌɪɹ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: For example, people who previously didn't get on can find they have something in common,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl pˈipəl hˈu pɹˈiviəsli dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɑn kˈæn fˈaɪnd ðˈeɪ hˈæv sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪn kˈɑmən/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: which is just common sense, really.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kˈɑmən sˈɛns ɹˈɪli/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Elizabeth Arnold also stresses
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ɪlˈɪzəbəθ ˈɑɹnəld ˈɔlsoʊ stɹˈɛsəz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: that you don't need a lot of people to get the choir off the ground.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɡˈɛt ðə kwˈaɪɚ ˈɔf ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: They started off four years ago with just five people.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈeɪ stˈɑɹtɪd ˈɔf fˈɔɹ jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɪð dʒˈʌst fˈaɪv pˈipəl/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: That's now risen to 19, while their average attendance at rehearsals is 12.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈæts nˈaʊ ɹˈɪzən tˈu 19 wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈævɚɪdʒ ətˈɛndəns ˈæt ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈɪz 12/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Many people don't have time to go to rehearsals outside work however,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /mˈɛni pˈipəl dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ɹɪhˈɝsəlz ˈaʊtsˈaɪd wˈɝk hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: they find the time to go to them while they're at work.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðˈeɪ fˈaɪnd ðə tˈaɪm tˈu ɡˈoʊ tˈu ðˈɛm wˈaɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈæt wˈɝk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: At John White, they found the middle of the day works best
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ðˈeɪ fˈaʊnd ðə mˈɪdəl ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ wˈɝks bˈɛst/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: because not everyone works the same hours, so scheduling early morning rehearsals can be problematic.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn wˈɝks ðə sˈeɪm ˈaʊɚz sˈoʊ skˈɛdʒʊlɪŋ ˈɝli mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹɪhˈɝsəlz kˈæn bˈi pɹˌɑbləmˈætɪk/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: The same is true for late afternoon.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪz tɹˈu fˈɔɹ lˈeɪt ˌæftɚnˈun/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Supporting their choir is something that John White are very happy to do.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /səpˈɔɹtɪŋ ðˈɛɹ kwˈaɪɚ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt dʒˈɑn wˈaɪt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈæpi tˈu dˈu/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: Although members pay a joining fee to cover the cost of refreshments at parties
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ˌɔlðˈoʊ mˈɛmbɚz pˈeɪ ə dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ fˈi tˈu kˈʌvɚ ðə kˈɑst ˈʌv ɹəfɹˈɛʃmənts ˈæt pˈɑɹtiz/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: and wear special concert shirts, the company organizes regular sessions with a professional vocal coach,
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /ənd wˈɛɹ spˈɛʃəl kˈɑnsɚt ʃˈɝts ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪzɪz ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ sˈɛʃənz wˈɪð ə pɹəfˈɛʃənəl vˈoʊkəl kˈoʊtʃ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: free of charge to members of the choir.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ tˈu mˈɛmbɚz ˈʌv ðə kwˈaɪɚ/

5imI0ivA86Q.text: So, if you'd like more information about the choirs, that is the end.
5imI0ivA86Q.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈud lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈaɪɹz ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə ˈɛnd/

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: Section two. You will hear a holiday company representative talking to a group
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /sˈɛkʃən tˈu jˈu wˈɪl hˈiɹ ə hˈɑlədˌeɪ kˈʌmpənˌi ɹˌɛpɹəzˈɛntətɪv tˈɔkɪŋ tˈu ə ɡɹˈup/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Phần hai. Bạn sẽ nghe một đại diện công ty du lịch nói chuyện với một nhóm

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: of tourists in a large
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈʌv tˈʊɹəsts ɪn ə lˈɑɹdʒ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: của khách du lịch trong một lớn

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: hotel about things they can do during their holiday.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /hoʊtˈɛl əbˈaʊt θˈɪŋz ðˈeɪ kˈæn dˈu dˈʊɹɪŋ ðˈɛɹ hˈɑlədˌeɪ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: khách sạn về những điều họ có thể làm trong kỳ nghỉ của mình.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 16.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /fˈɝst jˈu hˈæv sˈʌm tˈaɪm tˈu lˈʊk ˈæt kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 16/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Đầu tiên, bạn có một chút thời gian để xem các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 16.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 16. Hello everyone.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /nˈaʊ lˈɪsən kˈɛɹfəli ənd ˈænsɚ kwˈɛstʃənz 11 tˈu 16 həlˈoʊ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Bây giờ hãy nghe cẩn thận và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 11 đến 16. Xin chào mọi người.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: I'm Jake Stevens and I'm your rep here at the hotel.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈaɪm dʒˈeɪk stˈivənz ənd ˈaɪm jˈɔɹ ɹˈɛp hˈiɹ ˈæt ðə hoʊtˈɛl/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Tôi là Jake Stevens và tôi là đại diện của quý khách tại khách sạn.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: I'm sure you'll all have a great time here.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈaɪm ʃˈʊɹ jˈul ˈɔl hˈæv ə ɡɹˈeɪt tˈaɪm hˈiɹ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Tôi chắc chắn rằng tất cả các bạn sẽ có một khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời ở đây.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: So, let me tell you a bit about what's on offer.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /sˈoʊ lˈɛt mˈi tˈɛl jˈu ə bˈɪt əbˈaʊt wˈʌts ˈɑn ˈɔfɚ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Vậy, để tôi nói cho bạn biết một chút về những gì được cung cấp.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: I'll start by telling you about some of the excursions that are available for guests.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈaɪl stˈɑɹt bˈaɪ tˈɛlɪŋ jˈu əbˈaʊt sˈʌm ˈʌv ðə ɪkskˈɝʒənz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ əvˈeɪləbəl fˈɔɹ ɡˈɛsts/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ bắt đầu bằng cách nói về một số chuyến tham quan có sẵn cho du khách.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: One thing you have to do while you're here is go dolphin watching.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /wˈʌn θˈɪŋ jˈu hˈæv tˈu dˈu wˈaɪl jˈʊɹ hˈiɹ ˈɪz ɡˈoʊ dˈɑlfən wˈɑtʃɪŋ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Một điều bạn phải làm khi ở đây là đi ngắm cá heo.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: On our boat trips, we pretty well guarantee you'll see dolphins.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈɑn ˈaʊɚ bˈoʊt tɹˈɪps wˈi pɹˈɪti wˈɛl ɡˌɛɹəntˈi jˈul sˈi dˈɑlfənz/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Trong các chuyến đi thuyền của chúng tôi, chúng tôi khá chắc chắn bạn sẽ thấy cá heo.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: If you don't, you can repeat the trip free of charge.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu dˈoʊnt jˈu kˈæn ɹɪpˈit ðə tɹˈɪp fɹˈi ˈʌv tʃˈɑɹdʒ/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn không làm vậy, bạn có thể đi lại miễn phí.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: We organize daily trips for just 35 euros.
x0BAGGICvdQ.ipa: /wˈi ˈɔɹɡənˌaɪz dˈeɪli tɹˈɪps fˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst 35 jˈuɹˌoʊz/
x0BAGGICvdQ.vietnamese_text: Chúng tôi tổ chức các chuyến đi hàng ngày chỉ với 35 euro.

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: Unfortunately, there aren't any places left for this afternoon's trip,

x0BAGGICvdQ.text: And the best thing about this trip is that it's completely free.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: The news for Europe just keeps getting worse.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: France's political upheaval in December offered another glimpse at fractious European affairs.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fɹˈænsɪz pəlˈɪtəkəl əphˈivəl ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ ˈɔfɚd ənˈʌðɚ ɡlˈɪmps ˈæt fɹˈækʃəs jˌʊɹəpˈiən əfˈɛɹz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Germany is under pressure, and Volkswagen workers are are striking hard.

LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Mario Draghi sẽ trình bày báo cáo được mong đợi từ lâu của ông vào sáng nay

LOO41jlHRb8.text: on what Europe must do to regain its competitiveness.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈʌt jˈʊɹəp mˈʌst dˈu tˈu ɹɪɡˈeɪn ˈɪts kəmpˈɛtɪtɪvnɪs/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Châu Âu phải làm gì để lấy lại khả năng cạnh tranh.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Mario Dragi is a highly respected economist,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /mˈɑɹioʊ dragi ˈɪz ə hˈaɪli ɹɪspˈɛktɪd ɪkˈɑnəmɪst/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Mario Draghi là một nhà kinh tế học rất được kính trọng,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: is former president of the European Central Bank,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪz fˈɔɹmɚ pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt ˈʌv ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən sˈɛntɹəl bˈæŋk/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: là cựu chủ tịch Ngân hàng Trung ương Châu Âu,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: during one of Europe's most difficult times,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /dˈʊɹɪŋ wˈʌn ˈʌv jˈʊɹəps mˈoʊst dˈɪfəkəlt tˈaɪmz/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: trong một trong những thời điểm khó khăn nhất của châu Âu,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and also led Italy uh through through another challenging period.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ˈɔlsoʊ lˈɛd ˈɪtəli ˈʌ θɹˈu θɹˈu ənˈʌðɚ tʃˈæləndʒɪŋ pˈɪɹiəd/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: và cũng đã dẫn dắt nước Ý vượt qua một giai đoạn đầy thử thách khác.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: He's become a figure that you look to in times of trouble.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /hˈiz bɪkˈʌm ə fˈɪɡjɚ ðˈæt jˈu lˈʊk tˈu ɪn tˈaɪmz ˈʌv tɹˈʌbəl/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Ông ấy đã trở thành một nhân vật mà bạn tìm đến trong những lúc khó khăn.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: His report warned that the US and China were innovating
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /hˈɪz ɹipˈɔɹt wˈɔɹnd ðˈæt ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə wˈɝ ˌɪnəvˈeɪtɪŋ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Báo cáo của ông cảnh báo rằng Mỹ và Trung Quốc đang đổi mới

LOO41jlHRb8.text: so expeditiously Europe needed to invest hundreds of billions of euros extra every year
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˌɛkspədˈɪʃəsli jˈʊɹəp nˈidəd tˈu ˌɪnvˈɛst hˈʌndɹədz ˈʌv bˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz ˈɛkstɹə ˈɛvɚi jˈɪɹ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: châu Âu cần đầu tư thêm hàng trăm tỷ euro mỗi năm một cách nhanh chóng

LOO41jlHRb8.text: to compete, possibly to survive.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /tˈu kəmpˈit pˈɑsəbli tˈu sɚvˈaɪv/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: để cạnh tranh, có thể để tồn tại.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: The druggy plan got the conversation started, and then, of course,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðə druggy plˈæn ɡˈɑt ðə kˌɑnvɚsˈeɪʃən stˈɑɹtɪd ənd ðˈɛn ˈʌv kˈɔɹs/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Kế hoạch dùng thuốc đã khơi mào cuộc trò chuyện, và sau đó, tất nhiên,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: there's Trump, and then, of course, there's China,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz tɹˈʌmp ənd ðˈɛn ˈʌv kˈɔɹs ðˈɛɹz tʃˈaɪnə/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: có Trump, và sau đó, tất nhiên, có Trung Quốc,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and then there's a war in Ukraine and a war in the Middle East.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ðˈɛɹz ə wˈɔɹ ɪn jukɹˈeɪn ənd ə wˈɔɹ ɪn ðə mˈɪdəl ˈist/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: và rồi có một cuộc chiến ở Ukraine và một cuộc chiến ở Trung Đông.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: The conclusion was Europe has been stuck in a rut,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðə kənklˈuʒən wˈɑz jˈʊɹəp hˈæz bˈɪn stˈʌk ɪn ə ɹˈʌt/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Kết luận là châu Âu đã mắc kẹt trong một lối mòn,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and if nothing changes, in the current trajectory is maintained,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf nˈʌθɪŋ tʃˈeɪndʒəz ɪn ðə kˈɝənt tɹədʒˈɛktɚi ˈɪz meɪntˈeɪnd/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: và nếu không có gì thay đổi, với quỹ đạo hiện tại được duy trì,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: then Europe will probably account for less than a tenth of global GDP by 2050,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈɛn jˈʊɹəp wˈɪl pɹˈɑbəblˌi əkˈaʊnt fˈɔɹ lˈɛs ðˈæn ə tˈɛnθ ˈʌv ɡlˈoʊbəl ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev bˈaɪ 2050/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: thì Châu Âu có lẽ sẽ chiếm chưa đến một phần mười GDP toàn cầu vào năm 2050,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: which points to Europe having a much diminished role in the global economy
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ pˈɔɪnts tˈu jˈʊɹəp hˈævɪŋ ə mˈʌtʃ dɪmˈɪnɪʃt ɹˈoʊl ɪn ðə ɡlˈoʊbəl ɪkˈɑnəmi/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: những điểm cho thấy châu Âu có vai trò giảm sút đáng kể trong nền kinh tế toàn cầu

LOO41jlHRb8.text: in years to come.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ɪn jˈɪɹz tˈu kˈʌm/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: trong những năm tới.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Increasing productivity is one of solutions to this.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˌɪnkɹˈisɪŋ pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv səlˈuʃənz tˈu ðˈɪs/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Tăng năng suất là một trong những giải pháp cho vấn đề này.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: It doesn't mean making people work harder it means,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪt dˈʌzənt mˈin mˈeɪkɪŋ pˈipəl wˈɝk hˈɑɹdɚ ˈɪt mˈinz/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Điều đó không có nghĩa là bắt mọi người làm việc chăm chỉ hơn, mà là,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: for the same amount of work, a person creates more value.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ðə sˈeɪm əmˈaʊnt ˈʌv wˈɝk ə pˈɝsən kɹiˈeɪts mˈɔɹ vˈælju/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: với cùng một lượng công việc, một người tạo ra nhiều giá trị hơn.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: To appreciate the challenge,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /tˈu əpɹˈiʃiˌeɪt ðə tʃˈæləndʒ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Để đánh giá cao thử thách,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: let's quickly examine one of Europe's most iconic traditional industries Italy's olive business,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /lˈɛts kwˈɪkli ɪɡzˈæmɪn wˈʌn ˈʌv jˈʊɹəps mˈoʊst ˌaɪkˈɑnɪk tɹədˈɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstɹiz ˈɪtəliz ˈɑləv bˈɪznəs/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: hãy nhanh chóng xem xét một trong những ngành công nghiệp truyền thống mang tính biểu tượng nhất châu Âu, ngành kinh doanh ô liu của Ý,

LOO41jlHRb8.text: is worth billions of euros.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈɝθ bˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: trị giá hàng tỷ euro.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Prime Minister Georgia Malone's government wants the industry to grow
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /pɹˈaɪm mˈɪnəstɚ dʒˈɔɹdʒə məlˈoʊnz ɡˈʌvɚmənt wˈɑnts ðə ˈɪndəstɹi tˈu ɡɹˈoʊ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Chính phủ của Thủ tướng Georgia Malone muốn ngành công nghiệp phát triển

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and help the country reduce its mammoth debt burden.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd hˈɛlp ðə kˈʌntɹi ɹədˈus ˈɪts mˈæməθ dˈɛt bˈɝdən/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: và giúp đất nước giảm gánh nặng nợ khổng lồ.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: It's why all of Millers receive tens of millions of euros in post pandemic EU
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪts wˈaɪ ˈɔl ˈʌv mˈɪlɚz ɹəsˈiv tˈɛnz ˈʌv mˈɪljənz ˈʌv jˈuɹˌoʊz ɪn pˈoʊst pændˈɛmɪk ˈijˌu/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Đó là lý do tại sao tất cả các nhà máy của Miller nhận được hàng chục triệu euro từ EU sau đại dịch

LOO41jlHRb8.text: aid granted to Italy.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈeɪd ɡɹˈæntəd tˈu ˈɪtəli/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: viện trợ được cấp cho Ý.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Some farms spent their share upgrading their machinery.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈʌm fˈɑɹmz spˈɛnt ðˈɛɹ ʃˈɛɹ əpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ðˈɛɹ məʃˈinɚi/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Một số trang trại đã dùng phần chia của mình để nâng cấp máy móc.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Productivity is one of the best ways to grow an economy
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst wˈeɪz tˈu ɡɹˈoʊ ˈæn ɪkˈɑnəmi/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Năng suất là một trong những cách tốt nhất để phát triển nền kinh tế

LOO41jlHRb8.text: because it means, for the same amount of work, a person creates more value.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt mˈinz fˈɔɹ ðə sˈeɪm əmˈaʊnt ˈʌv wˈɝk ə pˈɝsən kɹiˈeɪts mˈɔɹ vˈælju/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: vì nó có nghĩa là, với cùng một lượng công vi���c, một người tạo ra nhiều giá trị hơn.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: And as important as olives are, cultivating them isn't as productive
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ˈæz ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt ˈæz ˈɑlɪvz ˈɑɹ kˈʌltɪvˌeɪtɪŋ ðˈɛm ˈɪzənt ˈæz pɹədˈʌktɪv/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Và quan trọng như ô liu, việc trồng chúng không mang lại hiệu quả cao bằng

LOO41jlHRb8.text: as developing semiconductors or solar panels two things the US and China prioritized years ago.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈæz dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ sˌɛmikəndˈʌktɚz ˈɔɹ sˈoʊlɚ pˈænəlz tˈu θˈɪŋz ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə pɹaɪˈɔɹətˌaɪzd jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: như phát triển chất bán dẫn hoặc tấm pin mặt trời hai thứ mà Hoa Kỳ và Trung Quốc đã ưu tiên từ nhiều năm trước.

LOO41jlHRb8.text: We haven't taken frontier technologies and dispersed them through our economy in the way
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈi hˈævənt tˈeɪkən fɹəntˈɪɹ tɛknˈɑlədʒiz ənd dɪspˈɝst ðˈɛm θɹˈu ˈaʊɚ ɪkˈɑnəmi ɪn ðə wˈeɪ/
LOO41jlHRb8.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta đã không áp dụng các công nghệ tiên phong và phổ biến chúng trong nền kinh tế của mình theo cách

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that would raise incomes and raise our efficiency,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈʊd ɹˈeɪz ˈɪnkˌʌmz ənd ɹˈeɪz ˈaʊɚ ɪfˈɪʃənsi/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: so by being left behind we are now poorer
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈoʊ bˈaɪ bˈiɪŋ lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd wˈi ˈɑɹ nˈaʊ pˈuɹɚ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and we're just not keeping pace with American productivity, which
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd wˈiɹ dʒˈʌst nˈɑt kˈipɪŋ pˈeɪs wˈɪð əmˈɛɹəkən pɹˌoʊdəktˈɪvəti wˈɪtʃ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: is what led to the estimate
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈʌt lˈɛd tˈu ðə ˈɛstəmət/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that the EU economy is 18% smaller than it may otherwise have
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈijˌu ɪkˈɑnəmi ˈɪz 18 smˈɔlɚ ðˈæn ˈɪt mˈeɪ ˈʌðɚwˌaɪz hˈæv/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: been, and that's equal to a shortfall of about3 trillion.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈɪn ənd ðˈæts ˈikwəl tˈu ə ʃˈɔɹtfˌɔl ˈʌv about3 tɹˈɪljən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: e And why one reason is the EU's jth of massive investments in transformative start prods
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈi ənd wˈaɪ wˈʌn ɹˈizən ˈɪz ðə eu's jth ˈʌv mˈæsɪv ˌɪnvˈɛstmənts ɪn tɹˌænsfˈɔɹmɑtˌɪv stˈɑɹt pɹˈɑdz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: we don't translate technologies at the cutting edge into new businesses,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈi dˈoʊnt tɹænzlˈeɪt tɛknˈɑlədʒiz ˈæt ðə kˈʌtɪŋ ˈɛdʒ ˈɪntu nˈu bˈɪznəsəz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and we don't have hugely successful technology companies in anything like the way
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd wˈi dˈoʊnt hˈæv hjˈudʒli səksˈɛsfəl tɛknˈɑlədʒi kˈʌmpənˌiz ɪn ˈɛniθˌɪŋ lˈaɪk ðə wˈeɪ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that the US does, or even China to some extent.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈʌs dˈʌz ˈɔɹ ˈivɪn tʃˈaɪnə tˈu sˈʌm ɪkstˈɛnt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: One reason is we we don't have great vent Capital markets here.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈʌn ɹˈizən ˈɪz wˈi wˈi dˈoʊnt hˈæv ɡɹˈeɪt vˈɛnt kˈæpətəl mˈɑɹkəts hˈiɹ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Most of the world's really big companies have been funded via this actually quite tiny asset
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /mˈoʊst ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz ɹˈɪli bˈɪɡ kˈʌmpənˌiz hˈæv bˈɪn fˈʌndəd vˈaɪə ðˈɪs ˈæktʃˌuəli kwˈaɪt tˈaɪni ˈæsˌɛt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: class in Europe that sort of didn't happen.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /klˈæs ɪn jˈʊɹəp ðˈæt sˈɔɹt ˈʌv dˈɪdənt hˈæpən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Part of it also is regulation.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈɪz ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Europe really believes in regulation that's not a bad thing,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /jˈʊɹəp ɹˈɪli bɪlˈivz ɪn ɹˌɛɡjəlˈeɪʃən ðˈæts nˈɑt ə bˈæd θˈɪŋ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: as I'm always told when I'm, you know, in Brussels,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈæz ˈaɪm ˈɔlwˌeɪz tˈoʊld wˈɛn ˈaɪm jˈu nˈoʊ ɪn bɹˈʌsəlz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: is what we're doing is a blueprint for everyone else.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪz wˈʌt wˈiɹ dˈuɪŋ ˈɪz ə blˈupɹˌɪnt fˈɔɹ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: But if you put it all together, you have a situation where you're not encouraging growth.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪf jˈu pˈʊt ˈɪt ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu hˈæv ə sˌɪtʃuˈeɪʃən wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ɛnkˈɝɪdʒɪŋ ɡɹˈoʊθ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: We are behind everywhere else in the world.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈi ˈɑɹ bɪhˈaɪnd ˈɛvɹiwˌɛɹ ˈɛls ɪn ðə wˈɝld/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: When people talk about billions, they sound like large numbers,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈɛn pˈipəl tˈɔk əbˈaʊt bˈɪljənz ðˈeɪ sˈaʊnd lˈaɪk lˈɑɹdʒ nˈʌmbɚz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: but now we're talking about trillions in terms of the valuation of tech companies.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈʌt nˈaʊ wˈiɹ tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt tɹˈɪljənz ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ðə væljuˈeɪʃən ˈʌv tˈɛk kˈʌmpənˌiz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Just take the biggest US ones over the last couple of years.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /dʒˈʌst tˈeɪk ðə bˈɪɡəst ˈʌs wˈʌnz ˈoʊvɚ ðə lˈæst kˈʌpəl ˈʌv jˈɪɹz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: If their combined value was a country,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ kəmbˈaɪnd vˈælju wˈɑz ə kˈʌntɹi/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: it would have the third biggest GDP in the world after the US and China.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈʊd hˈæv ðə θˈɝd bˈɪɡəst ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev ɪn ðə wˈɝld ˈæftɚ ðə ˈʌs ənd tʃˈaɪnə/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: I think people are waking up to the fact
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk pˈipəl ˈɑɹ wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp tˈu ðə fˈækt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that Europe really is in trouble
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈʊɹəp ɹˈɪli ˈɪz ɪn tɹˈʌbəl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: because not only does it not have the the tech platforms,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz nˈɑt ˈoʊnli dˈʌz ˈɪt nˈɑt hˈæv ðə ðə tˈɛk plˈætfˌɔɹmz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: but the digital era is eating into everything,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə dˈɪdʒətəl ˈɛɹə ˈɪz ˈitɪŋ ˈɪntu ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: as we're seeing what's happening in Germany with the car industry.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈæz wˈiɹ sˈiɪŋ wˈʌts hˈæpənɪŋ ɪn dʒˈɝməni wˈɪð ðə kˈɑɹ ˈɪndəstɹi/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: For example, that electric cars are fundamentally digital era products,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪɡzˈæmpəl ðˈæt ɪlˈɛktɹɪk kˈɑɹz ˈɑɹ fˌʌndəmˈɛntəli dˈɪdʒətəl ˈɛɹə pɹˈɑdəkts/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Volkswagen is at the the center of this difficult transition.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /vˈoʊlkswˌæɡən ˈɪz ˈæt ðə ðə sˈɛntɚ ˈʌv ðˈɪs dˈɪfəkəlt tɹænzˈɪʃən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: It's still Europe's biggest car maker and one of the EU's industrial engines,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪts stˈɪl jˈʊɹəps bˈɪɡəst kˈɑɹ mˈeɪkɚ ənd wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə eu's ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl ˈɛndʒənz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: but it didn't prepare for an electric vehicle revolution
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt dˈɪdənt pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ ˈæn ɪlˈɛktɹɪk vˈihɪkəl ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: or that it would be led by an American startup called Tesla
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðˈæt ˈɪt wˈʊd bˈi lˈɛd bˈaɪ ˈæn əmˈɛɹəkən stˈɑɹtˌʌp kˈɔld tˈɛslə/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and later rivaled by China.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd lˈeɪtɚ ɹˈaɪvəld bˈaɪ tʃˈaɪnə/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: VW became emblematic of Germany's struggle.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /vw bɪkˈeɪm ˌɛmbləmˈætɪk ˈʌv dʒˈɝməniz stɹˈʌɡəl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: What VW is trying to do is close up to three factories we're talking about tens
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈʌt vw ˈɪz tɹˈaɪɪŋ tˈu dˈu ˈɪz klˈoʊs ˈʌp tˈu θɹˈi fˈæktɚiz wˈiɹ tˈɔkɪŋ əbˈaʊt tˈɛnz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: of thousands, potentially, of job cuts.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈʌv θˈaʊzəndz pətˈɛnʃəli ˈʌv dʒˈɑb kˈʌts/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Meanwhile, Germany's neighbor is politically and financially deadlocked.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /mˈinwˌaɪl dʒˈɝməniz nˈeɪbɚ ˈɪz pəlˈɪtɪkəli ənd fənˈænʃəli dˈɛdlˌɑkt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: France has a number of problems high debt is one of them.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fɹˈæns hˈæz ə nˈʌmbɚ ˈʌv pɹˈɑbləmz hˈaɪ dˈɛt ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðˈɛm/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: The deficit is very wide, so that's the gap between
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðə dˈɛfəsət ˈɪz vˈɛɹi wˈaɪd sˈoʊ ðˈæts ðə ɡˈæp bɪtwˈin/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: what the government spends and what it brings in in tax revenue.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈʌt ðə ɡˈʌvɚmənt spˈɛndz ənd wˈʌt ˈɪt bɹˈɪŋz ɪn ɪn tˈæks ɹˈɛvənˌu/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: That's huge and it's proving very difficult to tackle.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæts hjˈudʒ ənd ˈɪts pɹˈuvɪŋ vˈɛɹi dˈɪfəkəlt tˈu tˈækəl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: It's also over what the EU even allows, which is this 3% of GDP.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ ˈoʊvɚ wˈʌt ðə ˈijˌu ˈivɪn əlˈaʊz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðˈɪs 3 ˈʌv ɡˈidˈipˈi#abbrev/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: France was well past that this year and is forecast to be for some time,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fɹˈæns wˈɑz wˈɛl pˈæst ðˈæt ðˈɪs jˈɪɹ ənd ˈɪz fˈɔɹkˌæst tˈu bˈi fˈɔɹ sˈʌm tˈaɪm/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and it makes investors more apprehensive about buying French debt.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ˈɪt mˈeɪks ˌɪnvˈɛstɚz mˈɔɹ ˌæpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv əbˈaʊt bˈaɪɪŋ fɹˈɛntʃ dˈɛt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: That's what this line shows the higher the line,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæts wˈʌt ðˈɪs lˈaɪn ʃˈoʊz ðə hˈaɪɚ ðə lˈaɪn/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: the riskier France is judged to be relative to the traditionally very safe Germany.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɪskiɚ fɹˈæns ˈɪz dʒˈʌdʒd tˈu bˈi ɹˈɛlətɪv tˈu ðə tɹədˈɪʃənəli vˈɛɹi sˈeɪf dʒˈɝməni/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and In December, that risk was the highest it had
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ɪn dɪsˈɛmbɚ ðˈæt ɹˈɪsk wˈɑz ðə hˈaɪəst ˈɪt hˈæd/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: been since 2012, when Europe was in the midst of a debt crisis,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈɪn sˈɪns 2012 wˈɛn jˈʊɹəp wˈɑz ɪn ðə mˈɪdst ˈʌv ə dˈɛt kɹˈaɪsəs/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: which is just compounding the fiscal difficulties that that it faces.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz dʒˈʌst kəmpˈaʊndɪŋ ðə fˈɪskəl dˈɪfəkəltiz ðˈæt ðˈæt ˈɪt fˈeɪsəz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: So until there is a political resolution, it's hard to see the French economy turning around.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈoʊ əntˈɪl ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə pəlˈɪtəkəl ɹˌɛzəlˈuʃən ˈɪts hˈɑɹd tˈu sˈi ðə fɹˈɛntʃ ɪkˈɑnəmi tˈɝnɪŋ ɚˈaʊnd/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: People are waking up the fact that that France is facing a potential debt crisis,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /pˈipəl ˈɑɹ wˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʌp ðə fˈækt ðˈæt ðˈæt fɹˈæns ˈɪz fˈeɪsɪŋ ə pətˈɛnʃəl dˈɛt kɹˈaɪsəs/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and Germany, on the other hand, is facing a potential employment crisis
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd dʒˈɝməni ˈɑn ðə ˈʌðɚ hˈænd ˈɪz fˈeɪsɪŋ ə pətˈɛnʃəl ɛmplˈɔɪmənt kɹˈaɪsəs/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: where it won't have the same number of workers producing the types of thing
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈɛɹ ˈɪt wˈoʊnt hˈæv ðə sˈeɪm nˈʌmbɚ ˈʌv wˈɝkɚz pɹədˈusɪŋ ðə tˈaɪps ˈʌv θˈɪŋ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that Germany has made itself famous for, and that impacts the whole of the European Union.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt dʒˈɝməni hˈæz mˈeɪd ˌɪtsˈɛlf fˈeɪməs fˈɔɹ ənd ðˈæt ˌɪmpˈækts ðə hˈoʊl ˈʌv ðə jˌʊɹəpˈiən jˈunjən/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: I really don't think Europe can do anything without France and Germany.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli dˈoʊnt θˈɪŋk jˈʊɹəp kˈæn dˈu ˈɛniθˌɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt fɹˈæns ənd dʒˈɝməni/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Reeing and doing well, you need those two economies to push everyone else,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /reeing ənd dˈuɪŋ wˈɛl jˈu nˈid ðˈoʊz tˈu ɪkˈɑnəmiz tˈu pˈʊʃ ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and everyone else trades with them, so we have no options.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn ˈɛls tɹˈeɪdz wˈɪð ðˈɛm sˈoʊ wˈi hˈæv nˈoʊ ˈɑpʃənz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: We need them to do well.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈi nˈid ðˈɛm tˈu dˈu wˈɛl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Put together, this is the state of Europe
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə stˈeɪt ˈʌv jˈʊɹəp/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: that Mario Drogy rang the alarm about the block is too reliant on traditional industry,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈæt mˈɑɹioʊ drogy ɹˈæŋ ðə əlˈɑɹm əbˈaʊt ðə blˈɑk ˈɪz tˈu ɹɪlˈaɪənt ˈɑn tɹədˈɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstɹi/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: too unproductive, too uncoordinated, and too averse to risk.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /tˈu ˌʌnpɹədˈʌktɪv tˈu ənkoʊˈɔɹdəneɪtɪd ənd tˈu əvˈɝs tˈu ɹˈɪsk/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: This fractured political landscape,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈɪs fɹˈæktʃɚd pəlˈɪtəkəl lˈændskˌeɪp/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: in which countries look to protect their own interests over
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ɪn wˈɪtʃ kˈʌntɹiz lˈʊk tˈu pɹətˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn ˈɪntɹəsts ˈoʊvɚ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: those of the Union, makes change difficult.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈoʊz ˈʌv ðə jˈunjən mˈeɪks tʃˈeɪndʒ dˈɪfəkəlt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: So what's next?
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌts nˈɛkst/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Where do we look for warning signs or silver linings?
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /wˈɛɹ dˈu wˈi lˈʊk fˈɔɹ wˈɔɹnɪŋ sˈaɪnz ˈɔɹ sˈɪlvɚ lˈaɪnɪŋz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: The euro against the dollar is a good diagnostic
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðə jˈuɹoʊ əɡˈɛnst ðə dˈɑlɚ ˈɪz ə ɡˈʊd dˌaɪəɡnˈɑstɪk/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: for where Europe is being left behind it's trended downward
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /fˈɔɹ wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹəp ˈɪz bˈiɪŋ lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd ˈɪts tɹˈɛndɪd dˈaʊnwɚd/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: and traded at equal value only a handful of times,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ənd tɹˈeɪdɪd ˈæt ˈikwəl vˈælju ˈoʊnli ə hˈændfˌʊl ˈʌv tˈaɪmz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: but to command geopolitical weight you need a big economy in dollar terms.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /bˈʌt tˈu kəmˈænd dʒˌioʊpəlˈɪtɪkəl wˈeɪt jˈu nˈid ə bˈɪɡ ɪkˈɑnəmi ɪn dˈɑlɚ tˈɝmz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: So crossing that parody threshold is a worrisome indicator for economists and politicians.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /sˈoʊ kɹˈɔsɪŋ ðˈæt pˈɛɹədi θɹˈɛʃˌoʊld ˈɪz ə wˈɝisəm ˈɪndəkˌeɪtɚ fˈɔɹ ɪkˈɑnəmɪsts ənd pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: A fall to par could embolden populist politicians who oppose the currency,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ə fˈɔl tˈu pˈɑɹ kˈʊd ɛmbˈoʊldən pˈɑpjələst pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz hˈu əpˈoʊz ðə kˈɝənsi/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: raising the remote but real threat of another Brexit-like event.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ɹˈeɪzɪŋ ðə ɹɪmˈoʊt bˈʌt ɹˈil θɹˈɛt ˈʌv ənˈʌðɚ brexitlike ɪvˈɛnt/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Germany's right-wing AfD party said it's planning an election campaign advocating
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /dʒˈɝməniz ɹˈaɪtwˌɪŋ afd pˈɑɹti sˈɛd ˈɪts plˈænɪŋ ˈæn ɪlˈɛkʃən kæmpˈeɪn ˈædvəkˌeɪtɪŋ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: this, but experts, including Drogy, have stressed that change, however difficult, is possible.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈɪs bˈʌt ˈɛkspɚts ˌɪnklˈudɪŋ drogy hˈæv stɹˈɛst ðˈæt tʃˈeɪndʒ hˌaʊˈɛvɚ dˈɪfəkəlt ˈɪz pˈɑsəbəl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: Cars, machines, robots this kind of precision engineering required to create this kind of hardware
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /kˈɑɹz məʃˈinz ɹˈoʊbˌɑts ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pɹisˈɪʒən ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹɪŋ ɹikwˈaɪɚd tˈu kɹiˈeɪt ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv hˈɑɹdwˌɛɹ/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: is something Europe is traditionally very, very good at, particularly Northern Italy, Southern Germany, Switzerland.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ jˈʊɹəp ˈɪz tɹədˈɪʃənəli vˈɛɹi vˈɛɹi ɡˈʊd ˈæt pˌɑɹtˈɪkjəlɚli nˈɔɹðɚn ˈɪtəli sˈʌðɚn dʒˈɝməni swˈɪtsɚlənd/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: These places, that are very, very good at making things very well,
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ðˈiz plˈeɪsəz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi vˈɛɹi ɡˈʊd ˈæt mˈeɪkɪŋ θˈɪŋz vˈɛɹi wˈɛl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: may play a pivotal role
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /mˈeɪ plˈeɪ ə pˈɪvətəl ɹˈoʊl/

LOO41jlHRb8.text: in where we we produce uh high quality technological goods going forward.
LOO41jlHRb8.ipa: /ɪn wˈɛɹ wˈi wˈi pɹədˈus ˈʌ hˈaɪ kwˈɑləti tˌɛknəlˈɑdʒɪkəl ɡˈʊdz ɡˈoʊɪŋ fˈɔɹwɚd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: What's up, sunshine?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈʌts ˈʌp sˈʌnʃˌaɪn/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Dạo này thế nào, nắng vàng?

liHpJgbATHA.text: I am feeling fine.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm fˈilɪŋ fˈaɪn/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tôi cảm thấy ổn.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Thanks to Miss Castellanos, Miss Ray, and all of my besties,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /θˈæŋks tˈu mˈɪs kɑsteɪlˈɑnoʊz mˈɪs ɹˈeɪ ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv mˈaɪ besties/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Nhờ có cô Castellanos, cô Ray, và tất cả những người bạn thân nhất của tôi,

liHpJgbATHA.text: or shall I say vesties, at Baldwin in Austin, Texas.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ʃˈæl ˈaɪ sˈeɪ vesties ˈæt bˈɔldwən ɪn ˈɔstən tˈɛksəs/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: hoặc tôi nên nói là vesties, tại Baldwin ở Austin, Texas.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Thumbs up for the creativity with each of your thumb prints.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /θˈʌmz ˈʌp fˈɔɹ ðə kɹˌieɪtˈɪvəti wˈɪð ˈitʃ ˈʌv jˈɔɹ θˈʌm pɹˈɪnts/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tuyệt vời cho sự sáng tạo với mỗi dấu vân tay của bạn.

liHpJgbATHA.text: And this, impeccable.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˌɪmpˈɛkəbəl/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Và cái này, hoàn hảo.

liHpJgbATHA.text: I am Coy Wire, it's time to shine with your CNN 10 minutes of news.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm kˈɔɪ wˈaɪɚ ˈɪts tˈaɪm tˈu ʃˈaɪn wˈɪð jˈɔɹ sˈiˈɛnˈɛn 10 mˈɪnəts ˈʌv nˈuz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tôi là Coy Wire, đã đến lúc tỏa sáng với 10 phút tin tức của CNN.

liHpJgbATHA.text: We begin in Ohio, where a hazardous situation has been unfolding
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈi bɪɡˈɪn ɪn oʊhˈaɪoʊ wˈɛɹ ə hˈæzɚdəs sˌɪtʃuˈeɪʃən hˈæz bˈɪn ənfˈoʊldɪŋ/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Chúng ta bắt đầu ở Ohio, nơi một tình huống nguy hiểm đang diễn ra

liHpJgbATHA.text: after a chemical tank exploded in Toledo.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl tˈæŋk ɪksplˈoʊdəd ɪn təlˈidoʊ/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: sau khi một bể hóa chất phát nổ ở Toledo.

liHpJgbATHA.text: The blast Tuesday night came after a chemical leak,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə blˈæst tˈuzdi nˈaɪt kˈeɪm ˈæftɚ ə kˈɛməkəl lˈik/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Vụ nổ tối thứ Ba xảy ra sau một vụ rò rỉ hóa chất,

liHpJgbATHA.text: forcing hundreds of people to evacuate their homes,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fˈɔɹsɪŋ hˈʌndɹədz ˈʌv pˈipəl tˈu ɪvˈækjəˌeɪt ðˈɛɹ hˈoʊmz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: buộc hàng trăm người phải sơ tán khỏi nhà của họ,

liHpJgbATHA.text: while others within several miles were told to shelter indoors because of concerns about toxic fumes.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈaɪl ˈʌðɚz wɪðˈɪn sˈɛvɹəl mˈaɪlz wˈɝ tˈoʊld tˈu ʃˈɛltɚ ˈɪndˌɔɹz bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv kənsˈɝnz əbˈaʊt tˈɑksɪk fjˈumz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: trong khi những người khác trong phạm vi vài dặm được yêu cầu trú ẩn trong nhà vì lo ngại về khói độc.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Some residents said that the chemical haze
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈʌm ɹˈɛzɪdənts sˈɛd ðˈæt ðə kˈɛməkəl hˈeɪz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Một số cư dân cho biết làn khói hóa chất

liHpJgbATHA.text: was so thick they initially thought there was a fire.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈɑz sˈoʊ θˈɪk ðˈeɪ ˌɪnˈɪʃəli θˈɔt ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz ə fˈaɪɚ/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: dày đến mức ban đầu họ nghĩ có cháy.

liHpJgbATHA.text: I assumed it was a house fire.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ əsˈumd ˈɪt wˈɑz ə hˈaʊs fˈaɪɚ/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã cho rằng đó là một vụ cháy nhà.

liHpJgbATHA.text: And when I opened up the door and and and person peeked out,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ˈaɪ ˈoʊpənd ˈʌp ðə dˈɔɹ ənd ənd ənd pˈɝsən pˈikt ˈaʊt/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Và khi tôi mở cửa ra và và và người đó ló đầu ra,

liHpJgbATHA.text: I realized it was something different, and that's when I grabbed my phone.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈiəlˌaɪzd ˈɪt wˈɑz sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt ənd ðˈæts wˈɛn ˈaɪ ɡɹˈæbd mˈaɪ fˈoʊn/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tôi nhận ra đó là một thứ gì đó khác, và đó là lúc tôi lấy điện thoại của mình.

liHpJgbATHA.text: And then when my nose started burning, I knew exactly it was definitely something different.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈɛn mˈaɪ nˈoʊz stˈɑɹtɪd bˈɝnɪŋ ˈaɪ nˈu ɪɡzˈæktli ˈɪt wˈɑz dˈɛfənətli sˈʌmθɪŋ dˈɪfɚənt/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Và rồi khi mũi tôi bắt đầu bỏng rát, tôi biết chính xác đó chắc chắn là một thứ gì đó khác biệt.

liHpJgbATHA.text: It was a smell.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ə smˈɛl/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Đó là một mùi hương.

liHpJgbATHA.text: It was the smell was so was so bad,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ðə smˈɛl wˈɑz sˈoʊ wˈɑz sˈoʊ bˈæd/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Mùi đó thật kinh khủng,

liHpJgbATHA.text: I I literally had to cover my my mouth and my nose.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈaɪ lˈɪtɚəli hˈæd tˈu kˈʌvɚ mˈaɪ mˈaɪ mˈaʊθ ənd mˈaɪ nˈoʊz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Tôi thực sự phải che miệng và mũi của mình.

liHpJgbATHA.text: That's how bad it it was.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæts hˈaʊ bˈæd ˈɪt ˈɪt wˈɑz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Mọi chuyện tệ đến mức đó.

liHpJgbATHA.text: The company that owns the tank says it contains glycidyl methacrylate,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə kˈʌmpənˌi ðˈæt ˈoʊnz ðə tˈæŋk sˈɛz ˈɪt kəntˈeɪnz glycidyl methacrylate/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Công ty sở hữu bồn chứa cho biết nó chứa glycidyl methacrylate,

liHpJgbATHA.text: an industrial chemical used to help make certain plastics, paints, and coatings.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæn ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl kˈɛməkəl jˈuzd tˈu hˈɛlp mˈeɪk sˈɝtən plˈæstɪks pˈeɪnts ənd kˈoʊtɪŋz/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: một hóa chất công nghiệp được sử dụng để sản xuất một số loại nhựa, sơn và chất phủ.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Health officials say exposure can irritate the eyes, skin, and respiratory system.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /hˈɛlθ əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ kˈæn ˈɪɹɪtˌeɪt ðə ˈaɪz skˈɪn ənd ɹˈɛspɚətˌɔɹi sˈɪstəm/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Các quan chức y tế cho biết việc tiếp xúc có thể gây kích ứng mắt, da và hệ hô hấp.

liHpJgbATHA.text: The city's mayor says the exposure is not expected to cause a lasting health disturbance.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə sˈɪtiz mˈeɪɚ sˈɛz ðə ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ ˈɪz nˈɑt ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu kˈɑz ə lˈæstɪŋ hˈɛlθ dɪstˈɝbəns/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Thị trưởng thành phố cho biết việc phơi nhiễm này không được dự kiến sẽ gây ra rối loạn sức khỏe kéo dài.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Officials say the leak was due to a quote error
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /əfˈɪʃəlz sˈeɪ ðə lˈik wˈɑz dˈu tˈu ə kwˈoʊt ˈɛɹɚ/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: Các quan chức cho biết rò rỉ là do lỗi trích dẫn

liHpJgbATHA.text: that occurred when the material was being transferred.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt əkˈɝd wˈɛn ðə mətˈɪɹiəl wˈɑz bˈiɪŋ tɹænsfˈɝd/
liHpJgbATHA.vietnamese_text: đã xảy ra khi vật liệu đang được chuyển giao.

liHpJgbATHA.text: As of this taping, first responders, hazmat,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæz ˈʌv ðˈɪs tˈeɪpɪŋ fˈɝst ɹɪspˈɑndɚz hazmat/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and safety teams hadn't been approaching the tank in case there would be more explosions.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd sˈeɪfti tˈimz hˈædənt bˈɪn əpɹˈoʊtʃɪŋ ðə tˈæŋk ɪn kˈeɪs ðˈɛɹ wˈʊd bˈi mˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And here's your knowledge drop some chemicals that are stable
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd hˈɪɹz jˈɔɹ nˈɑlədʒ dɹˈɑp sˈʌm kˈɛmɪkəlz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ stˈeɪbəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: as liquids can become far more dangerous if they heat up,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæz lˈɪkwədz kˈæn bɪkˈʌm fˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ dˈeɪndʒɚəs ˈɪf ðˈeɪ hˈit ˈʌp/

liHpJgbATHA.text: vaporize, or react unexpectedly, which is why emergency crews aren't just fighting
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /vˈeɪpɚˌaɪz ˈɔɹ ɹiˈækt ˌʌnɪkspˈɛktɪdli wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz wˈaɪ ɪmˈɝdʒənsi kɹˈuz ˈɑɹənt dʒˈʌst fˈaɪtɪŋ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: what they can see, they're monitoring what's in the air.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ kˈæn sˈi ðˈɛɹ mˈɑnətɚɪŋ wˈʌts ɪn ðə ˈɛɹ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: In the past 5 months, there have been evacuations, even deaths,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ɪn ðə pˈæst 5 mˈʌnθs ðˈɛɹ hˈæv bˈɪn ɪvˌækjəwˈeɪʃənz ˈivɪn dˈɛθs/

liHpJgbATHA.text: across the US after chemical leaks or explosions in Southern California,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /əkɹˈɔs ðə ˈʌs ˈæftɚ kˈɛməkəl lˈiks ˈɔɹ ɪksplˈoʊʒənz ɪn sˈʌðɚn kˌæləfˈɔɹnjə/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Washington State, and a recycling plant also in Toledo just 2 months ago.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈɑʃɪŋtən stˈeɪt ənd ə ɹisˈaɪkəlɪŋ plˈænt ˈɔlsoʊ ɪn təlˈidoʊ dʒˈʌst 2 mˈʌnθs əɡˈoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Pop quiz, hotshot what country is the world's largest coffee producer?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /pˈɑp kwˈɪz hˈɑʃˌɑt wˈʌt kˈʌntɹi ˈɪz ðə wˈɝldz lˈɑɹdʒəst kˈɑfi pɹədˈusɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Brazil, Indonesia, Colombia, or Ethiopia?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˌɪndoʊnˈiʒə kəlˈʌmbiə ˈɔɹ ˌiθiˈoʊpiə/

liHpJgbATHA.text: If you said Brazil, you are no average Joe.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu sˈɛd bɹəzˈɪl jˈu ˈɑɹ nˈoʊ ˈævɚɪdʒ dʒˈoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Brazil produces roughly 1/3 of the world's coffee,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl pɹədˈusəz ɹˈʌfli 13 ˈʌv ðə wˈɝldz kˈɑfi/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and if you like sugar in yours, they've got you covered there, too.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪk ʃˈʊɡɚ ɪn jˈʊɹz ðˈeɪv ɡˈɑt jˈu kˈʌvɚd ðˈɛɹ tˈu/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Brazil is also the world's biggest producer of sugarcane.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə wˈɝldz bˈɪɡəst pɹədˈusɚ ˈʌv ʃˈʊɡɚkˌeɪn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Millions of workers in Brazil, Latin America's largest economy,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /mˈɪljənz ˈʌv wˈɝkɚz ɪn bɹəzˈɪl lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkəz lˈɑɹdʒəst ɪkˈɑnəmi/

liHpJgbATHA.text: are getting something many people around the world would love an extra day off.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɑɹ ɡˈɛtɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ mˈɛni pˈipəl ɚˈaʊnd ðə wˈɝld wˈʊd lˈʌv ˈæn ˈɛkstɹə dˈeɪ ˈɔf/

liHpJgbATHA.text: As Brazil heads to the polls this weekend to elect their next president,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæz bɹəzˈɪl hˈɛdz tˈu ðə pˈoʊlz ðˈɪs wˈikˌɛnd tˈu ɪlˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ nˈɛkst pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: the nation's Senate has voted to reduce the country's work week from 6 days to 5,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə nˈeɪʃənz sˈɛnət hˈæz vˈoʊtɪd tˈu ɹədˈus ðə kˈʌntɹiz wˈɝk wˈik fɹˈʌm 6 dˈeɪz tˈu 5/

liHpJgbATHA.text: from 44 hours to 40, without reducing pay.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fɹˈʌm 44 ˈaʊɚz tˈu 40 wɪθˈaʊt ɹədˈusɪŋ pˈeɪ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: It's Brazil's largest labor reform in decades,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪts bɹəzˈɪlz lˈɑɹdʒəst lˈeɪbɚ ɹəfˈɔɹm ɪn dɛkˈeɪdz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and is expected to affect more than 35 million workers.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ˈɪz ɪkspˈɛktəd tˈu əfˈɛkt mˈɔɹ ðˈæn 35 mˈɪljən wˈɝkɚz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Brazil is following a growing trend across Latin America after Mexico,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɹəzˈɪl ˈɪz fˈɑloʊɪŋ ə ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ tɹˈɛnd əkɹˈɔs lˈætən əmˈɛɹəkə ˈæftɚ mˈɛksəkˌoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Chile, and Colombia recently passed similar laws to cap hours and benefit workers.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /tʃˈɪli ənd kəlˈʌmbiə ɹˈisəntli pˈæst sˈɪməlɚ lˈɔz tˈu kˈæp ˈaʊɚz ənd bˈɛnəfɪt wˈɝkɚz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The move is seen as a big legislative win for incumbent President Lula da Silva,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə mˈuv ˈɪz sˈin ˈæz ə bˈɪɡ lˈɛdʒəslˌeɪtɪv wˈɪn fˈɔɹ ˌɪnkˈʌmbənt pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt lˈulə dˈɑ sˈɪlvə/

liHpJgbATHA.text: who's currently seeking a fourth non-consecutive term.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /hˈuz kˈɝəntli sˈikɪŋ ə fˈɔɹθ nonconsecutive tˈɝm/

liHpJgbATHA.text: He's currently locked in a tight race with Senator Flavio Bolsonaro,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /hˈiz kˈɝəntli lˈɑkt ɪn ə tˈaɪt ɹˈeɪs wˈɪð sˈɛnətɚ flˈɑvioʊ bolsonaro/

liHpJgbATHA.text: the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who Lula defeated in 2022.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə sˈʌn ˈʌv fˈɔɹmɚ pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt jair bolsonaro hˈu lˈulə dɪfˈitəd ɪn 2022/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The two face off in a runoff election this Sunday.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə tˈu fˈeɪs ˈɔf ɪn ə ɹˈʌnˌɔf ɪlˈɛkʃən ðˈɪs sˈʌndˌeɪ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: You've probably heard of Apple's newest phone.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /jˈuv pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈɝd ˈʌv ˈæpəlz nˈuəst fˈoʊn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Officially launching tomorrow, the tech giant isn't just upgrading it is folding it in half.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /əfˈɪʃəli lˈɔntʃɪŋ təmˈɑɹˌoʊ ðə tˈɛk dʒˈaɪənt ˈɪzənt dʒˈʌst əpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪz fˈoʊldɪŋ ˈɪt ɪn hˈæf/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable smartphone,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈɪz ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable smˈɑɹtfˌoʊn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: but some might say it comes with about 2,000 problems.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt sˈʌm mˈaɪt sˈeɪ ˈɪt kˈʌmz wˈɪð əbˈaʊt 2000 pɹˈɑbləmz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: First, it cost 2,000 bucks.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fˈɝst ˈɪt kˈɑst 2000 bˈʌks/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And what about the engineering challenges?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹɪŋ tʃˈæləndʒɪz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: How do you make a screen bend thousands of times without cracking?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈu jˈu mˈeɪk ə skɹˈin bˈɛnd θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv tˈaɪmz wɪθˈaʊt kɹˈækɪŋ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: But could its design make it more useful or just more expensive?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt kˈʊd ˈɪts dɪzˈaɪn mˈeɪk ˈɪt mˈɔɹ jˈusfəl ˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst mˈɔɹ ɪkspˈɛnsɪv/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Apple gave CNN's Lisa Eadicicco one to take for a test fold.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæpəl ɡˈeɪv sˈiˈɛnˈɛnz lˈisə eadicicco wˈʌn tˈu tˈeɪk fˈɔɹ ə tˈɛst fˈoʊld/

liHpJgbATHA.text: This does feel sort of like an iPad, but not quite.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɪs dˈʌz fˈil sˈɔɹt ˈʌv lˈaɪk ˈæn ˈaɪpˌæd bˈʌt nˈɑt kwˈaɪt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: This is the iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable iPhone.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈæpəlz fˈɝst foldable ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And this is a really big deal for Apple
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə ɹˈɪli bˈɪɡ dˈil fˈɔɹ ˈæpəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: because it's the first time the iPhone has had a significant change like
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts ðə fˈɝst tˈaɪm ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn hˈæz hˈæd ə səɡnˈɪfɪkənt tʃˈeɪndʒ lˈaɪk/

liHpJgbATHA.text: this in its nearly 20-year history.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɪs ɪn ˈɪts nˈɪɹli 20year hˈɪstɚi/

liHpJgbATHA.text: So, I thought the Duo was going to feel more awkward,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ θˈɔt ðə dˈuoʊ wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu fˈil mˈɔɹ ˈɑkwɚd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: but it's really about the same size as a passport.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪts ɹˈɪli əbˈaʊt ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz ˈæz ə pˈæspˌɔɹt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And just for comparison, this is the latest foldable from Samsung,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst fˈɔɹ kəmpˈɛɹəsən ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə lˈeɪtəst foldable fɹˈʌm sˈæmsˌʌŋ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: which has been a leader in the foldable market so far.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ hˈæz bˈɪn ə lˈidɚ ɪn ðə foldable mˈɑɹkət sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I'm going to be using the iPhone Duo
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈi jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: as my regular phone for the next week to see how it holds up.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæz mˈaɪ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ fˈoʊn fˈɔɹ ðə nˈɛkst wˈik tˈu sˈi hˈaʊ ˈɪt hˈoʊldz ˈʌp/

liHpJgbATHA.text: So, this is my first full day with the iPhone Duo.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈɪs ˈɪz mˈaɪ fˈɝst fˈʊl dˈeɪ wˈɪð ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I am currently.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm kˈɝəntli/

liHpJgbATHA.text: In the car, driving down to Cape May,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ɪn ðə kˈɑɹ dɹˈaɪvɪŋ dˈaʊn tˈu kˈeɪp mˈeɪ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I've been using the iPhone Duo on this trip to read the news,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪv bˈɪn jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ ˈɑn ðˈɪs tɹˈɪp tˈu ɹˈɛd ðə nˈuz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: scroll through social media.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /skɹˈoʊl θɹˈu sˈoʊʃəl mˈidiə/

liHpJgbATHA.text: It is nicer to kind of have this much bigger screen
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz nˈaɪsɚ tˈu kˈaɪnd ˈʌv hˈæv ðˈɪs mˈʌtʃ bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin/

liHpJgbATHA.text: that feels more like a tablet.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt fˈilz mˈɔɹ lˈaɪk ə tˈæblət/

liHpJgbATHA.text: It does make it a lot easier to read.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt dˈʌz mˈeɪk ˈɪt ə lˈɑt ˈiziɚ tˈu ɹˈɛd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And so far, I'm not really noticing the crease that much at all.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ ˈaɪm nˈɑt ɹˈɪli nˈoʊtɪsɪŋ ðə kɹˈis ðˈæt mˈʌtʃ ˈæt ˈɔl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I thought it would be a little bit more noticeable the more
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɔt ˈɪt wˈʊd bˈi ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt mˈɔɹ nˈoʊtəsəbəl ðə mˈɔɹ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: that I've used it, but so far, so good.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈaɪv jˈuzd ˈɪt bˈʌt sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Let's take it out for a run.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /lˈɛts tˈeɪk ˈɪt ˈaʊt fˈɔɹ ə ɹˈʌn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I'm pretty impressed with how light this felt while I was running.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪm pɹˈɪti ˌɪmpɹˈɛst wˈɪð hˈaʊ lˈaɪt ðˈɪs fˈɛlt wˈaɪl ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɹˈʌnɪŋ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: It actually didn't feel any different than if I was running with my regular iPhone.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈæktʃˌuəli dˈɪdənt fˈil ˈɛni dˈɪfɚənt ðˈæn ˈɪf ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɹˈʌnɪŋ wˈɪð mˈaɪ ɹˈɛɡjəlɚ ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Next up was the Cape May Zoo, where I put the camera to the test.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /nˈɛkst ˈʌp wˈɑz ðə kˈeɪp mˈeɪ zˈu wˈɛɹ ˈaɪ pˈʊt ðə kˈæmɚə tˈu ðə tˈɛst/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The camera doesn't feel as awkward as you think,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə kˈæmɚə dˈʌzənt fˈil ˈæz ˈɑkwɚd ˈæz jˈu θˈɪŋk/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and sometimes it was nice having the bigger screen as a viewfinder.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪt wˈɑz nˈaɪs hˈævɪŋ ðə bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin ˈæz ə vjˈufˌaɪndɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I liked being able to prop up the phone to steady my shot,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪkt bˈiɪŋ ˈeɪbəl tˈu pɹˈɑp ˈʌp ðə fˈoʊn tˈu stˈɛdi mˈaɪ ʃˈɑt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: but the zoom isn't as good as what you'd get on the iPhone 18 Pro.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə zˈum ˈɪzənt ˈæz ɡˈʊd ˈæz wˈʌt jˈud ɡˈɛt ˈɑn ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn 18 pɹˈoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: But be warned, the inner camera behind the display isn't great.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt bˈi wˈɔɹnd ðə ˈɪnɚ kˈæmɚə bɪhˈaɪnd ðə dɪsplˈeɪ ˈɪzənt ɡɹˈeɪt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Photos can look dark and kind of grainy.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fˈoʊtˌoʊz kˈæn lˈʊk dˈɑɹk ənd kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɡɹˈeɪni/

liHpJgbATHA.text: By day three, I was thinking about different creative ways to use the front screen,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈaɪ dˈeɪ θɹˈi ˈaɪ wˈɑz θˈɪŋkɪŋ əbˈaʊt dˈɪfɚənt kɹiˈeɪtɪv wˈeɪz tˈu jˈus ðə fɹˈʌnt skɹˈin/

liHpJgbATHA.text: like dragging and dropping photos from my gallery to a text message at dinner.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /lˈaɪk dɹˈæɡɪŋ ənd dɹˈɑpɪŋ fˈoʊtˌoʊz fɹˈʌm mˈaɪ ɡˈælɚi tˈu ə tˈɛkst mˈɛsədʒ ˈæt dˈɪnɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: This is day five with the iPhone Duo,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz dˈeɪ fˈaɪv wˈɪð ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and we're about to hit the road to head home from Cape May.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd wˈiɹ əbˈaʊt tˈu hˈɪt ðə ɹˈoʊd tˈu hˈɛd hˈoʊm fɹˈʌm kˈeɪp mˈeɪ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: We have a pretty long car ride coming up,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈi hˈæv ə pɹˈɪti lˈɔŋ kˈɑɹ ɹˈaɪd kˈʌmɪŋ ˈʌp/

liHpJgbATHA.text: which is the perfect time to play some games on the iPhone Duo.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðə pɚfˈɛkt tˈaɪm tˈu plˈeɪ sˈʌm ɡˈeɪmz ˈɑn ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: This is one of the games that is actually optimized for this big screen.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ɡˈeɪmz ðˈæt ˈɪz ˈæktʃˌuəli ˈɑptəmˌaɪzd fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs bˈɪɡ skɹˈin/

liHpJgbATHA.text: As you can see, it takes up the entire display, almost edge to edge.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæz jˈu kˈæn sˈi ˈɪt tˈeɪks ˈʌp ðə ɪntˈaɪɚ dɪsplˈeɪ ˈɔlmˌoʊst ˈɛdʒ tˈu ˈɛdʒ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: But as I've been testing this phone, I've actually noticed
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈæz ˈaɪv bˈɪn tˈɛstɪŋ ðˈɪs fˈoʊn ˈaɪv ˈæktʃˌuəli nˈoʊtəst/

liHpJgbATHA.text: that a lot of apps aren't optimized for that bigger screen
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈæps ˈɑɹənt ˈɑptəmˌaɪzd fˈɔɹ ðˈæt bˈɪɡɚ skɹˈin/

liHpJgbATHA.text: because developers still need to update their apps.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz dɪvˈɛləpɚz stˈɪl nˈid tˈu əpdˈeɪt ðˈɛɹ ˈæps/

liHpJgbATHA.text: So, after using the iPhone Duo for about a week,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈæftɚ jˈuzɪŋ ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ fˈɔɹ əbˈaʊt ə wˈik/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I've been wondering, why is Apple releasing a foldable iPhone now?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪv bˈɪn wˈʌndɚɪŋ wˈaɪ ˈɪz ˈæpəl ɹilˈisɪŋ ə foldable ˈaɪfˌoʊn nˈaʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: I think part of that might come down to the fact
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðˈæt mˈaɪt kˈʌm dˈaʊn tˈu ðə fˈækt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: that Apple has faced pressure to prove it can still innovate
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈæpəl hˈæz fˈeɪst pɹˈɛʃɚ tˈu pɹˈuv ˈɪt kˈæn stˈɪl ˈɪnəvˌeɪt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and build on the success of the iPhone.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd bˈɪld ˈɑn ðə səksˈɛs ˈʌv ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Will the iPhone Duo be that answer?
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈɪl ðə ˈaɪfˌoʊn dˈuoʊ bˈi ðˈæt ˈænsɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: We'll find out when the phone launches on October 23rd.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈil fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt wˈɛn ðə fˈoʊn lˈɔntʃəz ˈɑn ɑktˈoʊbɚ 23rd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: From the revolutionary streets of the 18th century to modern political demonstrations,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ðə ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃənˌɛɹi stɹˈits ˈʌv ðə 18th sˈɛntʃɚi tˈu mˈɑdɚn pəlˈɪtəkəl dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃənz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: classical music has always been a key tool for political mobilization.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk hˈæz ˈɔlwˌeɪz bˈɪn ə kˈi tˈul fˈɔɹ pəlˈɪtəkəl mˌoʊbələzˈeɪʃən/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The lyrics were used as a way to spread news, rally citizens, and empower demonstrators.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə lˈɪɹɪks wˈɝ jˈuzd ˈæz ə wˈeɪ tˈu spɹˈɛd nˈuz ɹˈæli sˈɪtəzənz ənd ɪmpˈaʊɚ dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪtɚz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Now, amid the political unrest in France over the surging cost of living
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /nˈaʊ əmˈɪd ðə pəlˈɪtəkəl ənɹˈɛst ɪn fɹˈæns ˈoʊvɚ ðə sˈɝdʒɪŋ kˈɑst ˈʌv lˈɪvɪŋ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and the lack of government funding for education, the Orchestre du Nouvel Monde,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ðə lˈæk ˈʌv ɡˈʌvɚmənt fˈʌndɪŋ fˈɔɹ ˌɛdʒəkˈeɪʃən ðə orchestre dˈu nˈuvəl mˈɑnd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: or the Orchestra of the New World, is tapping back into their revolutionary rhythms.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈʌv ðə nˈu wˈɝld ˈɪz tˈæpɪŋ bˈæk ˈɪntu ðˈɛɹ ɹˌɛvəlˈuʃənˌɛɹi ɹˈɪðəmz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Aurivane Scatola explains how.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /aurivane scatola ɪksplˈeɪnz hˈaʊ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: These musicians have joined protests in France by providing the soundtrack.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈiz mjuzˈɪʃənz hˈæv dʒˈɔɪnd pɹˈoʊtˌɛsts ɪn fɹˈæns bˈaɪ pɹəvˈaɪdɪŋ ðə sˈaʊndtɹˌæk/

liHpJgbATHA.text: For us, a symphonic orchestra should be wherever it's more useful,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /fˈɔɹ ˈʌs ə sɪmfˈɑnɪk ˈɔɹkəstɹə ʃˈʊd bˈi wɛɹˈɛvɚ ˈɪts mˈɔɹ jˈusfəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and today it's in the streets The goal of the Orchestra of the New World
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd tədˈeɪ ˈɪts ɪn ðə stɹˈits ðə ɡˈoʊl ˈʌv ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈʌv ðə nˈu wˈɝld/

liHpJgbATHA.text: is to politicize classical music and bring it to the heart of the struggles,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪz tˈu pəlˈɪtɪsˌaɪz klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk ənd bɹˈɪŋ ˈɪt tˈu ðə hˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðə stɹˈʌɡəlz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and we want to turn the orchestra into a space of gathering and collective power.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu tˈɝn ðə ˈɔɹkəstɹə ˈɪntu ə spˈeɪs ˈʌv ɡˈæðɚɪŋ ənd kəlˈɛktɪv pˈaʊɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The Orchestre de Nouvel Monde says they're committed to social and climate justice in France.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə orchestre dˈi nˈuvəl mˈɑnd sˈɛz ðˈɛɹ kəmˈɪtɪd tˈu sˈoʊʃəl ənd klˈaɪmət dʒˈʌstəs ɪn fɹˈæns/

liHpJgbATHA.text: We are not here to use classical music to rehabilitate the image of the movement,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈi ˈɑɹ nˈɑt hˈiɹ tˈu jˈus klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk tˈu ɹˌihəbˈɪlətˌeɪt ðə ˈɪmədʒ ˈʌv ðə mˈuvmənt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: but we want to empower it.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu ɪmpˈaʊɚ ˈɪt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: We want to empower
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu ɪmpˈaʊɚ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: it because we believe in the power of classical music The protest started in support
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt bɪkˈɔz wˈi bɪlˈiv ɪn ðə pˈaʊɚ ˈʌv klˈæsɪkəl mjˈuzɪk ðə pɹˈoʊtˌɛst stˈɑɹtɪd ɪn səpˈɔɹt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: of striking teachers, and in the past month tens of thousands of people,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈʌv stɹˈaɪkɪŋ tˈitʃɚz ənd ɪn ðə pˈæst mˈʌnθ tˈɛnz ˈʌv θˈaʊzəndz ˈʌv pˈipəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: including students and unions, have taken to the streets across France, with some demonstrations turning violent.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˌɪnklˈudɪŋ stˈudənts ənd jˈunjənz hˈæv tˈeɪkən tˈu ðə stɹˈits əkɹˈɔs fɹˈæns wˈɪð sˈʌm dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃənz tˈɝnɪŋ vˈaɪələnt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Today's story getting a 10 out of 10.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /tədˈeɪz stˈɔɹi ɡˈɛtɪŋ ə 10 ˈaʊt ˈʌv 10/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Scientists in London inventing a solution to pop a real-world pollution problem.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈaɪəntɪsts ɪn lˈʌndən ˌɪnvˈɛntɪŋ ə səlˈuʃən tˈu pˈɑp ə realworld pəlˈuʃən pɹˈɑbləm/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The newly established BioLoop says that they have developed the first balloon
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə nˈuli ɪstˈæblɪʃt bioloop sˈɛz ðˈæt ðˈeɪ hˈæv dɪvˈɛləpt ðə fˈɝst bəlˈun/

liHpJgbATHA.text: that is biodegradable or something that can be broken down by bacteria
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz bˌaɪoʊdəɡɹˈeɪdəbəl ˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt kˈæn bˈi bɹˈoʊkən dˈaʊn bˈaɪ bæktˈɪɹiə/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and fungi and is turning it into natural substance like water, carbon dioxide, or nutrients.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd fˈʌndʒaɪ ənd ˈɪz tˈɝnɪŋ ˈɪt ˈɪntu nˈætʃɚəl sˈʌbstəns lˈaɪk wˈɔtɚ kˈɑɹbən daɪˈɑksˌaɪd ˈɔɹ nˈutɹiənts/

liHpJgbATHA.text: The team says BioLoop is made from rubber that has been treated to break down organically.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðə tˈim sˈɛz bioloop ˈɪz mˈeɪd fɹˈʌm ɹˈʌbɚ ðˈæt hˈæz bˈɪn tɹˈitɪd tˈu bɹˈeɪk dˈaʊn ɔɹɡˈænɪkli/

liHpJgbATHA.text: While natural latex is a fluid that comes out of a latex tree,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /wˈaɪl nˈætʃɚəl lˈeɪtˌɛks ˈɪz ə flˈuəd ðˈæt kˈʌmz ˈaʊt ˈʌv ə lˈeɪtˌɛks tɹˈi/

liHpJgbATHA.text: it becomes rubber through a process called sulfur vulcanization,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɪt bɪkˈʌmz ɹˈʌbɚ θɹˈu ə pɹˈɑsˌɛs kˈɔld sˈʌlfɚ vulcanization/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and that is the process that has toxic chemicals which can leach into the environment.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ðˈæt ˈɪz ðə pɹˈɑsˌɛs ðˈæt hˈæz tˈɑksɪk kˈɛmɪkəlz wˈɪtʃ kˈæn lˈitʃ ˈɪntu ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: So, existing latex balloons in their form have a terrible impact on the environment.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /sˈoʊ ɪɡzˈɪstɪŋ lˈeɪtˌɛks bəlˈunz ɪn ðˈɛɹ fˈɔɹm hˈæv ə tˈɛɹəbəl ˌɪmpˈækt ˈɑn ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: They're responsible for killing over a million seabirds every single year,
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ɹispˈɑnsəbəl fˈɔɹ kˈɪlɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ə mˈɪljən seabirds ˈɛvɚi sˈɪŋɡəl jˈɪɹ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: 100,000 sea turtles, and they leach carcinogens and toxins into our environment.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /100000 sˈi tˈɝtəlz ənd ðˈeɪ lˈitʃ kɑɹsˈɪnədʒənz ənd tˈɑksənz ˈɪntu ˈaʊɚ ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt/

liHpJgbATHA.text: BioLoop plans to develop more biodegradable party balloons, then move on to latex gloves, medical devices.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /bioloop plˈænz tˈu dɪvˈɛləp mˈɔɹ bˌaɪoʊdəɡɹˈeɪdəbəl pˈɑɹti bəlˈunz ðˈɛn mˈuv ˈɑn tˈu lˈeɪtˌɛks ɡlˈʌvz mˈɛdəkəl dɪvˈaɪsəz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Even clothing and apparel.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈivɪn klˈoʊðɪŋ ənd əpˈæɹəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: All right, superstars, shout-out time.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt sˌupɚstˈɑɹz shoutout tˈaɪm/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Our first one is going to Mrs.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈaʊɚ fˈɝst wˈʌn ˈɪz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu mˈɪsɪz/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Caballero and all of our friends at Bonita Vista in Chula Vista, California. Rise up.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /kˌæbəjˈɛɹoʊ ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ fɹˈɛndz ˈæt boʊnˈitə vˈɪstə ɪn tʃˈulə vˈɪstə kˌæləfˈɔɹnjə ɹˈaɪz ˈʌp/

liHpJgbATHA.text: And for our next shout-out, we are sending some love up to Seattle, Washington.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ nˈɛkst shoutout wˈi ˈɑɹ sˈɛndɪŋ sˈʌm lˈʌv ˈʌp tˈu siˈætəl wˈɑʃɪŋtən/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Miss Bargfrede, Mr.

liHpJgbATHA.text: Kenyon, and all of our friends at Eckstein Middle.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /kˈɛnjən ənd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ fɹˈɛndz ˈæt ˈɛkstˌin mˈɪdəl/

liHpJgbATHA.text: Fly Eagles, fly.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /flˈaɪ ˈiɡəlz flˈaɪ/

liHpJgbATHA.text: That is our 10.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz ˈaʊɚ 10/

liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ˈæsk ɡˈʊd kwˈɛstʃənz/

liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /stˈeɪ kjˈʊɹiəs bˈi kˈaɪnd/

liHpJgbATHA.text: and go make your little corner of this big world a little better.
liHpJgbATHA.ipa: /ənd ɡˈoʊ mˈeɪk jˈɔɹ lˈɪtəl kˈɔɹnɚ ˈʌv ðˈɪs bˈɪɡ wˈɝld ə lˈɪtəl bˈɛtɚ/
