Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ sˈʌm bjˈuti ɹˈɪtʃuəlz/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Vậy thì đã đến lúc thực hiện một vài nghi thức làm đẹp.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Again, I think the morning is the best time for self-care
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /əɡˈɛn ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ ˈɪz ðə bˈɛst tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ selfcare/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ buổi sáng là thời gian tốt nhất để chăm sóc bản thân.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: and just getting your mind and body right for the day.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst ɡˈɛtɪŋ jˈɔɹ mˈaɪnd ənd bˈɑdi ɹˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ðə dˈeɪ/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: và chỉ cần làm cho tâm trí và cơ thể bạn sẵn sàng cho ngày mới.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Before I do my skincare,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ dˈu mˈaɪ skincare/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Trước khi tôi làm chăm sóc da,

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I like to sit in front of my red light panel and meditate.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪk tˈu sˈɪt ɪn fɹˈʌnt ˈʌv mˈaɪ ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt pˈænəl ənd mˈɛdətˌeɪt/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích ngồi trước tấm đèn đỏ của mình và thiền định.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is such an easy habit stack.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ˈæn ˈizi hˈæbət stˈæk/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Đây là một chuỗi thói quen thật dễ dàng.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Not only am I rejuvenating my skin, but also my mind.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /nˈɑt ˈoʊnli ˈæm ˈaɪ ɹidʒˈuvənˌeɪtɪŋ mˈaɪ skˈɪn bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ mˈaɪ mˈaɪnd/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Không chỉ làn da của tôi đang được trẻ hóa, mà tâm trí tôi cũng vậy.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And since my life is pretty stressful right now,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd sˈɪns mˈaɪ lˈaɪf ˈɪz pɹˈɪti stɹˈɛsfəl ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Và vì cuộc sống của tôi khá căng thẳng ngay lúc này,

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: this really gets me in the right headsp space.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ɹˈɪli ɡˈɛts mˈi ɪn ðə ɹˈaɪt headsp spˈeɪs/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: điều này thực sự giúp tôi có được tâm trạng phù hợp.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I think habit stacking your beauty rituals is such a great way to get more
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk hˈæbət stˈækɪŋ jˈɔɹ bjˈuti ɹˈɪtʃuəlz ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈeɪ tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈɔɹ/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ việc kết hợp các thói quen làm đẹp của bạn là một cách tuyệt vời để có thêm

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: out of your morning.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaʊt ˈʌv jˈɔɹ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: ra khỏi buổi sáng của bạn.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: But you don't need to spend a lot of time doing them.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid tˈu spˈɛnd ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm dˈuɪŋ ðˈɛm/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Nhưng bạn không cần phải dành nhiều thời gian để làm chúng.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Even if it's one small thing that makes you feel more beautiful
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf ˈɪts wˈʌn smˈɔl θˈɪŋ ðˈæt mˈeɪks jˈu fˈil mˈɔɹ bjˈutəfəl/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Ngay cả khi đó là một điều nhỏ bé khiến bạn cảm thấy xinh đẹp hơn

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: or confident, it's worth doing.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɔɹ kˈɑnfədənt ˈɪts wˈɝθ dˈuɪŋ/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: hoặc tự tin, nó đáng để làm.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: My other favorite beauty habit stack is to listen to a podcast while doing my nails.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /mˈaɪ ˈʌðɚ fˈeɪvɚɪt bjˈuti hˈæbət stˈæk ˈɪz tˈu lˈɪsən tˈu ə pˈɔdkˌæst wˈaɪl dˈuɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Thói quen làm đẹp yêu thích khác của tôi là nghe podcast trong khi làm móng tay.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Most of you guys know my complicated nail journey.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /mˈoʊst ˈʌv jˈu ɡˈaɪz nˈoʊ mˈaɪ kˈɑmpləkˌeɪtəd nˈeɪl dʒˈɝni/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Hầu hết các bạn đều biết hành trình làm móng phức tạp của tôi.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I've gone through periods of constantly getting my nails done at a salon,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪv ɡˈɔn θɹˈu pˈɪɹiədz ˈʌv kˈɑnstəntli ɡˈɛtɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz dˈʌn ˈæt ə səlˈɑn/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: Tôi đã trải qua những giai đoạn liên tục đi làm móng ở tiệm,

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: but the gel would absolutely destroy my nail beds.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə dʒˈɛl wˈʊd ˌæbsəlˈutli dɪstɹˈɔɪ mˈaɪ nˈeɪl bˈɛdz/
Nrph1U5kY0Y.vietnamese_text: nhưng gel sẽ hủy hoại hoàn toàn giường móng của tôi.

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And I hate breathing in the chemicals, which is such a shame
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ hˈeɪt bɹˈiðɪŋ ɪn ðə kˈɛmɪkəlz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə ʃˈeɪm/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: because I really love the look of nails.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli lˈʌv ðə lˈʊk ˈʌv nˈeɪlz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: But I recently discovered these gel alternative polishes from manicurists
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ ɹˈisəntli dɪskˈʌvɚd ðˈiz dʒˈɛl ɔltˈɝnətɪv polishes fɹˈʌm manicurists/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: that you can do at home in three steps.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn dˈu ˈæt hˈoʊm ɪn θɹˈi stˈɛps/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I love that this formula is plant-based with all the benefits of traditional gel,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ðˈæt ðˈɪs fˈɔɹmjələ ˈɪz plantbased wˈɪð ˈɔl ðə bˈɛnəfɪts ˈʌv tɹədˈɪʃənəl dʒˈɛl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: but without the damage or chemicals.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bˈʌt wɪθˈaʊt ðə dˈæmədʒ ˈɔɹ kˈɛmɪkəlz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: The Extreme Flash top coat lasts up to 21 days, which is insane.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðə ɛkstɹˈim flˈæʃ tˈɑp kˈoʊt lˈæsts ˈʌp tˈu 21 dˈeɪz wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ˌɪnsˈeɪn/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And if you're like me and you hate taking off your nails with a drill,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈaɪk mˈi ənd jˈu hˈeɪt tˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɔf jˈɔɹ nˈeɪlz wˈɪð ə dɹˈɪl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: these easily come off with an acetone-free remover.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈiz ˈizəli kˈʌm ˈɔf wˈɪð ˈæn acetonefree ɹɪmˈuvɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Having my nails done makes me feel so put together even on my busiest days.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /hˈævɪŋ mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz dˈʌn mˈeɪks mˈi fˈil sˈoʊ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ ˈivɪn ˈɑn mˈaɪ bˈɪziəst dˈeɪz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If you guys want to ditch traditional gel and maintain healthier nails,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu ɡˈaɪz wˈɑnt tˈu dˈɪtʃ tɹədˈɪʃənəl dʒˈɛl ənd meɪntˈeɪn hˈɛlθiɚ nˈeɪlz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'll link this kit from Manicurist in the description.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪŋk ðˈɪs kˈɪt fɹˈʌm mˈænɪkjˌɝɪst ɪn ðə dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And you can get 15% off sitewide using my code.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd jˈu kˈæn ɡˈɛt 15 ˈɔf sitewide jˈuzɪŋ mˈaɪ kˈoʊd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: It is time to now make my matcha.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈaɪm tˈu nˈaʊ mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is one of my favorite parts of my morning.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt pˈɑɹts ˈʌv mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'm a big believer in that you don't really need to measure anything,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪm ə bˈɪɡ bəlˈivɚ ɪn ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt ɹˈɪli nˈid tˈu mˈɛʒɚ ˈɛniθˌɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: you know, you just measure with your heart.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ jˈu dʒˈʌst mˈɛʒɚ wˈɪð jˈɔɹ hˈɑɹt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: So, the first thing I do is I will heat up some water in my kettle.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðə fˈɝst θˈɪŋ ˈaɪ dˈu ˈɪz ˈaɪ wˈɪl hˈit ˈʌp sˈʌm wˈɔtɚ ɪn mˈaɪ kˈɛtəl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Just like a very small amount.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk ə vˈɛɹi smˈɔl əmˈaʊnt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: You don't need too much.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈu dˈoʊnt nˈid tˈu mˈʌtʃ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And then while that's heating up, I like to take some warm water.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈaɪl ðˈæts hˈitɪŋ ˈʌp ˈaɪ lˈaɪk tˈu tˈeɪk sˈʌm wˈɔɹm wˈɔtɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And I'll just fill like a small cup to soak my whisk.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪl dʒˈʌst fˈɪl lˈaɪk ə smˈɔl kˈʌp tˈu sˈoʊk mˈaɪ wˈɪsk/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is really important to soften the bristles.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt tˈu sˈɑfən ðə bɹˈɪsəlz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: It helps to like mix better.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈɛlps tˈu lˈaɪk mˈɪks bˈɛtɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Then I'm going to take two to three scoops of my favorite matcha.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu tˈeɪk tˈu tˈu θɹˈi skˈups ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt matcha/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is Rocky's matcha.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz rocky's matcha/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If you're looking for that super creamy, gently sweet,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈʊkɪŋ fˈɔɹ ðˈæt sˈupɚ kɹˈimi dʒˈɛntli swˈit/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: nutty kind of matcha that you always get at a cafe,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /nˈʌti kˈaɪnd ˈʌv matcha ðˈæt jˈu ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɡˈɛt ˈæt ə kəfˈeɪ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: this is the one you have to get.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə wˈʌn jˈu hˈæv tˈu ɡˈɛt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And then just sift it through.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dʒˈʌst sˈɪft ˈɪt θɹˈu/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is to remove any of the clumps.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz tˈu ɹimˈuv ˈɛni ˈʌv ðə klˈʌmps/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: All right. By now, my water is almost boiling.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt bˈaɪ nˈaʊ mˈaɪ wˈɔtɚ ˈɪz ˈɔlmˌoʊst bˈɔɪlɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: You don't want to use boiling water because it's going to burn your matcha
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈu dˈoʊnt wˈɑnt tˈu jˈus bˈɔɪlɪŋ wˈɔtɚ bɪkˈɔz ˈɪts ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈɝn jˈɔɹ matcha/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: and make it taste bitter.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd mˈeɪk ˈɪt tˈeɪst bˈɪtɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I just like to cover about like that much.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk tˈu kˈʌvɚ əbˈaʊt lˈaɪk ðˈæt mˈʌtʃ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And then take my softened whisk.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn tˈeɪk mˈaɪ sˈɔfənd wˈɪsk/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And now we whisk in an M motion.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ wˈi wˈɪsk ɪn ˈæn ˈɛm mˈoʊʃən/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'd say you want to whisk it for about a minute.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪd sˈeɪ jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu wˈɪsk ˈɪt fˈɔɹ əbˈaʊt ə mˈɪnət/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And you'll know it's ready
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd jˈul nˈoʊ ˈɪts ɹˈɛdi/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: when you start to see some tiny bubbles at the top like this.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /wˈɛn jˈu stˈɑɹt tˈu sˈi sˈʌm tˈaɪni bˈʌbəlz ˈæt ðə tˈɑp lˈaɪk ðˈɪs/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: It should look foamy.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪt ʃˈʊd lˈʊk fˈoʊmi/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I've just got some almond milk in here with some ice.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪv dʒˈʌst ɡˈɑt sˈʌm ˈɑmənd mˈɪlk ɪn hˈiɹ wˈɪð sˈʌm ˈaɪs/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And now it's time for my favorite part.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ ˈɪts tˈaɪm fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ fˈeɪvɚɪt pˈɑɹt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Got to get every last drop.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ɡˈɑt tˈu ɡˈɛt ˈɛvɚi lˈæst dɹˈɑp/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Matcha's expensive. We can't waste any.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /matcha's ɪkspˈɛnsɪv wˈi kˈænt wˈeɪst ˈɛni/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I feel like this is one of the best matchas I've ever made
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ fˈil lˈaɪk ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə bˈɛst matchas ˈaɪv ˈɛvɚ mˈeɪd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: in terms of color.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv kˈʌlɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Like look at that.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /lˈaɪk lˈʊk ˈæt ðˈæt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: All right, let's try it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt lˈɛts tɹˈaɪ ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: No astringency at all.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /nˈoʊ astringency ˈæt ˈɔl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: It's like so just like perfect.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪts lˈaɪk sˈoʊ dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk pɚfˈɛkt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'm telling you guys, a good matcha latte will hit every single time.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪm tˈɛlɪŋ jˈu ɡˈaɪz ə ɡˈʊd matcha lˈɑtˌeɪ wˈɪl hˈɪt ˈɛvɚi sˈɪŋɡəl tˈaɪm/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I also don't add any sweetener because the powder that I use is already naturally sweet.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈɔlsoʊ dˈoʊnt ˈæd ˈɛni swˈitənɚ bɪkˈɔz ðə pˈaʊdɚ ðˈæt ˈaɪ jˈus ˈɪz ɔlɹˈɛdi nˈætʃɚəli swˈit/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: This is so good.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈoʊ ɡˈʊd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I was actually so thirsty this whole morning.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈoʊ θˈɝsti ðˈɪs hˈoʊl mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: So, I already drank like half of this.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ ɔlɹˈɛdi dɹˈæŋk lˈaɪk hˈæf ˈʌv ðˈɪs/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: The reason I can really take my time in the mornings
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðə ɹˈizən ˈaɪ kˈæn ɹˈɪli tˈeɪk mˈaɪ tˈaɪm ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: is because I know exactly how much time I have
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪz bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ɪɡzˈæktli hˈaʊ mˈʌtʃ tˈaɪm ˈaɪ hˈæv/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: before I need to start actually doing work.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ nˈid tˈu stˈɑɹt ˈæktʃˌuəli dˈuɪŋ wˈɝk/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'm not stressed in the morning because I actually plan everything out the night before.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪm nˈɑt stɹˈɛst ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ ˈæktʃˌuəli plˈæn ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈaʊt ðə nˈaɪt bɪfˈɔɹ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I write everything down.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈaɪt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ dˈaʊn/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Yes, I have a Google calendar, Apple calendar, but nothing will ever beat a physical planner.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaɪ hˈæv ə ɡˈuɡəl kˈæləndɚ ˈæpəl kˈæləndɚ bˈʌt nˈʌθɪŋ wˈɪl ˈɛvɚ bˈit ə fˈɪzɪkəl plˈænɚ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: You can see it, feel it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈu kˈæn sˈi ˈɪt fˈil ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: The tactile movement of writing stuff down helps you remember it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðə tˈæktɪl mˈuvmənt ˈʌv ɹˈaɪtɪŋ stˈʌf dˈaʊn hˈɛlps jˈu ɹɪmˈɛmbɚ ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And before I go to bed, I review the next day's schedule
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd bɪfˈɔɹ ˈaɪ ɡˈoʊ tˈu bˈɛd ˈaɪ ɹˌivjˈu ðə nˈɛkst dˈeɪz skˈɛdʒʊl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: so I know what's expected.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ nˈoʊ wˈʌts ɪkspˈɛktəd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'm also just someone who needs to mentally prepare for things.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪm ˈɔlsoʊ dʒˈʌst sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu nˈidz tˈu mˈɛntəli pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ θˈɪŋz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Like if I have a day packed with meetings, I need to mentally prepare for it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /lˈaɪk ˈɪf ˈaɪ hˈæv ə dˈeɪ pˈækt wˈɪð mˈitɪŋz ˈaɪ nˈid tˈu mˈɛntəli pɹipˈɛɹ fˈɔɹ ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: So having a physical calendar, something I can actually see,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈævɪŋ ə fˈɪzɪkəl kˈæləndɚ sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈaɪ kˈæn ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈi/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: not a notification, is what makes my peaceful mornings possible.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /nˈɑt ə nˌoʊtəfəkˈeɪʃən ˈɪz wˈʌt mˈeɪks mˈaɪ pˈisfəl mˈɔɹnɪŋz pˈɑsəbəl/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I know that everything I just described sounds like a routine,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ ˈaɪ dʒˈʌst dɪskɹˈaɪbd sˈaʊndz lˈaɪk ə ɹutˈin/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: but I don't call it that.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt kˈɔl ˈɪt ðˈæt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And here's why.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd hˈɪɹz wˈaɪ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I don't do all of this every day.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt dˈu ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈɪs ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: My nails now last so long, I don't even need to do them every day
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /mˈaɪ nˈeɪlz nˈaʊ lˈæst sˈoʊ lˈɔŋ ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn nˈid tˈu dˈu ðˈɛm ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: or even every week.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɔɹ ˈivɪn ˈɛvɚi wˈik/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: It's barely even a task.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɛɹli ˈivɪn ə tˈæsk/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If I've got somewhere
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪv ɡˈɑt sˈʌmwˌɛɹ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: to be and I don't have time to do red light therapy, I skip it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /tˈu bˈi ənd ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈaɪm tˈu dˈu ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt θˈɛɹəpi ˈaɪ skˈɪp ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If I can't make my matcha, I don't make my matcha.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ kˈænt mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt mˈeɪk mˈaɪ matcha/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: There's some mornings I do three things from this list and that's it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz sˈʌm mˈɔɹnɪŋz ˈaɪ dˈu θɹˈi θˈɪŋz fɹˈʌm ðˈɪs lˈɪst ənd ðˈæts ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I don't punish myself for not completing something.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt pˈʌnɪʃ mˌaɪsˈɛlf fˈɔɹ nˈɑt kəmplˈitɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: There's no streak I have to maintain.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz nˈoʊ stɹˈik ˈaɪ hˈæv tˈu meɪntˈeɪn/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And especially as women, we need to be in tune with our bodies
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd əspˈɛʃli ˈæz wˈɪmən wˈi nˈid tˈu bˈi ɪn tˈun wˈɪð ˈaʊɚ bˈɑdiz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: and do different things throughout the month.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd dˈu dˈɪfɚənt θˈɪŋz θɹuˈaʊt ðə mˈʌnθ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If I'm about to get my period,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪm əbˈaʊt tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈaɪ pˈɪɹiəd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: sometimes I don't have the energy to be doing all of this.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv ðə ˈɛnɚdʒi tˈu bˈi dˈuɪŋ ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈɪs/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I'll literally just sit on my couch and use my heating pad instead
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪtɚəli dʒˈʌst sˈɪt ˈɑn mˈaɪ kˈaʊtʃ ənd jˈus mˈaɪ hˈitɪŋ pˈæd ˌɪnstˈɛd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: because that's what my body needs.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ðˈæts wˈʌt mˈaɪ bˈɑdi nˈidz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I think sometimes we need to let go of being super rigid
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk səmtˈaɪmz wˈi nˈid tˈu lˈɛt ɡˈoʊ ˈʌv bˈiɪŋ sˈupɚ ɹˈɪdʒəd/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: and allow the fluidity of life.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd əlˈaʊ ðə fluˈɪdəti ˈʌv lˈaɪf/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: If your routine is not serving you and you don't even know
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈɔɹ ɹutˈin ˈɪz nˈɑt sˈɝvɪŋ jˈu ənd jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn nˈoʊ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: why you do certain things, we need to recalibrate that.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /wˈaɪ jˈu dˈu sˈɝtən θˈɪŋz wˈi nˈid tˈu recalibrate ðˈæt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: The whole point of living an intentional life is to know the reasons
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðə hˈoʊl pˈɔɪnt ˈʌv lˈɪvɪŋ ˈæn ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl lˈaɪf ˈɪz tˈu nˈoʊ ðə ɹˈizənz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: for why you do things.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /fˈɔɹ wˈaɪ jˈu dˈu θˈɪŋz/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: Because if you understand the reason for doing something,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪf jˈu ˌʌndɚstˈænd ðə ɹˈizən fˈɔɹ dˈuɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: you're more likely to be consistent with it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /jˈʊɹ mˈɔɹ lˈaɪkli tˈu bˈi kənsˈɪstənt wˈɪð ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And if something is not serving you or adding value to your morning,
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɪz nˈɑt sˈɝvɪŋ jˈu ˈɔɹ ˈædɪŋ vˈælju tˈu jˈɔɹ mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: then don't do it.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ðˈɛn dˈoʊnt dˈu ˈɪt/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I hope you enjoyed following me along on my morning routine.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈoʊp jˈu ˌɛndʒˈɔɪd fˈɑloʊɪŋ mˈi əlˈɔŋ ˈɑn mˈaɪ mˈɔɹnɪŋ ɹutˈin/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And if this inspired you, let me know in the comments.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ðˈɪs ˌɪnspˈaɪɚd jˈu lˈɛt mˈi nˈoʊ ɪn ðə kˈɑmɛnts/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: I am really curious about what you guys do in the morning.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˈæm ɹˈɪli kjˈʊɹiəs əbˈaʊt wˈʌt jˈu ɡˈaɪz dˈu ɪn ðə mˈɔɹnɪŋ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: So tell me in the comments what you do every day.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ tˈɛl mˈi ɪn ðə kˈɑmɛnts wˈʌt jˈu dˈu ˈɛvɚi dˈeɪ/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And if you're also a victim of the 5 a.m.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɔlsoʊ ə vˈɪktəm ˈʌv ðə 5 ˈæm/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: club, let me know, too.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /klˈʌb lˈɛt mˈi nˈoʊ tˈu/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: And if you liked this video, then you would really love this one.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪkt ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ ðˈɛn jˈu wˈʊd ɹˈɪli lˈʌv ðˈɪs wˈʌn/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: All right, I got to get my day started, but thanks
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt ˈaɪ ɡˈɑt tˈu ɡˈɛt mˈaɪ dˈeɪ stˈɑɹtɪd bˈʌt θˈæŋks/

Nrph1U5kY0Y.text: so much for watching, and I'll see you in the next one. Bye.
Nrph1U5kY0Y.ipa: /sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ fˈɔɹ wˈɑtʃɪŋ ənd ˈaɪl sˈi jˈu ɪn ðə nˈɛkst wˈʌn bˈaɪ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you've wondered why some people always seem to look polished,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈuv wˈʌndɚd wˈaɪ sˈʌm pˈipəl ˈɔlwˌeɪz sˈim tˈu lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn đã từng thắc mắc tại sao một số người luôn trông chỉnh tề,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: no matter where you catch them, they have this composure that seems effortless.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈoʊ mˈætɚ wˈɛɹ jˈu kˈætʃ ðˈɛm ðˈeɪ hˈæv ðˈɪs kəmpˈoʊʒɚ ðˈæt sˈimz ˈɛfɚtləs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Bất kể bạn bắt gặp chúng ở đâu, chúng đều có sự điềm tĩnh dường như không cần cố gắng.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: In this video, I want to share my top tips
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɪn ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ ˈaɪ wˈɑnt tˈu ʃˈɛɹ mˈaɪ tˈɑp tˈɪps/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Trong video này, tôi muốn chia sẻ những lời khuyên hàng đầu của mình

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and grooming habits make it easy to always look polished.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ɡɹˈumɪŋ hˈæbəts mˈeɪk ˈɪt ˈizi tˈu ˈɔlwˌeɪz lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và thói quen chăm sóc bản thân giúp bạn luôn trông chỉnh tề.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you're new to my channel, hi, I'm Juliana.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ nˈu tˈu mˈaɪ tʃˈænəl hˈaɪ ˈaɪm dʒˌuliˈænə/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn mới đến kênh của tôi, xin chào, tôi là Juliana.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'm going to go step by step, starting with the more foundational aspects.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪm ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu ɡˈoʊ stˈɛp bˈaɪ stˈɛp stˈɑɹtɪŋ wˈɪð ðə mˈɔɹ faʊndˈeɪʃənəl ˈæspˌɛkts/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ đi từng bước, bắt đầu với những khía cạnh nền tảng hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Your hair, skin, and nails play a huge role in terms
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ skˈɪn ənd nˈeɪlz plˈeɪ ə hjˈudʒ ɹˈoʊl ɪn tˈɝmz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tóc, da và móng tay của bạn đóng vai trò rất quan trọng trong các thuật ngữ

FHr_OxICTcg.text: of how put together you seem.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈʌv hˈaʊ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu sˈim/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: của việc bạn trông có vẻ chỉnh chu như thế nào.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I think hair makes the biggest difference.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk hˈɛɹ mˈeɪks ðə bˈɪɡəst dˈɪfɚəns/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi nghĩ kiểu tóc tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn nhất.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'm a huge proponent for heatless waves.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪm ə hjˈudʒ pɹəpˈoʊnənt fˈɔɹ heatless wˈeɪvz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi là người ủng hộ mạnh mẽ cho các kiểu tóc xoăn không dùng nhiệt.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'll link a video in the cards where I have a tutorial
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈɪŋk ə vˈɪdioʊ ɪn ðə kˈɑɹdz wˈɛɹ ˈaɪ hˈæv ə tutˈɔɹiəl/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi sẽ liên kết một video trong thẻ nơi tôi có hướng dẫn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: on how to do them.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɑn hˈaʊ tˈu dˈu ðˈɛm/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: về cách thực hiện chúng.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They save a lot of time and a lot of hair damage.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ sˈeɪv ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm ənd ə lˈɑt ˈʌv hˈɛɹ dˈæmədʒ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Họ tiết kiệm rất nhiều thời gian và giảm thiểu hư tổn tóc.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'm personally someone who loves to have my hair curled,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪm pˈɝsənəli sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu lˈʌvz tˈu hˈæv mˈaɪ hˈɛɹ kˈɝld/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Cá nhân tôi thích làm xoăn tóc,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: which I don't think would be as sustainable if I use heat tools.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt θˈɪŋk wˈʊd bˈi ˈæz səstˈeɪnəbəl ˈɪf ˈaɪ jˈus hˈit tˈulz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: mà tôi không nghĩ là bền vững bằng nếu tôi sử dụng dụng cụ tạo kiểu bằng nhiệt.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Some people, however, may not actually want curly hair.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈʌm pˈipəl hˌaʊˈɛvɚ mˈeɪ nˈɑt ˈæktʃˌuəli wˈɑnt kˈɝli hˈɛɹ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tuy nhiên, một số người có thể không thực sự muốn có mái tóc xoăn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Some people prefer straight hair or they have a different curl pattern.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈʌm pˈipəl pɹəfˈɝ stɹˈeɪt hˈɛɹ ˈɔɹ ðˈeɪ hˈæv ə dˈɪfɚənt kˈɝl pˈætɚn/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Một số người thích tóc thẳng hoặc họ có kiểu xoăn khác.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: The thing you want to focus
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðə θˈɪŋ jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Điều bạn muốn tập trung vào

FHr_OxICTcg.text: on when it comes to looking polished is to have a clean hair silhouette,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt ˈɪz tˈu hˈæv ə klˈin hˈɛɹ sˌɪləwˈɛt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: khi nói đến việc trông chỉnh tề là có một đường nét tóc gọn gàng,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: just like the silhouette of your body.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /dʒˈʌst lˈaɪk ðə sˌɪləwˈɛt ˈʌv jˈɔɹ bˈɑdi/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: như hình bóng cơ thể em vậy.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Your hair will take on a specific shape.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ wˈɪl tˈeɪk ˈɑn ə spəsˈɪfɪk ʃˈeɪp/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tóc của bạn sẽ có một hình dạng cụ thể.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: And hair will tend to look most polished when it has a very clean silhouette.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd hˈɛɹ wˈɪl tˈɛnd tˈu lˈʊk mˈoʊst pˈɑlɪʃt wˈɛn ˈɪt hˈæz ə vˈɛɹi klˈin sˌɪləwˈɛt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Và tóc sẽ có xu hướng trông bóng bẩy nhất khi nó có đường nét rất gọn gàng.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: By clean, it just means that it has a noticeable shape to it.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈaɪ klˈin ˈɪt dʒˈʌst mˈinz ðˈæt ˈɪt hˈæz ə nˈoʊtəsəbəl ʃˈeɪp tˈu ˈɪt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Bằng cách sạch sẽ, nó chỉ có nghĩa là nó có một hình dạng rõ ràng.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: And this shape can be straight, curly, or wavy
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ʃˈeɪp kˈæn bˈi stɹˈeɪt kˈɝli ˈɔɹ wˈeɪvi/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Và hình dạng này có thể thẳng, xoăn hoặc gợn sóng

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and not blurred with a lot of flyaways or frizzy hair.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd nˈɑt blˈɝd wˈɪð ə lˈɑt ˈʌv flyaways ˈɔɹ frizzy hˈɛɹ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và không bị xơ rối hay phồng xù.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Personally, my hair can get frizzy and puffy quite easily.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /pˈɝsənəli mˈaɪ hˈɛɹ kˈæn ɡˈɛt frizzy ənd pˈʌfi kwˈaɪt ˈizəli/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Cá nhân tôi, tóc tôi khá dễ bị xù và phồng lên.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So, two things that have helped me are a hair oil.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ tˈu θˈɪŋz ðˈæt hˈæv hˈɛlpt mˈi ˈɑɹ ə hˈɛɹ ˈɔɪl/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Vì vậy, hai thứ đã giúp tôi là một loại dầu dưỡng tóc.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I use this very sparingly.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ jˈus ðˈɪs vˈɛɹi spˈɛɹɪŋli/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi sử dụng cái này rất hạn chế.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you have finer hair, but I love this one from Keristas.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv fˈaɪnɚ hˈɛɹ bˈʌt ˈaɪ lˈʌv ðˈɪs wˈʌn fɹˈʌm keristas/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn có mái tóc mỏng hơn, nhưng tôi thích loại này của Keristas.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's the elixir all team.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts ðə ɪlˈɪksɚ ˈɔl tˈim/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Đó là thuốc tiên của cả đội.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I love a shine spray or a smoothing spray.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ə ʃˈaɪn spɹˈeɪ ˈɔɹ ə smˈuðɪŋ spɹˈeɪ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi thích xịt bóng hoặc xịt làm mượt.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Garnier Fis is their diamond sleek smoothing spray.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɡˈɑɹniɚ fˈɪs ˈɪz ðˈɛɹ dˈaɪmənd slˈik smˈuðɪŋ spɹˈeɪ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Garnier Fis là xịt dưỡng tóc bóng mượt kim cương của họ.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: You also want to choose eyebrows that suit your face.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈu ˈɔlsoʊ wˈɑnt tˈu tʃˈuz ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz ðˈæt sˈut jˈɔɹ fˈeɪs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Bạn cũng muốn chọn lông mày phù hợp với khuôn mặt của mình.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you're unsure about the best eyebrows for your features,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ənʃˈʊɹ əbˈaʊt ðə bˈɛst ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz fˈɔɹ jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn không chắc chắn về kiểu lông mày nào phù hợp nhất với các đường nét trên khuôn mặt của mình,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: thinner eyebrows tend to look best on those with smaller eyes
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /θˈɪnɚ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz tˈɛnd tˈu lˈʊk bˈɛst ˈɑn ðˈoʊz wˈɪð smˈɔlɚ ˈaɪz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: lông mày thon hơn có xu hướng trông đẹp nhất trên những người có đôi mắt nhỏ hơn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and or a softer gaze compared to thicker eyebrows
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ˈɔɹ ə sˈɑftɚ ɡˈeɪz kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu θˈɪkɚ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và hoặc một ánh nhìn dịu dàng hơn so với lông mày dày hơn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: which work best with larger eyes and or a stronger gaze.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɝk bˈɛst wˈɪð lˈɑɹdʒɚ ˈaɪz ənd ˈɔɹ ə stɹˈɔŋɚ ɡˈeɪz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: công việc nào phù hợp nhất với đôi mắt to hơn và/hoặc ánh nhìn mạnh mẽ hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's all about choosing a style that looks proportional.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔl əbˈaʊt tʃˈuzɪŋ ə stˈaɪl ðˈæt lˈʊks pɹəpˈɔɹʃənəl/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tất cả là về việc chọn một phong cách trông cân đối.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Go for a straighter brow shape.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɡˈoʊ fˈɔɹ ə stɹˈeɪtɚ bɹˈaʊ ʃˈeɪp/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tạo dáng lông mày thẳng hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you want to appear youthful and approachable, it creates a softer like kind of nicer.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu əpˈɪɹ jˈuθfəl ənd əpɹˈoʊtʃəbəl ˈɪt kɹiˈeɪts ə sˈɑftɚ lˈaɪk kˈaɪnd ˈʌv nˈaɪsɚ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu bạn muốn trông trẻ trung và dễ gần, nó tạo ra một cảm giác mềm mại, dễ chịu hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Expression on the face compared to arch eyebrows, which can look more intimidating
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɪkspɹˈɛʃən ˈɑn ðə fˈeɪs kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ˈɑɹtʃ ˈaɪbɹˌaʊz wˈɪtʃ kˈæn lˈʊk mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɪmɪdˌeɪtɪŋ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Biểu cảm trên khuôn mặt so với lông mày cong, cái nào có thể trông đáng sợ hơn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but also very elegant and feline.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ vˈɛɹi ˈɛləɡənt ənd fˈilˌaɪn/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: nhưng cũng rất thanh lịch và giống mèo.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It has a nice lifting effect for the eyes.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈæz ə nˈaɪs lˈɪftɪŋ ɪfˈɛkt fˈɔɹ ðə ˈaɪz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nó có tác dụng nâng cơ mắt rất tốt.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Now, when it comes to makeup,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈaʊ wˈɛn ˈɪt kˈʌmz tˈu mˈeɪkˌʌp/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Còn khi nói đến trang điểm,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I don't really think you have to wear makeup to look polished,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈoʊnt ɹˈɪli θˈɪŋk jˈu hˈæv tˈu wˈɛɹ mˈeɪkˌʌp tˈu lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi không thực sự nghĩ rằng bạn phải trang điểm để trông chỉnh tề.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and honestly, the wrong makeup or smudged makeup can detract, uh, from your appearance.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ˈɑnəstli ðə ɹˈɔŋ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɔɹ smˈʌdʒd mˈeɪkˌʌp kˈæn dɪtɹˈækt ˈʌ fɹˈʌm jˈɔɹ əpˈɪɹəns/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và thành thật mà nói, lớp trang điểm sai hoặc bị lem có thể làm giảm, ờ, vẻ ngoài của bạn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So, you really want to find a style you like
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ jˈu ɹˈɪli wˈɑnt tˈu fˈaɪnd ə stˈaɪl jˈu lˈaɪk/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Vậy, bạn thực sự muốn tìm một phong cách mà bạn thích

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and only wear makeup as long as you feel like it can last on your face.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ˈoʊnli wˈɛɹ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈæz lˈɔŋ ˈæz jˈu fˈil lˈaɪk ˈɪt kˈæn lˈæst ˈɑn jˈɔɹ fˈeɪs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và chỉ trang điểm miễn là bạn cảm thấy nó có thể giữ trên mặt bạn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If your purpose for applying makeup is to make you look more lively
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈɔɹ pˈɝpəs fˈɔɹ əplˈaɪɪŋ mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɪz tˈu mˈeɪk jˈu lˈʊk mˈɔɹ lˈaɪvli/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nếu mục đích của bạn khi trang điểm là để trông bạn rạng rỡ hơn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and healthy, then I would just focus on bright under eyes,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd hˈɛlθi ðˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈʊd dʒˈʌst fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn bɹˈaɪt ˈʌndɚ ˈaɪz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và khỏe mạnh, thì tôi sẽ chỉ tập trung vào vùng dưới mắt sáng,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: groomed eyebrow hairs, and rouge on the cheeks and the lips.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɡɹˈumd ˈaɪbɹˌaʊ hˈɛɹz ənd ɹˈuʒ ˈɑn ðə tʃˈiks ənd ðə lˈɪps/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: lông mày được tỉa gọn gàng, má và môi được tô son hồng.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Makeup will essentially increase your contrast level, which is the shade difference between your features.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /mˈeɪkˌʌp wˈɪl ɛsˈɛnʃəli ˌɪnkɹˈis jˈɔɹ kˈɑntɹæst lˈɛvəl wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðə ʃˈeɪd dˈɪfɚəns bɪtwˈin jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Trang điểm về cơ bản sẽ làm tăng mức độ tương phản của bạn, đó là sự khác biệt về sắc thái giữa các đường nét trên khuôn mặt bạn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This makes a person look more healthy and vibrant.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs mˈeɪks ə pˈɝsən lˈʊk mˈɔɹ hˈɛlθi ənd vˈaɪbɹənt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Điều này làm cho người ta trông khỏe mạnh và tràn đầy sức sống hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Jewelry makes a huge difference when you have jewelry that's cohesive
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /dʒˈuəlɹi mˈeɪks ə hjˈudʒ dˈɪfɚəns wˈɛn jˈu hˈæv dʒˈuəlɹi ðˈæts koʊhˈisɪv/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Trang sức tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn khi bạn có những món trang sức hài hòa với nhau

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and matches well to your outfit.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd mˈætʃəz wˈɛl tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và hợp với trang phục của bạn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: The addition of small, sparkly elements does make you look more visually complex,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðə ədˈɪʃən ˈʌv smˈɔl spˈɑɹkli ˈɛləmənts dˈʌz mˈeɪk jˈu lˈʊk mˈɔɹ vˈɪʒwəli kˈɑmplɛks/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Việc bổ sung các yếu tố nhỏ, lấp lánh làm cho bạn trông phức tạp hơn về mặt thị giác,

FHr_OxICTcg.text: giving the impression of looking more dressed up.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɡˈɪvɪŋ ðə ˌɪmpɹˈɛʃən ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ mˈɔɹ dɹˈɛst ˈʌp/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: tạo ấn tượng về việc trông lịch sự hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: And this is such a hack
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌtʃ ə hˈæk/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Và đây là một mẹo hay như vậy

FHr_OxICTcg.text: because you don't actually have to put much effort into your jewelry.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli hˈæv tˈu pˈʊt mˈʌtʃ ˈɛfɚt ˈɪntu jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: bởi vì bạn không thực sự phải tốn nhiều công sức vào đồ trang sức của mình.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Nor do you need to have a huge jewelry collection you just want to have intentional
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈɔɹ dˈu jˈu nˈid tˈu hˈæv ə hjˈudʒ dʒˈuəlɹi kəlˈɛkʃən jˈu dʒˈʌst wˈɑnt tˈu hˈæv ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Bạn cũng không cần phải có một bộ sưu tập trang sức khổng lồ, bạn chỉ cần có ý định

FHr_OxICTcg.text: pieces that match your wardrobe and are tarnish
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /pˈisəz ðˈæt mˈætʃ jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd ˈɑɹ tˈɑɹnɪʃ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: những món đồ phù hợp với tủ quần áo của bạn và bị xỉn màu

FHr_OxICTcg.text: proof. Even something simple like a necklace just elevates your outfit
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /pɹˈuf ˈivɪn sˈʌmθɪŋ sˈɪmpəl lˈaɪk ə nˈɛkləs dʒˈʌst ˈɛləvˌeɪts jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: bằng chứng. Ngay cả một thứ đơn giản như vòng cổ cũng làm tăng thêm vẻ đẹp cho trang phục của bạn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and makes it look more intentional.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd mˈeɪks ˈɪt lˈʊk mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: và làm cho nó trông có chủ ý hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I do love a statement earring, like a chunky earring like this.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈu lˈʌv ə stˈeɪtmənt ˈɪɹɪŋ lˈaɪk ə tʃˈʌŋki ˈɪɹɪŋ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi rất thích hoa tai bản lớn, kiểu hoa tai dày như thế này.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It really brings the whole outfit together and frames the face.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪt ɹˈɪli bɹˈɪŋz ðə hˈoʊl ˈaʊtfˌɪt təɡˈɛðɚ ənd fɹˈeɪmz ðə fˈeɪs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Nó thực sự làm cho toàn bộ trang phục trở nên hài hòa và tạo khung cho khuôn mặt.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Accessories overall make a huge difference because they add dimension to an outfit.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /æksˈɛsɚiz ˈoʊvɚˌɔl mˈeɪk ə hjˈudʒ dˈɪfɚəns bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ ˈæd dɪmˈɛnʃən tˈu ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Phụ kiện nhìn chung tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn vì chúng thêm chiều sâu cho trang phục.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They make a person appear more put together since the outfit itself looks more intentionally curated.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ mˈeɪk ə pˈɝsən əpˈɪɹ mˈɔɹ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ sˈɪns ðə ˈaʊtfˌɪt ˌɪtsˈɛlf lˈʊks mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli kjʊɹˈeɪtɪd/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Chúng khiến người mặc trông chỉnh tề hơn vì bản thân bộ trang phục trông có vẻ được phối hợp có chủ đích hơn.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Beyond your jewelry, you can do this with an intentional belt or an elegant purse.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bɪˈɑnd jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi jˈu kˈæn dˈu ðˈɪs wˈɪð ˈæn ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəl bˈɛlt ˈɔɹ ˈæn ˈɛləɡənt pˈɝs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Ngoài trang sức của bạn, bạn có thể làm điều này với một chiếc thắt lưng có chủ ý hoặc một chiếc ví thanh lịch.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'm so excited to be partnering with Parisa Wong for this video.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪm sˈoʊ ɪksˈaɪtəd tˈu bˈi pˈɑɹtnɚɪŋ wˈɪð parisa wˈɔŋ fˈɔɹ ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi rất vui mừng được hợp tác với Parisa Wong cho video này.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I really resonate with their brand philosophy.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli ɹˈɛzənˌeɪt wˈɪð ðˈɛɹ bɹˈænd fəlˈɑsəfi/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Tôi thực sự đồng cảm với triết lý thương hiệu của họ.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They believe that luxury should be accessible to everyone.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ bɪlˈiv ðˈæt lˈʌɡʒɚi ʃˈʊd bˈi æksˈɛsəbəl tˈu ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Họ tin rằng sự xa hoa nên dành cho tất cả mọi người.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Their products focus on elevated designs and quality craftsmanship.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ pɹˈɑdəkts fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn ˈɛləvˌeɪtɪd dɪzˈaɪnz ənd kwˈɑləti kɹˈæftsmənʃˌɪp/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Sản phẩm của họ tập trung vào thiết kế tinh tế và tay nghề chất lượng cao.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They're exactly the pieces to have in your wardrobe
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ɪɡzˈæktli ðə pˈisəz tˈu hˈæv ɪn jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: Chúng là những món đồ hoàn hảo để có trong tủ quần áo của bạn

FHr_OxICTcg.text: if you want to look elegant and effortless.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu lˈʊk ˈɛləɡənt ənd ˈɛfɚtləs/
FHr_OxICTcg.vietnamese_text: nếu bạn muốn trông thanh lịch và tự nhiên.

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They use responsibly sourced leathers and produce in small batches.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ jˈus ɹɪspˈɑnsəbli sourced lˈɛðɚz ənd pɹədˈus ɪn smˈɔl bˈætʃəz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: The model that I have with me is the Gabrielle.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðə mˈɑdəl ðˈæt ˈaɪ hˈæv wˈɪð mˈi ˈɪz ðə ɡˈæbɹiɛl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I love a top handle bag.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv ə tˈɑp hˈændəl bˈæɡ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Something about a purse in the crook of your elbow is so ladylike to me.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ əbˈaʊt ə pˈɝs ɪn ðə kɹˈʊk ˈʌv jˈɔɹ ˈɛlbˌoʊ ˈɪz sˈoʊ lˈeɪdilˌaɪk tˈu mˈi/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: She's gorgeous and actually quite roomy.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ʃˈiz ɡˈɔɹdʒəs ənd ˈæktʃˌuəli kwˈaɪt ɹˈumi/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: She has feet at the bottom, which I think elevates any purse.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ʃˈi hˈæz fˈit ˈæt ðə bˈɑtəm wˈɪtʃ ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɛləvˌeɪts ˈɛni pˈɝs/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I wanted to choose this taupe tan color because this is a color
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɔntɪd tˈu tʃˈuz ðˈɪs taupe tˈæn kˈʌlɚ bɪkˈɔz ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə kˈʌlɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that you can wear all year round.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu kˈæn wˈɛɹ ˈɔl jˈɪɹ ɹˈaʊnd/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It has gorgeous gold hardware, and you can really dress it up or down.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪt hˈæz ɡˈɔɹdʒəs ɡˈoʊld hˈɑɹdwˌɛɹ ənd jˈu kˈæn ɹˈɪli dɹˈɛs ˈɪt ˈʌp ˈɔɹ dˈaʊn/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: My wardrobe is also so neutral, so it really goes with all my outfits.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /mˈaɪ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ˈɪz ˈɔlsoʊ sˈoʊ nˈutɹəl sˈoʊ ˈɪt ɹˈɪli ɡˈoʊz wˈɪð ˈɔl mˈaɪ ˈaʊtfˌɪts/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Let me show you how I style it.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /lˈɛt mˈi ʃˈoʊ jˈu hˈaʊ ˈaɪ stˈaɪl ˈɪt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This bag works so well with fall jackets, especially with longer coats.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs bˈæɡ wˈɝks sˈoʊ wˈɛl wˈɪð fˈɔl dʒˈækɪts əspˈɛʃli wˈɪð lˈɔŋɡɚ kˈoʊts/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I tend to go with a cross body. so I love
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ tˈɛnd tˈu ɡˈoʊ wˈɪð ə kɹˈɔs bˈɑdi sˈoʊ ˈaɪ lˈʌv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that it comes with the cross body strap.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt kˈʌmz wˈɪð ðə kɹˈɔs bˈɑdi stɹˈæp/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: The colors just go so well together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðə kˈʌlɚz dʒˈʌst ɡˈoʊ sˈoʊ wˈɛl təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Something like this for fall is casual but put together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ lˈaɪk ðˈɪs fˈɔɹ fˈɔl ˈɪz kˈæʒəwəl bˈʌt pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I love doing three color outfits.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈʌv dˈuɪŋ θɹˈi kˈʌlɚ ˈaʊtfˌɪts/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I feel like it makes an outfit look very clean and cohesive.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ fˈil lˈaɪk ˈɪt mˈeɪks ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt lˈʊk vˈɛɹi klˈin ənd koʊhˈisɪv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's very Upper East Side, New York.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi ˈʌpɚ ˈist sˈaɪd nˈu jˈɔɹk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Because of the size of this bag, you can really dress it up as well.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈʌv ðə sˈaɪz ˈʌv ðˈɪs bˈæɡ jˈu kˈæn ɹˈɪli dɹˈɛs ˈɪt ˈʌp ˈæz wˈɛl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's just small enough
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts dʒˈʌst smˈɔl ɪnˈʌf/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that it could be a really great date night purse for nice events.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt kˈʊd bˈi ə ɹˈɪli ɡɹˈeɪt dˈeɪt nˈaɪt pˈɝs fˈɔɹ nˈaɪs ɪvˈɛnts/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I think it's such a chameleon.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɪts sˈʌtʃ ə kəmˈiliən/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It works with your entire wardrobe, and it makes getting dressed and looking polished much easier.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɝks wˈɪð jˈɔɹ ɪntˈaɪɚ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd ˈɪt mˈeɪks ɡˈɛtɪŋ dɹˈɛst ənd lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt mˈʌtʃ ˈiziɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Thank you so much, Parisa Wong, for sponsoring this video.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ parisa wˈɔŋ fˈɔɹ spˈɑnsɚɪŋ ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I'll leave a link to the purse in my description.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪl lˈiv ə lˈɪŋk tˈu ðə pˈɝs ɪn mˈaɪ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: These are purses for a capsule wardrobe and pieces you'll love forever,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈiz ˈɑɹ pˈɝsɪz fˈɔɹ ə kˈæpsəl wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ənd pˈisəz jˈul lˈʌv fɚˈɛvɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: so definitely check them out if you're interested.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ dˈɛfənətli tʃˈɛk ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ˈɪf jˈʊɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: All right, continuing with wardrobe.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɔl ɹˈaɪt kəntˈɪnjuɪŋ wˈɪð wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Those who look put together don't necessarily have a huge wardrobe they just have a wardrobe
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈoʊz hˈu lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ dˈoʊnt nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli hˈæv ə hjˈudʒ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ðˈeɪ dʒˈʌst hˈæv ə wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that works well together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɝks wˈɛl təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Each piece, or at least most pieces, match each other in color
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈitʃ pˈis ˈɔɹ ˈæt lˈist mˈoʊst pˈisəz mˈætʃ ˈitʃ ˈʌðɚ ɪn kˈʌlɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and style, so pairing them together, even
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd stˈaɪl sˈoʊ pˈɛɹɪŋ ðˈɛm təɡˈɛðɚ ˈivɪn/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: if you don't have a lot of time or not interested in dressing up,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv ə lˈɑt ˈʌv tˈaɪm ˈɔɹ nˈɑt ˈɪntɹəstɪd ɪn dɹˈɛsɪŋ ˈʌp/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: it'll still look cohesive.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪtəl stˈɪl lˈʊk koʊhˈisɪv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This is why capsule wardrobes are so popular and so powerful.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈaɪ kˈæpsəl wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊbz ˈɑɹ sˈoʊ pˈɑpjəlɚ ənd sˈoʊ pˈaʊɚfəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They really maximize how polished you can look with how few pieces you can have.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ɹˈɪli mˈæksəmˌaɪz hˈaʊ pˈɑlɪʃt jˈu kˈæn lˈʊk wˈɪð hˈaʊ fjˈu pˈisəz jˈu kˈæn hˈæv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Like with your jewelry, you really don't need a huge wardrobe of clothing.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /lˈaɪk wˈɪð jˈɔɹ dʒˈuəlɹi jˈu ɹˈɪli dˈoʊnt nˈid ə hjˈudʒ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ˈʌv klˈoʊðɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Honestly, that can make getting dressed overwhelming
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɑnəstli ðˈæt kˈæn mˈeɪk ɡˈɛtɪŋ dɹˈɛst ˌoʊvɚwˈɛlmɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and actually make it harder to look put together
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ˈæktʃˌuəli mˈeɪk ˈɪt hˈɑɹdɚ tˈu lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: because it can become too complex to make sure that an outfit looks fully cohesive.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈɪt kˈæn bɪkˈʌm tˈu kˈɑmplɛks tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt lˈʊks fˈʊli koʊhˈisɪv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Instead, you want to build your wardrobe so that it suits you.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˌɪnstˈɛd jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu bˈɪld jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb sˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪt sˈuts jˈu/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: There are certain, uh, universal rules in terms of looking polished.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ sˈɝtən ˈʌ jˌunəvˈɝsəl ɹˈulz ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ pˈɑlɪʃt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: There's no unintentional holes, rips, or tears in your clothing, as well as really scuffed shoes.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz nˈoʊ ˌʌnɪntˈɛnʃənəl hˈoʊlz ɹˈɪps ˈɔɹ tˈɛɹz ɪn jˈɔɹ klˈoʊðɪŋ ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz ɹˈɪli skˈʌft ʃˈuz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I think every girl or every person honestly should have a steamer in their wardrobe,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɛvɚi ɡˈɝl ˈɔɹ ˈɛvɚi pˈɝsən ˈɑnəstli ʃˈʊd hˈæv ə stˈimɚ ɪn ðˈɛɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: especially if you wear like silk, cotton, sometimes linen certain fabrics
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈu wˈɛɹ lˈaɪk sˈɪlk kˈɑtən səmtˈaɪmz lˈɪnən sˈɝtən fˈæbɹɪks/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that I think are very high quality.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk ˈɑɹ vˈɛɹi hˈaɪ kwˈɑləti/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They can be a little temperamental in terms of wrinkling and creasing.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ kˈæn bˈi ə lˈɪtəl tˌɛmpɹəmˈɛntəl ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ɹˈɪŋkəlɪŋ ənd creasing/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Another thing is if you have pets, definitely have a lint roller in your wardrobe.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənˈʌðɚ θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv pˈɛts dˈɛfənətli hˈæv ə lˈɪnt ɹˈoʊlɚ ɪn jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Once we get past the basics, though, we want to focus on timeless clothing pieces.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈʌns wˈi ɡˈɛt pˈæst ðə bˈeɪsɪks ðˈoʊ wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn tˈaɪmləs klˈoʊðɪŋ pˈisəz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Timeless pieces tend to be fitted but not skin tight they often follow the natural silhouette.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /tˈaɪmləs pˈisəz tˈɛnd tˈu bˈi fˈɪtəd bˈʌt nˈɑt skˈɪn tˈaɪt ðˈeɪ ˈɔfən fˈɑloʊ ðə nˈætʃɚəl sˌɪləwˈɛt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This can mean things like a-ine skirts, tailored blazers, and just pieces
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈæn mˈin θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk ˈeɪn skˈɝts tˈeɪlɚd blˈeɪzɚz ənd dʒˈʌst pˈisəz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that are not ultra tight or ultra baggy.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ nˈɑt ˈʌltɹə tˈaɪt ˈɔɹ ˈʌltɹə bˈæɡi/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's also very flattering to mix loose and tight pieces in your outfit.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ vˈɛɹi flˈætɚɪŋ tˈu mˈɪks lˈus ənd tˈaɪt pˈisəz ɪn jˈɔɹ ˈaʊtfˌɪt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Too many loose pieces, especially if you're curvy, can look shapeless,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /tˈu mˈɛni lˈus pˈisəz əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ kˈɝvi kˈæn lˈʊk ʃˈeɪpləs/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: whereas too many tight pieces, especially if you're less curvy
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wɛɹˈæz tˈu mˈɛni tˈaɪt pˈisəz əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈɛs kˈɝvi/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: or you don't feel comfortable in very tight clothing, can feel too stiff.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɔɹ jˈu dˈoʊnt fˈil kˈʌmfɚtəbəl ɪn vˈɛɹi tˈaɪt klˈoʊðɪŋ kˈæn fˈil tˈu stˈɪf/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So instead, mixing the pieces tends to be the happy medium.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˌɪnstˈɛd mˈɪksɪŋ ðə pˈisəz tˈɛndz tˈu bˈi ðə hˈæpi mˈidiəm/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you're not sure where to put the tight and the loose pieces,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ʃˈʊɹ wˈɛɹ tˈu pˈʊt ðə tˈaɪt ənd ðə lˈus pˈisəz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: wear tight clothing in areas that you want to shrink
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɛɹ tˈaɪt klˈoʊðɪŋ ɪn ˈɛɹiəz ðˈæt jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu ʃɹˈɪŋk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: or to exaggerate, like a dress that's tight at the waist and flares out.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɔɹ tˈu ɪɡzˈædʒɚˌeɪt lˈaɪk ə dɹˈɛs ðˈæts tˈaɪt ˈæt ðə wˈeɪst ənd flˈɛɹz ˈaʊt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: The area that you're emphasizing is your waist.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðə ˈɛɹiə ðˈæt jˈʊɹ ˈɛmfəsˌaɪzɪŋ ˈɪz jˈɔɹ wˈeɪst/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Loose, really unstructured, puffy pieces these just add volume.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /lˈus ɹˈɪli ənstɹˈʌkʃɚd pˈʌfi pˈisəz ðˈiz dʒˈʌst ˈæd vˈɑljum/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So, if you like more volume around your shoulders, around your hips,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu lˈaɪk mˈɔɹ vˈɑljum ɚˈaʊnd jˈɔɹ ʃˈoʊldɚz ɚˈaʊnd jˈɔɹ hˈɪps/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: this can be a really, uh, useful tool.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈæn bˈi ə ɹˈɪli ˈʌ jˈusfəl tˈul/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Whereas loose structured pieces, like a blazer with structured shoulders,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wɛɹˈæz lˈus stɹˈʌktʃɚd pˈisəz lˈaɪk ə blˈeɪzɚ wˈɪð stɹˈʌktʃɚd ʃˈoʊldɚz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: this is really great to streamline an area, make an area look very sleek and clean.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɹˈɪli ɡɹˈeɪt tˈu stɹˈimlˌaɪn ˈæn ˈɛɹiə mˈeɪk ˈæn ˈɛɹiə lˈʊk vˈɛɹi slˈik ənd klˈin/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Those that look put together will also dress in their best colors.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈoʊz ðˈæt lˈʊk pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ wˈɪl ˈɔlsoʊ dɹˈɛs ɪn ðˈɛɹ bˈɛst kˈʌlɚz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This comes down a lot to your undertone.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈʌmz dˈaʊn ə lˈɑt tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you have a warmer undertone, choose warm, earthy shades whereas,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə wˈɔɹmɚ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn tʃˈuz wˈɔɹm ˈɝθi ʃˈeɪdz wɛɹˈæz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: if you have a cooler undertone, go for cooler, ashy shades.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə kˈulɚ ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn ɡˈoʊ fˈɔɹ kˈulɚ ˈæʃi ʃˈeɪdz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you have a neutral undertone like personally, I'm more neutral
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv ə nˈutɹəl ˈʌndɚtˌoʊn lˈaɪk pˈɝsənəli ˈaɪm mˈɔɹ nˈutɹəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: then you can tap into both palettes.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɛn jˈu kˈæn tˈæp ˈɪntu bˈoʊθ palettes/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Another thing with colors is how bright and intense they are.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənˈʌðɚ θˈɪŋ wˈɪð kˈʌlɚz ˈɪz hˈaʊ bɹˈaɪt ənd ˌɪntˈɛns ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: This will depend on your contrast level.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs wˈɪl dɪpˈɛnd ˈɑn jˈɔɹ kˈɑntɹæst lˈɛvəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If you're someone who's more high contrast, like personally I am higher contrast.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈuz mˈɔɹ hˈaɪ kˈɑntɹæst lˈaɪk pˈɝsənəli ˈaɪ ˈæm hˈaɪɚ kˈɑntɹæst/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Where you have darker hair and lighter skin, or darker hair
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɛɹ jˈu hˈæv dˈɑɹkɚ hˈɛɹ ənd lˈaɪtɚ skˈɪn ˈɔɹ dˈɑɹkɚ hˈɛɹ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and skin that contrasts a lot with the whites of your eyes
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd skˈɪn ðˈæt kˈɑntɹæsts ə lˈɑt wˈɪð ðə wˈaɪts ˈʌv jˈɔɹ ˈaɪz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and your teeth, then more intense, bold colors and saturated shades will suit you most.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd jˈɔɹ tˈiθ ðˈɛn mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛns bˈoʊld kˈʌlɚz ənd sˈætʃɚˌeɪtɪd ʃˈeɪdz wˈɪl sˈut jˈu mˈoʊst/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: They don't have to necessarily be neons,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈeɪ dˈoʊnt hˈæv tˈu nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli bˈi nˈiˌɑnz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but the intensity should be there to match your features.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə ɪntˈɛnsəti ʃˈʊd bˈi ðˈɛɹ tˈu mˈætʃ jˈɔɹ fˈitʃɚz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Compared to if you have very low contrast, especially with lighter complexions,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /kəmpˈɛɹd tˈu ˈɪf jˈu hˈæv vˈɛɹi lˈoʊ kˈɑntɹæst əspˈɛʃli wˈɪð lˈaɪtɚ kəmplˈɛkʃənz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: you often look best in more muted shades, as well as patterns and prints.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈu ˈɔfən lˈʊk bˈɛst ɪn mˈɔɹ mjˈutɪd ʃˈeɪdz ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz pˈætɚnz ənd pɹˈɪnts/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: These tend to make a color especially stronger colors look less saturated
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈiz tˈɛnd tˈu mˈeɪk ə kˈʌlɚ əspˈɛʃli stɹˈɔŋɚ kˈʌlɚz lˈʊk lˈɛs sˈætʃɚˌeɪtɪd/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and make them a little softer and more flattering.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd mˈeɪk ðˈɛm ə lˈɪtəl sˈɑftɚ ənd mˈɔɹ flˈætɚɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Now, the whole point to choosing the right colors for your wardrobe is not just based
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðə hˈoʊl pˈɔɪnt tˈu tʃˈuzɪŋ ðə ɹˈaɪt kˈʌlɚz fˈɔɹ jˈɔɹ wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb ˈɪz nˈɑt dʒˈʌst bˈeɪst/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: on picking colors you like,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɑn pˈɪkɪŋ kˈʌlɚz jˈu lˈaɪk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but the right colors will make all the difference in terms of making
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə ɹˈaɪt kˈʌlɚz wˈɪl mˈeɪk ˈɔl ðə dˈɪfɚəns ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv mˈeɪkɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: you look your most radiant.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈu lˈʊk jˈɔɹ mˈoʊst ɹˈeɪdˌiənt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Even when you don't have a bunch of makeup or hair done,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈivɪn wˈɛn jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɔɹ hˈɛɹ dˈʌn/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: if you choose the right colors, you will look more put together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu tʃˈuz ðə ɹˈaɪt kˈʌlɚz jˈu wˈɪl lˈʊk mˈɔɹ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Compare this to if you wear a color
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /kəmpˈɛɹ ðˈɪs tˈu ˈɪf jˈu wˈɛɹ ə kˈʌlɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that really washes you out you have to compensate a lot with more intense makeup
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt ɹˈɪli wˈɑʃɪz jˈu ˈaʊt jˈu hˈæv tˈu kˈɑmpənsˌeɪt ə lˈɑt wˈɪð mˈɔɹ ˌɪntˈɛns mˈeɪkˌʌp/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and hair in order to still look polished.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd hˈɛɹ ɪn ˈɔɹdɚ tˈu stˈɪl lˈʊk pˈɑlɪʃt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Now, if you want to build a classic wardrobe,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈaʊ ˈɪf jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu bˈɪld ə klˈæsɪk wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: especially one that's suited for your body type and features,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /əspˈɛʃli wˈʌn ðˈæts sˈutɪd fˈɔɹ jˈɔɹ bˈɑdi tˈaɪp ənd fˈitʃɚz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but you're not really sure where to start in terms of shopping,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈʊɹ nˈɑt ɹˈɪli ʃˈʊɹ wˈɛɹ tˈu stˈɑɹt ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv ʃˈɑpɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I definitely recommend joining my Substack.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ dˈɛfənətli ɹˌɛkəmˈɛnd dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ mˈaɪ substack/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I absolutely love my Substack community, and thank you guys so much.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ ˌæbsəlˈutli lˈʌv mˈaɪ substack kəmjˈunəti ənd θˈæŋk jˈu ɡˈaɪz sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So many of you guys have come over to my Substack already, which is so exciting.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ mˈɛni ˈʌv jˈu ɡˈaɪz hˈæv kˈʌm ˈoʊvɚ tˈu mˈaɪ substack ɔlɹˈɛdi wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz sˈoʊ ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Thank you so much.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /θˈæŋk jˈu sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: On my Substack, I post weekly shoppable lookbooks
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɑn mˈaɪ substack ˈaɪ pˈoʊst wˈikli shoppable lookbooks/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and fully styled outfits with the different body types and complexions in mind.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd fˈʊli stˈaɪld ˈaʊtfˌɪts wˈɪð ðə dˈɪfɚənt bˈɑdi tˈaɪps ənd kəmplˈɛkʃənz ɪn mˈaɪnd/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I post these every Sunday.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ pˈoʊst ðˈiz ˈɛvɚi sˈʌndˌeɪ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Right now, I'm in my fall content,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ ˈaɪm ɪn mˈaɪ fˈɔl kˈɑntɛnt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but we're going to be moving into fall to winter as well as holidays soon.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈiɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈi mˈuvɪŋ ˈɪntu fˈɔl tˈu wˈɪntɚ ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz hˈɑlədˌeɪz sˈun/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: I really focus on pieces that not only will look good in an outfit,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹˈɪli fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn pˈisəz ðˈæt nˈɑt ˈoʊnli wˈɪl lˈʊk ɡˈʊd ɪn ˈæn ˈaʊtfˌɪt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but really build out into a greater sophisticated wardrobe.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt ɹˈɪli bˈɪld ˈaʊt ˈɪntu ə ɡɹˈeɪtɚ səfˈɪstəkˌeɪtɪd wˈɔɹdɹˌoʊb/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: So, if you are interested, I'll leave the link to my Substack in my description.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf jˈu ˈɑɹ ˈɪntɹəstɪd ˈaɪl lˈiv ðə lˈɪŋk tˈu mˈaɪ substack ɪn mˈaɪ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Now, this last step is a little more nuanced, but it's very essential.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /nˈaʊ ðˈɪs lˈæst stˈɛp ˈɪz ə lˈɪtəl mˈɔɹ nˈuɑnst bˈʌt ˈɪts vˈɛɹi ɛsˈɛnʃəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Even if you follow all my tips from the earlier part of this video,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf jˈu fˈɑloʊ ˈɔl mˈaɪ tˈɪps fɹˈʌm ðə ˈɝliɚ pˈɑɹt ˈʌv ðˈɪs vˈɪdioʊ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but you neglect this last step, the whole thing can kind of fall apart.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt jˈu nəɡlˈɛkt ðˈɪs lˈæst stˈɛp ðə hˈoʊl θˈɪŋ kˈæn kˈaɪnd ˈʌv fˈɔl əpˈɑɹt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: You not only want to focus on a polished appearance, but also a composed demeanor.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈu nˈɑt ˈoʊnli wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn ə pˈɑlɪʃt əpˈɪɹəns bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ə kəmpˈoʊzd dɪmˈinɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: One of the easiest ways to look collected and composed is with your posture.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ˈiziəst wˈeɪz tˈu lˈʊk kəlˈɛktəd ənd kəmpˈoʊzd ˈɪz wˈɪð jˈɔɹ pˈɑstʃɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: You want to focus on having a straight back,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈu wˈɑnt tˈu fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn hˈævɪŋ ə stɹˈeɪt bˈæk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: your chest slightly lifted, your head level, and your shoulders up, back, and down.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /jˈɔɹ tʃˈɛst slˈaɪtli lˈɪftəd jˈɔɹ hˈɛd lˈɛvəl ənd jˈɔɹ ʃˈoʊldɚz ˈʌp bˈæk ənd dˈaʊn/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: It's very simple, but we can often forget and easily switch back to slouching,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪts vˈɛɹi sˈɪmpəl bˈʌt wˈi kˈæn ˈɔfən fɚɡˈɛt ənd ˈizəli swˈɪtʃ bˈæk tˈu slˈaʊtʃɪŋ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: and this does wonders.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs dˈʌz wˈʌndɚz/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Whether you're sitting, you're standing, you're just how you move,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɛðɚ jˈʊɹ sˈɪtɪŋ jˈʊɹ stˈændɪŋ jˈʊɹ dʒˈʌst hˈaʊ jˈu mˈuv/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: whenever you catch yourself like
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wɛnˈɛvɚ jˈu kˈætʃ jɚsˈɛlf lˈaɪk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: this, all you have to do is gently bring yourself back into alignment.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɔl jˈu hˈæv tˈu dˈu ˈɪz dʒˈɛntli bɹˈɪŋ jɚsˈɛlf bˈæk ˈɪntu əlˈaɪnmənt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Good posture makes all the difference in terms of looking put together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ɡˈʊd pˈɑstʃɚ mˈeɪks ˈɔl ðə dˈɪfɚəns ɪn tˈɝmz ˈʌv lˈʊkɪŋ pˈʊt təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Even if the outfit you're wearing is somewhat basic
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf ðə ˈaʊtfˌɪt jˈʊɹ wˈɛɹɪŋ ˈɪz sˈʌmwˈʌt bˈeɪsɪk/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: or you don't have full glam makeup, it does help also to move slightly slower.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɔɹ jˈu dˈoʊnt hˈæv fˈʊl ɡlˈæm mˈeɪkˌʌp ˈɪt dˈʌz hˈɛlp ˈɔlsoʊ tˈu mˈuv slˈaɪtli slˈoʊɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: When I say slower, you don't actually have to move like a turtle,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈɛn ˈaɪ sˈeɪ slˈoʊɚ jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli hˈæv tˈu mˈuv lˈaɪk ə tˈɝtəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but especially if you're someone who's a little more anxious
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt əspˈɛʃli ˈɪf jˈʊɹ sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈuz ə lˈɪtəl mˈɔɹ ˈæŋkʃəs/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: or just want to come across as confident.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɔɹ dʒˈʌst wˈɑnt tˈu kˈʌm əkɹˈɔs ˈæz kˈɑnfədənt/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: One of the easiest ways is to move intentionally and not too frantically.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ˈiziəst wˈeɪz ˈɪz tˈu mˈuv ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli ənd nˈɑt tˈu fɹˈæntəkəli/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: If a person moves really frantically, then they not only make others around them uncomfortable,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ˈɪf ə pˈɝsən mˈuvz ɹˈɪli fɹˈæntəkəli ðˈɛn ðˈeɪ nˈɑt ˈoʊnli mˈeɪk ˈʌðɚz ɚˈaʊnd ðˈɛm ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: but it also signals to your own nervous system
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ sˈɪɡnəlz tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn nˈɝvəs sˈɪstəm/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: that you don't feel like things are together.
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt fˈil lˈaɪk θˈɪŋz ˈɑɹ təɡˈɛðɚ/

FHr_OxICTcg.text: Just by slowing things down slightly, doing things very intentionally by moving intentionally,
FHr_OxICTcg.ipa: /dʒˈʌst bˈaɪ slˈoʊɪŋ θˈɪŋz dˈaʊn slˈaɪtli dˈuɪŋ θˈɪŋz vˈɛɹi ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli bˈaɪ mˈuvɪŋ ˌɪntˈɛnʃənəli/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Mark Zuckerberg, a journalist was asking him a question about the news feed.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /mˈɑɹk zˈʌkɚbˌɝɡ ə dʒˈɝnələst wˈɑz ˈæskɪŋ hˈɪm ə kwˈɛstʃən əbˈaʊt ðə nˈuz fˈid/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Mark Zuckerberg, một nhà báo đang hỏi ông ấy một câu hỏi về bảng tin.

B8ofWFx525s.text: And the journalist was asking him, "Why is this so important"
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðə dʒˈɝnələst wˈɑz ˈæskɪŋ hˈɪm wˈaɪ ˈɪz ðˈɪs sˈoʊ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Và nhà báo hỏi ông ấy, "Tại sao điều này lại quan trọng đến vậy"

B8ofWFx525s.text: And Zuckerberg said, "A squirrel dying in your front yard may be more relevant
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd zˈʌkɚbˌɝɡ sˈɛd ə skwˈɝəl dˈaɪɪŋ ɪn jˈɔɹ fɹˈʌnt jˈɑɹd mˈeɪ bˈi mˈɔɹ ɹˈɛləvənt/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Và Zuckerberg nói: "Một con sóc chết trước sân nhà bạn có thể liên quan hơn

B8ofWFx525s.text: to your interests right now than people dying in Africa"
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /tˈu jˈɔɹ ˈɪntɹəsts ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ ðˈæn pˈipəl dˈaɪɪŋ ɪn ˈæfɹəkɑ/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: vào sở thích của bạn ngay bây giờ hơn là người chết ở châu Phi"

B8ofWFx525s.text: And I want to talk about what a Web based
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɑnt tˈu tˈɔk əbˈaʊt wˈʌt ə wˈɛb bˈeɪst/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Và tôi muốn nói về một cái dựa trên Web

B8ofWFx525s.text: on that idea of relevance might look like.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɑn ðˈæt aɪdˈiə ˈʌv ɹˈɛləvəns mˈaɪt lˈʊk lˈaɪk/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: ý tưởng về sự liên quan đó có thể trông như thế nào.

B8ofWFx525s.text: So when I was growing up in a really rural area in Maine,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈɛn ˈaɪ wˈɑz ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp ɪn ə ɹˈɪli ɹˈʊɹəl ˈɛɹiə ɪn mˈeɪn/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Vậy khi tôi lớn lên ở một vùng nông thôn hẻo lánh ở Maine,

B8ofWFx525s.text: the Internet meant something very different to me.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt mˈɛnt sˈʌmθɪŋ vˈɛɹi dˈɪfɚənt tˈu mˈi/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Internet có ý nghĩa rất khác đối với tôi.

B8ofWFx525s.text: It meant a connection to the world.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt mˈɛnt ə kənˈɛkʃən tˈu ðə wˈɝld/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Nó có nghĩa là một sự kết nối với thế giới.

B8ofWFx525s.text: It meant something that would connect us all together.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt mˈɛnt sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈʊd kənˈɛkt ˈʌs ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Nó có nghĩa là một điều gì đó sẽ kết nối tất cả chúng ta lại với nhau.

B8ofWFx525s.text: And I was sure that it was going to be great for democracy
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ wˈɑz ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ˈɪt wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu bˈi ɡɹˈeɪt fˈɔɹ dɪmˈɑkɹəsi/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Và tôi đã chắc chắn rằng điều đó sẽ rất tốt cho nền dân chủ

B8ofWFx525s.text: and for our society.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ səsˈaɪəti/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: và cho xã hội của chúng ta.

B8ofWFx525s.text: But there's this shift in how information is flowing online, and it's invisible.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈɛɹz ðˈɪs ʃˈɪft ɪn hˈaʊ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən ˈɪz flˈoʊɪŋ ˈɔnlˌaɪn ənd ˈɪts ˌɪnvˈɪzəbəl/
B8ofWFx525s.vietnamese_text: Nhưng có một sự thay đổi trong cách thông tin lan truyền trên mạng, và nó vô hình.

B8ofWFx525s.text: And if we don't pay attention to it, it could be a real problem.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈɪf wˈi dˈoʊnt pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃən tˈu ˈɪt ˈɪt kˈʊd bˈi ə ɹˈil pɹˈɑbləm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So I first noticed this in a place I spend a lot
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ fˈɝst nˈoʊtəst ðˈɪs ɪn ə plˈeɪs ˈaɪ spˈɛnd ə lˈɑt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: of time my Facebook page.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈʌv tˈaɪm mˈaɪ fˈeɪsbˌʊk pˈeɪdʒ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: I'm progressive, politically, big surprise, but I've always gone out of my way to meet conservatives.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈaɪm pɹəɡɹˈɛsɪv pəlˈɪtɪkəli bˈɪɡ sɚpɹˈaɪz bˈʌt ˈaɪv ˈɔlwˌeɪz ɡˈɔn ˈaʊt ˈʌv mˈaɪ wˈeɪ tˈu mˈit kənsˈɝvətɪvz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: I like hearing what they're thinking about; I like seeing
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈaɪ lˈaɪk hˈiɹɪŋ wˈʌt ðˈɛɹ θˈɪŋkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ˈaɪ lˈaɪk sˈiɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: what they link to; I like learning a thing or two.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ lˈɪŋk tˈu ˈaɪ lˈaɪk lˈɝnɪŋ ə θˈɪŋ ˈɔɹ tˈu/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And so I was surprised when I noticed one day
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ ˈaɪ wˈɑz sɚpɹˈaɪzd wˈɛn ˈaɪ nˈoʊtəst wˈʌn dˈeɪ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that the conservatives had disappeared from my Facebook feed.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə kənsˈɝvətɪvz hˈæd dˌɪsəpˈɪɹd fɹˈʌm mˈaɪ fˈeɪsbˌʊk fˈid/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And what it turned out was going
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt ˈɪt tˈɝnd ˈaʊt wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: on was that Facebook was looking at which links I clicked
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɑn wˈɑz ðˈæt fˈeɪsbˌʊk wˈɑz lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt wˈɪtʃ lˈɪŋks ˈaɪ klˈɪkt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: on, and it was noticing that, actually,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɑn ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz nˈoʊtɪsɪŋ ðˈæt ˈæktʃˌuəli/

B8ofWFx525s.text: I was clicking more on my liberal friends' links than on my conservative friends' links.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑz klˈɪkɪŋ mˈɔɹ ˈɑn mˈaɪ lˈɪbˌɝəl fɹˈɛndz lˈɪŋks ðˈæn ˈɑn mˈaɪ kənsˈɝvətɪv fɹˈɛndz lˈɪŋks/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And without consulting me about it, it had edited them out. They disappeared.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wɪθˈaʊt kənsˈʌltɪŋ mˈi əbˈaʊt ˈɪt ˈɪt hˈæd ˈɛdətəd ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ðˈeɪ dˌɪsəpˈɪɹd/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So Facebook isn't the only place that's doing this kind of invisible,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ fˈeɪsbˌʊk ˈɪzənt ðə ˈoʊnli plˈeɪs ðˈæts dˈuɪŋ ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ˌɪnvˈɪzəbəl/

B8ofWFx525s.text: algorithmic editing of the Web.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk ˈɛdətɪŋ ˈʌv ðə wˈɛb/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Google's doing it too.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɡˈuɡəlz dˈuɪŋ ˈɪt tˈu/

B8ofWFx525s.text: If I search for something, and you search for something,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪf ˈaɪ sˈɝtʃ fˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ ənd jˈu sˈɝtʃ fˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: even right now at the very same time, we may get very different search results.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈivɪn ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ ˈæt ðə vˈɛɹi sˈeɪm tˈaɪm wˈi mˈeɪ ɡˈɛt vˈɛɹi dˈɪfɚənt sˈɝtʃ ɹɪzˈʌlts/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Even if you're logged out, one engineer told me,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈivɪn ˈɪf jˈʊɹ lˈɔɡd ˈaʊt wˈʌn ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹ tˈoʊld mˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: there are 57 signals that Google looks at everything
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ 57 sˈɪɡnəlz ðˈæt ɡˈuɡəl lˈʊks ˈæt ˈɛvɹiθˌɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: from what kind of computer you're
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /fɹˈʌm wˈʌt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv kəmpjˈutɚ jˈʊɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: on to what kind of browser you're using to where you're located
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɑn tˈu wˈʌt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bɹˈaʊzɚ jˈʊɹ jˈuzɪŋ tˈu wˈɛɹ jˈʊɹ lˈoʊkˌeɪtəd/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that it uses to personally tailor your query results.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt jˈusəz tˈu pˈɝsənəli tˈeɪlɚ jˈɔɹ kwˈiɹi ɹɪzˈʌlts/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Think about it for a second: there is no standard Google anymore.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ˈɪt fˈɔɹ ə sˈɛkənd ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz nˈoʊ stˈændɚd ɡˈuɡəl ˌɛnimˈɔɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And you know, the funny thing about this is that it's hard to see.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd jˈu nˈoʊ ðə fˈʌni θˈɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðˈæt ˈɪts hˈɑɹd tˈu sˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: You can't see how different your search results are.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /jˈu kˈænt sˈi hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt jˈɔɹ sˈɝtʃ ɹɪzˈʌlts ˈɑɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: From anyone else's.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /fɹˈʌm ˈɛniwˌʌn ˈɛlsɪz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: But a couple of weeks ago, I asked a bunch of friends to Google "Egypt"
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt ə kˈʌpəl ˈʌv wˈiks əɡˈoʊ ˈaɪ ˈæskt ə bˈʌntʃ ˈʌv fɹˈɛndz tˈu ɡˈuɡəl ˈidʒəpt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and to send me screen shots of what they got.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd tˈu sˈɛnd mˈi skɹˈin ʃˈɑts ˈʌv wˈʌt ðˈeɪ ɡˈɑt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So here's my friend Scott's screen shot, and here's my friend Daniel's screen shot.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈɪɹz mˈaɪ fɹˈɛnd skˈɑts skɹˈin ʃˈɑt ənd hˈɪɹz mˈaɪ fɹˈɛnd dˈænjəlz skɹˈin ʃˈɑt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: When you put them side-by-side, you don't even have to read the links to see
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈɛn jˈu pˈʊt ðˈɛm sidebyside jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈivɪn hˈæv tˈu ɹˈɛd ðə lˈɪŋks tˈu sˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: how different these two pages are.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt ðˈiz tˈu pˈeɪdʒəz ˈɑɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: But when you do read the links, it's really quite remarkable.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈɛn jˈu dˈu ɹˈɛd ðə lˈɪŋks ˈɪts ɹˈɪli kwˈaɪt ɹɪmˈɑɹkəbəl/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Daniel didn't get anything about the protests in Egypt at all in his first page
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /dˈænjəl dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ˈɛniθˌɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðə pɹˈoʊtˌɛsts ɪn ˈidʒəpt ˈæt ˈɔl ɪn hˈɪz fˈɝst pˈeɪdʒ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: of Google results Scott's results were full of them,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈʌv ɡˈuɡəl ɹɪzˈʌlts skˈɑts ɹɪzˈʌlts wˈɝ fˈʊl ˈʌv ðˈɛm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and this was the big story of the day at that time.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs wˈɑz ðə bˈɪɡ stˈɔɹi ˈʌv ðə dˈeɪ ˈæt ðˈæt tˈaɪm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: That's how different these results are becoming.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæts hˈaʊ dˈɪfɚənt ðˈiz ɹɪzˈʌlts ˈɑɹ bɪkˈʌmɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So it's not just Google and Facebook either.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪts nˈɑt dʒˈʌst ɡˈuɡəl ənd fˈeɪsbˌʊk ˈiðɚ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: This is something that's sweeping the web.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæts swˈipɪŋ ðə wˈɛb/

B8ofWFx525s.text: There are a whole host of companies
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ə hˈoʊl hˈoʊst ˈʌv kˈʌmpənˌiz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that are doing this kind of personalization Yahoo News,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ dˈuɪŋ ðˈɪs kˈaɪnd ˈʌv pˌɝsənələzˈeɪʃən jˈɑhˌu nˈuz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: the biggest news site on the Internet,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðə bˈɪɡəst nˈuz sˈaɪt ˈɑn ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: is now personalized different people get different things Huffington Post,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪz nˈaʊ pˈɝsənəlˌaɪzd dˈɪfɚənt pˈipəl ɡˈɛt dˈɪfɚənt θˈɪŋz hˈʌfɪŋtən pˈoʊst/

B8ofWFx525s.text: the Washington Post, the New York Times all flirting with personalization in various ways.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðə wˈɑʃɪŋtən pˈoʊst ðə nˈu jˈɔɹk tˈaɪmz ˈɔl flˈɝtɪŋ wˈɪð pˌɝsənələzˈeɪʃən ɪn vˈɛɹiəs wˈeɪz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And this moves us very quickly toward a world
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs mˈuvz ˈʌs vˈɛɹi kwˈɪkli təwˈɔɹd ə wˈɝld/

B8ofWFx525s.text: in which the Internet is showing us what it thinks we want to see,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɪn wˈɪtʃ ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ˈɪz ʃˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌs wˈʌt ˈɪt θˈɪŋks wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu sˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: but not necessarily what we need to see.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt nˈɑt nˌɛsəsˈɛɹəli wˈʌt wˈi nˈid tˈu sˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: As Eric Schmidt said, "It will be very hard for people to watch
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈæz ˈɛɹɪk ʃmˈɪt sˈɛd ˈɪt wˈɪl bˈi vˈɛɹi hˈɑɹd fˈɔɹ pˈipəl tˈu wˈɑtʃ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: or consume something that has not, in some sense, been tailored for them."
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɔɹ kənsˈum sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt hˈæz nˈɑt ɪn sˈʌm sˈɛns bˈɪn tˈeɪlɚd fˈɔɹ ðˈɛm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So I do think this is a problem, and I think,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ dˈu θˈɪŋk ðˈɪs ˈɪz ə pɹˈɑbləm ənd ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk/

B8ofWFx525s.text: if you take all of these filters together, you take all these algorithms,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu tˈeɪk ˈɔl ˈʌv ðˈiz fˈɪltɚz təɡˈɛðɚ jˈu tˈeɪk ˈɔl ðˈiz ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: you get what I call a filter bubble.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /jˈu ɡˈɛt wˈʌt ˈaɪ kˈɔl ə fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And Your filter bubble is your own personal, unique universe of information
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd jˈɔɹ fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl ˈɪz jˈɔɹ ˈoʊn pˈɝsɪnəl junˈik jˈunəvˌɝs ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that you live in online, and what's in your filter bubble depends
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt jˈu lˈaɪv ɪn ˈɔnlˌaɪn ənd wˈʌts ɪn jˈɔɹ fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl dɪpˈɛndz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: on who you are and it depends on what you do.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɑn hˈu jˈu ˈɑɹ ənd ˈɪt dɪpˈɛndz ˈɑn wˈʌt jˈu dˈu/

B8ofWFx525s.text: But the thing is that you don't decide what gets
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt jˈu dˈoʊnt dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt ɡˈɛts/

B8ofWFx525s.text: in, and more importantly, you don't actually see what gets edited out.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɪn ənd mˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtəntli jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli sˈi wˈʌt ɡˈɛts ˈɛdətəd ˈaʊt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So one of the problems with the filter bubble was discovered by some researchers at Netflix,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə pɹˈɑbləmz wˈɪð ðə fˈɪltɚ bˈʌbəl wˈɑz dɪskˈʌvɚd bˈaɪ sˈʌm ɹˈisɚtʃɚz ˈæt nˈɛtflɪks/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and they were looking at the Netflix queues
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ wˈɝ lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt ðə nˈɛtflɪks kjˈuz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and they noticed something kind of funny that a lot of us probably have noticed,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ nˈoʊtəst sˈʌmθɪŋ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv fˈʌni ðˈæt ə lˈɑt ˈʌv ˈʌs pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈæv nˈoʊtəst/

B8ofWFx525s.text: which is there are some movies that just sort of zip right up
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ sˈʌm mˈuviz ðˈæt dʒˈʌst sˈɔɹt ˈʌv zˈɪp ɹˈaɪt ˈʌp/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and out to our houses.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈaʊt tˈu ˈaʊɚ hˈaʊsəz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: They enter the queue they just zip right out.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈeɪ ˈɛntɚ ðə kjˈu ðˈeɪ dʒˈʌst zˈɪp ɹˈaɪt ˈaʊt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So "Iron Man" zips right out.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪɚn mˈæn zˈɪps ɹˈaɪt ˈaʊt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And "Waiting for Superman" can wait for a really long time.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wˈeɪtɪŋ fˈɔɹ sˈupɚmən kˈæn wˈeɪt fˈɔɹ ə ɹˈɪli lˈɔŋ tˈaɪm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: What they discovered was that in our Netflix queues
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈeɪ dɪskˈʌvɚd wˈɑz ðˈæt ɪn ˈaʊɚ nˈɛtflɪks kjˈuz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: there's this epic struggle going on between our future aspirational selves
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɛɹz ðˈɪs ˈɛpɪk stɹˈʌɡəl ɡˈoʊɪŋ ˈɑn bɪtwˈin ˈaʊɚ fjˈutʃɚ aspirational sˈɛlvz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and our more impulsive present selves.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈaʊɚ mˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈʌlsɪv pɹˈɛzənt sˈɛlvz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: You know, we all want to be someone who has watched "Rashomon,"
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ wˈi ˈɔl wˈɑnt tˈu bˈi sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu hˈæz wˈɑtʃt rashomon/

B8ofWFx525s.text: but right now we want to watch "Ace Ventura" for the fourth time.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu wˈɑtʃ ˈeɪs vɛntʃˈɝə fˈɔɹ ðə fˈɔɹθ tˈaɪm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: (Laughter) So the best editing gives us a bit of both.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /lˈæftɚ sˈoʊ ðə bˈɛst ˈɛdətɪŋ ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə bˈɪt ˈʌv bˈoʊθ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: It gives us a little bit of Justin Bieber and a little bit of Afghanistan.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv dʒˈʌstən bˈibɚ ənd ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv æfɡˈænəstˌæn/

B8ofWFx525s.text: It gives us some information vegetables; it gives us some information dessert.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən vˈɛdʒtəbəlz ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dɪzˈɝt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And the challenge with these kinds of algorithmic filters, these personalized filters,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðə tʃˈæləndʒ wˈɪð ðˈiz kˈaɪndz ˈʌv ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk fˈɪltɚz ðˈiz pˈɝsənəlˌaɪzd fˈɪltɚz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: is that, because they're mainly looking at what you click on first,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪz ðˈæt bɪkˈɔz ðˈɛɹ mˈeɪnli lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt wˈʌt jˈu klˈɪk ˈɑn fˈɝst/

B8ofWFx525s.text: it can throw off that balance.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt kˈæn θɹˈoʊ ˈɔf ðˈæt bˈæləns/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And instead of a balanced information diet, you can end up surrounded by information junk food.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv ə bˈælənst ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dˈaɪət jˈu kˈæn ˈɛnd ˈʌp sɚˈaʊndɪd bˈaɪ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dʒˈʌŋk fˈud/

B8ofWFx525s.text: What this suggests is actually that we may have the story about the Internet wrong.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈɪs sədʒˈɛsts ˈɪz ˈæktʃˌuəli ðˈæt wˈi mˈeɪ hˈæv ðə stˈɔɹi əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ɹˈɔŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: In a broadcast society this is how the founding mythology goes in a broadcast society,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti ðˈɪs ˈɪz hˈaʊ ðə fˈaʊndɪŋ məθˈɑlədʒˌi ɡˈoʊz ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti/

B8ofWFx525s.text: there were these gatekeepers, the editors, and they controlled the flows of information.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɝ ðˈiz ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz ənd ðˈeɪ kəntɹˈoʊld ðə flˈoʊz ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And along came the Internet and it swept them out of the way,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd əlˈɔŋ kˈeɪm ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ənd ˈɪt swˈɛpt ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə wˈeɪ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and it allowed all of us to connect together, and it was awesome.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ˈɪt əlˈaʊd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈʌs tˈu kənˈɛkt təɡˈɛðɚ ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz ˈɑsəm/

B8ofWFx525s.text: But that's not actually what's happening right now.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈæts nˈɑt ˈæktʃˌuəli wˈʌts hˈæpənɪŋ ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: What we're seeing is more of a passing of the torch from human
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈʌt wˈiɹ sˈiɪŋ ˈɪz mˈɔɹ ˈʌv ə pˈæsɪŋ ˈʌv ðə tˈɔɹtʃ fɹˈʌm hjˈumən/

B8ofWFx525s.text: gatekeepers to algorithmic ones.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk wˈʌnz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And the thing is that the algorithms don't yet have the kind of embedded ethics
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt ðə ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz dˈoʊnt jˈɛt hˈæv ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɛmbˈɛdɪd ˈɛθɪks/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that the editors did.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz dˈɪd/

B8ofWFx525s.text: So if algorithms are going to curate the world for us,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz ˈɑɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kjˈʊɹət ðə wˈɝld fˈɔɹ ˈʌs/

B8ofWFx525s.text: if they're going to decide what we get to see
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt wˈi ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and what we don't get to see, then we need to make sure
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wˈʌt wˈi dˈoʊnt ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi ðˈɛn wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that they're not just keyed to relevance.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ nˈɑt dʒˈʌst kˈid tˈu ɹˈɛləvəns/

B8ofWFx525s.text: We need to make sure that they also show us things
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ʃˈoʊ ˈʌs θˈɪŋz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that are uncomfortable or challenging or important.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl ˈɔɹ tʃˈæləndʒɪŋ ˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: This is what TED does other points of view.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌt tˈɛd dˈʌz ˈʌðɚ pˈɔɪnts ˈʌv vjˈu/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And the thing is, we've actually been here before as a society.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz wˈiv ˈæktʃˌuəli bˈɪn hˈiɹ bɪfˈɔɹ ˈæz ə səsˈaɪəti/

B8ofWFx525s.text: In 1915, it's not like newspapers were sweating a lot about their civic responsibilities.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ɪn 1915 ˈɪts nˈɑt lˈaɪk nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ swˈɛtɪŋ ə lˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðˈɛɹ sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪlətiz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Then people noticed that they were doing something really important
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈɛn pˈipəl nˈoʊtəst ðˈæt ðˈeɪ wˈɝ dˈuɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that, in fact, you couldn't have a functioning democracy
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ɪn fˈækt jˈu kˈʊdənt hˈæv ə fˈʌŋkʃənɪŋ dɪmˈɑkɹəsi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: if citizens didn't get a good flow of information,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪf sˈɪtəzənz dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ə ɡˈʊd flˈoʊ ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that the newspapers were critical because they were acting as the filter,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ðə nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ kɹˈɪtɪkəl bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ˈæktɪŋ ˈæz ðə fˈɪltɚ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and then journalistic ethics developed.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dʒˌɝnəlˈɪstɪk ˈɛθɪks dɪvˈɛləpt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: It wasn't perfect, but it got us through the last century.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑzənt pɚfˈɛkt bˈʌt ˈɪt ɡˈɑt ˈʌs θɹˈu ðə lˈæst sˈɛntʃɚi/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And so now, we're kind of back in 1915 on the Web.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ nˈaʊ wˈiɹ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bˈæk ɪn 1915 ˈɑn ðə wˈɛb/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And we need the new gatekeepers to encode
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid ðə nˈu ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ɛnkˈoʊd/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that kind of responsibility into the code that they're writing.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti ˈɪntu ðə kˈoʊd ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: I know that there are a lot of people here from Facebook
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl hˈiɹ fɹˈʌm fˈeɪsbˌʊk/

B8ofWFx525s.text: and from Google Larry and Sergey people who have helped build the Web
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd fɹˈʌm ɡˈuɡəl lˈɛɹi ənd sˈɛɹdʒi pˈipəl hˈu hˈæv hˈɛlpt bˈɪld ðə wˈɛb/

B8ofWFx525s.text: as it is, and I'm grateful for that.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ˈæz ˈɪt ˈɪz ənd ˈaɪm ɡɹˈeɪtfəl fˈɔɹ ðˈæt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: But we really need you to make sure
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bˈʌt wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that these algorithms have encoded in them a sense of the public life,
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈiz ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz hˈæv ɛnkˈoʊdɪd ɪn ðˈɛm ə sˈɛns ˈʌv ðə pˈʌblɪk lˈaɪf/

B8ofWFx525s.text: a sense of civic responsibility.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ə sˈɛns ˈʌv sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti/

B8ofWFx525s.text: We need you to make sure that they're transparent enough
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ tɹænspˈɛɹənt ɪnˈʌf/

B8ofWFx525s.text: that we can see what the rules are that determine what gets through our filters.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn sˈi wˈʌt ðə ɹˈulz ˈɑɹ ðˈæt dətˈɝmən wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ˈaʊɚ fˈɪltɚz/

B8ofWFx525s.text: And we need you to give us some control
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu ɡˈɪv ˈʌs sˈʌm kəntɹˈoʊl/

B8ofWFx525s.text: so that we can decide what gets through and what doesn't.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ənd wˈʌt dˈʌzənt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: Because I think we really need the Internet
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/

B8ofWFx525s.text: to be that thing that we all dreamed of it being.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /tˈu bˈi ðˈæt θˈɪŋ ðˈæt wˈi ˈɔl dɹˈimd ˈʌv ˈɪt bˈiɪŋ/

B8ofWFx525s.text: We need it to connect us all together.
B8ofWFx525s.ipa: /wˈi nˈid ˈɪt tˈu kənˈɛkt ˈʌs ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ/
